Entries.Title: Gachiakuta
Entries.Description: In a floating city where the rich discard their waste—and people—Rudo is framed for murder and thrown into the Pit, where a hellscape of mutated garbage beasts dwell. To survive, he must wield a new power and join the rogue Cleaners. Rudo doesn’t just aim to battle monsters, but the corrupt who cast him into Hell.

Episodes.Title: The Sphere
Episodes.Description: Bullied outcast Rudo finds respite in repurposing trash, until a terrible tragedy changes his life forever.

Episodes.Title: The Inhabited
Episodes.Description: Cast into the Pit, Rudo is saved by the mysterious Enjin who may not have his best interests at heart.

Episodes.Title: The Ground
Episodes.Description: Enjin is a Giver, a being who can give life to things and draw out their power. Ludo, who has also awakened to his power as a Giver, is scouted by Enjin to join an organization called the Cleaners, which fights against the Spotted Beasts born from garbage. Ludo accepts the offer in order to find a way to return to the Heavenly World where he has lived until now, but he suddenly gets into a fight with his trainer, Zanca.

Episodes.Title: Cleaner HQ
Episodes.Description: After being introduced to Cleaner HQ, Rudo follows Riyo on a job to learn the business.

Episodes.Title: Raiders
Episodes.Description: The Cleaners go on a job to save another Sphereite who survived the fall. Rudo tags along to learn more.

Episodes.Title: One Good Strike!!
Episodes.Description: With the job having gone terribly wrong, Rudo finds himself face to face with a merciless Raider named Jabber.

Episodes.Title: A Score to Settle
Episodes.Description: Jabber employs a new strategy to get through Rudo's defenses, and another ally joins the fray.

Episodes.Title: Moving Forward
Episodes.Description: Rudo deals with the emotional aftermath of the Jabber fight and gets a new lead about returning to the Sphere.

Episodes.Title: The City of Graffiti
Episodes.Description: To get a "spell" for their next mission, the Cleaners head to Canvas Town, where they make a tragic discovery.

Entries.Title: Nukitashi the Animation
Entries.Description: On Seiran Island, secret society NLNS is united by Junnosuke Tachibana, who is determined to crush a law. They have found a benefactor, an unknown rich man, who offers them a secret base and cash. Their mission is to locate a mysterious girl and stop the law, keeping the SHO off their trail.

Episodes.Title: Pervert Law
Episodes.Description: Seiran Island, the land of paradise, aka the land of filthy debauchery, where any sexual acts are permitted and enforced by the Pervert Law. Junnosuke, a transfer, is a virgin with pride who despises sex with no love. However, sex is a duty of the island residents! Virginity is a serious crime!! All those who refuse sex will get guillotined by the Future Seiran Homeland Organization (or FS)!!! Junnosuke decides to protect his virginity with his dear life, evading all perverts along with his young virgin sister, Asane. However, they run into Nanase Katagiri, the school's legendary virgin hunter #$%!*...!

Episodes.Title: Savior
Episodes.Description: Item creation to outsmart the FS, securing every escape route, and Nanase's home cooking that achieves perfect nutrition. With Nanase as their ally, Junnosuke and Masane begin their plan to destroy the perverted ordinance. And on Seiran Island, there were other girls besides them who were also struggling! Hinami Watarai, a virgin who is never propositioned for sex by anyone due to her youthful appearance! Azumi Misaki, a virgin with a terrifying libido, but who doesn't want to show her plump body to others! One day, a major incident befalls Hinami!?

Episodes.Title: Pop-up Shower
Episodes.Description: To protect Hinami from the “Preschooler Man,” Junnosuke proudly declares himself part of the Anti-Copulation Force. However, despite appearances, Hinami turned out to be a full-fledged adult!! In the end, Junnosuke and his group had unwittingly sabotaged her chance at sex. Naturally, the sinister hand of FS draws near! He gives everything he’s got to flee, but after exhausting all his weapons, he finds himself in a desperate, do-or-die chastity crisis!! Just when all hope seems lost, a terrifying long-range sniper shot from a girl in a kimono saves Junnosuke from the brink!? And to make matters even more chaotic—Misaki, having heard the commotion, rushes to the scene...!!

Episodes.Title: Romp Day
Episodes.Description: Student Council President Touka Reizeiin declares the opening of the lewdest festival of all—“Athletic Cumpetition”! Seizing the opportunity, Junnosuke and his team plan a covert infiltration of the student council room to steal intel on "Fumino Kotoyose." But the lewd festival is no joke! Erotic competition! Erotic competition!! Erotic competition!!! Barely managing to cling to his virginity, Junnosuke presses on toward his true objective: the student council room. But waiting for him there is Misaki—making an epic anal contraction...!?

Episodes.Title: Anti-Copulation Front
Episodes.Description: It’s been decided—Governor Hitoura will be giving a speech at Lewd Land. Determined to take him down, Fumino heads there with Misaki at her side. Meanwhile, backed by a mysterious benefactor, Junnosuke and his team clutch their brand-new weapons and set off for Lewd Land in search of Fumino. Misaki slips past FS’s ironclad security and goes full throttle through Lewd Land on a pleasure bicycle! Junnosuke and the others join the fray, unleashing total chaos!! But just when they think they’ve got the upper hand, the deadliest lewd assassin appears… and the greatest virgin crisis in history begins—!?

Episodes.Title: Bang Away
Episodes.Description: The NLNS succeeds in saving Fumino and Misaki, but at a huge sacrifice. Junnosuke has lost his virginity forever... That's not to say he had pervert sex with the love of his life! Pulling himself together, he welcomes the new members on his team! Meanwhile, the Future SHO also starts recruiting new members to go up against the Anti-Copulation Force. Junnosuke takes this opportunity to sneak into the Future SHO, but what awaits him after enrollment is a training so terrifying that it makes his pubes crawl—!

Episodes.Title: Cumming-of-Age Day
Episodes.Description: Junnosuke, now an official member of the Future SHO, receives an order from his benefactor that Fumino will be handed over on the Cumming-Of-Age Day. The NLNS devise a plan towards the big day, while the Future SHO have successfully created a clone of the Anti-Copulation Force leader's cock via Ikuko's vagina! Amidst all this, Junnosuke gets promoted as the school president, Touka Reizeiin's personal assistant!! But upon spending time with the Future SHO and sharing conversations between them, he comes to realize that they too, have firm beliefs of their own...

Episodes.Title: Cumpanion
Episodes.Description: After developing a soft spot for the Future SHO, Junnosuke aborts the operation, and they fail to hand over Fumino to their benefactor by the end of Cumming-Of-Age Day. Ashamed of the trouble he caused, he resigns from the Future SHO, and returns to the NLNS base with no strategy in mind. His benefactor gives him a final warning, "If you fail to hand over Fumino again, I will cut off all support". The Future SHO also begins posting wanted posters of Junnosuke's cock around town. Junnosuke is overcome with guilt, believing everything is his fault. Unable to see him like that, Nanase reaches out to him...

Entries.Title: SAKAMOTO DAYS
Entries.Description: Once the greatest hitman of all, Taro Sakamoto retired in the name of love. But when his past catches up, he must fight to protect his beloved family.

Episodes.Title: The Legendary Hit Man
Episodes.Description: Sakamoto enjoys a quiet life in retirement with his family. But one day, an old colleague demands he return to the assassin world — or face consequences.

Episodes.Title: Vs. Son Hee and Bacho
Episodes.Description: While out on an errand, Sakamoto and Shin encounter Lu Shaotang, the daughter of a mafia boss, who's on the run and targeted by twin assassins.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Sugar Park
Episodes.Description: After learning of the huge bounty on Sakamoto's head, the crew tries to enjoy a family outing at the amusement park while fending off assassins.

Episodes.Title: Hard-Boiled
Episodes.Description: With the poison-wielding hitman taken out, the Sakamotos head to their next attraction, where they're ambushed by Dondenkai Ltd's ultimate assassin duo.

Episodes.Title: Source of Strength
Episodes.Description: Sakamoto goes all out in a fierce one-on-one duel with Boiled. Meanwhile, ORDER members are tasked with handling a serial case targeting assassins.

Episodes.Title: Heisuke Mashimo
Episodes.Description: Hoping to win the million-yen prize, Team Sakamoto enters the shopping district's survival tournament and teams up with a completely clueless sniper.

Episodes.Title: Jurassic Bastard
Episodes.Description: While manning the store alone, Lu gets kidnapped by a mysterious group. Sakamoto and Shin pursue her but are halted by an invisible assassin.

Episodes.Title: Sakamoto's vs. the Lab
Episodes.Description: To rescue Lu, Sakamoto and Shin infiltrate a top-secret lab seized by assassins. Meanwhile, in the prison cell, Lu meets someone from Shin's childhood.

Episodes.Title: All Aboard
Episodes.Description: In the depths of the Lab, Shin and Heisuke join forces to take down the invisible assailant, while Sakamoto engages in an intense battle against Kashima.

Episodes.Title: Bathhouse Roughhouse
Episodes.Description: Exhausted from their battle, the crew heads to a local bathhouse but finds it too dangerous to relax. Later, a mysterious man arrives in search of Lu.

Episodes.Title: Casino Battle
Episodes.Description: The crew faces Wutang in a high-stakes casino showdown to learn who issued Sakamoto's bounty. Meanwhile, X sends a group of vicious assassins their way

Episodes.Title: Overload
Episodes.Description: As Sakamoto gathers intel on the assassins targeting him, ORDER begins hunting the death row inmates. Later, Shin and Lu face a deadly assault.

Episodes.Title: Just Desserts
Episodes.Description: Saw's attacks push Shin and Lu to awaken new abilities, turning the tables on the deadly killer. Meanwhile, Dump ambushes Osaragi at a temple.

Episodes.Title: Strong Assault
Episodes.Description: The battles rage on even as the crew gets treated by Granny Miya! Minimalist threatens Aoi at the store while Heisuke clashes with Apart at Tokyo Tower.

Episodes.Title: Round and Round the Tower
Episodes.Description: Deadly battles with death row inmates break out everywhere! The Minimalist who attacked the Sakamoto Store is defeated by Nagumo of ORDER, disguised as Aoi, leaving only Apart as the only death row inmate remaining.

Episodes.Title: Slice Slice Dance
Episodes.Description: While X and Gaku invade the JAA, a lone ORDER assassin stands in their way. Amid the chaos, Sakamoto discovers the shocking truth about X's identity.

Episodes.Title: Have a Nice Flight
Episodes.Description: After facing Takamura, X and his men temporarily retreat from the devastated JAA Kanto Branch and begin a new plan. Meanwhile, Sakamoto learns that X is his former JCC classmate, Uzuki. Advised by Hyo, Sakamoto and Shin board a plane to take the JCC transfer exam and search for clues in the JCC data bank.

Episodes.Title: Kanaguri
Episodes.Description: It's every assassin for themselves as the exam takes to the skies. While Sakamoto impresses fellow candidate Akira, Shin takes on the germaphobe Mafuyu.

Episodes.Title: Exam, Stage Three
Episodes.Description: Stage Three of the JCC exams begins as a trio of special applicants joins the fray. Toramaru, a devoted Sakamoto fan, immediately clashes with Shin.

Episodes.Title: Mutual Fans
Episodes.Description: Sakamoto discovers Akira's ties to an old friend. While Shin and Toramaru vie over their favorite assassin, X's secret plans throw the exam into chaos.

Episodes.Title: Hard Mode
Episodes.Description: Shin teams up with Mafuyu, Toramaru and Kaji to take down a berserk Shinaya. Can these ragtag new allies work together to defeat their rampaging foe?

Entries.Title: The Fragrant Flower Blooms with Dignity
Entries.Description: When the intimidating Rintaro meets the open-minded Kaoruko, the unlikely duo grows closer. The issue? Their neighboring high schools hate each other.

Episodes.Title: Rintaro and Kaoruko
Episodes.Description: While helping at his family's patisserie, Rintaro meets Kaoruko. He fears his appearance has scared her off — but she returns the next day to see him.

Episodes.Title: Chidori and Kikyo
Episodes.Description: Tensions between the two schools escalate during a commotion at Chidori's gates. Later, Rintaro finds a surprise visitor waiting at the patisserie.

Episodes.Title: A Kind Person
Episodes.Description: Desperate to improve their grades, Rintaro and Shohei cram in the library. There, Rintaro runs into Kaoruko, but their tender moment gets interrupted.

Episodes.Title: Warmth of the Heart
Episodes.Description: Though Rintaro becomes more comfortable with Kaoruko during their study session, he faces unexpectedly strong opposition to their growing bond.

Episodes.Title: Premonition of a New Beginning
Episodes.Description: Pressure mounts as Rintaro's friends discover a note from Kaoruko hidden in his notebook. Saku's frustration towards Rintaro's reticence grows.

Episodes.Title: Self-Loathing / I Love You!
Episodes.Description: It's an important night of confessions, apologies and cherished memories when Subaru and Kaoruko catch up at the park where they used to play as kids.

Episodes.Title: Coolest Guy Ever
Episodes.Description: Noticing Rintaro's strange behavior, Shohei, Saku and Ayato follow him after school and try to eavesdrop on his meeting with Kaoruko and Subaru.

Episodes.Title: The Meaning of These Feelings
Episodes.Description: Despite the awkwardness, Rintaro manages to introduce his friends to the girls. Later, Kaoruko makes a bold suggestion on how Rintaro could repay her.

Episodes.Title: Blond Hair and Pierced Ears
Episodes.Description: While Rintaro struggles with his tangled emotions about Kaoruko, he invites his friends over to his home — but two unexpected visitors shake things up.

Episodes.Title: Summer Storm
Episodes.Description: To prepare for their finals, the six Chidori and Kikyo students hold a joint study session. Later, Shohei makes a sharp observation about Rintaro.

Entries.Title: Lord of Mysteries
Entries.Description: In a Victorian world of steam, dreadnoughts, and occult horrors, Zhou Mingrui awakens as Klein Moretti. He walks a razor’s edge between light and darkness, entangled with warring Churches. This is the legend of unlimited potential…and unspeakable danger.

Episodes.Title: The Fool
Episodes.Description: Zhou Mingrui wakes up in the body of Klein Moretti. A strange notebook holds the key to a dark power.

Episodes.Title: Beyonder
Episodes.Description: Klein Moretti joins the Nighthawks and heads off on his first task to find an abducted child.

Episodes.Title: The Notebook
Episodes.Description: Klein Moretti pursues the Antigonus Family's notebook and faces off against another Beyonder.

Episodes.Title: Magic Mirror
Episodes.Description: Klein Moretti learns ritualistic magic from Old Neil. Meanwhile, an organization has their eyes on Klein.

Episodes.Title: Hero
Episodes.Description: A tragedy befalls a passenger ship and Klein Moretti is tasked with solving the mystery.

Episodes.Title: Teacher
Episodes.Description: Klein Moretti discovers an ancient secret about his teacher, Azik Eggers.

Episodes.Title: Coincidence
Episodes.Description: When too many coincidences appear, Klein Moretti discovers he may be caught in an elaborate scheme.

Episodes.Title: Losing Control
Episodes.Description: Klein Moretti is on a mission, and the most dreaded fate that could happen to a Beyonder becomes reality.

Episodes.Title: Party
Episodes.Description: Klein succeeds in ascending to Sequence 8, but this glorious moment is overshadowed by an event.

Episodes.Title: Clue
Episodes.Description: Dunn and Klein attend the scene of a possibly supernatural murder of a congressman.

Episodes.Title: Mastermind
Episodes.Description: Following Klein's suspicions, the Nighthawk investigates what Sharon Khoy is hiding.

Episodes.Title: The Bomb
Episodes.Description: Lanevus threatens to destroy Tingen, putting the Nighthawks in check.

Entries.Title: The Share House's Secret Rule
Entries.Description: After entering university, Ryota moves into a share house where he meets two stunningly beautiful sharemates, Momoka and Kanade. As the three of them begin to cohabitate together, they agree on one "secret rule." "If it's just for a minute, you can touch whatever you want." Thus begins Ryota's new life at the share house, where sweet temptation lies behind every door...!

Episodes.Title: My roommates are way too cute
Episodes.Description: After Ryota moves into a share house, he finds himself living with two gorgeous housemates. At first, it seems like a dream come true, but he soon discovers that the two girls are incredibly lazy! Ryota’s patience quickly runs out, and decides to leave. But before he can go, the two make him an intriguing offer: “How about a new rule? For every chore you do, you get to touch us for one minute…”

Episodes.Title: Come on... Touch me
Episodes.Description: Taking advantage of the "Touch Points" system his roommates suggested, Ryota and Momoka begin to get a bit closer. But after things go a little too far, the atmosphere between them turns awkward. Has Kanade noticed what’s going on? Either way, she doesn’t hold back—leaning in as Ryota massages her shoulders, she whispers, “Come on... touch me. For one minute, you can do whatever you want…”

Episodes.Title: I’ll do it for you...
Episodes.Description: Ryota uses his "Touch Points" with Kanade, and before he knows it, the two of them start getting hot and heavy... Given the recent developments, Ryota feels the dynamic with his two beautiful roommates shifting. Just then, Momoka decides it’s time to join in on the housework, declaring, “I have points from housework too... Now I'll do it for you…”

Episodes.Title: I'm just working out...!
Episodes.Description: After things heat up between Momoka and Ryota, she starts to feel embarrassed and begins avoiding him around the house. Ryota then hears a loud noise at the entrance—it’s Kanade, stumbling in, clearly drunk! With no other choice, Ryota helps her to her room. But as they reach her bed, Kanade, still tipsy, looks up at him and pleads, “Hey… you’ve still got some Touch Points left, right?”

Episodes.Title: They might hear me...
Episodes.Description: After learning that Momoka is being followed by a male student from her university, Ryota steps in to help by posing as her boyfriend to keep the stalker at bay. Though the plan succeeds, the stalker lashes out, and Ryota ends up injured while protecting her. Later, as Momoka cares for him in the hospital, the two find themselves closer than they’ve been in a long time.

Episodes.Title: You've had too much to drink...
Episodes.Description: After the restaurant that Kanade works at becomes short-staffed, she desperately asks Ryota for help. To his surprise, he encounters a completely different side of Kanade—responsible, hardworking, and mature—far from the lazy person he knows at the share house. As the night winds down, Kanade serves Ryota a drink. But after some time, a tipsy Ryota finds himself getting closer and closer to her.

Episodes.Title: We can’t do this in a movie theater...
Episodes.Description: Ryota and Kanade’s passionate connection continues to deepen, and it doesn't go unnoticed, even by Momoka. Sensing the growing tension between them, Momoka decides to invite Ryota to the movie theater to find out how he truly feels. However, Momoka ends up clinging to Ryota in fear of the scary movie. Overcome by the sight of her vulnerability, Ryota can’t help but give in to the moment.

Episodes.Title: One minute... There's no way I can stop...
Episodes.Description: Ryota overhears Momoka and Kanade talking in secret. Have they discovered that he's slept with both of them? But as if to chase away his worries, the girls suggest Ryota spend time together in the living room, with a very specific idea in mind. “Tonight, we'll fulfill one of your requests.” Ryota finds himself faced with a big decision... “One minute... There's no way I can stop...”

Entries.Title: Tougen Anki
Entries.Description: After a Momotaro assassin suddenly kills his adoptive father, Shiki vows to avenge him. But first, he must learn to control his newly awakened Oni blood.

Episodes.Title: Oni's Blood
Episodes.Description: Teenager Shiki is attacked by a mysterious man. As his foster father Tsuyoshi helps him flee, he learns of his surprising and legendary heritage.

Episodes.Title: If You Want to Make It, Keep On Winning
Episodes.Description: Shiki wakes up confused in front of Naito, who explains the situation between the Oni and the Momotaro.

Episodes.Title: Blood Eclipse Release
Episodes.Description: The first test the boys face to enter the academy is playing "demon catcher."

Episodes.Title: Work with Me
Episodes.Description: If they want to pass the test their teacher has given them, students must work together.

Episodes.Title: Bad News
Episodes.Description: The students reach the Kyoto underground and discover new things about the war they are involved in.

Episodes.Title: Even the Loner Path Has Its Limits
Episodes.Description: The undead attack the students and Shiki is forced to make a decision that will change his mind.

Episodes.Title: The Beauty is a Beast
Episodes.Description: Yomogi uses his power to seal off the underground and the students must fight to survive.

Episodes.Title: The Unreliable Hero
Episodes.Description: Kuina fights a battle against another ugly, but this time he finds himself in a very delicate situation.

Episodes.Title: Momotaro Spirit
Episodes.Description: The riots affect the security of the temple and the students must evacuate the people as soon as possible.

Entries.Title: Clevatess
Entries.Description: One of the Lords of Dark Beasts, Clevatess’s reign shatters when he revives a hero he personally slayed and adopts an orphaned humanoid baby—the last hope to save a dying world. Now bound together, what fate awaits this unlikely trio?

Episodes.Title: The Lord of Dark Beasts
Episodes.Description: An expedition of heroes challenges a powerful monster that keeps mankind trapped on a single continent.

Episodes.Title: The Beast Lord in Captivity
Episodes.Description: Alicia and Clevatess are captured by a group of foul bandits.

Episodes.Title: Hero's Duty
Episodes.Description: Nell is punished for her dreams of freedom.

Episodes.Title: Magical Talent
Episodes.Description: Clevatess and Alicia's time at the bandit camp nears its end.

Episodes.Title: Boelate's March
Episodes.Description: Clevatess and Alicia are suddenly attacked by an unexpected opponent.

Episodes.Title: Insect Controlling Wizard
Episodes.Description: Alicia and Nelluru stop at a small village after destroying the bandits.

Episodes.Title: Secrets of Magic
Episodes.Description: Drel's wizards come to steal Luna away.

Episodes.Title: Current of Insects
Episodes.Description: Alicia continues her battle against the wizards.

Episodes.Title: War Zone Hiderat
Episodes.Description: The battle intensifies as Drel's army reaches Hiderat.

Episodes.Title: Margo and Drel
Episodes.Description: The truth about Drel's origins is revealed.

Episodes.Title: Fake Hero
Episodes.Description: The truth about the hero legend is revealed.

Entries.Title: The Summer Hikaru Died
Entries.Description: Six months ago, Hikaru vanished for a week. Now, as his best friend Yoshiki senses something amiss and confronts him, the harrowing truth emerges.

Episodes.Title: Replacement
Episodes.Description: Yoshiki confronts Hikaru about his suspicions and discovers the terrifying truth. Even though they try to live normally, eerie incidents begin to occur.

Episodes.Title: Suspicion
Episodes.Description: While Yoshiki and Hikaru accompany their classmates to a creepy mountain trail, a mysterious man arrives at Kubitachi Village and begins investigating.

Episodes.Title: Denial
Episodes.Description: Recalling childhood memories with Hikaru, Yoshiki continues to struggle with his complex emotions. Desperate, he reaches out to Kurebayashi.

Episodes.Title: Summer Festival
Episodes.Description: As Yoshiki attends the summer festival with Hikaru, the village elders fret over the recent death and Tanaka ends up with more questions than answers.

Episodes.Title: Wig Ghost
Episodes.Description: When Yoshiki's sister spots a creepy clump of hair in the bathroom, Hikaru visits the Tsujinaka home to investigate — but things take a deadly turn.

Episodes.Title: Asako
Episodes.Description: Yoshiki and his classmates discuss a story their teacher assigned them. Later, at a sleepover, Asako's sharp observations put her in grave danger.

Episodes.Title: Determination
Episodes.Description: After the sobering realization that Hikaru is truly dangerous, Yoshiki decides that he must act and invites his best friend to skip school together.

Episodes.Title: Contact
Episodes.Description: Yoshiki and Hikaru investigate Nonuki-sama and its link to Kubitachi's history. While at the library, they get an important lead from a surprising source.

Episodes.Title: Old Man Takeda
Episodes.Description: Kurebayashi shares her knowledge about impurities with the boys. Later, the elder Takeda loses his temper over Hikaru's ignorance of the Indo's history.

Entries.Title: TO BE HERO X
Entries.Description: In a world full of brilliant heroes, it’s the trust of fans that turns heroes into superheroes. If a hero loses the people’s trust, they lose their special abilities. Trust value is collected, quantified, and used to determine a hero’s ranking, displayed on their wrist. Every two years, the top heroes go to a tournament to fight, determine new trust values, and earn their rankings.

Episodes.Title: NICE
Episodes.Description: Lin Ling finds himself filling the role of superhero Nice when he witnesses the unthinkable.

Episodes.Title: Moon
Episodes.Description: Nice and Moon work together to live up to fans' expectations while devising a plan to regain their freedom.

Episodes.Title: The Ever-Standing Hero
Episodes.Description: Nice (Lin Ling) aims to defeat the Ever-Standing Hero in order to rank up into the top ten.

Episodes.Title: The Commoner
Episodes.Description: Nice (Lin Ling) faces off with God Eye to save Moon.

Episodes.Title: One Actor
Episodes.Description: Yang Cheng, an E-Soul stage actor, struggles with gaining popularity while juggling work and romance.

Episodes.Title: Two E-Souls
Episodes.Description: Yang Cheng gains public trust after footage of him saving Pomelo makes its way around social media.

Episodes.Title: Three Seats
Episodes.Description: Yang Cheng seeks revenge for what happened to Shang Chao.

Episodes.Title: The Cyan Girl
Episodes.Description: A girl who is luckier than usual survives a plane crash and is taken to an orphanage.

Episodes.Title: Loss and Gain
Episodes.Description: After escaping the orphanage, Cyan is forced to fend for herself until she's presented with an opportunity.

Episodes.Title: The Truth Behind Luck
Episodes.Description: After Cyan's departure, both the orphanage and its surroundings are plunged into bad luck.

Episodes.Title: Road to the Crown
Episodes.Description: The young Liu Yuwei enters the top 10 rankings as the hero Queen and is on her way to becoming a top hero.

Episodes.Title: Fall of the Star
Episodes.Description: Queen loses to an anonymous man in the hero tournament. The public begins to associate misfortune with Lucky.

Episodes.Title: Tough Girl
Episodes.Description: Genius youth inventor Loli dreams of becoming a hero, but her looks prevent her from gaining Trust Value.

Episodes.Title: Impromptu Counterattack
Episodes.Description: Loli and Nuonuo face previous top hero DJ Shindig who launched an assault on the Glimmer Laboratory.

Episodes.Title: Affective Disorder
Episodes.Description: Ghostblade reflects on what led him to become a hero, and vows to fill a role he wasn't able to before.

Episodes.Title: The Cure
Episodes.Description: Ghostblade uses the mission to get closer to Nuonuo, but danger lurks just around the corner.

Episodes.Title: Whisper Flower
Episodes.Description: Little Johnny's past and his father's ties to other heroes is revealed.

Episodes.Title: Died-Out Flame
Episodes.Description: Little Johnny becomes a young hero to find out the truth surrounding his father's death.

Episodes.Title: Breaking the Balance
Episodes.Description: The exploration team prepares to enter the alien ship, but they are not the only ones.

Episodes.Title: The Ruins Incident
Episodes.Description: Inside the spaceship there is a showdown between different camps.

Episodes.Title: Nurturing God
Episodes.Description: Nice tries to keep his smile and Dragon Boy begins his mission.

Episodes.Title: The Last Smile
Episodes.Description: Nice appears in the middle of Smile and Dragon's fight. But is he friend or foe?

Entries.Title: Secrets of the Silent Witch
Entries.Description: Humans couldn’t handle magic without chanting until Monica Everett, the Silent Witch and one of the Seven Sages, made unspoken magecraft possible. Painfully shy, she enjoys seclusion. One day, Louis Miller, the Barrier Mage, delivers the king’s order: Go undercover at a prestigious school for nobles to guard the second prince. Get ready for her silent mission to begin!

Episodes.Title: A Colleague Arrives and Acts Unreasonably
Episodes.Description: Monica Everett, the Silent Witch is visited by a colleague to go undercover at Serendia Academy.

Episodes.Title: Taking a Step Forward
Episodes.Description: Monica transfers to Serendia Academy after accepting the top-secret mission. Her mission is to secretly guard the second prince Felix without him noticing.

Episodes.Title: Serendia Academy Student Council
Episodes.Description: Monica is accused of being an accomplice for attacking Felix, so she looks for the culprit to clear her name.

Episodes.Title: The Perfect Formula
Episodes.Description: Louis’s familiar Ryn was at the Serendia Academy to drop off his message when they detected an irregular mana by the boy’s dorm. When they went to the woods behind the dorm, they found Cyril losing control of his mana and slowly spreading ice around and freezing himself, too. Monica identifies the reason behind the mana rampage and finds out that there’s a culprit behind it. The hidden secret of the student council gets unveiled.

Episodes.Title: The Adventure of the Silent Witch
Episodes.Description: It's the weekend and Monica is freed from her duty, so she decides to go to the city of Craeme with Nero.

Episodes.Title: A Cup Out of Place
Episodes.Description: Serendia Academy is a distinguished academy dedicated to nurturing refined ladies and gentlemen, so girls are required to take ballroom dancing and tea party classes. Since Monica lived in isolation in a mountain cabin for a long time, she must re-take her ballroom dance test. Monica was already struggling, and to make matters worse, the tea party announcement was made. Her group is Monica’s friends Lana Colette and Casey Grove, as well as Claudia who is an intelligent woman known as the “walking library.” How will the tea party and Monica’s re-examination for the ballroom dance go?

Episodes.Title: A Jealous Noblewoman
Episodes.Description: The ballroom dance re-examination test is over, so Monica is having a barbecue with Glenn and the others.

Episodes.Title: My Responsibility
Episodes.Description: Monica is attending school for the first time in a week, so Lana and Casey hold a welcome back party for her. Claudia also joins and the girls have fun. Everyone is curious about the school festival that’s right around the corner. Casey is going to sell her embroideries at the charity bazaar, and Monica’s eyes light up when she sees them, so Casey promises to make one for Monica, too. That same day after school, supplies are delivered to the school, so Monica heads to the storage with Cyril. Casey fills in for the stage designer and accompanies them, but…

Episodes.Title: The Hidden Secret
Episodes.Description: The assassination plot against the second prince by Spiralflame was thwarted by Monica the Silent Witch.

Entries.Title: The Water Magician
Entries.Description: Reincarnation had Ryo dreaming of peace, but instead he lands into a monster-infested wilderness. With water magic and eternal youth, he survives countless wicked concoctions for 20 years, becoming one of the most powerful magicians ever. Ryo’s fate shifts when he meets Abel, a genius knight, thrusting him into magical society’s spotlight. Thus, the Water Magician’s wild adventure begins!

Episodes.Title: The Slow, But Dangerous, Life
Episodes.Description: After dying, Ryo Mihara finds himself reincarnated in a fantasy world with the ability to cast water magic.

Episodes.Title: Abel the Castaway
Episodes.Description: Ryo encounters a castaway who requests his help.

Episodes.Title: The Town of Lune
Episodes.Description: Abel is welcomed back in the town of Lune and Ryo gets acquainted with civilization.

Episodes.Title: Eclipses & Akuma
Episodes.Description: As Ryo settles into life as an adventurer, he has an unexpected encounter with a menacing foe.

Episodes.Title: The Great Tidal Bore
Episodes.Description: Ryo looks for ways to prepare for another akuma encounter, while trouble is brewing in the dungeon.

Episodes.Title: The Sealed Dungeon
Episodes.Description: The aftermath of the Great Tidal Bore brings visitors from out of town who might be just as troublesome.

Episodes.Title: Beyond the Gate
Episodes.Description: As Abel escorts a team of academics through the dungeon, a strange warp puts them all in danger.

Episodes.Title: Unprecedented
Episodes.Description: Ryo comes to Abel's rescue in the depths of the dungeon, facing off against mysterious enemies.

Episodes.Title: Nils and the Mysterious Town
Episodes.Description: A quest that takes Ryo to Nils hometown reveals more about the magical world.

Episodes.Title: The Open Port Festival
Episodes.Description: Ryo and his roommates travel to the coastal town of Whitnash for a job.

Entries.Title: Wolf King
Entries.Description: A young commoner comes of age and learns he's the last of a long line of Werewolves — and heir to the throne.

Episodes.Title: The Rise of the Wolf
Episodes.Description: On a moonlit night, seemingly average teen Drew Ferran starts to notice unusual changes, exposing a family secret that sets him on a strange new path.

Episodes.Title: Brackenholme
Episodes.Description: While an arrogant Lion prince awaits his betrothal, Whitley consults a magister in training and Drew learns more about his abilities.

Episodes.Title: The Caged Beast
Episodes.Description: A bride-to-be arrives amid rumors of a lone Wolf's return. Duke Bergan tells Drew about his origins. Prince Lucas and Lord Vankaskan prepare to pounce.

Episodes.Title: The Wyrmwood
Episodes.Description: Drew's daring flight from Brackenholme takes him into dangerous waters — and through a cursed forest that feels like a maze. Thankfully, he isn't alone.

Episodes.Title: Return to Motley
Episodes.Description: Hector and Gretchen bring an injured Drew back home, where he reunites with an old friend and unearths a clue that could lead him to his mentor.

Episodes.Title: The Maelstrom
Episodes.Description: The friends launch a search for Count Vega at All Hallow's Bay. But can a pirate actually be trusted? King Leopold welcomes the Bearlords into his den.

Episodes.Title: Chained
Episodes.Description: The Maelstrom sails into Westland, where both allies and enemies lie in wait. With time running out, Whitley makes an important discovery.

Episodes.Title: The Fall of the Lion
Episodes.Description: Drew's life hangs in the balance as the kingdom prepares for a wedding — and an execution — on the same day. But a twist of fate could change everything.

Episodes.Title: The Wolf in Waiting
Episodes.Description: Drew is grappling with the weight of royal destiny and an eerie prediction of his doom when a brazen crime upends his world and forces him to act.

Episodes.Title: Baba Korga
Episodes.Description: While following clues to find Gretchen and Lucas, Drew and Whitley stumble upon a mysterious woman in the woods. Vincent pays Hector an unwelcome visit.

Episodes.Title: Biting Point
Episodes.Description: As Whitley's condition worsens, she makes plans to protect Drew by visiting a healer in secret. Hector seeks advice from an unexpected source.

Episodes.Title: Hell Comes to Haggard
Episodes.Description: After running afoul of a fiery Goatlord, Drew becomes a prisoner of his own mind. Leopold requests a meeting with the Wolf Council... or is it a trap?

Episodes.Title: The Gathering Storm
Episodes.Description: Drew's party arrives at Cape Gala, where a charming Horselord seems too good to be true. Bergan vows vengeance — despite the Queen's caution.

Episodes.Title: The Reckoning
Episodes.Description: As a sinister plot comes into focus, Lucas arranges a welcome party, and a haunted Hector confronts a ghost. A family reunion takes a surprising turn.

Episodes.Title: Hunted
Episodes.Description: With Highcliff under siege, a Bear and a Lion clash on the battlefield. Gretchen shields Whitley from tragic news. Hector learns to harness his powers.

Episodes.Title: The Fall of the Wolf
Episodes.Description: Whitley and Gretchen rally an unlikely army to fight back. But in the end, Drew must take a leap of faith to save his kingdom — and the people he loves.

Entries.Title: Dealing with Mikadono Sisters Is a Breeze
Entries.Description: Yu Ayase, son of a late legendary actress, is overwhelmingly mediocre. When he’s invited to stay with his mother’s friend, Yu is shocked to find out that he’ll be living with three prodigy sisters who possess both beauty and talent…and who rule his new school as the Three Emperors. Can Yu manage to melt the sisters’ cold hearts and fulfill his mother’s last wish for him to build a happy family?

Episodes.Title: Prodigy and Mediocrity
Episodes.Description: Yu Ayase transfers to a school for prodigies—but despite his gifted mother, he's perfectly mediocre.

Episodes.Title: Her Secret
Episodes.Description: Tasked with looking out for the sisters, Yu tries to win them over—through their stomachs.

Episodes.Title: I Want Us to Be a Family
Episodes.Description: Yu begins to get to know the three sisters, and they start to see him as more than just an unwelcome guest.

Episodes.Title: A Memory the Sisters Can Share
Episodes.Description: Yu carries out his plan to have the sisters enjoy the Cherry Blossom Night Festival together.

Episodes.Title: A Father's Teachings
Episodes.Description: The three sisters grow closer after the festival... and then their father comes home.

Episodes.Title: This Is a Date
Episodes.Description: As Kazuki prepares for her most challenging role yet, she asks Yu on a date to get in the mindset.

Episodes.Title: You Will Win No Matter What
Episodes.Description: Yu throws himself into intense training with Niko's help, preparing for his one-on-one showdown with Hayato.

Episodes.Title: I'll Make You Swoon
Episodes.Description: Niko wins the battle against Hayato, so she says to Yu “I’ll grant you any wish” for doing his best for her.

Episodes.Title: The Shadow of a Genius
Episodes.Description: Yu delivers Miwa's forgotten lunch during her shogi game. Touched, she asks him to have lunch with her.

Episodes.Title: I Already Knew It
Episodes.Description: Kazuki and Niko try to console Miwa, but she gets angry and runs out of the house. Yu goes to look for her.

Entries.Title: Apocalypse Bringer Mynoghra: World Conquest Starts with the Civilization of Ruin
Entries.Description: In Eternal Nations, a fantasy strategy game where players manage an empire, Takuto Ira is a legendary player who sits atop the leaderboard. Takuto goes unconscious during a hospitalization and awakens on the continent of Idoragya, which looks just like the game. Takuto meets Sludge Atou, his favorite unit in the game, and decides to build Mynoghra, an evil empire.

Episodes.Title: New Game
Episodes.Description: Takuto wakes in a fantasy world with his Hero, Atou, and the use of game mechanics from a 4X strategy game.

Episodes.Title: Let's Announce the Founding of Mynoghra
Episodes.Description: Takuto uses the Refugee system to welcome the dark elves into his nation, and learns of two good nations nearby.

Episodes.Title: The Time for Domestic Affairs has Come
Episodes.Description: Takuto focuses on solidifying the foundation of his civilization, setting policies, and watching his home grow.

Episodes.Title: Life Doesn't Always Go Your Way
Episodes.Description: The paladins from Qualia fight their way south and finally reach the Accursed Lands to face Atou.

Episodes.Title: I’m the Monster You’ve Been Looking For
Episodes.Description: Atou engages the Paladins in combat and learns several key details about the world her and Takuto now inhabit.

Episodes.Title: King, Are You an Evil Person?
Episodes.Description: Atou recruits little girls to care for Takuto. He helps them face their survivor's guilt over eating their mom

Episodes.Title: Please Be My Friend!
Episodes.Description: Forngawn's Staff Holders visit Mynoghra, the sociable Pepe defusing tensions and forging an alliance.

Episodes.Title: What a Human thing to do!
Episodes.Description: The twins go to Dragontan with the human-obsessed Medic units to observe its culture. They befriend the mayor.

Episodes.Title: It’s Well Past Your Bedtime
Episodes.Description: Atou heads to Dragontan while Isla goes around mothering everyone and doling out headpats.

Episodes.Title: Go Forth and Conquer
Episodes.Description: The enemy proves to be a JRPG! Atou then fights foes operating under completely different game mechanics!

Entries.Title: New PANTY & STOCKING with GARTERBELT
Entries.Description: On the brink between Heaven and Hell lies the town of Daten City, where sinister spirits known as "Ghosts" feast upon humanity.

Episodes.Title: Panty and Stocking: Homecoming
Episodes.Description: Continuing from the cliffhanger in the previous season, Garterbelt, Brief and Chuck team up with Scanty and Kneesocks to resurrect Panty and stop an out-of-control Stocking.

Episodes.Title: BITCH GIRLS 4LIFE
Episodes.Description: Garterbelt has Panty, Stocking, Scanty and Knee Socks search all over Daten City for a ghost made of water and oil.

Episodes.Title: The Bodycard
Episodes.Description: In order to pay off three trillion Daten City dollars worth of bills Panty competes in a card game in order to get a rare card that is worth the exact amount needed to pay the bills.

Episodes.Title: Project S: The Worst Ever Dojo
Episodes.Description: After another argument with Panty, Stocking works together with Scanty to kill a Ghost at a dojo.

Episodes.Title: Bitch Perfect
Episodes.Description: Daten City is experiencing an unprecedented SNS boom! Stocking is engrossed in an app that lets you earn hearts and feel good. Before I knew it, Panty and the Demon Sisters have also gotten hooked on the app...

Episodes.Title: F*ck & Furious
Episodes.Description: On a certain afternoon, Panty was sleeping peacefully with a relaxed breathing sound. Under the bed, there was a crumpled ball of tissue paper...

Episodes.Title: Daten City President
Episodes.Description: Stocking must win Daten City's presidential election in order to pardon Panty.

Episodes.Title: Pet Cematary Hills
Episodes.Description: Panty plans to kill a cat Ghost, but soon grows affection for it.

Episodes.Title: Shoot for Yesterday!
Episodes.Description: The four girls, with the help of a strange man from space, try to kill a monolith before it destroys the universe.

Episodes.Title: Rolling Sisters
Episodes.Description: A sushi ghost causes a hurricane to strike Daten City while Scanty attempts to poop.

Episodes.Title: Mutant Garterbelts
Episodes.Description: Garterbelt takes pity on a Turtle Ghost, which later possesses his soul.

Episodes.Title: Bitch Serial Killer!
Episodes.Description: A series of murders are happening in Daten City, the victims are blonde sexy promiscuous girls, on hands of a Murderer Ghost, and the next one in the spotlight is Panty.

Episodes.Title: The Brothers from Heaven
Episodes.Description: Panty and Stocking get replaced by their cousins, the angel brothers Polyester and Polyurethane.

Episodes.Title: Independence Dick
Episodes.Description: Garterbelt, Briefs, and Chuck finally cry out in despair at the tyranny of the Angel Sisters and Devil Sisters. Garterbelt leaves the church and heads to Casino City with Briefs to fulfill her humble dream of spending a night at Casino City's strip bar! But...

Episodes.Title: Longest Bitch Yard
Episodes.Description: Both the Anarchy and Daemon Sisters are sent to prison and must win a game of American football for their freedom.

Episodes.Title: Lord of the Kokan the Great

Entries.Title: Witch Watch
Entries.Description: A diligent teen winds up living with his spunky childhood friend, a trainee witch, to protect her from a dire prophecy. But can they survive high school?

Episodes.Title: Witch's Return
Episodes.Description: Morihito Otogi is a teenager with ogre strength. His childhood friend, Nico, is coming home after completing her witch training! Following an old pact, they begin living together. Can Morihito protect the clumsy Nico from a dire prophecy?

Episodes.Title: A Giant Rookie / Let's Go to a Diner / The Flying Classroom
Episodes.Description: On the first day of school, Morihito urges Nico to hide the fact that she's a witch, but she tries using magic to secretly help him out in class.

Episodes.Title: Fresh Transparent Fashions for Spring / Witch's Delivery Service / Lost Dogs and the Patter of Rain
Episodes.Description: Nico's mother sends Morihito a letter containing a worrying prophecy. Unable to decipher the meaning, Morihito spends the rest of the day on his toes.

Episodes.Title: Kanshi Kazamatsuri, the Tengu
Episodes.Description: Kanshi explains that Nico's mother sent him to protect her. He and Morihito clash, but he takes a moment to warn him of an enemy within the school.

Episodes.Title: My Student Is My Favorite Artist / My Tummy Is Tender Today / Cat Scout
Episodes.Description: Closet manga fan Ms. Makuwa loses her composure when she realizes that one of her students is a popular fan artist for her favorite series.

Episodes.Title: Under the Lovers' Tree
Episodes.Description: After realizing Morihito is getting popular with the girls at school, Nico learns of a so-called lovers' tree near the site of an upcoming field trip.

Episodes.Title: Kan and Nico's Channel / The Tea Ceremony Is a Piece of Tea Cake
Episodes.Description: Nico and Kanshi start an online video channel, but Morihito is annoyed by their lack of originality and asks their hipster classmate Magami for help.

Episodes.Title: Kanshi’s Part-Time Job Diaries ~The Superhero Show~ / Kanshi’s Part-Time Job Diaries ~The Side Job~
Episodes.Description: When Kanshi can’t pay his share of the living expenses, Morihito hands him a flyer from an amusement park hiring performers for a superhero show.

Episodes.Title: Dear Kara / New Friends / Date with the Knight
Episodes.Description: Nico and Morihito's classmate Kara asks them to restore a letter from her deceased mother, which her father put through a paper shredder.

Episodes.Title: Trope-tacular Student Council / A Stray Cat’s Bubble of Bliss
Episodes.Description: After a student council vice president makes a dramatic entrance to forbid Nico from using magic, the council’s other larger-than-life members arrive.

Episodes.Title: Dogs and Raindrops (1)
Episodes.Description: Kanshi saves Keigo from a bully who claims to be using a candy with a stimulant effect. A self-proclaimed witch appears before Nico and Morihito.

Episodes.Title: Dogs and Raindrops (2)
Episodes.Description: A transformed Keigo attacks the isolated Morihito. Surrounded by Wolf's "Dogs," Kanshi and Nico devise a plan to locate and neutralize the warlock.

Episodes.Title: Keigo Magami, the Werewolf / Kind Tiger, Proud Wolf / Easy Spices for Enthralling Cooking
Episodes.Description: Morihito and the others decide to get rid of any crescent-shaped objects to minimize the risk of Keigo transforming into a werewolf in the house.

Episodes.Title: Uron Mirage Chapter 119: The Phasey Hunt, Part 4 / Diary of My Favorite Artist
Episodes.Description: In Episode 119 of Uron Mirage, swordsmen Utsuro, Oboro, Sagiri and Zack decide to split up and search the buildings of an abandoned research facility.

Episodes.Title: Summer Demon
Episodes.Description: Ibuki's newest prophecy advises seeking a family that dispels evil. Nico and her friends set out in search, treating the journey like a summer trip.

Episodes.Title: Miharu Kiryu, the Vampire / Missing Parasol / I'm So Glad You're Here
Episodes.Description: Vampire Miharu moves into the Otogi house, but as a night person with different energy needs, he may struggle to adjust to communal living.

Episodes.Title: We Got Trapped in a Death Game, But It Sucked / Long Long a Go Go
Episodes.Description: Morihito and the other guys awake in an unknown place. A mysterious figure tells them they must play a game — and that Nico is being held hostage.

Episodes.Title: Kara and Shiki / Mega Marble Mania Madness / Scramble Scrap Squad
Episodes.Description: Nico and Kukumi help Kara out at the shrine run by her father. When Nico casts a spell to make a paper cat move around, Kara gets an idea.

Episodes.Title: Letter from a Friend
Episodes.Description: When tidying the house, Morihito finds a letter Nico wrote to him when they were kids. Nico shares her memories of those days with Nemu and the guys.

Episodes.Title: The Lost Wolf and the Stray Cat
Episodes.Description: Noticing that Keigo seems sad, Nico gives him a ring imbued with a levitation spell. As he secretly trains to use it, Nemu approaches him.

Episodes.Title: Secret Urges / Keiko's Carefree Style / Jekyll Visits the Otogi House
Episodes.Description: As Keigo wonders why his channel isn't getting more views, Nico casts a spell on him that she believes will help make his videos more interesting.

Episodes.Title: The Incredible Shrinking Adventure / The Hamazaki Fall Bread Festival / Lucky Birthday
Episodes.Description: While sharing donuts with Kara and Morihito, Nico decides to shrink herself and Morihito down so they can experience eating a giant pastry.

Episodes.Title: Our First Offline Meetup / Fave Artist File: Creative Surge / Fave Artist File: Crazy Event Arc

Entries.Title: Marry Me, Let's Have a Baby!
Entries.Description: At a speed-dating event, Taika hits it off with a woman named Ayano, a doctor who’s eager to have children. However, just as the matching couples are about to be announced, he panics and makes a break for it when his fears about his erectile dysfunction begin to surface... Later, at an appointment for his condition, Taika is shocked to discover that his doctor is none other than Ayano herself! On top of that, he realizes that when he's with Ayano, his erectile dysfunction disappears! This is a story about two people who decide to enter into a secret contractual marriage with one goal, to have a child in less than a year!

Entries.Title: Scooped Up by an S-Rank Adventurer!
Entries.Description: Lloyd is a white mage who was unexpectedly banished from the hero's party. As he was lost and uncertain, he happened to cross paths with an S-rank adventurer party in need of a white mage, so he joined them on their quest. Little did anyone know at the time that the hero's party would fall apart and Lloyd would rise to fame.

Episodes.Title: Lloyd is Cast Out
Episodes.Description: Lloyd grows up under the tutelage of Merlin, then becomes an adventurer under the Hero. Later, he's cast out.

Episodes.Title: Lloyd is Recruited
Episodes.Description: During his recruitment Lloyd learns the party's previous white mage has a sick sister, so he heals her.

Episodes.Title: Lloyd Sets Out
Episodes.Description: After learning about their quest, Lloyd travels with his new party and fights monsters alongside them.

Episodes.Title: Lloyd Gives Support
Episodes.Description: The party reaches their quest's farm and fights off thousands of manipulated monsters with Lloyd's support.

Episodes.Title: Lloyd to the Rescue
Episodes.Description: Lloyd and the party race back to aid Ishtar, only to encounter a group of demons holding a beastwoman captive.

Episodes.Title: Lloyd Frees Them
Episodes.Description: Lina rallies Ishtar's defenders while Lloyd & Kureha free a 2nd horde of monsters and return to save Ishtar.

Episodes.Title: Lloyd Saves Ishtar
Episodes.Description: Most monsters left, but golems are attacking Ishtar. Lloyd enhances the defenders and they save the city.

Episodes.Title: Lloyd Stays at a Hot Spring
Episodes.Description: The party rests in a hot spring town. Silica masters a spell. Daggas gets a shield. Llyod improves his magic.

Episodes.Title: The S-Rank Adventurers Strive to Get Stronger
Episodes.Description: Cross and Yui each meet someone new who helps them grow stronger while Lloyd improves his magic.

Episodes.Title: Lloyd Fights
Episodes.Description: Lloyd's party gets attacked by demons, and they fight one of the four great generals to protect Claire.

Entries.Title: The Brilliant Healer's New Life in the Shadows
Entries.Description: Banished as "useless," Zenos, a self-taught healer from the slums, turns despair into defiance and opens a secret clinic in the city's shadows. With unlicensed, unmatched magic, he cures, comforts, and rights wrongs, quietly becoming a legend. But as his power grows, even the royal palace takes notice. Can he buck the odds and heal a world that cast him aside?

Episodes.Title: An Equal Price
Episodes.Description: Zenos, an unlicensed healer working in the shadows, works to fix what's ailing his patients.

Episodes.Title: The Underground Healer in the Abandoned Part of Town
Episodes.Description: Kicked out of his party for his unorthodox skills and humble origins, Zenos seeks a new way of life.

Episodes.Title: Turf War
Episodes.Description: An encounter with the chief of the orcs leads Zenos into a three-way standoff in the slums.

Episodes.Title: A Righteous Hero
Episodes.Description: Zenos resolving the feud between the demihuman gangs attracts attention from an unwanted source.

Episodes.Title: A Place to Belong
Episodes.Description: Zenos' old party find themselves at an impasse, and wondering if they kicked out the reason for their success.

Episodes.Title: The End of Adventure
Episodes.Description: A rampaging golem threatens the slums as Zenos is forced to organize a resistance.

Episodes.Title: Special Service
Episodes.Description: After having dealt with the the rampaging golem, Zenos and his friends visit a hot springs to recuperate.

Episodes.Title: The Royal Hospital
Episodes.Description: Zenos attends class at the Royal Hospital's headquarters, under the assumed identity of "Zeno."

Episodes.Title: Faction Infiltration
Episodes.Description: Zenos' gets an invite to the Goldran Laboratory, and a chance to track down Becker's missing student.

Episodes.Title: A Request from a Noble Lady
Episodes.Description: A request for Zenos to treat Lord Fennel's daughter ends up being complicated by her haughty attitude.

Episodes.Title: Just a Normal Healer
Episodes.Description: Zenos is invited to a dinner party by Goldran, where he hopes to discover the truth.

Episodes.Title: Choosing Who Lives
Episodes.Description: Zenos learns the truth behind Becker's investigation, and faces the question: are lives equal in value?

Entries.Title: CITY THE ANIMATION
Entries.Description: This town, is not just a normal town. There's laughter, love and emotional moments. An unpredictable ordinary life presented by the residents! Exciting stuffs come one after another. Welcome to CITY.

Episodes.Description: CITY—something happens every day. Tsurubishi dives a crispy fried noodle into a customer's bag, while Nagumo witnesses it. An absolute, desperate situation! Matsuri and Eri enjoying their after-school adventures. Todoroki and Onikamaboko struggle to create a joke for "Rakutan-kun." After hearing Niikura's dream, Nagumo starts thinking what they want to do. Something starting to blossom in CITY.

Perpetually broke Nagumo faces off against Niikura, who just wants her money back. When Wako joins in, their chaotic campus life kicks into high gear. Meanwhile, the CITY Minami Eleven soccer team scrambles to protect their always-injured ace, Sasago. Todoroki negotiates the fate of Rakutan-kun—testing the bond between editor and author. And the sun sets on CITY.

With a performance approaching, Tekaridake Theater's leader, Tekaridake, tries to rally his unmotivated troupe. Sleepwalker Riko Izumi steals the heart of 16-year-old Tatewaku Makabe. Spring is just around the corner. Matsuri and Eri share kindness to protect world peace. Nagumo, Niikura, and Wako find a treasure map—let the battle begin! Another peaceful day in CITY.

Tanabe loves handing out awards for anything and everything, and now she begins the search for Nagumo! Tsurubishi visits the izakaya 'Yamabushi,' eager to get the iconic 'Boss! The usual!' and starts frequenting it. Niikura chases after a pendant that got caught on a 'Mimineko.' Matsuri and Eri embark on a big adventure chasing the Mimineko. The lives of each person intersect in CITY.

Nagumo is taken away by Tanabe. Their destination is the Tanabe Residence Hospitality Twin Towers. With the help of a kind person they meet along the way, Nagumo and Wako try to escape, but the guardians on each floor block their path... Meanwhile, Niikura continues to run recklessly, chasing the Mimineko. Disconnected dots begin to connect in CITY!

The Adataras' morning is always busy. Umi, Sora, Kamome, Tatsuta, and Ryota, all head off together as usual. An anonymous manuscript titled 'Kanki-kun' arrives at the CITY magazine editorial office. Feeling something special about it, Todoroki makes a proposal to Onikamaboko. At the riverside at dusk, Eri tries to convey something to Matsuri... The seasons of CITY continue to change.

Taking over for the owner of Café Yamabushi, Tsurubishi sets out to make the ultimate fried rice. With pride, he embarks on a journey to find the perfect ingredients. Late night, Niikura is struck by hunger and eats whatever she can. Meanwhile, Kuratake, the barber known as “the baddest guy in CITY,” been selling off gifts from his regulars. In CITY, there's no light without a little darkness.

A girl in love can't stop sighing. After 18 years of waiting for an invitation, Tanabe finally learns his crush's favorite food?! Tekaridake casts Nagumo as the lead in "Throat". Despite endless NGs, he powers through—and the curtain rises! A police officer becomes a fan of Riko Izumi. Tatewaku, too, ends up asking her out. Something is blooming in CITY.

The CITY race with a 1-million-yen prize is on. Nagumo competes against Obaba. Niikura aims to steal pendant from the CITY Minami Eleven. Tekaridake runs with a pair in tow. Matsuri and Eri move in sync. The Three Crows hold fine sake in hand. With surprises at every turn, the unpredictable race keeps everyone on edge. Who will win the race? As everyone runs, CITY begins to spin!

Nagumo and Niikura scheme to strike it rich through video streaming. However, Nagumo's reaction to Niikura's heartfelt script is... Meanwhile, Riko Izumi's fan club stands in Tatewaku's way. The CITY Minami Eleven captain, Obina, leads the charge to stop Tatewaku's rampage! Meanwhile, the Three Crows head off for a brief vacation. The summer in CITY stirs into a frenzy!

Entries.Title: Betrothed to My Sister's Ex
Entries.Description: Marie, the second daughter of a poor baron’s household, is treated like a servant by her parents. Even at Marie’s birthday party, her beautiful elder sister, Anastasia, is the star. Outside, Marie bumps into Count Kyuros Granado, who falls for her at first sight. Yet, due to a misunderstanding, the Count proposes to Anastasia. After a tragic accident, Marie must marry the count instead!

Episodes.Title: I Could Never Replace My Sister
Episodes.Description: Marie is always dressed in tatters and is treated like a servant in her own home. Then she meets Count Kyros.

Episodes.Title: Marie, I Want to Marry You
Episodes.Description: Kyros hates aristocratic society and its ties of obligation. But why? And what changed when he met Marie?

Episodes.Title: A Life I Saw in a Dream, and a Dream-like Life
Episodes.Description: Marie begins her new life as Kyros' fiancée and finds herself bewildered by the differences from her old life.

Episodes.Title: I've Found the Things I Like
Episodes.Description: Kyros wants to provide Marie with every comfort, but Mio cautions him. Then a package from the baron arrives.

Episodes.Title: The Prince and the Pitch-Black Warrior
Episodes.Description: Luiphon takes Marie to a sword fighting contest. The ferocity of it scares her. Then the dark warrior fights.

Episodes.Title: Am I Enough As I Am?
Episodes.Description: Liu Liu, Kyros' mother, discovers surprising things about Marie. Mio investigates the baron on Kyros' orders.

Episodes.Title: You're So Close, I Think You May Make Me Dizzy
Episodes.Description: Mio investigates a comment in a letter from Marie's brother. Marie and Kyros go to the capital for a date.

Episodes.Title: A Gift More Lovely Than Jewels
Episodes.Description: Kyros and Marie meet Luiphon at a jeweler's at his request. Thoughts of Anastasia haunt Marie's happiness.

Episodes.Title: In Pursuit of Anastasia's Spirit
Episodes.Description: Kyros demands the truth of Anastasia's accident, but he and Marie are not prepared for the answers they find.

Entries.Title: Super Cube
Entries.Description: In an accident, an ordinary boy, Wang Xiaoxiu, obtains a space system called "Superpower Cube" from a high-latitude cosmic civilization and gains extraordinary powers. When the school belle, Shen Yao, Wang Xiaoxiu’s longtime crush, confesses her love to him, the delinquent Sun Jun, who also has a crush on her, is provoked. Wang Xiaoxiu resolves the crisis with his wit and extraordinary powers, but it also brings more disasters as a result. Shen Yao is taken to the world of extraordinary beings by a mysterious person, and Wang Xiaoxiu embarks on a journey to rescue her. Fighting in the bizarre universe, he finds the meaning of fairness and justice on the path to becoming a peerless powerhouse.

Episodes.Title: Super a Reincarnation? The Goddess Confessed to Me!
Upgrade! Battle 5? Not to Be Feared!
Melee! Is Wang Xiaoxiu Still Human?
Brave Climb Tower: A Fight With Explosive Funds
Being Tricked By a Black-Hearted Agent Into Working as a Bodyguard
Rudra Feast: Warriors and Golden Bells
Rudra Feast: The Strength of the Young Lady

Entries.Title: New Saga
Entries.Description: After a brutal war, magic swordsman Kyle defeats the Demon King but is left dying. A crimson crystal sends him four years into the past to his once-destroyed hometown where he finds his lost loved ones alive. Armed with future knowledge, Kyle vows to prevent the coming tragedy and rewrite fate.

Episodes.Title: I'll Change My Fate
Episodes.Description: Kyle is sent back in time after his fateful fight with the demon king and swears to save the world this time.

Episodes.Title: The Hero's Conditions
Episodes.Description: Kyle sets about making preparations for his heroic journey and the fight to come.

Episodes.Title: Application of the Contract
Episodes.Description: Kyle reunites with some old companions in new ways before making his first major play to change the future.

Episodes.Title: The Perfect Start to a Heroic Tale
Episodes.Description: To save the ill-fated Princess Milena, Kyle must brave a danger the likes of which he's never faced before.

Episodes.Title: Reunion at Dawn
Episodes.Description: Old friends become enemies as Kyle comes up with a plan to get Princess Milena to safety.

Episodes.Title: Brothers in Arms
Episodes.Description: Kyle's party is celebrated for rescuing the princess, but they're given no time to rest on their laurels.

Episodes.Title: To the Blacksmith's Nation
Episodes.Description: Kyle's party arrives in Karan and becomes embroiled in tensions between Zirgus and the Gargan Empire.

Episodes.Title: Those Who Act Out of Sight
Hidden Ambitions
Episodes.Description: Kyle insists on finding the secret underground passage hidden beneath Karan.

Episodes.Title: Duel
Episodes.Description: The demons agree to formally duel Kyle's party for the holy sword and information.

Episodes.Title: Secret Red-Hot Strategy
Episodes.Description: Kyle and his companions acquire surprising new information about demons.

Entries.Title: There's No Freaking Way I'll Be Your Lover! Unless...
Entries.Description: Renako Amaori is leaving her awkward and lonely junior high school life behind, determined to become a normal girl with normal friends in high school. Glamorous, confident Mai Ouzuka is Renako’s total opposite: wealthy, outgoing, and a literal fashion model. Against the odds, the two girls form an immediate connection. Renako thinks she may have found the best friend of her dreams…until Mai’s romantic confession sends her into a tailspin. Renako wants to prove to Mai that being BFFs is better than being girlfriends, but Mai is dead set on convincing Renako that they’re destined to be lovers.

Episodes.Title: Girlfriends? No Freaking Way!
Episodes.Description: Renako starts high school determined to leave her introverted self behind and miraculously lands in the top-tier popular group. But keeping up the extrovert act is exhausting. Just as she’s about to break, the school’s princess, Mai Ouzuka, confesses to her!? This isn’t the high school life she imagined!

Episodes.Title: First Kiss?! No Freaking Way!
Episodes.Description:
The showdown between Renako and Mai has begun: best friend or girlfriend?

Mai visits Renako as a “friend,” and they have a blast. Friendship is the best!  But Mai’s feelings keep growing. Hoping to prove friendship wins, Renako plans a fun weekend outing. Everything's going great… until a sudden downpour flips everything on its head!?

Episodes.Title: You Can't Freaking Force Me!
Episodes.Description:
Renako tries to forget the kiss, while Mai leaves for work in Paris. Renako walks home with Ajisai after school, holding hands and making plans to hang out later, too. Mai calls her a cheater, but they're not even dating, so how can she be?!

But then when Ajisai comes over, Mai shows up too, bringing her little sister Haruna. Now it’s a chaotic four-person hangout... What could possibly go wrong?

Episodes.Title: Mai?! No Freaking Way! (...Or Maybe?)
Episodes.Description: Mai skips school, and Renako starts to worry... Maybe she really went too far. But then Satsuki calls her in to reveal the truth. Turns out, a heartbroken Mai told her something crazy... She's planning to join a Suitors Party?! How did it come to this?! Renako rushes to the hotel venue, where she and Mai face off… in swimsuits. Now’s the time. Renako has to finally tell Mai how she really feels!

Episodes.Title: Girlfriends? No Freaking Way! (Round 2)
Episodes.Description: Satsuki suddenly drops a bomb: “Let’s be girlfriends.”  It’s clearly revenge for Mai's careless treatment of her. Still, Renako agrees to play along for two weeks if it helps the two make up.  But why does Ajisai seem bothered? No way… right? Meanwhile, Mai’s as calm as ever. Things are shifting with Satsuki, but is it really headed in the right direction?

Episodes.Title: Too Many Freaking Secrets!
Episodes.Description:
Satsuki suddenly starts acting all couple-y in front of Mai, much to Renako's confusion. After seeing an unexpected side of Satsuki, Renako dares to admit she's actually an introvert, only to find out Satsuki already knew. Shocked, Renako runs off, but Satsuki finds her, and somehow she ends up spending the night at Satsuki’s place.

Are they really taking a bath together too!?

Wait, why!?

Episodes.Title: No Freaking Way I’m Surviving This Mess!
Episodes.Description: Thanks to Ajisai-san, Mai finally agrees to talk with Satsuki, and Renako gets roped in as a witness. Just when it seems like they’ll make up, Satsuki drops a secret photo of her and Renako! Wait, what?! Things spiral out of control and somehow it’s turned into an FPS showdown??! There’s no way Renako's losing… absolutely no way…!

Episodes.Title: A Perfect Win? No Freaking Way!
Episodes.Description: After their FPS practice, Renako stays the night at Satsuki’s. “Thanks for letting me face Mai,” Satsuki smiles, making Renako wish they’d just make up already. The long-awaited showdown begins! Mai’s flawless aim, Renako’s sharp instincts… and Satsuki struggling to keep up. But Renako can’t let her lose without a fight!

Episodes.Title: Visiting Ajisai’s House? No Freaking Way!
Episodes.Description: After the troubles with Satsuki settle down, Renako visits Ajisai over summer break... Only to realize that behind her gentle smile are hidden struggles. When Ajisai suddenly declares she’s running away, Renako decides to join her. Their destination: a hot spring! A fleeting summer escape that brings the two closer than ever.

Episodes.Title: A Trip With Just the Two of Us?! No Way!
Episodes.Description: At the inn, Ajisai insists on paying the full bill, but Renako, wanting to split it “like friends,” challenges her to a game of ping-pong. They clash, grow a little closer... but Renako loses, and now the two of them are alone in a private hot spring. This isn't exactly normal “friend” distance, is it? Wait, why is this starting to feel kind of... steamy!?

Entries.Title: Devil May Cry
Entries.Description: When a mysterious villain threatens to open the gates of Hell, a devilishly handsome demon hunter could be the world's best hope for salvation.

Episodes.Title: Inferno
Episodes.Description: A violent heist at a Vatican City museum sparks chaos, pulling unsuspecting demon hunter Dante into a sinister plot to forge a rift between worlds.

Episodes.Title: Our Lady of Sorrows
Episodes.Description: In Washington, DARKCOM gathers a group of mercenaries and offers a bounty to bring in Dante — and the family heirloom that hangs around his neck.

Episodes.Title: The Deep and Savage Way
Episodes.Description: A flashback sheds light on Mary's past. In the present, a convoy with precious cargo hits a roadblock as the White Rabbit creeps closer to his prey.

Episodes.Title: All Hope Abandon
Episodes.Description: The amulet's signal leads DARKCOM to a run-down apartment building. But is it really the Rabbit's lair... or a trap? Dante learns his true origins.

Episodes.Title: Descent
Episodes.Description: Grim discoveries complicate Mary's mission. An exhilarating free fall fuels an epic transformation, forcing Dante to confront his demon side.

Episodes.Title: The First Circle
Episodes.Description: A revealing trip down the rabbit hole yields a haunting tale of two childhoods — parallel stories with intertwining fates.

Episodes.Title: At the Gates of Paradise
Episodes.Description: The stage is set for the ultimate showdown as the Rabbit and his army lie in wait for Dante to arrive. But there's more than one hero ready to fight.

Episodes.Title: A River of Blood and Fire
Episodes.Description: Dante and Mary face impossible choices — and an enemy more powerful than the world has ever seen. In the aftermath, Baines puts a bold plan into motion.

Entries.Title: Please Put Them On, Takamine-san
Entries.Description: Student council president Takane Takamine is a popular star student. On the other hand, Koushi Shirota doesn't have many friends. That all changes when Koushi accidentally discovers Takane's ability to go back in time and alter past actions just by changing her lingerie. After some pestering, Koushi agrees to help Takane and be her closet, by having spare lingerie on hand.

Episodes.Title: Become My Closet
Episodes.Description: Takamine is basically a goddess. Shirota is like an NPC, but he glimpses her bare breasts. Weirdness ensues...

Episodes.Title: Let Me Redo It Until I'm Satisfied.
Episodes.Description: It's Shirota's first day as Takamine's closet. How is he even supposed to pull off what she's asking of him?

Episodes.Title: I Want You to Enjoy the Very Best
Episodes.Description: Shirota learns how much effort Takamine has put in to be who she is. Later she helps him get first place.

Episodes.Title: Don't Be Dense, Be Sharp.
Episodes.Description: When Shirota gets sick, Takamine nurses him with surprising devotion, making him wonder if it means something.

Episodes.Title: I Want You to Make This Cat Purr, Meow.
Episodes.Description: Shirota is over at Takamine's place, but then the lightning knocks out the power and sends her into his arms.

Episodes.Title: Honey, Let Me Wash Your Back.
Episodes.Description: Takamine and Shirota roleplay newly-weds. She escalates things by joining him in the bath to wash his back.

Episodes.Title: Even That Which Isn't Visible From There
Episodes.Description: Takamine and Shirota talk about the future. When he says he's set on work, not college, she briefly looks sad.

Episodes.Title: You Two Seem Quite Intimate
Episodes.Description: Shirota runs into Ellie, a friend from grade school. They're hanging out in the park where Takamine sees them.

Episodes.Title: Let Me Do It!!
Episodes.Description: Takamine challenges Shirota to a water balloon fight, the loser has to obey the winner. What will it be?

Episodes.Title: It Rains, and Shirota Freezes Up
Episodes.Description: The class will put on the play Cinderella. Naturally, Takamine will be Cinderella, but who will be the prince?

Episodes.Title: I'll Let You Do a Dry Run
Episodes.Description: To calm Shirota's nerves, Takamine goes into the haunted house with him. It works, but now where is Ouji?

Episodes.Title: Only Look At Me
Episodes.Description: Can Shirota make it to the end of Cinderella without messing up? Near the end, something unexpected happens!

Entries.Title: Sword of the Demon Hunter
Entries.Description: Jinta journeys through a century-spanning epic, all while questioning why he wields a sword.

Episodes.Title: Demons and Humans
Episodes.Description: It is 1840, year 1 of Japan's Tenpo era. There lies a small village known as Kadono that is home to the siblings Jinta and Suzune. Jinta is quickly dispatched to slay demons.

Episodes.Title: The Demon's Daughter
Episodes.Description: Jinta changes his name to Jinya and departs Kadono. Ten years pass and he is now a ronin living in Edo, well-known by the locals as "the demon slayer."

Episodes.Title: The Devourer (1)
Episodes.Description: Three years have passed from the Nihonbashi incident. Jinya hears talk of street killings occurring near a soba shop. The number of dead don't match the number of missing.

Episodes.Title: The Devourer (2)
Episodes.Description: Jinya and Natsu get attacked by the slasher thought to be a demon. After Mosuke arrives to help and Jinya brandishes his blade, the demon quickly vanishes into the darkness.

Episodes.Title: The Garden of Happiness (1)
Episodes.Description: In the fall of 1853, a samurai by the name of Naotsugu Miura grows concerned about his missing brother. However, everyone insists that he doesn't have a brother.

Episodes.Title: The Garden of Happiness (2)
Episodes.Description: Jinya and Naotsugu witness a young girl losing her parents in a fire, which brings the unexpected truth of the mystery to light.

Episodes.Title: The Cursed Night of Kudanzaka
Episodes.Description: In the winter of 1853, Jinya is hired by Jyuuzou to investigate a demonic painting known as "the Ukiyo-e of Kudanzaka" that's said to be cursed.

Episodes.Title: Blossoming Dreams of the Kanzashi (1)
Episodes.Description: In the spring of 1854, rumors spread of a demon woman who kills men in the Yoshiwara redlight district. Jinya investigates.

Episodes.Title: Blossoming Dreams of the Kanzashi (2)
Episodes.Description: A man named Somegorou Akitsu gifts Natsu a hairpin then crosses paths with Jinya. Somegorou's spirit dogs attack Jinya and he must use his demon powers to defend himself.

Episodes.Title: Harlot in the Rain
Episodes.Description: In May of 1855, Naotsugu and a woman in a kimono catch sight of a man in the distance who looks different to both. Naotsugu sees his brother and the woman sees an old flame.

Episodes.Title: Drunken Dreams of Lingering Snow (1)
Episodes.Description: In winter of 1856, Zenji brings a liquor to the soba shop and it becomes immensely popular. However, Jinya finds something unsavory about it.

Episodes.Title: Drunken Dreams of Lingering Snow (2)
Episodes.Description: A series of violent incidents occur across Edo, all related to Yuki-no-Nagori. Worse yet, rumors of a woman with blonde hair send chills down Jinya's spine.

Episodes.Title: Drunken Dreams of Lingering Snow (3)
Episodes.Description: It turns out Yuki-no-Nagori is an evil drink. Jinya finds a demon calling out the name "Jinta". As they face off, Jinya suffers from the weakness of his own heart.

Episodes.Title: Embodiment of Jealousy
Episodes.Description: Back in the winter of 1839, when Jinya was still just Jinta, there were rumors of strange phenomena occurring near the Modori River. Byakuya orders Jinta to investigate.

Episodes.Title: Late Night Tales of Demonic Swords ~Hijin~
Episodes.Description: The year is 1862. The arrival of the Perry Expedition in Japan brings unrest into the cities. Jinya hears about a cursed sword called the "Yatonomori Kaneomi."

Episodes.Title: Logic of the Amanojaku
Episodes.Description: In July of 1863, Jinya hears rumors of a demon in Mizuho temple that devours humans. Upon visiting, Jinya comes across a silver-haired fox demon.

Episodes.Title: By the Sword
Episodes.Description: In March of 1864, a job comes to Jinya to slay a demon named Okada. Okada has become a crazed murderer willing to kill anyone from fellow samurai to women and children.

Episodes.Title: A Chat Over Tea
Episodes.Description: In September of 1867, Somegoro Akitsu leaves Kyoto with a tea set that he takes to Jinya. Akitsu wants to find someone who can use the set to conduct a tea ceremony.

Episodes.Title: Change
Episodes.Description: Jinya and his daughter, Nomari, enjoy peaceful days staying with Naotsugu and his family. However, time changes all things and their world faces a drastic transformation.

Episodes.Title: Wish (Part 1)
Episodes.Description: While engaged in a fierce battle with Tsuchiura, Jinya is forced to take on his demonic form, witnessed by both Naotsugu and Nomari.

Episodes.Title: Wish (Part 2)
Episodes.Description: Jinya and Tsuchiura face off during a heavy rainstorm. When Jinya's demon arm begins to throb, it sparks a resonance that allows them to experience each other's pasts.

Episodes.Title: Twin Shizuka
Episodes.Description: In April of 1872, Jinya departs Edo and now lives in Kyoto. He runs a soba shop on Sanjyo Street. One night, Jinya saves a girl named Himawari as she's surrounded by demons.

Entries.Title: From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman
