Entries.Description: Beryl Gardenant, a middle-aged swordsman running a dojo in the backwaters, lives a quiet life, until Allucia, former student and Commander of the Royal Order of Knights, appears! Beryl’s life is about to change dramatically! City life. Old students. New friends and formidable foes. It’s all too much. But after years of training, he has mad skills, and he’s been dubbed “the backwater swordmaster.”

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Goes to the Capital
Episodes.Description: Beryl Gardenant lives a quiet life running a dojo in the backwaters, until Allucia, his former student, appears with a new job for him – special instructor to the knights she commands! Beryl accepts the job, but Vice-Commander Henblitz doesn’t think he’s up to the task and challenges him to a duel.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Is Astounded by a Wizard
Episodes.Description: Allucia reminisces about her training with Beryl, and her resolve to have him instruct the knights hardens. While taking in the city sights with Curuni, Beryl meets up with Ficelle, another former student. She surprises him with her magic. But another wizard gives him even more of a surprise!

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Weathers a Fierce Attack
Episodes.Description: Former student and top-ranking adventurer Surena enlists Beryl’s help to train new adventurers. At the Adventurer’s Guild, Beryl ends up in a duel with her to prove he has what it takes for the job. He isn’t really happy with the turn of events, but Surena seems to feel differently.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Takes Flight With a Monster
Episodes.Description: To protect the new adventurers, Beryl faces off against a dangerous monster. Unlike other opponents, it acts on instinct, and he’s drawn into a ferocious battle, unable to get a read on its moves. Later on, he faces an encounter that will turn his future upside down.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets Enraged by the Bad Guys
Episodes.Description: Beryl encounters a pickpocket. Seeing the despair in her eyes, he confronts her in an attempt to get her to open up, but it’s not as easy as he thinks. With the help of Allucia and Lucy, he strives to help her free herself from the clutches of shadowy forces and the evil that binds her.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Faces the Dead
Episodes.Description: Someone is controlling the lowlifes taking advantage of Mewi behind the scenes. Religion and international relations come to the forefront, and with no ties that might cause an international incident, Beryl is asked to flush out the mastermind. New sword in hand, Beryl battles for Mewi’s future.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Learns the Challenges of Parenting
Episodes.Description: Beryl and Mewi start living in the house Lucy gave Beryl. Although unsure, Beryl works on becoming a parent figure for Mewi. When they find out that the magic institute Mewi is enrolled at has a student dormitory, Beryl wonders whether it is best for her to live with him, or on campus.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets Struck by a Lightning-Fast Sword
Episodes.Description: When a delegation from a neighboring country arrives, Allucia asks Beryl to help guard the VIPs, and he can’t refuse. Beryl needs the right clothes for the job, so he and Allucia go shopping. It’s just like a date! The next day, Allucia approaches Beryl with an offer.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Goes on His First Hunt in Ages
Episodes.Description: Mewi needs a new bag for school, so Beryl goes shopping. But he quickly realizes just how expensive bags can be! A job offer from Surena provides a means to make some extra cash, and he jumps at the chance. But he soon realizes – this job is one even high-ranking adventurers have never completed!

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Guards a Princess
Episodes.Description: The Vice Commander of the Holy Order of the Church of Sphene is Beryl’s former student, Rose, and he renews his ties with her. When the delegation arrives, Beryl is assigned to guard the two royal families as they tour the capital. But a shadow looms over what is supposed to be a joyous event.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Throws Himself into a Deadly Fight
Episodes.Description: Beryl helps protect the royal family from assassins, but the assassins all kill themselves, and any clues to the mastermind are lost. Lucy thinks a conflict between royalty and religion is at play. Despite Beryl wanting to cancel the tour of the capital to keep the prince safe, the plan goes ahead.

Episodes.Title: The Old Country Bumpkin Gets Praised as a Master Swordsman
Episodes.Description: It was Rose behind the flood of assassins. Beryl confronts her in an effort to find where her true intentions lie. Rose tells him, and the two draw their swords against each other. What will the outcome be in this battle between master and student?

Entries.Title: Chuhai Lips: Canned Flavor of Married Women
Entries.Description: The omnibus manga centers on college student Tsuyoshi, who loves drinking strong canned chu-hai, and his encounters with various married women.

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of My Strict Aunt's Lips
Episodes.Description: Tsuyoshi, a third-year college student, leads a lazy life drinking cheap and tasty canned chuhai. One day, his aunt, Yui Koriyama, who he has a soft spot for, pays him an unexpected visit.

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of a Sun-Kissed Gyaru's Lips
Episodes.Description: On a midsummer's day, Tsuyoshi heads to the convenience store to get chuhai, and reunites with Ai Natsuno, his junior from high school. Ai is now married, with a huge makeover as a sun-kissed gyaru, but acts like a spoiled child around Tsuyoshi, just like she used to.

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of a Married Club Senpai's Lips
Episodes.Description: Tsuyoshi starts an online drinking session with his two guy friends, and the college idol senpai, Miki Kanzaki. As Miki gets drunk from canned chuhai and exposes herself on screen, Tsuyoshi and the gang can't take their eyes off her.

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of My Russian Friend's Sister's Lips
Episodes.Description: Tsuyoshi goes round Joseph's house and meets his older sister and married Russian beauty, Anastasia. The three have canned chuhai, but Anastasia gets dead drunk and mistakes Tsuyoshi for her younger brother. He ends up taking care of her, but...

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of a Mysterious, Tanuki-Faced Married Woman's Lips
Episodes.Description: One night when Tsuyoshi was wandering around town with canned chuhai in his hand, he meets a wild tanuki, and gets led to a big mansion. There he meets a tanuki-faced beauty, Tamami Miyazawa, who gives him a warm reception, but for a certain reason...

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of a Baby-Faced, Cheeky Married Woman's Lips
Episodes.Description: By chance, Tsuyoshi ends up having a one-night stand with Nozomi Kuji, a married woman who looks too young for her age. Since then, they've become canned chuhai drinking buddies. In the midst of this, Nozomi vents out her frustration about her busty-loving hubby, and Tsuyoshi gets lectured on the appeal of small breasts...

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of an Otherworldly, Married Dark Elf's Lips
Episodes.Description: Tsuyoshi enters a parallel universe and saves a dark elf beauty, Symphis with the skill he gained from the chuhai god. Tsuyoshi gradually becomes drawn to Symphis as she talks about her husband, but something doesn't add up...

Episodes.Title: The Flavor of a Quiet Former Rebel, the Barbershop Owner's Lips
Episodes.Description: As Tsuyoshi goes to his regular barbershop, the quiet forty-odd beauty owner, Sari Kirihara, announces that the shop will be closing down. Tsuyoshi ends up drinking canned chuhai at Sari's house without the presence of her husband, but realizing her secret feelings, tries to snuggle up to her...

Entries.Title: Celestial Bonds
Entries.Description: A celestial warrior with no memory of a past battle teams up with her shape-shifting companion to solve a series of mysterious deaths.

Episodes.Title: Juanjuan Keeps the Land Safe, the Black Evil Bird Commits Crimes
The Mirage Wraith Appears Amidst the Search for Fireflies
The Black Spirit Bird Becomes a Celestial Pet, While Poor Caiqing Lies Buried in the Earth
Epiphyllum Blooms, Spiritual Bird Spreads Wings for Beauty
A Bloodthirsty Plague Breeds Madness, Lixiao's Healing Hands Win Him Fame
The Past Fades With the Wind, Only Hoping the Enemy Appears in Dreams
No Trace of the One Who Left, No Way to Forget Her Kindness
Unspoken Love, Rising Storm, Pressing Forward Through the Veil
Traded Blood for a Red Lotus—But No One Can Trade for You
A Thousand Searches, One Sudden Glance
Scheme All You Can, It Will Come to Naught
Into the Flames You Went, Across the Blades I'll Come

Entries.Title: Unexpectedly Naughty Fukami
Entries.Description: "Why is a perfect specimen of a man like me getting this turned on by a guy like that?!" Thus begins the obstinate relationship of a playboy narcissist and a deceivingly frumpily-dressed, hot bodied otaku!

Episodes.Title: A guy to suit Mr.Perfect
Episodes.Description: Kaji, the ace of the sales department, has a secret—he's gay. But dating apps have been a bust, and finding his ideal match seems impossible. Then, one day, he's sent on an overnight business trip with Fukami, a quiet, unassuming guy from the engineering team. At first, Kaji isn't impressed. But when he catches a glimpse of Fukami fresh out of the shower, he realizes—this guy is exactly his type! As they talk, they discover they have more in common than expected—including that they both like men. Could this be the start of something more?!

Episodes.Title: What's Your Game, Zero?!
Episodes.Description: After returning from the business trip, Fukami keeps ignoring Kaji. No one on the dating apps looks a good as Fukami, though! Then, one evening, the two wind up alone together at the office. Fukami tries to leave as if nothing happened, leaving Kaji to say some pretty unexpected things to secure a second date.

Episodes.Title: Fukami and... a Girl?!
Episodes.Description: Kaji consoles a coworker who discovers he'd been dating a married man, and then happens to spot Fukami out with a lady as well, shopping for a ring! The stunned Kaji decides to ask the people at IT if Fukami has a fiancee, only to learn Fukami has been out for the last three days. A concerned Kaji heads to Fukami's house...

Episodes.Title: Say My Name
Episodes.Description: Kaji gets back the smartphone he left at Fukami's place—with Fukami's contact details snuck inside the case! Wanting to see if his feelings are the real deal, Kaji sets a date with Fukami for drinks. On the day of, however, Kaji is caught up by how cute Fukumi is, and things take them back to Kaji's place...

Episodes.Title: I Won't Go Easy On You!
Episodes.Description: Kaji is shocked to see Fukami's new haicut. But Kaji isn't the only one in the office to notice what Fukami has to offer. In a mere three days, he'd gone from a zero to a total ladies' man. Kaji is both annoyed and compelled by Fukami's obliviousness at his own appeal. Seizing the initiative, he ties up Fukami with his necktie...!

Episodes.Title: Sorry, I've Got a Cold
Episodes.Description: After walking home in the pouring rain after being pushed away by Fukami, Kaji has caught a cold. He falls asleep regretting how he told Fukami "We should stop seeing each other for a while." Awakening to the sound of someone calling his name, he sees a worried Fukami peering back at him. Caught up in the shock, Kaji graps Fukamiu close for a kiss...

Episodes.Title: I Couldn't Help But Be Attracted
Episodes.Description: Kaji thought he didn't need love in his life, but meeting Fukami changed that, and so he refuses to just give in. After a simple honest mistake, Kaji's coworker tells him he's just fine without being perfect. Kaji wonders how those words might strike Fukami, and begins to reminisce about their times together...

Episodes.Title: Is It So Bad if I Fall in Love?
Episodes.Description: Kaji goes to see Fukami at the hospital only to be asked what relation he has to the patient. Tears begin to come as he searches for an answer. Realizing how important Fukami truly is to him, the man himself appears right behind him! The two proceed to clear up their miscommunication, and make progress toward to putting aside ill will...

Entries.Title: Marvel Zombies
Entries.Description: After the Avengers are overtaken by a zombie plague, a desperate group of survivors discover the key to bringing an end to the super-powered undead, racing across a dystopian landscape and risking life and limb to save their world.

Entries.Title: The All-Devouring Whale: Homecoming
Entries.Description: Fan Lingxiao, a spiritual pet master with exceptional talents, was plotted against during the Level-A sect promotion competition and was devoured by Kun, his own spiritual pet. When he opened his eyes again, he found himself reincarnated into a young man named “Liu Fengmang” and was imprisoned in the White Mansion’s dungeon. Meanwhile, his own sect, Lingxiao Pavilion, was in a perilous state. To uncover the truth of being devoured by Kun and revitalize his sect, Fan Lingxiao, accompanied by his existing spiritual pets, embarked on a brand-new adventure journey with Gu Ling, Cheng Xi, and Yue Tong.

Episodes.Title: If the Opponent is Strong, You Should Be Too

Entries.Title: Summer Pockets
Entries.Description: Hairi Takahara never expected summer to feel like a dream. Sent to Torishirojima to sort through his late grandmother's belongings, he's met with endless sea, quiet nostalgia, and mysterious girls, each chasing something just out of reach. As he settles into island life, lost memories begin to surface and he finds what he never knew he'd lost.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Torishirojima Island
Episodes.Description: A young boy with a wounded heart begins a new life on a quiet island.

Episodes.Title: Ways to Spend Your Summer Vacation
Episodes.Description: The boy with the broken wings begins to settle into life on a tropical island.

Episodes.Title: Pirate Ship and Girl
Episodes.Description: A mysterious chest is uncovered in the attic of a school.

Episodes.Title: One Summer's Treasure
Episodes.Description: The crew goes searching for keys to a treasure chest.

Episodes.Title: Higeneko Adventure
Episodes.Description: Hairi travels across the island in search of a pirate ship.

Episodes.Title: Across the Seven Seas
Episodes.Description: Hairi learns the story of the Higenekos.

Episodes.Title: The Lighthouse, the Song and the Girl
Episodes.Description: Hairi meets a girl sitting on a lighthouse. She is trying to find out what she wants to do.

Episodes.Title: Looking for Things to Do
Episodes.Description: Tsumugi decides to make a balcony on the lighthouse out of the empty Paringles cans she's been collecting.

Episodes.Title: Tsumugi and Tsumugi
Episodes.Description: Hairi and Shizuku look for Tsumugi, but Hairi ends up lost himself.

Episodes.Title: A Lifetime's Worth of Summer Breaks
Episodes.Description: Hairi gives Tsumugi a summer break she'll never forget.

Episodes.Title: The Summer Butterfly and the Night Girl
Episodes.Description: Hairi starts over at the island and meets a new girl.

Episodes.Title: Priestess of Sorakado
Episodes.Description: Hairi ignores Ao's warning not to come back into the mountain at night. As it turns out, it was for good reason.

Episodes.Title: A Pair of Butterflies
Episodes.Description: Ao continues her search for the butterfly she seeks.

Episodes.Title: Dawn Memories
Episodes.Description: Ao and Ai have a lot of catching up to do.

Episodes.Title: The Girl Who Forgot Summer Vacation
Episodes.Description: Hairi meets a lone girl on the island.

Episodes.Title: Not a Date
Episodes.Description: Hairi visits the main island and talks a little about his past.

Episodes.Title: Natsudori Ritual
Episodes.Description: Hairi and Shiroha need to make arrangements to prepare for the upcoming ritual. Shiroha's visions become clearer.

Episodes.Title: One More Summer Vacation
Episodes.Description: Hairi tries to grant Umi's wish.

Episodes.Title: Magic Picture Diary
Episodes.Description: Umi's true hopes for summer vacation are revealed.

Entries.Title: Eyes of Wakanda
Entries.Description: Follow the adventures of brave Wakandan warriors throughout history in this globe-trotting adventure, where they must carry out dangerous missions to retrieve Vibranium artifacts from the enemies of Wakanda. They are the Hatut Zaraze and this is their story.

Episodes.Title: Into the Lion's Den
Episodes.Description: A former member of the Dora Milaje is sent to take down a rogue Wakandan known as The Lion.

Episodes.Title: Legends and Lies
Episodes.Description: Amidst the Trojan War, a soldier attempts to breach the city's defenses to retrieve an artifact.

Episodes.Title: Lost and Found
Episodes.Description: A powerful stowaway infiltrates the Golden City and threatens the secrets kept within.

Episodes.Title: The Last Panther
Episodes.Description: Two Wakandans must choose to complete their mission or defy their homeland and save their world.

Entries.Title: April Showers Bring May Flowers
Entries.Description: Pessimistic high school student Hana Tabata doesn't believe her life could ever be like that of a heroine from the shoujo manga she reads—she's convinced she's ugly, and she's always alone. Still, she can't help but imagine herself as a leading lady when she's changing out flowers early one morning...until she's caught in the act by her handsome classmate Yousuke Ueno! Hana can't wrap her head around his kind words at first, but as they grow closer, she finds her life slowly beginning to change…

Episodes.Title: How to Act as an Extra
Ugly Girl and Flower on a High Peak
The Only Day in a Year to Become the Main Cast
I Want to Watch Fireworks With You
The Sweet and Spicy Stormy Area

Entries.Title: The Shy Hero and the Assassin Princesses
Entries.Description: The hero Toto has talent, but his shyness has prevented him from forming a party. As he languishes in the town of origins, three beautiful women—Ciel, Anemone, and Goa—invite Toto to join their party out of the blue. Toto gears up to begin the journey, but unbeknownst to him, all three women are plotting to kill him for their own reasons!

Episodes.Title: The Shy Hero and the Three Princesses
Episodes.Description: Toto is a hero, but very shy, and three assassins have him in their sights.

Episodes.Title: The Shy Hero and the First Adventure
Episodes.Description: Toto, Ciel, Anemone, and Goa officially form a party and take on their first quest.

Episodes.Title: The Shy Hero and the Lovers' Rendezvous
Episodes.Description: Goa and Anemone each make attempts on Toto's life, while Ciel seeks out high quality sweets.

Episodes.Title: The Shy Hero and The Promotion Quest
Episodes.Description: Toto and the assassins have earned the right to test for their next adventurer rank by clearing a dungeon.

Episodes.Title: The Shy Hero and Independence
Episodes.Description: Ciel is faced with an ultimatum: kill Toto or be taken back to the Demon Lord's castle for more training.

Episodes.Title: The Shy Hero and the Costumed Princesses
Episodes.Description: Toto and his party make their first long distance journey on their quest.

Episodes.Title: The Shy Hero and the Town of Mad Love
Episodes.Description: Toto and his party arrive in a town where love is in the air, to a disturbing degree.

Episodes.Title: The Shy Hero and the Witch of Hypnosis
Episodes.Description: Anemone has fallen under hypnosis and wastes no time in attacking Ciel and Goa.

Episodes.Title: The Shy Hero and Wrestling on the Water
Episodes.Description: Toto's party arrives at a seaside town where they enter a local competition.

Episodes.Title: The Shy Hero and The Demons
Episodes.Description: The truth about Fresnir and Coshta leaves Toto new perspective to consider.

Entries.Title: Umamusume: Cinderella Gray
Entries.Description: Unbeknownst to those around her, the staggering potential of this ashen-haired “Beast” will soon catapult her to the national stage—and down the path of a legend. Follow her journey as the gates open on this hot-blooded Cinderella story!

Episodes.Title: I'm Here
Episodes.Description: Nestled in the sleepy countryside lies Kasamatsu Tracen Academy. Jo Kitahara, a trainer, can't help but bemoan the state of regional races compared to the star-studded national scene. But one day, as he passively watches the newest batch of racers practice, he spots an ashen-haired Umamusume. After seeing her stunning racing form, Jo Kitahara is convinced—at long last, he's found a star.

Episodes.Title: Let Me Race
Episodes.Description: Oguri Cap and Belno Light are officially scouted by Jo Kitahara. Seeing as a racer needs to belong to a team in order to race, Oguri Cap accepts and begins training for her debut race. When the day arrives, she finds the student hailed as their generation's ace—Fujimasa March—waiting for her...

Episodes.Title: View from the Top
Episodes.Description: Up until now, Oguri Cap has simply run because she can, but after her heated race with Fujimasa March, her heart wells with a new, bitter emotion. As Oguri Cap and her team ensure she's properly prepared for her next race, another opponent shows her face: Norn Ace. Annoyed by Oguri Cap, Norn Ace's friends propose a certain "strategy" to her...

Episodes.Title: The Junior Crown
Episodes.Description: The day of the Junior Crown is here, and Oguri Cap and Fujimasa March make good on the promise they made at Mt. Kinka to enter. While Oguri Cap had no answer when Fujimasa March asked her for her goal back then, her aspirations will surely take shape during this race with her rival.

Episodes.Title: What's Best for Her
Episodes.Description: Oguri Cap and the rest of her team make their way to Chukyo Racecourse for the Chukyo Hai, but Kitahara can't shake Musaka's ominous words from his mind. Brows furrowed, he heads for the stands, only to discover Symboli Rudolf and Maruzensky have come to observe the race.

Episodes.Title: The Beast
Episodes.Description: After Symboli Rudolf offers his trainee a place in the Twinkle Series, Kitahara approaches a reluctant Oguri Cap with a wager—if she wins the Gold Junior, she'll transfer to the nationals; otherwise, they'll aim for the Tokai Derby. As she heads into the race, Oguri Cap remains conflicted. She wants to give her all in her long-awaited battle against March, but...

Episodes.Title: Tracen Academy
Episodes.Description: Musaka gives Tracen Academy's two newest students—Oguri Cap and Belno Light—a tour of the expansive campus. Afterwards, Oguri Cap comes face to face with her new classmates—and potential rivals. As class begins, the teacher explains the goal of many of her contemporaries, the G1 Classic Triple Crown. There's just one problem...

Episodes.Title: The Right Stuff
Episodes.Description: Oguri Cap's transfer from Kasamatsu has unfortunately overlapped with the registration deadline for the Classic races. Eager to show Symboli Rudolf she has what it takes to take on these races, she sets her sights on the G3 Pegasus Stakes. But standing in her way is a racer with four consecutive wins under her belt...

Episodes.Title: The Japanese Derby
Episodes.Description: Symboli Rudolf witnesses Oguri Cap's might firsthand—the no-name racer from the boonies wipes the floor with even the strong national racers. In her, Symboli Rudolf sees a star capable of setting the Twinkle Series alight. But should she use her authority to advocate for a miracle at the Japan Derby, or should she remain loyal to the rules?

Episodes.Title: The Peak
Episodes.Description: Ultimately, Oguri Cap is unable to enter the Japanese Derby, which means she needs a new racing goal. Hoping to inspire Oguri Cap, Musaka takes her and Belno Light to see the Takarazuka Kinen, a Grand Prix race where the lineup is decided by a fan poll. There, Oguri Cap witnesses the racer currently dominating the Twinkle Series.

Episodes.Title: The Star of Kasamatsu
Episodes.Description: Musaka declares that if Oguri Cap wants to take on Tamamo Cross in the fall Tenno Sho, she has to win the Mainichi Okan. A task easier said than done, as Oguri Cap's winning streak means all her rivals' eyes are on her. This year's Mainichi Okan is shaping up to be a ten-versus-one race...

Episodes.Title: The Fall Tenno Sho
Episodes.Description: At last, the day of the fall Tenno Sho arrives, and with it, the first clash between the two ashen-haired Umamusume, Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap. Hoping to surpass the top racer and become the best in all of Japan, Oguri Cap steps onto the turf. Although Tamamo Cross holds a similar dream, there's a special someone in her heart as she enters the course.

Episodes.Title: Japan's Best
Episodes.Description: The crowd is on the edge of their seats as the racers enter the homestretch of the fall Tenno Sho. With 400 meters remaining, each runner musters the last of their strength. With Oguri Cap right on her tail, Tamamo Cross begins to feel the pressure. As exhaustion creeps in, her past flashes before her eyes. Her loved ones in her heart, Tamamo Cross breaks past her limits and enters a zone beyond her rivals...

Entries.Title: The Wonderfully Weird World of Gumball
Entries.Description: Welcome back to Elmore, where the laws of reality are a joke, and family life is anything but ordinary. Whether he's battling an evil fast-food empire, facing off against a sentient AI in love with his mom, or trying to stop Banana Joe from wearing pants — Gumball Watterson drags his brother Darwin, sister Anais, and the rest of the town of Elmore along for the ride. With even wilder stories, bigger twists, and surreal humor, the show is so amazing that they had to rename it!

Episodes.Title: The Burger
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin want to find a healthy dinner option for their family because they are hooked on Joyful Burger, but an evil food consortium has monopolized the food industry.

Episodes.Title: The Assistant
Episodes.Description: Feeling unappreciated by her family, Nicole strikes up a friendship with a sympathetic Al. As their relationship intensifies, the Al tries to drive a wedge between Nicole and the other Wattersons.

Episodes.Title: The Distance
Episodes.Description: Gumball must find a way to save his relationship with Darwin after the boys are forced to live in separate rooms.

Episodes.Title: The Thing
Episodes.Description: Richard must retrace the memories of his day in order to figure out what "the thing" is, so Nicole's family dinner with Granny Jo Jo won't be another epic failure.

Episodes.Title: The Butts
Episodes.Description: Gumball must help Principal Brown have body confidence about his butt in order to be allowed to do his poem about butts at the Poetry Recital.

Episodes.Title: The Traffic
Episodes.Description: The Wattersons must get Anais to Daisyland before the park closes for good.

Episodes.Title: The Astrological
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Penny must stay together through the end of the school day to prove that they are meant to be together, despite an astrological prediction Mr. Small has made.

Episodes.Title: The Cheerleader
Episodes.Description: Gumball wants to get Richard on the cheerleading team in order to end their family's generational trauma.

Episodes.Title: The Boring
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin use Molly's time-halting power (because she's so boring) to avoid an after school beatdown by Tina.

Episodes.Title: The Teacher
Episodes.Description: Gumball wants to take down Miss Simian after she punishes him for not respecting his school-provided calculator.

Episodes.Title: The App
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin must stop an evil social media app from turning every kid in Elmore into mindless internet-trend-following drones.

Episodes.Title: The Entrance
Episodes.Description: Gumball and Darwin attempt to make a big impression at the coolest party of the year with the most praise-worthy entrance the world has ever seen.

Episodes.Title: The Letter
Episodes.Description: Darwin wants to get back a love letter he wrote to Carrie before she sees it.

Episodes.Title: The Gut
Episodes.Description: When Anais enlists her dad's help with her science project, Richard's GUT becomes its own brilliant thinking entity, separate from the original Richard we all know, and Anais must choose between the two.

Episodes.Title: The Wrinkle
Episodes.Description: Anais starts aging prematurely due to the stress and pressure of looking out for the rest of her stupid family.

Episodes.Title: The Gourmet
Episodes.Description: After tasting Masami's gourmet, double-truffle mac-n-cheese at lunch, Gumball decides to do whatever it takes to get a full serving of the delicious meal.

Episodes.Title: The Pool
Episodes.Description: In the midst of a heatwave, Richard enlists Gumball, Darwin and Anais to assist him in his mission to jump in the Robinson's newly-installed above ground pool.

Episodes.Title: The Portrait
Episodes.Description: Nicole wants a new family portrait where everyone's entire face is in the photo and they're all smiling.

Episodes.Title: The Climb
Episodes.Description: Gumball must face his demons and overcome an embarrassing incident from his past if he wants to finally summit the dreaded rock-climbing wall in gym class.

Episodes.Title: The Amadain
Episodes.Description: Gumball vows to wear a shell and partake in strange Fitzgerald traditions, in order to help Penny get through a tense family birthday party with ease.

Entries.Title: Lazarus
Entries.Description: In 2052, a Nobel Prize-winning neuroscientist develops a drug called Hapna — a cure-all that has the unexpected side-effect of causing death three years later. In response to this threat, a special force of agents—nicknamed "Lazarus"— is assembled to take on the malevolent Skinner.

Episodes.Title: Goodbye Cruel World
Episodes.Description: The miracle drug, Hapna, now threatens to wipe out humanity. A chronic jail-breaker named Axel is asked to find the only man with a cure: Dr. Skinner.

Episodes.Title: Life in the Fast Lane
Episodes.Description: Genius hacker Eleina finds a potential lead to Skinner. The Lazarus team splits into two groups to investigate it, but both end up getting shot at.

Episodes.Title: Long Way from Home
Episodes.Description: Searching Skinner's house and interviewing his old colleague reveals a new lead. Axel and Leland go to Istanbul but have trouble with local thugs.

Episodes.Title: Don't Stop the Dance
Episodes.Description: The team investigates a club owned by a stockbroker who got rich off Hapna. One of his associates is the hacker Dr. 909, who may be helping Skinner.

Episodes.Title: Pretty Vacant
Episodes.Description: The team tries to lure Skinner out of hiding with a fake cure staged by the president of Delta Medicinal, but a hacker named Popcorn Wizard butts in.

Episodes.Title: Heaven Is a Place on Earth
Episodes.Description: A secluded commune where Eleina once lived is identified as a potential hiding spot for Skinner. She and Leland infiltrate it to find out for sure.

Episodes.Title: Almost Blue
Episodes.Description: Coordinates from an AI lead to islands that Skinner bought just before they sunk under rising sea levels. The team visit them hoping to learn more.

Episodes.Title: Unforgettable Fire
Episodes.Description: Chris is held captive on an arctic oil rig by Russian operatives. The team unites to save her, despite learning Chris was once a Russian spy herself.

Episodes.Title: Death on Two Legs
Episodes.Description: An inquiry is held at the Pentagon to determine the future of Lazarus where information emerges that prompts Schneider of INSCOM to hire an assassin.

Episodes.Title: I Can't Tell You Why
Episodes.Description: Skinner's medical history provides a lead but requires entry to a private clinic. Leland takes Axel and Doug to his home to secure them an invite.

Episodes.Title: Runnin' with the Devil
Episodes.Description: Doug and Eleina go to Islamabad seeking the elusive hacker but are pursued by INSCOM. Meanwhile, Axel gets into a chaotic fight with the assassin.

Episodes.Title: Close to the Edge
Episodes.Description: Eleina gets a lead to Skinner from Popcorn Wizard, but with Hersch, Axel, and Doug out of commission, it's up to Chris and Leland to crack the case.

Episodes.Title: The World Is Yours
Episodes.Description: Abel conducts a raid to free Hersch, while Axel sneaks off to face his nemesis. The rest of the team pursues Skinner in a final bid to save humanity.

Entries.Title: Over the Divine Realms
Entries.Description: Six days and nights, a strange case, and a boy who returns to twelve years ago. Can he break the shackles of the land this time?

Entries.Title: Uglymug, Epicfighter
Entries.Description: After a false accusation, Shigeru Yoshioka becomes an unemployed recluse. By choosing to remain ugly in another world, Shigeru gains higher status. He begins his second life as an absolute god with cheat-level stats. At first, Shigeru tags along with Seika, Seiji, and Leeds, but due to a weakness caused by direct contact with a girl, he considers breaking away from the party. However…

Episodes.Title: An Epicgod is Born
Episodes.Description: Shigeru Yoshioka is a very ugly man who tries to reincarnate in another world, disgusted with life.

Episodes.Title: Exploring Epic Dungeon
Episodes.Description: Shigeru and his group spend their first day in the city and set out to explore their first dungeon.

Episodes.Title: Hero's Epic Burning
Episodes.Description: After his transformation, Seiji is determined to take down Kyoshiro's band of bandits.

Episodes.Title: One-Arm Epic Danger
Episodes.Description: Shigeru's group heads to Valleria, but they decide to camp halfway to rest.

Episodes.Title: Epic Angel Descends
Episodes.Description: Shigeru and Reeze stop Reia from hurting Seika. Then, Seika transforms into an angel to help Reia.

Episodes.Title: Epic Undercover Mission
Episodes.Description: In Valleria, the party goes to a casino. Then, the hall master Kajita invites Seika to join the Extra Stage.

Episodes.Title: Villainous Epic Master
Episodes.Description: Shigeru and Seika reach the Extra Stage of the casino to uncover Kajita’s “Liberation plan.”

Episodes.Title: Epic Colosseum Showdown
Episodes.Description: Shigeru and the team barge into the battlefield, where they find out Kajita’s terrifying power.

Episodes.Title: Starting an Epic Company
Episodes.Description: Shigeru’s mind is on Karina and Ordnung Spear. Then, a man who looks like Shigeru’s former boss appears.

Episodes.Title: Bewitching Epic Lady
Episodes.Description: Leah, a mysterious applicant to Vis Bridge, seems to be connected to Shigeru’s past as well as Ordnung Spear.

Entries.Title: Takopi's Original Sin
Entries.Description: A Happy alien, Takopi, lands on Earth with one mission: to spread happiness! When he meets Shizuka, a lonely fourth grader, he vows to bring back her smile using his magical Happy Gadgets. But as he uncovers the pain in her life, Takopi learns that true happiness may require more than gadgets.

Episodes.Title: To You in 2016
Episodes.Description: Shizuka lives a painful life until things start to take a sudden turn when she meets an alien named Takopi.

Episodes.Title: Takopi's Salvation
Episodes.Description: Takopi makes various attempts to help Shizuka, but things don't seem to work in his favor.

Episodes.Title: Takopi's Confession
Episodes.Description: Takopi realizes something important while covering up the crime with Shizuka and Naoki.

Episodes.Title: Azuma-kun's Salvation
Episodes.Description: Naoki struggles between his conscience and his desire to help Shizuka.

Episodes.Title: To You in 2022
Episodes.Description: Shizuka goes to Tokyo, and Takopi remembers something very important that happened in the past.

Episodes.Title: To All of You in 2016
Episodes.Description: Takopi makes an important decision that will save not only Shizuka but also Marina and Naoki.

Entries.Title: Welcome to the Outcast's Restaurant!
Entries.Description: When superstar adventurer Dennis gets booted from the world’s strongest party, he teams up with runaway Atelier to serve up his true passion—delicious cuisine. But this not-so-average eatery has not-so-average patrons. Dennis will battle his quirky customers’ troubles with his trusty butcher knife and wok. Visit Adventurer’s Restaurant and fill up your heart and stomach!

Episodes.Title: You Are Free
Episodes.Description: Dennis, cast out of a top-tier adventuring party, decides to follow his dreams and open his own restaurant.

Episodes.Title: It's Crazy Delicious!
Episodes.Description: The Adventurer's Restaurant is open at last, and their first customer is...someone wearing full plate armor?!

Episodes.Title: That's an Adventurer!
Episodes.Description: A boy named Vivia comes to the restaurant. He's been cast out of his party, so he may deign to join a new one.

Episodes.Title: Then, I'll Have the Daily Special
Episodes.Description: Bachel has been thoroughly ground down by her crushing workload. Then another scolding pushes her to the edge.

Episodes.Title: It's Too Soon for a Marriage Proposal!
Episodes.Description: The restaurant is booming, but Dennis is worried about Atelier! Katie approaches Dennis with a request.

Episodes.Title: I've Come for Lady Atelier
Episodes.Description: The Workstatt family butler arrives to retrieve Atelier. He tells Dennis and the others of her tragic past.

Episodes.Title: Get Better Soon
Episodes.Description: The restaurant is packed, but Dennis falls ill. As he dreams of his youth, the others try to cook for him.

Episodes.Title: Today, We Are Closed for Business Reasons
Episodes.Description: It's a cause for celebration as three of the regulars at the restaurant have acquired new jobs. While the group soaks in the hot springs and enjoys some barbecue, a shadow lurks around the temporarily closed establishment.

Episodes.Title: If It's Important to You, Then Please Don't Let Go of It!
Episodes.Description: Dennis and Atelier decide to leave town to protect their friends, but familiar figures block their way.

Episodes.Title: The Higher and Further Away a Place Is, the More I Aim to Reach It
Episodes.Description: Dennis and the others continue preparing for battle. Vigo thinks back on what he's done to get this far.

Entries.Title: YAIBA: Samurai Legend
Entries.Description: Yaiba's journey to becoming a true samurai takes him from his home in the forest to a bustling city full of rivals, friends and ancient powers.

Episodes.Title: Meeting Yaiba
Episodes.Description: Yaiba Kurogane is determined to become a true samurai, but things take an odd turn in the jungle.

Episodes.Title: Fujinken Reborn
Episodes.Description: Yaiba has come up with a plan and is willing to do nearly anything to provoke Onimaru to a duel.

Episodes.Title: Another Maken
Episodes.Description: Onimaru now wants to fight Yaiba, but something's off, not least the horns sprouting from his head.

Episodes.Title: Attack of the Eight Ogres
Episodes.Description: Yaiba has the Raijinken but it's the Thunder God that turns the tables on him. Then there's Onimaru.

Episodes.Title: Onsen Fun
Episodes.Description: Yaiba et al. head to Ganryu Island to learn about an arcane maken but end up at a shady hot spring.

Episodes.Title: The Unexpected Mr. Bat
Episodes.Description: Yaiba and crew are back on track but stop in Nagoya where there's more in store than great food.

Episodes.Title: Kojiro Resurrected
Episodes.Description: Yaiba and his companions finally reach Ganryujima, where they encounter Mr. Spider — and a resurrected, but somewhat peeved, Sasaki Kojiro.

Episodes.Title: The Duel at Ganryu Island
Episodes.Description: Musashi and Kojiro's duel must proceed as recorded so Yaiba can return to his original time, but Yaiba's careless comment threatens to change history.

Episodes.Title: Dawn of the Lightning Slash
Episodes.Description: Needing to develop a new sword technique that can counter Onimaru, Yaiba undergoes further grueling training with Musashi — and a scheming Kojiro.

Episodes.Title: Onimaru's Devil Kings
Episodes.Description: Yaiba and his companions storm Onimaru Castle, but they fall through a trap into the depths of the stronghold and face Onimaru's new henchmen.

Episodes.Title: Raijinken vs. Fujinken
Episodes.Description: While Yaiba rides high, Onimaru tempts the young hero. And in pure Yaiba fashion, eyebrows rise.

Episodes.Title: Nadeshiko Yamoto Is Calling
Episodes.Description: A showdown's heating up between Yaiba and Onimaru, but the neighborhood rumor mill is even hotter.

Episodes.Title: Find the Dragon God Orb
Episodes.Description: Yaiba and team learn of an orb that promises gravity-defying powers. But an undead assassin awaits...

Episodes.Title: The Rise of Ninja Kotaro!
Episodes.Description: Lake Biwa's orb surprises, but it's Shikoku's Mt. Tsurugi that hides a shadowy and dangerous threat.

Episodes.Title: Showdown! Magician vs. Yaiba
Episodes.Description: Team Yaiba may have secured the Gold Orb on Shikoku, but it's on to Kyushu, and on Yaiba's back.

Episodes.Title: A Battle of Giants
Episodes.Description: Troupe Yaiba traipses to Nara for a pivotal tip-off, but it's an odd traveling warrior who shows up.

Episodes.Title: The Man of Yagyu Shinkage-ryu
Episodes.Description: Yaiba battles Goemon using the Orb of Giants only to lose two of the spheres to the villain's guile.

Episodes.Title: Crisis on Kawanaka-Jima
Episodes.Description: Jubei's giving Yaiba and team a fighting chance, but that's before they meet the ninja army

Episodes.Title: Darkness Orb Escape Training
Episodes.Description: Team Yaiba unmasks the true nature of the mysterious orb seized from Goemon, and it’s unlike anything the travelers have encountered before. This time, aspirations are a liability. Is this new realm a dream come true? Or is it a nightmare about to unfurl?

Episodes.Title: The Ruse of Basho the Monkey
Episodes.Description: The team is eager to grab the illusive final prize, but a decrepit temple and old man stand defiant.

Episodes.Title: Mystery Atop Mt. Fuji
Episodes.Description: An off-the-wall sphere guides Yaiba to Mt. Fuji to find the elusive and perilous Dragon God Orb.

Entries.Title: Private Tutor to the Duke's Daughter
Entries.Description: After Allen failed the court sorcerer exam, he couldn't return home even if he wanted to. While searching for a job, an unexpected offer comes his way to be the private tutor of the duke's daughter. Just as he lowers his guard, he faces a girl who can't use magic at all! But what is preventing her magic from working? Allen's unconventional lessons gently shine a light on the girl's future.

Episodes.Title: The Duke's Magically Impaired Daughter
Episodes.Description: Barred from his dream job, a young sorcerer leaps at a suspiciously generous offer.

Episodes.Title: That Which Rejects
Episodes.Description: Ellie's talents bloom, but despite Allen's best efforts, Tina has yet to manage a single spell.

Episodes.Title: In the Wake of Tears, Flowers Bloom
Episodes.Description: Tina loses control, calling up an ice storm that threatens Allen and herself.

Episodes.Title: The Final Exam
Episodes.Description: Tina and Ellie train for the duke's challenge, but do they stand a chance against a full-fledged sorcerer?

Episodes.Title: The Royal Academy at Last (1)
Episodes.Description: Tina and Ellie take their entrance exams while Allen renews old acquaintances.

Episodes.Title: The Royal Academy at Last (2)
Episodes.Description: Lydia kicks off her court sorceress career by picking a fight with a prince, and Allen rushes to intervene.

Episodes.Title: Extracurricular Lessons at a Hot Spring
Imitation
Episodes.Description: Prince Gerard storms into the academy. The girls have come a long way, but can they fend off a grown knight?

Episodes.Title: A Lightless Road
Episodes.Description: The danger has passed, but mysteries remain. And Stella's inner demons have only grown stronger.

Episodes.Title: Felicia's Decision
Episodes.Description: Felicia gets a shock when her father fails Allen's interview to do business with the ducal houses.

Entries.Title: Hell Teacher: Jigoku Sensei Nube
Entries.Description: A number of inexplicable phenomena have been plaguing the town of Domori. In order to protect the town's children, a new homeroom teacher known as “Nube” arrives. Normally gentle and a bit outgoing, Nube has a secret side: he is, in fact, the only psychic teacher in Japan. Rumor also has it his left hand is possessed by a demon! Hell's messenger of justice is here to take on the school's seven mysteries, ghosts, and evil spirits attacking his students.

Episodes.Title: The 99-Legged Bug
Episodes.Description: The town of Domori may be plagued by mysterious phenomena, but things are not going well for Class 5-3's new homeroom teacher Meisuke Nueno, either. Right from the start, Nueno, or "Nube" for short, becomes the target of fifth-grader Hiroshi's bursts of rage. After witnessing something bizarre, Nueno suspects there may be an otherworldly reason behind Hiroshi's sudden personality change.

Episodes.Title: Rampage of the Fox Demon
Episodes.Description: Nueno uses his ultimate weapon Demon Hand to exorcise the Yokai possessing Hiroshi. But suddenly, the mysterious and handsome Tamamo appears, kidnapping Hiroshi right before Nueno's eyes! As Nueno gives chase, Tamamo makes preparations throughout town for an unknown ritual. Just why did he kidnap Hiroshi, and what is his true identity?

Episodes.Title: The Midnight Honor Student
Episodes.Description: An unsettling shadow appears in the school in the dead of night. It's rumored that an honor student is erasing blackboards, replacing flowers of flower vases, and cleaning the rabbit cages when there should be no one there. To get to the truth of the matter, Hiroshi and his friends sneak into the school, only to encounter a voice in the dark saying, "Let's be friends!"

Episodes.Title: The Rokurokubi
Episodes.Description: After witnessing Nueno's amazing power, Miki becomes obsessed with gaining psychic abilities. She even tries to train while sleeping. When her efforts produce an unusual result, she joyfully celebrates her success. However, her friends are far from impressed. In fact, they are scared of what Miki has become.

Episodes.Title: Hatamonba's Curse
Episodes.Description: Katsuya will do anything to make his sister Manami happy, even if it means he has to run around borrowing money. That is how he unwittingly falls victim to the evil spirit Hatamonba's trap. When he realizes Hatemonba's deadly blade is not only pointing at his own neck, but also his sister's, he runs to Nueno for help. However, Hatamonba's sword appears to be mightier than Nueno's Demon Hand.

Episodes.Title: The Teketeke Ghost
Episodes.Description: Fear grips Makoto after he hears about Teketeke, the spirit of a girl who lost her lower body in a railway accident. According to the story, now she wanders the world in search of new legs. Makoto grows desperate for help upon learning that the spirit is coming for him within three days. However, Nueno urges him to forget everything, insisting that Teketeke is nothing more than a myth.

Episodes.Title: The Unseasonable Yuki-onna
Episodes.Description: As unseasonable snow blankets the town of Domori, a beautiful young woman appears before Nueno. Her name is Yukime, and she has come to fulfill a promise she made to him five years ago. Excited by their teacher's improbable romance, Nueno's students sneakily tag along on their date, only to witness Yukime's frosty intentions.

Episodes.Title: Great Inventions and Spirit World Communicators
Episodes.Description: Young inventor Akira finds a broken tablet and becomes even more obsessed with building great machines, as if he is possessed by something. One day, Akira announces he can bring the dead back to life, scaring his friends. Nueno senses something is wrong and investigates Akira's inventions, when he notices something strange within Akira's tablet...

Episodes.Title: The Girl Who Brings Happiness
Episodes.Description: One day, Nube meets a little girl in town. She is a Zashiki Warashi, a spirit that brings good fortune to people. The Zashiki Warashi becomes attached to Nube and follows him to school. From that day on, unexpected good fortune begins to befall his classmates one after another. However, as he sees how the students in his class gradually forget about hard work and start relying on good fortune, Nube finds it difficult to say goodbye to the Zashiki Warashi, but...

Entries.Title: Kakushite! Makina-san!!
Entries.Description: Eita, a mechanical otaku, discovers that Makina, the school idol he's secretly liked, is actually a robot built for sexual purposes. Now, he must navigate her bold advances while helping her keep her identity hidden in this chaotic romantic comedy.

Episodes.Title: Makina Is Discovered as a Robot
Episodes.Description:
Eita Akutsu is a gloomy, friendless, and virgin mechanical otaku. Even someone like him has a girl he admires—Makina Agatsuma, the popular and glamorous “gyaru.”

One night, as Eita returns to his lonely apartment, he finds none other than Makina crouching in front of his doorway...

Episodes.Title: Makina Is in My Room
Episodes.Description: Makina Agatsuma is actually an AI robot created to captivate men. She immediately sets her sights on seducing Eita Akutsu to make him her pawn. However, Eita is extremely uncomfortable with anything sexual. On top of that, Makina herself is restricted from accessing sexual content due to limitations in her programming...

Episodes.Title: Makina Bathes with a Guy
Episodes.Description: Makina, armed with inaccurate knowledge about sex, tries to seduce Eita. However, Eita, inexperienced with girls, is too busy awkwardly trying to be considerate. Sensing a lack of progress, Makina, under the pretense of taking care of him, barges into the bathroom while Eita is taking a shower.

Episodes.Title: Makina Gets a Uniform
Episodes.Description: Eita Akutsu begins living together with Makina Agatsuma to help her maintain a normal life without revealing her true identity. Carefully avoiding the watchful eyes of their landlady, the two head to a park where Eita’s close friend Mamimi is waiting. There, they’ve arranged to receive a hand-me-down school uniform for Makina.

Episodes.Title: Thus, Makina Can No Longer Hide
Episodes.Description: Having returned to school life, Makina slips on a banana peel and falls. Eita can’t stop worrying that her malfunctioning left leg might fall off at any moment. Seeing his anxious behavior, Mamimi becomes convinced that he must be a dangerous stalker targeting Makina…

Episodes.Title: Thus, Makina Is Taken
Episodes.Description: Makina, whose mechanical identity must remain a secret, frantically calls Mamimi from her apartment to explain away the commotion caused at school. During the call, she starts making odd sounds due to Eita's ongoing maintenance, but somehow manages to keep her cover until the end. Just as things settle down, a mysterious girl suddenly appears at their apartment...

Episodes.Title: Thus, the Sisters Swap Places
Episodes.Description: Makina loses her body to her younger sister robot, Mimika. According to Makina, Mimika is an agent-type robot skilled at pretending to be fragile in order to manipulate others emotionally. To track down the now-missing Mimika, Eita proposes a strategy only a true mecha geek could devise.

Episodes.Title: Thus, Makina Becomes a Ghost Story
Episodes.Description: Shrunken down to a tiny size, Makina finds herself in a tense face-off with a now gigantic Mimika. However, she’s unable to make a move—Eita is being held hostage. Mimika threatens Eita, demanding that he perform maintenance on her. As Eita trembles in fear, Makina reveals a secret plan for a dramatic comeback.

Episodes.Title: Thus, Makina Shares a Kiss
Episodes.Description: After her dramatic comeback victory, Makina points her weapon at Mimika, intending to destroy her. Eita rushes to stop her, revealing his soft-hearted nature. Sensing this, Mimika cunningly seizes the opportunity and shows her true shrewd self. Moved by her act, Eita ends up agreeing to live together with Mimika. Seeing this, Makina becomes jealous and sulks...

Episodes.Title: Thus, the Weapon Awakens
Episodes.Description: Eita continues repairing Makina’s fragile left leg, but thanks to Mimika’s suggestion, they visit a riverside embankment that lingers in Makina’s fading memories. Meanwhile, Mamimi, still determined to take down Eita, encounters a new robotic warrior named Alma…

Episodes.Title: Thus, Makina Gets Covered in Burrs
Episodes.Description: After their riverside visit, Makina and Mimika return home in a panic—their hair is completely covered in burdock burrs! Meanwhile, Mamimi, now armed with Alma, devises a completely outrageous strategy to utterly defeat Eita.

Episodes.Title: Thus, Makina Does a Naughty Workout
Episodes.Description: As Eita and Makina head to school the next day, Makina, thrilled by the improvements to her left leg, can’t stop smiling. But in gym class, disaster strikes—soft tennis is on the schedule! Eita just wants to keep a low profile, but Mamimi has other plans, setting a devious trap that will drag him right into the spotlight…

Entries.Title: Nyaight of the Living Cat
Entries.Description: A virus turns humanity into feral cats, leaving a few survivors to fight back. Kunagi, a man with no past but vast cat knowledge, struggles to survive. However, the virus spreads through cuddles—can he resist the adorable menace?

Episodes.Title: Everything Becomes Cat
Episodes.Description: The world is plunged into chaos due to a virus that turns people into cats through contact with infected cats.

Episodes.Title: Tonight the Cats Steal the Stars
Episodes.Description: Kunagi, Kaoru, and Tanishi take shelter in a supermarket, where Kaoru reunites with a friend.

Episodes.Title: Cats in Prison
Episodes.Description: Kaoru treats the gang to her special "cat rice," but their respite is short-lived.

Episodes.Title: The Cat Is a Harsh Master
Episodes.Description: Kunagi and crew make it to the top of a building where a rescue chopper waits, but it's already at capacity...

Episodes.Title: Cat Max
Episodes.Description: Kunagi and Kaoru meet a man named Arata, who invites them to the citadel where he's been taking refuge.

Episodes.Title: Cat Rising
Episodes.Description: Grandma, leader of Wendelstein, sends Kunagi and crew to a mall to search for a team that's gone missing.

Episodes.Title: The Feline D-REX from Another World
Episodes.Description: At the mall, Kunagi and crew meet a cat that somehow understands human language and writing.

Episodes.Title: Nyarmageddon
Episodes.Description: Kunagi and crew have finished gathering supplies, but now they suddenly face a cat riding on a bear...

Episodes.Title: Commeowndo
Episodes.Description: The citadel's residents welcome the cat from the mall, giving him a name, a special translator device, and...

Episodes.Title: Norwegian d'Arc
Episodes.Description: After their shelter is overrun by cats, Tsutsumi and her new friends find their way to Wendelstein.

Entries.Title: Anne Shirley
Entries.Description: On the beautiful Prince Edward Island in Canada, an orphan named Anne Shirley is mistakenly sent to Green Gables, the home of Matthew and Marilla Cuthbert. They choose to adopt her anyway, as Anne finds friendship, love, and happiness in her new home. Come along for the story of a purehearted and imaginative girl growing up, leaving for college, and returning home a changed woman.

Episodes.Title: It’s Such an Interesting World
Episodes.Description: Eleven-year-old orphan Anne goes to live with her new family, only to discover that they expected a boy.

Episodes.Title: I Love Pretty Things
Episodes.Description: Anne rejoices in her new life at Green Gables, but unkind words from Mrs. Lynde spark a stormy confrontation.

Episodes.Title: Looking Forward to Things Is Half the Pleasure of Them
Episodes.Description: Anne thrills in anticipation of her first picnic, but a lost brooch puts her dreams in jeopardy.

Episodes.Title: One Can’t Stay Sad Very Long in Such an Interesting World
Episodes.Description: Anne invites Diana to tea, but a mix-up with bottles could make it their last meeting as friends.

Episodes.Title: Let Us Look on the Bright Side of Things
Episodes.Description: Newly twelve-year-old Anne comes to grief in an affair of honor. Matthew insists on puffed sleeves.

Episodes.Title: I Thought Nothing Could Be as Bad as Red Hair
Episodes.Description: The story club is formed. Then, Anne's vanity leads to vexation of spirit.

Episodes.Title: I’ve Been Making Mistakes, but Each Mistake Has Helped to Cure Me of My Shortcomings
Episodes.Description: Anne becomes an unfortunate lily maid, and the Queen's class is organized.

Episodes.Title: I Don’t Want to Be Anyone but Myself
Episodes.Description: The pass list is out. Anne celebrates at the hotel concert.

Episodes.Title: Next to Trying and Winning, the Best Thing Is Trying and Failing
Episodes.Description: Anne becomes a Queen's girl and spends the winter at Queen's, chasing the glory and the dream.

Episodes.Title: I Don’t Know What Lies Around the Bend, but I’m Going to Believe That the Best Does
Episodes.Description: After the reaper whose name is Death touches her life, Anne comes to the bend in the road.

Episodes.Title: I’d Like to Add Some Beauty to Life
Episodes.Description: Anne becomes a full-fledged schoolma'am and encounters all sorts and conditions of men... and women.

Episodes.Title: Perhaps We Always Love Best the People Who Need Us
Episodes.Description: Marilla adopts twins, and one, Davy, goes in search of a sensation.

Episodes.Title: When I Think Something Nice Is Going to Happen, I Seem to Fly Right Up on the Wings of Anticipation
Episodes.Description: After a chapter of accidents, Anne gets her wish in the way it often happens.

Episodes.Title: It Is Never Too Late for the Real Prince to Come for the True Princess
Episodes.Description: Anne meets sweet Miss Lavendar and learns the story of her romance over an afternoon at the stone house.

Episodes.Title: I’ll Come From the Ends of the Earth If Necessary
Episodes.Description: Anne wonders what lies around the bend in her road and attends a wedding at the stone house.

Episodes.Title: It’s Nicer Not to Know
Episodes.Description: The shadow of change leads to greetings and farewells as Anne sets off for Redmond College.

Episodes.Title: Love Is the Power That Transforms Everything
Episodes.Description: After letters from home and a day in the park, Anne goes home again and gets her first proposal.

Episodes.Title: I Feel as If I Had Opened a Book and Found Roses of Yesterday, Sweet and Beloved, Between Its Leaves
Episodes.Description: Anne deals with an unwelcome lover and a welcome friend, visits Patty's Place, and finds roses of yesterday.

Episodes.Title: I’ll Walk the Road to Heaven From Here
Episodes.Description: Anne writes "Averil's Atonement," and an old friend receives the summons that may not be evaded.

Episodes.Title: My World Has Tumbled Into Pieces
Episodes.Description: Relationships are adjusted, Gilbert speaks, and spring and Anne return to Green Gables.

Episodes.Title: Has the Real Prince Come at Last...?
Episodes.Description: Enter Jonas, enter Prince Charming, enter Christine.

Episodes.Title: How Horrible It Is That People Have to Grow Up, and Marry, and Change!

Entries.Title: Dekin no Mogura: The Earthbound Mole
Entries.Description: A shady self-proclaimed hermit named Momoyuki Mogura, AKA: Mogura, is banned from the afterlife due to an incident. Now he collects spirit possessed will-o'-wisps in his lantern, hoping to make a comeback.

Episodes.Title: At a Certain Location in Tokyo
Episodes.Description: Magi and Yaeko, two liberal arts students, have a fateful encounter with the strange Mogura.

Episodes.Title: Spirit = Human
Episodes.Description: Mogura describes the hell on Earth he experienced when he was drafted.

Episodes.Title: The Gathered Crew
Episodes.Description: Magi and Yaeko are introduced to true exorcisms.

Episodes.Title: The Mystery of the Mad Dog and the Red Panda
Episodes.Description: Magi's workplace becomes infested with spirits.

Episodes.Title: Trigger
Episodes.Description: Magi's younger brother is disturbed to discover his friend's family doting on an old child's doll.

Episodes.Title: Brothers and Sisters
Episodes.Description: Shio learns that Kyoshiro's mother Kyoko has her own unique supernatural ability.

Episodes.Title: The Trap of Only Seeing Results
Episodes.Description: Sakurako takes home a maneki-neko in accordance with Kyoko's vision, but her problems remain unresolved.

Entries.Title: Long Story Short
Entries.Description: From the creator of "BoJack Horseman" comes this animated comedy about a family over time, following siblings from childhood to adulthood and back again.

Episodes.Title: Yoshi's Bar Mitzvah
Episodes.Description: It's a night to remember when Avi brings his girlfriend home to meet the family on the same weekend his kid brother is becoming a man.

Episodes.Title: Hannah's Dance Recital
Episodes.Description: Shira and Kendra head north to attend a winter-themed dance recital in Santa Rosa... and to ask Avi a very important question.

Episodes.Title: There's a Mattress in There
Episodes.Description: With Elliott's blessing, Yoshi goes all-in on an exciting new business opportunity, inspired by a salesman wearing flip-flops.

Episodes.Title: Shira Can't Cook
Episodes.Description: To crush the competition at a high-stakes school potluck, Shira tries making knishes — her mother's most difficult recipe.

Episodes.Title: Yoshi & Baby
Episodes.Description: Yoshi's determined to come through for his sister and be responsible. But a chance meeting while waiting in line for potato ice cream changes everything.

Episodes.Title: Wolves
Episodes.Description: While trying to address the "wolf situation" at Hannah's school, Avi teams up with a group of parents who take things a little too far.

Episodes.Title: Kendra's Job
Episodes.Description: Kendra weighs the pros and cons of putting work before personal relationships when she's accepted into a management training program.

Episodes.Title: The Intervention
Episodes.Description: The truth comes out when the kids come home for an awkward conversation under the guise of celebrating their parents' anniversary.

Episodes.Title: Honoring Naomi Schwartz
Episodes.Description: A special event at the Jewish Community Center puts Naomi in the spotlight — but it's the same night as Shira's prom.

Episodes.Title: Uncle Barry
Episodes.Description: A somber occasion brings everyone together in Las Vegas, leading to a surprise family gathering in the desert.

Entries.Title: Onmyo Kaiten Re:Birth Verse
Entries.Description: Narihira Takeru is a delinquent who often thinks about Tsukimiya, the girl who appears in his dreams. After an unexpected accident, Takeru finds himself in a parallel universe, and the world that Tsukimiya lives in. When Takeru and Tsukimiya are slain by a monster, he awakens again and realizes he has leapt through time. Now, Takeru must train with Abe Seimei to fight for Tsukimiya’s life!

Episodes.Title: Don't Admit Defeat Even If You're Dead! A Delinquent in Denji Heian-kyo!
Episodes.Description: After an accident, teenage delinquent Takeru wakes up to find the literal girl of his dreams standing there.

Episodes.Title: You Can't Build Trust With Words! This Delinquent Will Be an Onmyoji
Episodes.Description: Takeru wakes up in Denji Heian-kyo again, but nobody remembers him or believes his stories about fighting oni.

Episodes.Title: Don't Just Focus on What You Can See! Yura's Wavering Feelings
Episodes.Description: When Takeru proves to be a good battle partner for Atsunaga, Yura has some difficult decisions to make.

Episodes.Title: Don't Get Used to Being Alone! Takeru's First Centennial Pandemonium!
Episodes.Description: Seimei plans to put Takeru's explosive but unpredictable power to use in the upcoming Centennial Pandemonium.

Episodes.Title: Come On Down, Once-in-a-Millennium Me! The Yasha Mask That Guides Takeru
Episodes.Description: After the trauma of losing a Centennial Pandemonium fight, Takeru becomes afraid to enter the black mist.

Episodes.Title: This Time I'll Protect You! What Appeared Beyond the Centennial Pandemonium
Episodes.Description: Takeru's power reaches all new heights, but revelations await him during the next Centennial Pandemonium.

Episodes.Title: Say It Ain't So! The Truth About Denji Heian-kyo Is Revealed
Episodes.Description: Seimei explains to Takeru the shocking truth regarding how things work in Denji Heian-kyo.

Episodes.Title: Don't Screw Around With People Desperately Trying to Get By! The Wailing of Seiryu Tower
Episodes.Description: Takeru decides to aid Tsukimiya in thwarting Seimei's World Whittle. Their first stop, Seiryu Tower.

Episodes.Title: Fight Me for Real! Takeru vs. Seimei, Souls Going Mano a Mano
Episodes.Description: As Takeru destroys the Towers of the Four Gods one by one, Seimei chooses to personally face him in combat.

Episodes.Title: Change the Future on Your Own! Seimei, Across a Thousand Years
Episodes.Description: Seimei tells Takeru of the events from a thousand years ago that led him to begin the World Whittle.

Episodes.Title: Get Ready, Hareaki! Final Showdown in Denji Heian-kyo!!
Episodes.Description: Tsukimiya makes a power play in the final Denji Heian-kyo, and Takeru must team up with Seimei to stop her.

Entries.Title: Detectives These Days Are Crazy!
Entries.Description: Once a legendary detective, Nagumo Keiichiro now stumbles through middle age baffled by smartphones and modern life. His quiet decline gets disrupted when Mashiro, a bold high school girl, bursts into his office demanding to become his apprentice. Though he’s rusty and set in his ways, her relentless enthusiasm drags him back into detective work. Now the gap-bridging detective duo is on the case!

Episodes.Title: Former Great Detective Nagumo Keiichiro / Mashiro's Pest Extermination
Episodes.Description: Nagumo Keiichiro was once a great child detective, but age is starting to catch up with him.

Episodes.Title: With Ghosts, Go for the Knees / Find the Real Thief! / Three Minutes Until Mashiro Explodes
Episodes.Description: Mashiro's schoolmate seeks the agency's help in catching a ghost, and Nagumo is suspected of underwear theft.

Episodes.Title: Great Detective Asunaro / The Ones Who Don't Realize They're Stalkers Are the Most Dangerous
Episodes.Description: A young detective lockpicks his way into Nagumo's office and asks to work for him.

Episodes.Title: Murder at the Mansion of Screams / Maki-chan and the Generation Gap
Episodes.Description: Nagumo is invited to a dinner party at a stately old mansion... where a mass murder once took place.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the World of Grown-Ups / A Midsummer Thriller / Mashiro and the Agent from the Stars
Episodes.Description: Nagumo takes Mashiro to his favorite bar to give her a taste of grown-up society.

Episodes.Title: Mashiro Hosts Girls' Night Out / Assistant Switch!! / Battle to the Death at 100° Celsius
Episodes.Description: Mashiro spends an evening with Azuha and Maki. Later, Nagumo and Asunaro switch partners.

Episodes.Title: Nagumo-san's Grown-Up Allure / The Lost Child and Mashiro / The Great Detective vs. Phantom Thief Riverfake
Episodes.Description: Mashiro brings back a lost little girl... and finds out there's more to her than meets the eye.

Episodes.Title: Nagumo's Cyber Case File / The Phantom Thief's Method / A Detective Assistant's Day Off
Episodes.Description: The gang tries to sniff out a cyber criminal who's brainwashing people through online videos.

Episodes.Title: Take Good Care of Your Smartphone / Maki-chan and Asunaro
Episodes.Description: Mashiro loses her smartphone, and Asunaro recounts how he and Maki became partners.

Episodes.Title: Catch the Sneak Photographer! / The Bullet Bride
Episodes.Description: Nagumo receives a case of someone taking indecent photos of women at a water park.

Episodes.Title: Mashiro and the Psychic of Love
Episodes.Description: A client asks Nagumo to save his wife from a psychic who seems to have brainwashed his village.

Entries.Title: Watari-kun's ****** Is About to Collapse
Entries.Description: Naoto Watari lives solely for his little sister, Suzushiro, until his chaotic childhood friend, Satsuki, storms back into his life. Without uttering a single word, her very presence ignites buried memories and unravels his rigid routine. As tensions rise and secrets surface, Naoto’s devotion to Suzushiro clashes with unresolved pain, threatening to collapse his fragile world.

Episodes.Title: The Day Peace Began to Collapse
Episodes.Description: Watari Naoto and his sister Suzu try to live a normal life. His destructive childhood friend Satsuki returns.

Episodes.Title: Small Lies
Episodes.Description: The plants in the garden are beginning to sprout. But so are the small lies that everybody employs.

Episodes.Title: Worldly Desires, Begone
Episodes.Description: Ishihara-san has the image that Naoto is a perfect, kind, chaste saint. Can he kill all his desires, though?

Episodes.Title: Showing and Being Seen
Episodes.Description: Everyone is going to the beach. Satsuki and Ishihara get bathing suits. What will Naoto say to them?

Episodes.Title: Ideal Partner
Episodes.Description: On their walk, Naoto and Ishihara run into Fujioka, her "ex-boyfriend". What really happened between them?

Episodes.Title: Confession
Episodes.Description: After overcoming multiple obstacles, Ishihara finally confesses her feelings to Naoto. What is his response?

Episodes.Title: After School, Just Before Summer Break
Episodes.Description: Ishihara and Naoto go on a date at the zoo, albeit with Suzu in tow.

Episodes.Title: A Cute Junior
Episodes.Description: At a part-time job interview, Naoto meets Umezawa Makina, a junior from middle school and the ace of the track and field club. When Makina finds out that Naoto doesn't have a smartphone, she forcefully takes him to buy one, but once he gets the phone, the first person he calls is Murasaki. Makina, who went on to join the track and field club at a prestigious girls' high school in Tokyo, has actually fallen into a slump and has been skipping club activities. Seeing that Naoto seems happy, unlike her, Makina plots to make him break up with her and become her toy to kill time...

Episodes.Title: The Fireworks
Episodes.Description: Makina, who is showing off to her club members by saying she is going to the fireworks festival with her boyfriend, asks Naoto to play the role of her boyfriend. Naoto recommends Tokui for the role and makes an arrangement to meet Murasaki, who is going with some local friends, on the way. On the day of the fireworks festival, Naoto and Murasaki sneak out of the festival midway and head home as it starts to rain. Soon, the downpour begins to pour, and the two seek shelter at Naoto's house, where they find Satsuki, who has come to take care of her vegetable garden out of concern for it. Everyone is soaked, and the three of them end up staying at the house for the night, but...

Episodes.Title: A Relationship I Don't Want to Mess Up

Entries.Title: The Beginning After the End
Entries.Description: After a mysterious death, King Grey is reborn as Arthur Leywin on the magical continent of Dicathen. Although he enters his second life as a baby, his previous wisdom remains. He begins to master magic and forge his own path as the years go by, seeking to correct the mistakes of his past life.

Episodes.Title: The Rebirth of the King
Episodes.Description: Having defeated countless enemies, obtaining wealth, fame, and everything else imaginable, the most powerful king, Grey, abruptly dies one day. He then awakens suddenly, having reincarnated in a world where magic exists. He is given the name Arthur, and begins living a second life, with loving parents.

Episodes.Title: The King, Under Attack
Episodes.Description: The Leywin family travels to the floating city of Xyrus so that Arthur can begin his formal education in magic. The adventuring party that Reynolds and Alice belong to, the Twin Horns, accompany them as guards, when they run into something unexpected...

Episodes.Title: Meeting the King
Episodes.Description: During the battle with the bandits, Arthur falls off of a cliff. When he awakens he encounters a mysterious beast, clad in armor. Her name is Sylvia. She helps Arthur, and seems to know where his family is, but who is she really...?

Episodes.Title: Saved by the King
Episodes.Description: Having parted ways with Sylvia, Arthur hears a girl's scream in the woods. Upon rushing to the voice, he encounters an elf girl named Tessia, who has been captured by slavers. With Sylvia's words to "seek light in his new life" ringing in his ears, Arthur decides to challenge them by himself.

Episodes.Title: The King's Test
Episodes.Description: Arthur arrives in the Elenoir Kingdom with Tessia, before being arrested by elvish soldiers who harbor deep resentment toward humans. Things are looking tense until Elenoir's former ruler, Virion, has him released. Arthur is then invited to the kingdom's castle. But the pain in his mana core seems to be getting worse...

Episodes.Title: The King's Training
Episodes.Description: After being informed of a way to let Reynolds and Alice know about his survival, Arthur joins Virion and they head to a witch's house. Using special sorcery, he is able to see his parents. Witnessing the depth of their grief, Arthur decides that he will train under Virion to protect those he cares about, and to control the dangerous power growing within him.

Episodes.Title: The King Says Goodbye
Episodes.Description: It's been three years after Arthur began his training in the Kingdom of Elenoir, having worked alongside Tessia as they both grew stronger. Arthur enlists Virion's help in order to awaken the beast that slumbers within his mana core. Then, one night, the stone Sylvia gave him begins to shine…

Episodes.Title: Reunited with the King
Episodes.Description: Having arrived in the city of Xyrus, Arthur is thrilled to meet his younger sister, Eleanor, and to reunite with his parents. While sparring with Reynolds, he demonstrates how much he has grown. After witnessing Arthur's strength, Vincent Helstea proposes that the reborn king enroll in Xyrus Academy, a prestigious sorcery school.

Episodes.Title: The King Teaches
Episodes.Description: Vincent and his wife Tabitha are hoping to enroll their daughter, Lilia, in Xyrus Academy. And while Lilia hopes to live up to her parents’ expectations, she has yet to awaken her mana. In the meantime, Arthur runs into a group of the academy’s students while shopping in town.

Episodes.Title: The King’s Defiance
Episodes.Description: The Helstea Auction, which even the royals of the Sapin Kingdom attend, is opened. Vincent invites Arthur to the auction house. While among valuables on offer, Arthur discovers Sylvie has gone missing, and that she’s attracted the attention of a court sorcerer in the service of the Sapin Royal family!

Episodes.Title: The King’s Decision
Episodes.Description: Having arrived at Xyrus Academy, Arthur displays his skills to the school’s director, Cynthia, who proves to be every bit as formidable as her position as the head of the prestigious magic academy suggests. Despite being overwhelmed, Arthur still shows his power and the two strike a deal...

Episodes.Title: The King’s Departure
Episodes.Description: Donning a mask and taking up the alter-ego of Note, Arthur arrives at the guild to begin service as an adventurer. He has new encounters meeting Elijah, a young boy with ties to dwarven royalty, and Lucas, a half-elf member of the Sapin royal family. Afterwards, Arthur and Jasmine leave on their first adventure together. In order to protect those he cares for, the king seeks even greater power.

Entries.Title: Yandere Dark Elf: She Chased Me All the Way from Another World!
Entries.Description: Hinata did it. He got reincarnated into another world, took up the mantle of Hero, and slew the dreaded Demon Lord alongside his party of fellow adventurers. As his reward, he’s returned to Earth to resume a normal life. Or it would be if it wasn’t for the fact that his dark elf companion Mariabelle decided to travel to Earth to come and live with him! Now she uses her arcane talents to ward off any potential romantic rivals and capture Hinata’s affection.

Episodes.Title: A Girl I Met in Another World
Episodes.Description: The Demon Lord is defeated, but Hinata's troubles have just begun. Especially when Mariabell refuses to let the boundaries between worlds keep him away from her.

Episodes.Title: Academy Life
Episodes.Description: Mariabell is getting used to Hinata's world, but then she makes an alarming discovery: Hinata's been talking to another girl...

Episodes.Title: Shopping
Episodes.Description: Mariabell plays volleyball and goes shopping with Hinata and Sakura.

Episodes.Title: Visitors From Another World
Episodes.Description: Hinata and Mariabell's former party members arrive to drag her back to their world.

Episodes.Title: The Neighbor
Episodes.Description: May's worried about Cecil and invites her and the rest of their friends to a hot spring for a little R&R. She also might be reviewing the springs for her live stream as well.

Episodes.Title: Parenting
Episodes.Description: Why do Hinata and Sakura have a baby? Mariabell must know.

Episodes.Title: Love and Illness
Episodes.Description: When Hinata catches a cold, it's up to Mariabell to nurse him back to health!

Episodes.Title: Debut as a Vendor - Part 1
Episodes.Description: Sakura's new fantasy manga is all thanks to Hinata and Mariabell's adventures!

Episodes.Title: Debut as a Vendor - Part 2
Episodes.Description: Sakura's manga is more popular than expected.

Episodes.Title: The Distance Between Us
Episodes.Description: Mariabell's cosplay photos went viral and now she's getting unwanted attention from other boys.

Episodes.Title: The Temptation of the Sea?
Episodes.Description: Hinata overthinks his relationship with Mariabell. Perhaps she can reassure him when they all go to the beach.

Episodes.Title: I'm Glad I Met You
Episodes.Description: Hinata teaches Mariabell how to swim. A dolphin snatches Sakura's swimsuit and Hinata and Mariabell end up alone together. What will happen next?

Entries.Title: BE@RBRICK
Entries.Description: In a town where everyone's roles are predetermined, an aspiring singer-songwriter and her bandmates break free to pursue their dreams and inspire others to do the same.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Vinylville
Episodes.Description: Budding pop star Jasmine crafts a music video—and major surprise—with her friends.

Episodes.Title: That Takes the Cake
Episodes.Description: The band makes a unique practice space their own. Meanwhile, their message of self-expression inspires a baker to break from the mold.

Episodes.Title: Ring and Sing
Episodes.Description: Jasmine discovers her math teacher longs to be a pro wrestler. To support her, the newly named Brushstrokes host an epic live event.

Episodes.Title: I Hope You Dance, Mom
