Episodes.Description: DMBEETZ score a hit after stealing the Brushstrokes' song. Nick's mom shares her dream and asks for help stepping into the spotlight.

Episodes.Title: Good at Being Bad
Episodes.Description: Todd promises to get the Brushstrokes on BRBX Media, but their broadcast is threatened by Klaus' mischievous parents.

Episodes.Title: The Play's the Thing
Episodes.Description: The Brushstrokes discover a rising star as they try to rewrite Ms. Goldenshorts' school musical.

Episodes.Title: The Third Option
Episodes.Description: A vengeful Ms. Goldenshorts goes all out to unmask the Brushstrokes. Jasmine recruits extra help to keep their secret safe.

Episodes.Title: Mission Im-pose-able
Episodes.Description: While the Brushstrokes look for inspiration, Jasmine struggles to connect with a bandmate. Holly's family makes a deal with Ms. Goldenshorts.

Episodes.Title: Band Nerves, Take a Swerve
Episodes.Description: A major opportunity at BRBX Media fuels anxiety. Jasmine tries to soothe her bandmates, but trouble awaits at the studio.

Episodes.Title: An Announcement of an Announcement
Episodes.Description: The Brushstrokes plan a rooftop concert to prove they're still together...but things don't go as expected.

Episodes.Title: DMBEETHZ
Episodes.Description: A shocking twist changes everything. In the aftermath, the Brushstrokes dig deep to support a friend.

Episodes.Title: The Ballad of Ms. Goldenshorts
Episodes.Description: As Ms. Goldenshorts deals with DMBEETZ drama, the Brushstrokes get trapped in Mr. Hitmaker's studio.

Episodes.Title: Vinylville 2.0
Episodes.Description: It's a race against time to stop Ms. Goldenshorts. Can the Brushstrokes pull off one more show and inspire fans to paint their own destinies?

Entries.Title: Mobile Suit Gundam GQuuuuuuX
Entries.Description: High-school student Amate Yuzuriha lives peacefully in a space colony floating in outer space. But when she meets a war refugee named Nyaan, Amate is drawn into the illegal mobile suit dueling sport known as Clan Battle.

Episodes.Title: The Red Gundam
Episodes.Description: Amate Yuzuriha, a high-school girl living in the Izuma colony, meets a female courier named Nyaan.

Episodes.Title: The White Gundam
Episodes.Description: Char, an ace pilot of the Principality of Zeon forces, captures the Earth Federation's latest mobile suit Gundam, a key component to their "Operation V," at Side7. From that moment, the tide of war shifts dramatically, ultimately leading to Principality of Zeon’s victory in the One Year War. However, just before the end of the war, Gundam and Char...

Episodes.Title: Machu in Clan Battle
Episodes.Description: Amate meets a boy named Shuji, who pilots the Red Gundam. She can’t forget the sensation of the glowing universe they experienced together and suggests forming a MAV to enter the Clan Battle. Amate decides to use the entry name "MACHU."

Episodes.Title: The Witch's War
Episodes.Description: A super unicum known as the "Witch," who shot down over 100 enemies during the One Year War, enters the Clan Battle to settle an old score with the Red Gundam. Seeing this Witch, who clings to mobile suit combat even at the cost of abandoning her husband and child, Machu witnesses the depths of human obsession.

Episodes.Title: Nyaan Doesn't Know About Kira-Kira
Episodes.Description: Machu plans to earn money in the Clan Battle and travel to Earth with Shuji and Nyaan. However, on the day of the Clan Battle, Machu is caught by Xavier. At this rate, the trip to Earth will remain just a dream. At that moment, Nyaan…

Episodes.Title: The Plot to Assassinate Kycilia
Episodes.Description: Annqi discovers Shuji’s hideout. Information about the Red Gundam is worth more than any Clan Battle prize money. Machu finds out that Annqi schemes to sell that intel during the Clan Battle. Earth Federation forces’ intelligence agency finds out about Kycilia’s top secret information decides to…

Episodes.Title: Machu's Rebellion
Episodes.Description: Upon learning of Annqi's plan, Machu devises a plan with Nyaan to use the Clan Battle as a means to help Shuji escape. However, their opponent in the next Clan Battle turns out to be a newly built mobile armor operated by terrorists aiming to assassinate Kycilia.

Episodes.Title: Falling on the Moon
Episodes.Description: In the final stages of the One Year War, the Sodon Fleet led by Char launched to stop the Earth Federation forces' operation to drop Solomon Fortress; to protect the lunar city of Granada. Five years later in Granada. Nyaan was there with Kycilia.

Episodes.Title: The Rose of Sharon
Episodes.Description: Guided by a mysterious message, Machu escapes Sodon and descends alone to Earth in GQuuuuuuX. After crash-landing to Earth, she is rescued by a woman adored as “lady,” who is being held captive in the Kabas estate. Machu decides to escape with her and attempts to flee in the Core Fighter.

Episodes.Title: Yomagn'tho Blockade
Episodes.Description: To stop Yomagn'tho from causing destruction, Machu takes on a mission from Challia Bull to rescue the girl of rose. However, Kycilia makes her move first. Nyaan’s mobile suit, the GFreD, begins activating the Zeknova cannon. Its target: all of humanity on Earth—

Episodes.Title: Alphacide
Episodes.Description: Machu's GQuuuuuuX fights against Nyaan's GFreD as she tries to rescue the girl of rose. Eventually, guided by Shuji, Machu ventures alone into the heart of Yomagn'tho. There, she meets Char and Kycilia.

Episodes.Title: That's Why I...
Episodes.Description: This is the end game. A white mobile suit appears from the other side, attempting to kill Lalah. To Machu’s shock, the pilot of this White Devil is none other than Shuji. Determined to protect Lalah, Machu becomes a MAV with Nyaan and decides to fight Shuji.

Entries.Title: Even Given the Worthless "Appraiser" Class, I'm Actually the Strongest
Entries.Description: In a world where heroes are born, not made, Ein’s god-given gift is the weakest: the power to appraise things. Treated cruelly by his peers, Ein spends his days in self-abasement—until he meets Yuri, the spirit of the World Tree. Yuri and her protector, Ursula, bless Ein with the Spirit Eye, unlocking new strength. As his abilities grow, Ein embarks on a journey to uncover his true purpose.

Episodes.Title: "Appraiser" Is a Worthless Class
Episodes.Description: The appraiser Ein is exploring a dungeon with his party, who keep mistreating him and call him "trash picker." As they venture further, they get swarmed by a pack of strong monsters called Hell Hounds. In order to survive, Ein's party members Zoid and Jolene betray him and leave him behind as bait, dooming him to a certain and painful death!

Episodes.Title: Super Appraise with My Spirit Eye
Episodes.Description: Ein manages to survive his plunge thanks to the help of a mysterious power, but even greater dangers await him in the depths of the dungeon. Can he master his newfound abilities and attempt to make an escape?

Episodes.Title: Revenge Match
Episodes.Description: With the artificial spirit eye that Yuri bestowed upon him, and with Ursula's training, Ein has gotten stronger. When he sets his sights on reaching the surface, Yuri asks him to take her with him. To that end, Ursula further enhances both his eyes, and they are ready to leave. That's when Yuri asks Ein a certain question...

Episodes.Title: Searching for the Sisters
Episodes.Description: In search of Yuri's sisters, Ein enters a dungeon that Jasper told him about. This hidden dungeon is just full of traps. But what is Zoid doing here?!

Episodes.Title: Quest to Vanquish the Behemoth
Episodes.Description: Pina and Kurohime join Ein. Soon after, guild master Meegan gives Ein an SS-rank quest to defeat the Behemoth.

Episodes.Title: VS Zoid
Episodes.Description: Ein doubts that any of his feats were due to his development. Meanwhile, a monster attacks Yuri and Pina.

Episodes.Title: The Girl of the Forbidden Library
Episodes.Description: Ein gains entry to the Forbidden Library of the kingdom. There he meets a girl with a surprising background.

Episodes.Title: Nigun's Shadow
Episodes.Description: Ein travels to Rayshik to fight demons, but once there, Lord Nigun claims no demons had ever been sighted.

Episodes.Title: Rise to Action
Episodes.Description: Ein's will to protect the village is put to the test with monsters approaching and the true evil revealed.

Episodes.Title: Nigun's Darkness
Episodes.Description: Ein faces Shadow, but in order to defeat him, he would have to hurt Nigun. Is there no other way?

Episodes.Title: The Demon Ioana
Episodes.Description: On the way to meet another spirit, Ein has to face two new threats from the demon realm, Hornet and Ioana.

Episodes.Title: Happiness, Forever
Episodes.Description: Ein's latest challenge is to win Mei's trust. But then there's also a castle in need of cleaning....

Entries.Title: Solo Camping for Two
Entries.Description: Gen Kinokura just wanted to enjoy his peaceful solo camping trips—no distractions, no problems. Enter Shizuku Kusano, a clueless but enthusiastic newbie who crashes his campsite (literally). Now, this bothered outdoorsman is stuck teaching her the ropes. Laughs, mishaps, and heartwarming moments await this duo-camp adventure under the stars!

Episodes.Title: Pondering While Solo Camping
Episodes.Description: Gen’s peaceful solo camping trip is interrupted by a first timer without a tent.

Episodes.Title: Enjoy Going Solo
Episodes.Description: Shizuku insists on camping with Gen until she's comfortable camping solo, so they go solo camping together.

Episodes.Title: Beware of Gear Acquisition Traps
Episodes.Description: Gen and Shizuku go shopping for camping gear together.

Episodes.Title: What Do You Do While Camping?
Episodes.Description: Shizuku is unable to explain why she wants to go camping alone, so she asks Gen for his thoughts.

Episodes.Title: The Path You Choose Yourself
Episodes.Description: Gen examines his feelings on camping with Shizuku, while Akihito hangs out with Shizuku and her friends.

Episodes.Title: Master Mode
Episodes.Description: Gen teaches Shizuku the basics of campfires.

Episodes.Title: The Origins of Going Solo
Episodes.Description: Gen thinks back on his camping experiences and when he started camping solo.

Episodes.Title: Katsu! Use Gear Properly
Episodes.Description: Gen is appalled by the state of Shizuku's backpack and teaches her how to pack properly.

Episodes.Title: Occasionally, Like a Master
Episodes.Description: Shizuku embarks on her first multi-day camping trip with Gen.

Episodes.Title: Because I Like Gen-san
Episodes.Description: Shizuku runs into Gen's old flame.

Entries.Title: Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man
Entries.Description: Peter Parker is on his way to becoming a hero, but his path to get there is anything but ordinary.

Episodes.Title: Amazing Fantasy
Episodes.Description: During high school orientation Peter's life is forever changed. A new era of Spider-Man begins here!

Episodes.Title: The Parker Luck
Episodes.Description: Peter begins an exclusive internship, but his first day is way more complicated than he expected.

Episodes.Title: Secret Identity Crisis
Episodes.Description: Peter deals with the fallout of his secret revealed. Meanwhile, Lonnie's perfect life falls apart.

Episodes.Title: Hitting the Big Time
Episodes.Description: Peter and Norman work through creative differences, while Lonnie undergoes a loyalty test.

Episodes.Title: The Unicorn Unleashed
Episodes.Description: Peter makes a new friend. Meanwhile, Lonnie finds himself in the sights of a dangerous gang.

Episodes.Title: Duel with the Devil
Episodes.Description: Peter's night off is derailed when he must suit up to stop a mysterious intruder.

Episodes.Title: Scorpion Rising
Episodes.Description: Peter and Lonnie face the consequences of their secret lives. Spider-Man faces his biggest threat.

Episodes.Title: Tangled Web
Episodes.Description: Norman gives Spider-Man an ultimatum, causing Peter to do some soul-searching.

Episodes.Title: Hero or Menace
Episodes.Description: Spider-Man swings into action, as Lonnie looks to settle a score and Norman visits an old friend.

Episodes.Title: If This Be My Destiny...
Episodes.Description: Peter's internship takes a dark turn with the arrival of an unexpected visitor.

Entries.Title: Winx Club: The Magic is Back
Entries.Description: When Bloom discovers she has magic, her life takes a wild turn. At the Alfea school for fairies and witches, she meets five girls who become her best friends — and her greatest strength. Together, they’re the Winx. As dark secrets rise and powerful enemies close in, the Winx will need to unlock their true potential to protect their world — and themselves.

Episodes.Title: A New Fairy in Alfea
Episodes.Description: Bloom discovers she has magical powers on her 16th birthday, after a scary encounter with a magic creature. She is rescued by Stella and Flora, two fairies from Alfea School for Fairies and Witches.

Episodes.Title: Which Fairy is Witch?
Episodes.Description: Bloom is torn when she learns she must take a test at Alfea to determine whether she is a fairy or a witch. The Trix take advantage of her doubts, pushing Bloom closer to despair.

Episodes.Title: Winx v Trix
Episodes.Description: When Stella's ring mysteriously disappears, the Winx embarks on a risky mission to retrieve it from Cloud Tower. As they explore the school's eerie tunnel, Bloom faces a powerful awakening.

Episodes.Title: A Trick by the Trix
Episodes.Description: The Winx face their toughest physical exam yet, pushing their magic and teamwork to the limits. Meanwhile, Bloom attempts to bond with the mysterious Damien.

Episodes.Title: The Shopping Trip
Episodes.Description: The Winx plan a day of adventure in Magixia, but Griselda's strict restrictions and an incomplete project keep them grounded... until Robin helps them sneak away.

Episodes.Title: Into the Woods
Episodes.Description: Despite Faragonda sealing their powers away, the Winx are sent on a challenging camping trip in the Dark Forest. Meanwhile, Vexius seizes the opportunity to capture Bloom's Dragon Flame.

Episodes.Title: Dark Bloom
Episodes.Description: A dark spell turns Bloom into Dark Bloom, turning her against her friends and wreaking chaos at Alfea. Meanwhile, Aisha's love for dance clashes with her parents' expectations.

Episodes.Title: Rock and Roll Fairies
Episodes.Description: Excitement builds as Musa's concert in Magixia approaches, but her nerves skyrocket when a mysterious agent shows interest, planning their next dangerous move against Bloom.

Episodes.Title: The Simulation Room
Episodes.Description: As the Winx prepare for an unexpected Simulation Room test, Damien struggles in the room and each girl faces their deepest fears, revealing vulnerabilities they never anticipated.

Episodes.Title: Stella's New Crush
Episodes.Description: Bloom learns from Faragonda that she possesses the powerful Dragon Flame, but she fears the dangers it might bring. Meanwhile, Stella is excited about a blind date with the mysterious Prince Luke.

Episodes.Title: A New Enemy
Episodes.Description: When Vexius launches a devastating attack on Red Fountain, the Winx and Specialists must unite to protect the school. Meanwhile, Bloom uncovers a shocking connection between Vexius and the Dragon Flame.

Episodes.Title: Lightrock Fortress
Episodes.Description: With Vexius' dark power growing, Alfea prepares for a looming battle, but Bloom's sudden disappearance raises alarm. Meanwhile, Bloom learns a shocking truth about her past and her family.

Episodes.Title: The Power of the Dragon Flame
Episodes.Description: Bloom and the Winx uncover shocking truths about the Dragon Flame’s origins and its connection to Damien and Vexius. Meanwhile, Bloom faces a personal revelation that will change everything.

Entries.Title: 斑马百科2025
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Common Side Effects
Entries.Description: Former high school lab partners Marshall and Frances begin to unravel a conspiracy involving big pharma and the federal government to suppress knowledge of a rare mushroom that may hold the key to curing all the world’s diseases.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: Marshall meets his old high school classmate Frances and lets her in on a world-changing secret.

Episodes.Title: Lakeshore Limited
Episodes.Description: Marshall's forced on the run as the DEA pursues him.

Episodes.Title: Hildy
Episodes.Description: Marshall visits an old mentor as new pressures mount.

Episodes.Title: Dumpsite
Episodes.Description: Frances tracks down Marshall in an unlikely location.

Episodes.Title: Star-Tel-Lite
Episodes.Description: Marshall, Frances, and their crazy neighbors deal with the aftermath of a dangerous incident.

Episodes.Title: In the System
Episodes.Description: Stuck in jail, Marshall faces new threats.

Episodes.Title: Blowfish
Episodes.Description: A chance encounter offers a risky opportunity for escape.

Episodes.Title: Amelia & Wyatt
Episodes.Description: Marshall and his new ally make a bold move.

Episodes.Title: Cliff's Edge
Episodes.Description: Marshall's mushroom project grows out of hand.

Episodes.Title: Raid
Episodes.Description: Dangerous forces converge on Marshall's camp.

Entries.Title: Dr. Seuss's Red Fish, Blue Fish
Entries.Description: One fish, two fish, meet Red Fish and Blue Fish! From there to here — and from here to there — these friends find opposites everywhere!

Episodes.Title: Quiet/Loud + Clean/Dirty + Go/Stop + Lock/Unlock
Episodes.Description: Red and Blue take jobs as babysitters and pet groomers, team up to rescue Blue's teddy bear from a taxi, and help animals sleep tight at the farm.

Episodes.Title: Loose/Tight + Gather/Scatter + Catch/Let Go + Relax/Stressed
Episodes.Description: The friends try on Halloween costumes, work together to clean up leaves, and try to catch a colorful butterfly — then they find some time to unwind!

Episodes.Title: Dangerous/Safe + Inside/Outside + First/Last
Episodes.Description: A tea party attracts an uninvited guest, a sneaky mouse makes mischief on movie night, and Blue and Red buckle up to win a race.

Episodes.Title: Awake/Asleep + Hot/Cold + Clumsy/Graceful
Episodes.Description: On a snowy Christmas Eve, the friends try to stay up and see Santa Fish. Later on, they hit the pool to stay cool, then bundle up to go ice skating.

Episodes.Title: Near/Far + Heavy/Light + Open/Shut
Episodes.Description: A furry dog wants Red and Blue's frisbee, Little Fish needs help moving into a new house, and a snappy clam traps the friends' favorite ball.

Entries.Title: Fermat Kitchen
Entries.Description: The story centers on Gaku Kitada, a talented mathematics scholar, and Kai Asakura, a young but similarly talented chef. After Gaku suffers setbacks on his dream of becoming a mathematician, he meets Kai as he is running his own food business, and joins Kai in an attempt at something new.

Episodes.Title: A Mysterious Man
Episodes.Description: After failing at the Mathematics Olympiad and giving up on his dream of becoming a mathematician, Gaku Kitada meets Kai Asakura, a young genius chef, through a plate of spaghetti Napolitan he prepared at the school cafeteria. It is then that a terrible piece of news will turn his life upside down.

Episodes.Title: The Door of Truth
Episodes.Description: After impressing the benefactors of Wels Academy with his "mathematical method" spaghetti Napolitan, Gaku is invited by Kai to visit his Tokyo restaurant. There, he faces a challenge from Chef Ranna Akamatsu.

Episodes.Title: Challenge Gods With Cooking
Episodes.Description: Gaku unexpectedly reunites with Kagura Musashi, his childhood friend and former Math Olympiad rival. Disappointed by his decision to leave math behind, she scoffs—until he serves her a dish crafted through logical precision.

Episodes.Title: Before and After
Episodes.Description: Realizing that the path of cooking leads to the "Gate of Truth," Takeru takes the hand of Umi, who boasts that he will "challenge God with cooking." After graduating from school at the top of his class, Takeru moves to Tokyo and begins living with Umi as an apprentice chef at "K." Umi, who has noticed Takeru's fatal weakness, puts him in charge of the meals at "K" and gives him the task of creating meals that will satisfy all the staff within a week. Takeru enters "K" kitchen in high spirits, but is horrified by the harshness of the battlefield.

Entries.Title: Ruri Rocks
Entries.Description: High schooler Ruri Tanigawa loves shiny things. She loves them so much that she heads into the mountains to search for crystals herself—where she unexpectedly meets Nagi Arato, a graduate student studying mineralogy. As the pair start collecting minerals together, Ruri begins developing a genuine appreciation for science and the beauty of the natural world.

Episodes.Title: My First Mineral Hunt
Episodes.Description: High school girl Ruri meets graduate student Nagi while collecting minerals in the mountains.

Episodes.Title: The Value of Golden Color
Episodes.Description: Ruri is determined to find gold, but Nagi explains that it might not be as likely as she hopes.

Episodes.Title: The Lost Planet
Episodes.Description: Ruri meets Nagi's colleague Imari, and the three embark on a journey to find a lost mine.

Episodes.Title: Study of Sands
Episodes.Description: In search of sapphire, Nagi teaches Ruri how to study sand, but Ruri prefers to hunt on a bigger scale.

Episodes.Title: Worlds Seen and Unseen
Episodes.Description: Ruri, Nagi, and Imari head to the beach in search of agate, and Ruri learns about the long lifecycle of rocks.

Episodes.Title: A Closer Look into the Blue
Episodes.Description: Just as the group begins searching for sapphire on foot, Ruri uncovers a grave mistake that halts their plans.

Episodes.Title: Seaside Recycling Studio
Episodes.Description: Ruri finds sea glass on the beach and runs into her classmate Shoko, who has a secret passion for minerals.

Episodes.Title: The Golden Elegy
Episodes.Description: Ruri teams up with Shoko for a science project, which takes a turn when they discover a strange, orange rock.

Episodes.Title: Time Capsule of 1.9 Million Tons
Episodes.Description: Ruri and Nagi head out to hunt for opals but discover that the area has already been fully excavated.

Episodes.Title: Sentence to an Abandoned Railroad
Episodes.Description: Imari leads a hunt for manganese ore, when the group encounters a mystery along abandoned railroad tracks.

Entries.Title: KAMITSUBAKI CITY UNDER CONSTRUCTION
Entries.Description: Seven years after humanity was devastated by a major disaster, a beacon of science and prosperity rises in Kamitsubaki City. But lurking in its shadows are Tesseractor monsters born from human darkness. Only the Witchling, five girls with Song of Purification, stand against them. With every note, they fight, not just to protect the peace of the city, but to heal a broken world.

Episodes.Title: -Witchling- (2)
Episodes.Description: The witchlings address an unfolding disaster at City Hall, but Sekai foresees a greater disaster to come.

Episodes.Title: Song of Purification
Episodes.Description: As the RD struggles to keep the outbreak under control, Sekai rushes to save the people of her old church.

Episodes.Title: Fragment
Episodes.Description: The witchlings debate the fallout from their last mission while the RD Chief struggles to understand.

Episodes.Title: Malice
Episodes.Description: The witchlings are left reeling from a sudden betrayal as disappearances rise around the city.

Episodes.Title: Familiar
Episodes.Description: The witchlings are forced to run from suspicious townspeople while trying to find and stop Kugel.

Episodes.Title: Memory Egg
Episodes.Description: Exploring Kugel's memories forces the witchlings to confront a shocking truth about their world.

Episodes.Title: Phenomenon
Episodes.Description: As time ticks down for Kamitsubaki CIty, Kafu confronts the forces preventing her from singing.

Episodes.Title: Blackout
Episodes.Description: Maxwell prepares to unleash hell on Kamitsubaki City, but the witchlings are far from a united front.

Episodes.Title: Desire
Episodes.Description: The situation grows even more dire for the witchlings as Maxwell's plan comes to fruition.

Entries.Title: You and Idol Precure ♪
Entries.Description: Middle school student Uta Sakura loves to sing any chance she gets. But music becomes more than a hobby when she meets Purirun, a fairy whose hometown has plunged into darkness. The Chokkiri Gang took over her land and began stealing her people's sparkle. Determined to help, Uta is transformed into the legendary protector Cure Idol and vows to return their sparkle through song.

Episodes.Title: Cure Idol Debuts!
Episodes.Description: Uta Sakura lives in Hanamichi Town. One day while on a walk, she meets a fairy named Purirun. Purirun has come in search of Kirakiland’s savior called Idol Precure.

Episodes.Title: Am I Going Viral?
Episodes.Description: The Queen of Kirakiland, Pikarine, tells Uta about Team Chokkiri and their boss, Darkine. Meanwhile, Cure Idol is going viral on TV and social media as a “mysterious new idol.”

Episodes.Title: Have Courage! Cure Wink Debuts!
Episodes.Description: Nana, who is feeling down about a mistake she made during her piano competition, is invited to Uta’s family’s home, Café Glitter. Uta and Uta’s little sister Hamori cheer her up, and she is ready to do her best at the school welcome event…

Episodes.Title: The Legendary Idol?! Kaito Hibiki
Episodes.Description: Just like it did with Cure Idol, the word is spreading about Cure Wink. Meanwhile, another popular “legendary idol” Kaito Hibiki drops by Cafe Glitter.

Episodes.Title: We Got a Manager!
Episodes.Description: A man named Tanaka appears before Uta and Nana and says he knows they're Idol Precures. Meanwhile, a message arrives that says, “I want to hire the Pretty Cures.”

Episodes.Title: My Heart's Going Kyun-Kyun?!
Episodes.Description: Uta and Nana get to know Kokoro Shigure, president of the Cure Idol and Cure Wink Research Club. Purirun wants to become friends with Kokoro and follows her after school.

Episodes.Title: Dancing Heart! Cure Kyun-Kyun's Debut!
Episodes.Description: Kokoro is shocked to see Cure Idol and Cure Wink battle the Makkuranda, and runs away, saying “I can’t do that!” She tries to forget about the Idol Precures that she loves by putting away all her merchandise and dancing her troubles away, but…

Episodes.Title: Sleepover! Idol Precure Study Session!
Episodes.Description: Kokoro says she wants to study Cure Idol and Cure Wink, so they decide to have a sleepover at Uta’s house.

Episodes.Title: The Seven Wonders of Nana!
Episodes.Description: On their way home from school, Nana suddenly begins acting strangely. When she continues to say and do strange things, Uta and Kokoro start to count the “Seven Wonders of Nana.”

Episodes.Title: CD Debut! Idol Precure!
Episodes.Description: The Idol Precure songs are being made into a CD, so Cure Idol and the others start recording. But Cure Kyun-Kyun is so nervous that she can’t sing well.

Episodes.Title: Trio Dreams
Episodes.Description: Inspired by the school broadcast, Uta and the others begin to think about their dreams for the future. To help Uta, who is having trouble deciding, Nana and Kokoro begin “Uta’s Dream Search Project.”

Episodes.Title: Purirun's fan, Meroron is here!
Episodes.Description: A new arrival to Hanamichi Town from Kirakiland is discovered. Purirun says it’s Meroron, and Uta and her friends go searching for them.

Episodes.Title: Go! Go! Kirakilight!
Episodes.Description: Uta and her friends form a girls volleyball team for the school ball-game tournament. On her team is Wakaba, a member of the official school team. She’s in love with Shota, another volleyball player, and declares that she’ll tell him her feelings if they win.

Episodes.Title: Dear Mom, a Message from Kokoro
Episodes.Description: Kokoro’s mother has to work despite it being the weekend, and Kokoro sees her off. Kokoro buys her a carnation for Mother’s Day and has trouble coming up with a good message for the card, so she drops by Cafe Glitter to get some advice.

Episodes.Title: Operation Make Sissy Fall In Love
Episodes.Description: Meroron is jealous of Purirun’s relationship with Uta, so Uta and the others, who also want to be closer with Meroron, encourage Purirun to spend more time with Meroron. Purirun invites Meroron to dress in matching outfits and go on a date.

Episodes.Title: Full Bloom! Intensive Practice! Hanamichi Town Festival!
Episodes.Description: Idol Precure is invited to appear at the Hanamichi Town Festival. Uta and the others want to make the event a success, so they ask Tanaka to help them make an intensive practice regimen.

Episodes.Title: Purirun's Decision! Let's Go to Kirakiland!
Episodes.Description: Purirun desperately wants to help Uta and decides to go to Kirakiland with Meroron. Meanwhile, Uta and the others are preparing to go on stage at the Hanamichi Town Festival.

Episodes.Title: Who Are You? Zukyoon Through My Heart!
Episodes.Description: A mysterious duo has suddenly appeared: Cure Zukyoon and Cure Kiss. Uta wakes up in the middle of a dream about Cure Zukyoon, and even at school her head is full of Cure Zukyoon all day. Kokoro sees this and determines that Uta has become a fan of Cure Zukyoon.

Episodes.Title: The Pair's Vow! Cure Zukyoon and Cure Kiss Debut!
Episodes.Description: Cure Idol and her friends chase after Cure Zukyoon and Cure Kiss but lose sight of them. Sometime later, a magazine reporter who wants to learn the truth about the duo appears, and Uta and the others offer to help.

Episodes.Title: Puri! A Picnic to Find Memories!
Episodes.Description: Uta and the others learn that Purirun gave up all their memories of them to become a Precure. Uta and the others invite the fairies on a picnic to try to recover Purirun's memories.

Episodes.Title: Super-Duper! A Miracle in Unison!
Episodes.Description: Uta, who fainted due to a cold, gets upset and cries about how Purirun's memories aren't returning. But once she feels better, she visits Purirun and proposes they make new memories together, and they begin taking selfies.

Episodes.Title: Idol Precure VS ZukyoonKiss?!
Episodes.Description: Idol Precure and ZukyoonKiss are hired for a promotional campaign showdown at Pretty Holic. But Meroron sees Purirun’s usual carefree attitude and comes up with an idea…

Episodes.Title: This Is My Signature!
Episodes.Description: The Precures are asked to sign a present for a fan, and they realize they’ve never made their own signatures. At that moment, they hear the news that Kaito Hibiki has resumed his activities.

Episodes.Title: Tanakhan's Summer Holiday!
Episodes.Description: When Uta and the others learn that Tanaka hasn’t taken a summer holiday in years, they offer to do his usual jobs for him so he can rest. But when faced with a sudden day off, he’s not sure what to do with himself.

Episodes.Title: Wink in a Field of Sunflowers
Episodes.Description: Thanks to an idea from Nana, they decide to visit some sunflower fields. Nana enjoys the vast expanses of blooming sunflowers, but she can’t stop worrying about Zakkuri.

Episodes.Title: The Kyun-er the Better!
Episodes.Description: They decide to create an Idol Precure and ZukyoonKiss fanclub and Kokoro works especially hard at it. While answering a question about favorite sayings for the fanclub newsletter, Kokoro remembers something from her early years.

Episodes.Title: Let's all have Kyun-Kyun hearts together!
Episodes.Description: As the Idol Precure and ZukyoonKiss Fanclub gains momentum, Uta and the others decide to begin making videos for their fans on their CureTube channel. Then, at school check-in day during their summer holidays, Uta receives a letter.

Episodes.Title: Woof Woof! Together with Kyu-Chan!
Episodes.Description: Uta and the others visit Grandpa Heiji Sakura’s house. They bring the family dog, Kyutaro, along and when something makes Uta feel lonely, he wants to help cheer her up.

Episodes.Title: Meroron's Friend
Episodes.Description: In response to a fan question, Idol Precure say, “We are all friends.” However, Cure Kiss can’t accept those words and takes Cure Zukyoon away, saying, “We’re not friends.”

Episodes.Title: Precure! Kirakkiran for You!
Episodes.Description: Meroron is locked in a dark capsule generated by the legendary Heart Kirari Lock. Uta and the others call Pikarine and ask about the most precious thing that Meroron locked away.

Episodes.Title: Who's the Center of Idol Precure?!
Episodes.Description: When asked, "Why is Cure Idol always in the middle?" Uta realizes that she has been monopolizing the center position. Uta and the others listen to Kokoro's explanation and begin to think about the center position in Idol Precure.

Entries.Title: My Senior Brother is Too Strong
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: My Melody & Kuromi
Entries.Description: When My Melody's visit to the Cloud Kingdom leads to a whirlwind of trouble, can she, Kuromi and their friends save their home before it's too late?

Episodes.Title: What's This? My Heart Is Pounding
Episodes.Description: Tired of being overshadowed, Kuromi steals precious ingredients from her rival. My Melody ventures into the forest and stumbles upon a strange discovery.

Episodes.Title: Fluffy and Soft
Episodes.Description: Up in the clouds, My Melody has an ominous encounter with a giant, fluffy bear. Back in Mariland, Flat encourages her to join the upcoming sweets contest.

Episodes.Title: Kuromi's Great Recipe Heist
Episodes.Description: My Melody's new creation is delightfully light and airy with a satisfying crunch. Unhappy with her own recipes, Kuromi sneaks into her rival's home.

Episodes.Title: Honey Car Chase!
Episodes.Description: Everyone loves My Melody's new cupcakes, but mean online reviews upset her. Determined to uncover her baking secrets, Tanba and Sasage chase her down.

Episodes.Title: The Sweets Contest Begins
Episodes.Description: Ready, set... bake! My Melody, Flat and Piano impress the crowd with their teamwork. Can Kuromi steal the spotlight with her wild creation?

Episodes.Title: The Secret of Kuromi's Dorayaki
Episodes.Description: Kuromi's wildest dreams have come true! She's now the most popular patissier in Mariland. But Mr. Pistachio's help might be a recipe for trouble...

Episodes.Title: What Should I Do?
Episodes.Description: Chased into the forest by ravenous villagers, My Melody and Kuromi find themselves in a jam — until a thunderous voice comes to their rescue.

Episodes.Title: Time for Teamwork
Episodes.Description: As My Melody faces her home and town in ruins, Tanba and Sasage get punished for coming clean about their past. Kuromi turns to her friend for help.

Episodes.Title: To the Cloud Kingdom!
Episodes.Description: Amidst the rubble, My Melody shares her honest feelings with Kuromi. They decide to return to the Cloud Kingdom together to set things right.

Episodes.Title: Pistachio's Past
Episodes.Description: While Flat and Piano continue researching the Cloud Kingdom's history and the tragedy that befell it, My Melody and Kuromi confront Pistachio.

Episodes.Title: All for Our Best Friend
Episodes.Description: Kuromi desperately tries to awaken My Melody while Pistachio moves forward with his plan. But things turn sour as an uncontrollable rot spreads.

Episodes.Title: My Melody & Kuromi
Episodes.Description: For three days, My Melody's friends struggle to stay awake, watching over her as she dreams of her Mama's words of wisdom. Will Mariland be saved in time?

Entries.Title: The Unaware Atelier Meister
Entries.Description: Kurt Rockhans is a kind-hearted errand boy for a hero’s party, the Flaming Dragon Fang. One day, he's banished from the party and finds out he has the lowest rank in combat. In order to make a living, Kurt picks up various jobs and discovers he has astonishing abilities. Though he doesn't realize it yet, Kurt has SSS-rank skills in anything other than fighting, as he sets off on a new journey.

Episodes.Title: The Guy in Charge of Chores with Low Self-Esteem Turned Out to Actually Possess Incredible Skills
Episodes.Description: After he's fired from his party of heroes, the 15-year-old Kurt turns to a temp agency for work.

Episodes.Title: His First Atelier
Episodes.Description: Kurt accepts an offer from Bandana to go work at his first Atelier, which harbors a dangerous secret.

Episodes.Title: What Mining Means To Him
Episodes.Description: While Ophelia and the others discuss plans to uncover who cursed Liselotte, Kurt takes a job as a porter.

Episodes.Title: New Friends in a New Atelier
Episodes.Description: Yulishia establishes a new atelier in the frontier town without letting Kurt know he's its atelier meister.

Episodes.Title: A Frontier Town With Enemies at All Sides
Episodes.Description: Tristan & a demon lord force Marlefiss to summon hordes of monsters to attack the town in order to kill Lise.

Episodes.Title: The Ninth Direction
Episodes.Description: Kurt tunnels into the ruins from underground and saves Marlefiss while his allies defeat the demon lord.

Episodes.Title: The New Papa of a Mysterious Egg
Episodes.Description: After helping a village with a water shortage, Kurt receives an egg that hatches into a 3-year old girl.

Episodes.Title: Akuri's Fwoosh
Episodes.Description: While Kurt and Yulishia help a farm with their pigs, a demon tries to take away Akuri.

Episodes.Title: Lise's Confession
Episodes.Description: Mimico reports on Akuri and interrogates Solflare. Then Kurt & Lise go on a date before the rescue mission.

Episodes.Title: Yulishia's Date
Episodes.Description: Yulishia's date with Kurt is ruined when thugs harass a local meat bun shop over a cooking competition.

Episodes.Title: The Margrave's Secret
Episodes.Description: While the group distracts the Margrave, Akuri warps Kurt into the forbidden room hiding the Margrave's secret.

Episodes.Title: A Common Story About How the Former Head of Chores for a Party of Heroes Was Actually SSS-Rank in All Except Combat Skills
Episodes.Description: The Margrave tries to summon a demon to save his daughter. After he fails, the mastermind summons it anyway.

Entries.Title: Utagoe Ha Mille-Feuille
Entries.Description: The a cappella club is filled with unique individuals some might say they're a bit odd. Even if they're not flashy or popular, there's a special kind of youth that connects through their voices, creating something truly unique.

Episodes.Title: Pop Music Debut?!
Episodes.Description: April. Uta, a freshman, is starting high school and aims to join the light music club. However, when she sees the glamorous boys and girls of the light music club chatting away, her extremely negative personality makes her hesitant to take the first step.

Episodes.Title: Ulurun TV
Episodes.Description: Uta struggles with her first a cappella practice. Meanwhile, a new member candidate found by club president Airi becomes a hot topic. All the club members go out to recruit her to take on the role of "voice percussion," a unique part of a cappella.

Entries.Title: Hotel Inhumans
Entries.Description: The best hotels must meet certain standards, including the finest cuisine, ways to relax, and entertainment. Of course, they also need the best selection of weapons, reliable ways to falsify one's identity, and ways to dispose of evidence. In this hotel at the border of death stand two concierges, Ikuro Hoshi and Sara Haizaki. What kinds of requests will the assassins have for them next?

Episodes.Title: Sister Sister
Episodes.Description: A wounded man flees to Hotel Inhumans, where they cater to a certain clientele and the concierges are skilled.

Episodes.Title: Dying Service 1
Episodes.Description: Kase is a hitman who stays at the hotel when he escapes the life others believe he leads.

Episodes.Title: Dying Service 2
Episodes.Description: Kase's wound is dire. As his consciousness fades, memories of his wife, and one last request, fill his mind.

Episodes.Title: Corpse Reviver
Episodes.Description: Nina has been raised to kill. One night, at the hotel bar, she listens to her next target's newest song.

Episodes.Title: Remember Me
Episodes.Description: A couple arrives at the hotel. As Ikuro offers to take their weapons, Sara stops him for a surprising reason.

Episodes.Title: A Last Supper 2
Episodes.Description: Sara and Ikuro fight in their own ways for the sake of their guest, Ringo, as her condition quickly worsens.

Episodes.Title: Spider
Episodes.Description: A reporter who specializes in scandals tails a gunman from a murder scene to a hotel that isn't on any map.

Episodes.Title: Risk Management
Episodes.Description: An old man claiming to be a regular arrives at the hotel, but his last stay there was twenty years ago!

Episodes.Title: Another Sky 1
Episodes.Description: Sniper Danica and spotter Chetana are a sought after team, but they first met when Danica was betrayed.

Entries.Title: Turkey! Time to Strike
Entries.Description: Mai Otonashi is a second-year student and the captain of the Ikkokukan High School Bowling Club, and recently, she's struggled to win. Whenever she scores a Turkey, three consecutive strikes, she follows it up with an unbeatable split—the Snake Eyes. This is the story of Mai, Rina, Sayuri, Nozomi, and Nanase as they fight, fall, and rise again in pursuit of victory in the final days of summer.

Episodes.Title: Knock Down the Snake Eyes!
Episodes.Description: After botching another match, bowling club captain Mai struggles to keep the club fun for all of its members.

Episodes.Title: Lost, Outside the Spot
Episodes.Description: The girls find themselves in the past facing immediate danger when a handsome young 'B' comes to their rescue.

Episodes.Title: Lean on Your Balance Line
Episodes.Description: The girls deal with Suguri's eccentric sisters while brainstorming ways to get home without affecting history.

Episodes.Title: The Chaotic Big Four
Episodes.Description: Mai forgets her promise and asks Sumomo to build a bowling lane while Rina wrestles with her inner struggles.

Episodes.Title: A Passing Hook Ball
Episodes.Description: After losing her ball while testing out a "plan B" to get home, Nozomi starts to find common ground with Anzu.

Episodes.Title: Reverse Hook, Clear Across
Episodes.Description: With bandits roaming nearby, the girls learn from their hosts about life and values in the Sengoku period.

Episodes.Title: Hold On to the Loft Ball
Episodes.Description: The long-lost eldest sister Natsume unexpectedly returns home from her travels without her mysterious partner.

Episodes.Title: A Surprise Blind Score
Episodes.Description: As they enjoy the hot spring and learn more about their hosts and each other, the girls uncover a new mystery.

Episodes.Title: Right in the Pocket Together
Episodes.Description: The secret of the house is finally revealed and Mai suggests a way to decide which of the sisters gets to die.

Episodes.Title: What Do We Do? Split
Episodes.Description: The girls return to their time and start learning about their Sengoku friends and the history of the region.

Entries.Title: The Shiunji Family Children
Entries.Description: The Shiunji family with their seven children reside in a mansion within Tokyo’s Setagaya ward. The eldest son, Arata, is tired of being pushed around by his five sisters and daydreams of a life without them. That is, until Arata’s father reveals a shocking truth—Arata isn’t biologically related to his sisters! The siblings’ relationships will be tested as they navigate life in this new light.

Episodes.Title: What If...?
Episodes.Description: Arata (16), the 3rd of 7 siblings and oldest son of the Shiunji family, dreams of a different life until...

Episodes.Title: Now What
Episodes.Description: How will the siblings come to terms with the news?

Episodes.Title: For Now
Episodes.Description: The gang heads to an amusement park to celebrate Kotono's birthday!

Episodes.Title: Respectively
Episodes.Description: After Ouka's confession, Minami and Banri want to find out if anything has changed for Arata.

Episodes.Title: Perhaps
Episodes.Description: Kotono's suspicions continue to grow. Meanwhile, Seiha has a theory and demands to test it out.

Episodes.Title: Now's the Time
Episodes.Description: Minami's distractions catch up to her in the lead-up to her inter-highs.

Episodes.Title: Surely
Episodes.Description: Where is Minami, and what comes of the tournament finals?

Episodes.Title: Since Then
Episodes.Description: Minami deals with the aftermath, and Banri needs someone to help her.

Episodes.Title: Not Yet
Episodes.Description: Ouka's gone AWOL, and the gang must figure out what's going on.

Episodes.Title: Finally
Episodes.Description: Arata has found Ouka, but what next? And how will the rest of the family respond?

Episodes.Title: So Then
Episodes.Description: The kids hit up their dad's summer villa in Karuizawa for a chill holiday, but things heat up for Arata!

Episodes.Title: Still
Episodes.Description: As the family trip draws to a close, the siblings each come to terms with their bonds in their own way.

Entries.Title: My Hero Academia: Vigilantes
Entries.Description: Koichi Haimawari is a dull college student who aspires to be a hero but has given up on his dream. Although 80% of the world’s population has superhuman powers called Quirks, few are chosen to become heroes and protect people. Everything changes for Koichi when he and Pop☆Step are saved by the vigilante Knuckleduster and get recruited to become vigilantes themselves!

Episodes.Title: I'm Here
Episodes.Description: Koichi is convinced he'll never manage to become a hero, until he meets someone with an odd take on justice.

Episodes.Title: Takeoff
Episodes.Description: Some people frown upon vigilante activities, but the least they could do is remember The Crawler's name.

Episodes.Title: Bee
Episodes.Description: The drug Trigger is wreaking havoc all over town, but figuring out who's dealing it is easier said than done.

Episodes.Title: Top Runner
Episodes.Description: What happens when pro heroes and vigilantes target the same villain? Is it possible to work as a team?

Episodes.Title: Judgment
Episodes.Description: Koichi and Pop each find themselves considerably influenced by various events from their pasts.

Episodes.Title: Crossing Lines
Episodes.Description: Hachisuka tries manipulating Stendhal into fighting targets of her choosing, but can anyone control him?

Episodes.Title: Makoto/Truth
Episodes.Description: Makoto offers to help a struggling Koichi with his studies, but she requests something surprising in return.

Episodes.Title: Major
Episodes.Description: The American hero Captain Celebrity sets up shop in Japan, and it isn't long before trouble begins.

Episodes.Title: Mom Descends!
Episodes.Description: Koichi's mother is in town, and he's willing to take drastic measures so that she'll let him stay in Tokyo.

Episodes.Title: Event Announcement!
Episodes.Description: Pop receives a request to perform at an upcoming local event, and she finds herself in need of guidance.

Episodes.Title: The Day Of
Episodes.Description: Preparing for Narufest proves to be an uphill battle. Will teamwork be what gets everyone to the finish line?

Episodes.Title: Goodbye to Dad
Episodes.Description: There's trouble when the power goes out at Narufest, all while Knuckleduster fights a very personal battle.

Episodes.Title: What a Man Takes with Him
Episodes.Description: Narufest turned out to be a huge success, but our vigilantes must decide whether it's time for some changes.

Entries.Title: Chainsaw Man – The Compilation
Entries.Description:
The two-part compilation, Part I and Part II, re-edits and condenses the key moments from the first season of the Chainsaw Man anime. This compilation revisits Denji's journey, from his humble beginnings as a debt-ridden devil hunter to his transformation into the Chainsaw Man.

In addition to the re-edited material, the compilation includes newly animated segments titled Chainsaw Days. These segments adapt bonus chapters from the original manga.

Episodes.Title: Part 1
Episodes.Description: Denji is a young man who makes a pact with a demon and ends up working as a Devil Hunter hunting devils.

Episodes.Title: Part 2
Episodes.Description: As a Public Security Devil Hunter, Denji faces increasingly powerful devils.

Entries.Title: With You and the Rain
Entries.Description: On a rainy day, Fuji meets a cute critter posing as a dog and offering an umbrella and a cue card that says, “Please take me home,” and she can’t resist. With this dog-poster’s quirky charm and mysterious ways, life together becomes a heartwarming adventure of friendship and shared seasons.

Episodes.Title: Rainy Days
Episodes.Description: While getting drenched in the rain, Fuji encounters an "abandoned dog" on the street and brings it home.

Episodes.Title: The Evening Sun
Episodes.Description: Fuji and her "dog" go on a walk with her neighbor Kii and her dog Kinako. Then Fuji's dad, Tatsuo, shows up.

Episodes.Title: Friends
Episodes.Description: Fuji's friends from school, Ren and Mimi, visit her for a gyoza party.

Episodes.Title: Summer Festival
Episodes.Description: You, Fuji, Kii, and Fuji's parents go to the summer festival, and You disappears.

Episodes.Title: The Same Moon
Episodes.Description: Fuji meets manga artist Tokaku Arata in a video meeting. You and Fuji meet Medaka and Noriko on their walk.

Episodes.Title: The Cat and Pumpkins
Episodes.Description: Fuji's twin brother, Teru, and his pregnant wife, Wako, leave their cat at Fuji's.

Episodes.Title: It's Nothing
Episodes.Description: Fuji encounters a writer's block and cannot get out of it.

Episodes.Title: The Cry
Episodes.Description: Fuji hears You cry for the first time.

Episodes.Title: A Secret
Episodes.Description: It turns out that Fuji doesn't want others to know she's a writer.

Episodes.Title: A River That Cannot Be Crossed
Episodes.Description: Fuji reaches out to Ren for support as she struggles with writer's block.

Entries.Title: Medalist
Entries.Description: Tsukasa Akeuraji, a frustrated skater, meets Inori Yuitsuka, a girl who yearns to be a figure skater. Motivated by Inori's obsession on the rink, Tsukasa begins coaching Inori. Inori's talent blossoms, and Tsukasa becomes a brilliant mentor. Together they aim to make her a glorious medalist!

Episodes.Title: A Genius on the Ice
Episodes.Description: When former figure skater Tsukasa Akeuraji meets a self-taught skater, Inori Yuitsuka, he tries to persuade her to join a formal ice skating club. Unfortunately, Inori's mother wants her clumsy daughter to give up skating altogether.

Episodes.Title: Prelim Badge Test
Episodes.Description: Tsukasa and Hitomi encourage Inori to take the Badge Test, a certification exam for figure skating which will allow Inori to qualify for competitions. On the day of the test, Inori meets a beautiful girl who looks like a princess.

Episodes.Title: Taiyaki and Cake
Episodes.Description: Tsukasa decides to enter Inori into the Meikoh Cup to build up her record of success. When Inori feels shy dancing in front of others, Tsukasa gets her to dance in his shadow to conquer her nerves. During skating practice, Inori also meets a girl named Miké at the rink.

Episodes.Title: Meikoh Cup, Junior Women's Prelim Free Skating (1)
Episodes.Description: Inori's first competition, the Meikoh cup, begins. Inori's future is at stake, and while she gets off to a rocky start, her mother and sister are there to support her from the sidelines.

Episodes.Title: Meikoh Cup, Junior Women's Prelim Free Skating (2)
Episodes.Description: Inori came in top in the first round of the Prelims, whereas Miké was the last one to secure a spot. Determined to turn things around, Miké decides to try and pull off a double rotation combination that no one at the Prelims has done before.

Episodes.Title: The Night of the First Competition
Episodes.Description: Hikaru is one of the best performers of Inori's generation, and Inori is eager to catch up. However, she worries about how far behind she is in terms of her skill level compared to others her age. Tsukasa suggests Inori compete in a competition immediately after passing the level one badge test.

Episodes.Title: Level One Badge Test
Episodes.Description: Inori faces the level one badge test, setting her next step of competing in a championship. A successful double jump will be essential for a high score.

Episodes.Title: Western Powerhouses (1)
Episodes.Description: On the way to a competition, Inori leaves her skates on a train by accident. Tsukasa goes on a mad hunt for the skates ten stations away.

Episodes.Title: Western Powerhouses (2)
Episodes.Description: After a smooth start, Inori decides to take each jump carefully, one by one. She controls her center of gravity and maintains a high speed, and Tsukasa cannot hide his excitement as she continues with her flawless performance.

Episodes.Title: Howling at Night
Episodes.Description: Inori competes in her second Meikoh cup, but she will need to perfect the extremely difficult double Axel if she is to progress to the next level. Meanwhile, Tsukasa is asked by Olympic silver medalist Shinichiro Sonidori to mentor his son, Rioh.

Episodes.Title: Dance the Night
Episodes.Description: The Lux Higashiyama FSC summer training camp begins, and Inori plans to perfect her double Axel. Meanwhile, Tsukasa offers to help Rioh, but Rioh turns him down.

Episodes.Title: Shirone's Lesson
Episodes.Description: Tsukasa learns of the anguish Rioh has been carrying, and dances Rioh's program on the rink. Rioh is surprised to see that Tsukasa's skating is much more skillful than he expected.

Episodes.Title: Morning Arrives
Episodes.Description: The day of the Level Six Badge Test has finally arrived. The venue is the memorable place where Inori first met Hikaru. When Hikaru suddenly appears, she promises to meet Inori again at the All-Japans.

Entries.Title: #1 Happy Family USA
Entries.Description: An exploration of the experiences of a Muslim-American family that must learn how to code-switch as they navigate the early 2000s: a time of fear, war, and the rapid expansion of the boy-band industrial complex.

Episodes.Title: NINE TEN
Episodes.Description: Hello, I am Hussein, and this is my family, the Husseins! This is a very big day for us. We have experienced a loss… but I negotiated a very cheap burial price! Go me. Tomorrow is already looking better!

Episodes.Title: #1 VIGIL MOURNERS!
Episodes.Description: Look how many candles we have! We are the most sad AND the least scary! There is nothing hidden in my halal cart. Trust us. Now.

Episodes.Title: WE ARE NOTHING!
Episodes.Description: The government has created a new secret spy program called See Something Say Something! But you can't see something if we are nothing!

Episodes.Title: EGYPT IS ON THE PHONE!
Episodes.Description: Mona, this is a very important phone call. We are speaking to our relatives in Egypt. This is a very expensive call, but of course I got us a phone card that is very cheap. It is very important that you make our move across the world seem worth it. Make us look good! Now.

Episodes.Title: VERY GOOD HATE CRIME!
Episodes.Description: Hateful, but helpful. The best hate crime I have ever seen. I love this country.

Episodes.Title: DAUGHTER PRESIDENT!
Episodes.Description: The school election is just as important as the presidential election and only one of them is rigged. Soon my daughter will run the world! While my son wastes away. Inshallah.

Episodes.Title: INSHALLAH PUBES!
Episodes.Description: Rumi, once they grow down there, they leave your head. I’m sorry son. It’s time for you to grow up. You will be a bald man by high school.

Episodes.Title: A SLEEPOVER WITH MR. PRESIDENT!
Episodes.Description: We love you Mr. Bush. Feel free to stay at our house, and torture our family. We cannot wait to visit this Guantanamo Bay! It sounds beautiful.

Entries.Title: 9-nine- Ruler's Crown
Entries.Description: 9-nine is a tale of the town of Shiromitsugawa, host to mysterious Artifacts and the superpowers they bestow on their Users. A tale of growing trust and budding romance between the protagonist and the heroine, and also a murder mystery where they hunt down the culprit behind a series of supernatural murders.

Episodes.Title: Branch 01
Episodes.Description: During a town revitalization event at the White Snake Tsukumo Shrine, a sudden earthquake occurs. Sho Shinkai witnesses the destruction of a sacred artifact in the main hall of the shrine and injures his finger on a fragment he picked up. This was a sign of a quiet and strange occurrence. A few days later, rumors spread that a stone statue of a girl had appeared in the park. In response to this mysterious occurrence, Sho goes to investigate the rumor with his classmates Yoichi Fukazawa and Miyako Kujo to see if it is true. Is it a coincidence or fate? The "story" quietly begins to move.

Episodes.Title: Branch 02
Episodes.Description: A mysterious fire suddenly breaks out at Hakusen Academy. As the students are filled with fear, Shinkai Sho rushes around trying to save his younger sister, Shinkai Ten. Kujo Miyako, who seems to know something, offers to help Sho. As Sho and Miyako search for the cause of the fire, a supernatural being with the ability to freely control flames appears before them. Facing a threat that cannot be countered by common sense, Miyako activates her powers using an accessory called an "Artifact," which bestows special abilities. As danger looms, the two join forces to face the supernatural being. What fate awaits them at the end of the battle?

Episodes.Title: Branch 03
Episodes.Description: Miyako has been given the "power to take away ownership of other people's things" by the artifact. Sophitia also tells her that Sho has an unidentified power. With her help, Sho and Miyako begin investigating the culprit of the petrification incident. They discover a new use for Miyako's power and take a step closer to solving the case. The two of them build a strong bond through their investigation. However, Yuki Kia, who is pursuing the culprit of the petrification incident alone, appears and begins to suspect that Sho may be the culprit.

Entries.Title: KOWLOON GENERIC ROMANCE
Entries.Description: Real estate agents Reiko Kujirai and Hajime Kudo work in the nostalgic Kowloon Walled City. As they spend more time together, Reiko’s feelings for Hajime grow. But when she finds a photo of him and his former fiancée, she’s shocked to see the woman looks exactly like her. Reiko then realizes a chilling truth: she has no memory of her past.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: In the nostalgic Kowloon Walled City, Reiko Kujirai is mistaken as her coworker Hajime Kudo's girlfriend.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Reiko tells Yaomay about the photo. Then Reiko meets Miyuki Hebinuma at the free beauty consultation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Kudo looks for Gwen to no avail. Meanwhile, a masked man tells Reiko she and Kujirai B are different people.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Miyuki Hebinuma investigates Kowloon with Gwen. Meanwhile, Reiko decides to keep living in Kujirai B's room.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Reiko tries to learn more about Kujirai B. Meanwhile, Yaomay acts strange when Reiko mentions the name Yangli.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Gwen tells Reiko and Yaomay that the residents of Kowloon have the second version of themselves.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Miyuki continues to investigate Kowloon and Kurijais situation with Yulongs help. Its a painfull anniversary for Kudo and Kurijai and Yaomay attempt to leave Kowloon.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Reiko learns there are people who can’t see her. Yaomay goes to Hong Kong to investigate.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Yaomay forgets what happened in Hong Kong. Meanwhile, a young man named Xiaohei appears.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Reiko notices that Kujirai B’s glasses show her B’s vision. Then she finds a warning on a talisman.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Reiko takes the boy Xiaohei to meet the girl Xiaohei. Gwen starts to figure out how this Kowloon is created.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Miyuki gives up on his revenge, and Reiko learns the true cause of death of Kujirai B from talking to Yulong.

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: As reality and fiction, past and present intwetwine, Reiko witnesses Kudo's memory of Kujirai B's death.

Entries.Title: Eclipse of Illusion
Entries.Description: After being betrayed on her wedding day, a powerful heroine rejects immortality and embraces vengeance, embarking on a ruthless path to destroy gods and seek justice.

Entries.Title: Bad Girl
Entries.Description: At heart, Yuu Yuutani is a total goody-two-shoes and only has eyes for the school's Madonna, Atori Mizutori. To get the attention of Atori, Yuu gives up the honor roll to become a bad girl! Too bad this very good girl isn't very good at being bad!

Episodes.Title: As of Today, I'm a Bad Girl! / I Wanna Be a Bad Girl! / Dog Ears and a Collar
Episodes.Description: Yuu Yuutani is a model first year student. However, to get the attention of her crush Atori Mizutori, Yuu decides to reinvent herself as the baddest of all delinquents!

Episodes.Title: Natural-Born Ero-ist / Secret Club / Please Tell Me!
Episodes.Description: Yuu plots to use her delinquent charisma to impress Atori by on a Student Council visit to a kindergarten.

Episodes.Title: I Hate You / Is Ruu Cute? / First Kiss
Episodes.Description: Mistaking Yuu for one of her fans, school idol Rura offers to shake her hand. But Yuu is so preoccupied with thoughts of Atori that she won't even admit that Rura is cute.

Episodes.Title: ADC Committee Assemble! / The Secret Classroom / A Rendez-vous With Rura Ruriha
Episodes.Description: Yuu is once again stalking Atori. She finds what she believes is a holy revelation from Atori left on a whiteboard.

Episodes.Title: Shijimi and Hotate / Bool! / I've Got You Now!
Episodes.Description: Head library assistant Kiyoraka, is a faultless honor student. However, she has an unexpected hidden side and takes an interest in Yuu.

Episodes.Title: Violent Times / Four-lling in Love / Heaven and Hell
Episodes.Description: Yuu feels down about not being able to see Atori during Golden Week. She takes another blow when she hears that Atori is going to an amusement park with a special someone.

Episodes.Title: Clothes Change Chaos / The Enemy Is Within the Classroom / Welcome to Cafe Scramble!
Episodes.Description: When Yuu stays after school to do some "birdwatching," or, taking secret candid photos of Atori, she encounters Mizuka!

Episodes.Title: A Co-Ord Based on Vibes / Confession / She's Here!
Episodes.Description: Yuu comes up with a way to make Atori sign up for forest camp. Yuu soon finds herself in a tight spot on a different bus than Atori and Suzu.

Episodes.Title: Something Bad / Another Mountain / I'll Tempt You!
Episodes.Description: It's time for forest camp, but Yuu finds herself left behind at the rest stop. But with Atori also left behind, the two try to come up with a plan.

Episodes.Title: In the Private Study Room / Gripping Rather Than Grabbing / In My Room
Episodes.Description: The girls visit the library to study for a test. There's a sudden flash of lightning, and the school is enveloped in darkness due to a power outage.

Entries.Title: Princession Orchestra
Entries.Description: Using the power of music, three girls transform into magical "princesses" to protect their peaceful utopian home from threatening, mysterious creatures.

Episodes.Title: What a Wonderful World
Episodes.Description: Minamo and her best friend Natsu encountered a strange land called Alicepia where they go to a live event held here. However, the event was attacked by a group of monsters called Jamaocks. At that moment, Minamo witnessed a Princess who sings and dance to defeat the monster.

Episodes.Title: The Girl's Best Efforts
Episodes.Description:
Minamo Sorano transforms into Princess Ripple but continues to struggle against monsters due to her inexperience. Just then, Princess Zeal, whom she saw recently at a concert venue, comes to her rescue and saves the day.

The true identity of Princess Zeal is Kagari Shirube, who happens to be Natsu Hinomoto’s idol and someone she deeply admires. Minamo learns more about the Princesses and the monsters known as Jamaock from Kagari.

Episodes.Title: Shooting Star, Cut Through the Darkness
Tears Have No Place in Paradise
Handing Down a Place to Belong
Power to Destroy, Power to Protect

Entries.Title: Can a Boy-Girl Friendship Survive?
Entries.Description: Childhood BFFs Himari and Yu’s vow of friendship hits turbulence when Yu reunites with his first crush in high school. Himari, who’s never known the fuzzy warmth of a crush, now must confront her feelings. Their shared dreams and peaceful days as a twosome gardening club are tested in this tale of love, flowers, and growing pains!

Episodes.Title: Anemone Flaccida and Queen of the Night
Episodes.Description: Yu has a passion for accessories. His best friend is his biggest supporter. But are they really just friends?

Episodes.Title: The Hibiscus Hair Ornament
Episodes.Description: Yu ponders his next product, and Himari forms a plan to bring Yu and Rion closer together.

Episodes.Title: Tulips and the Face of Love
Episodes.Description: Yu grapples with the reveal of Rion as his first crush, as his relationship with Himari begins to shift.

Episodes.Title: Hydrangea and a New Seed
Episodes.Description: Himari's decision to break off her friendship with Yu causes a rift in their relationship.

Episodes.Title: A Hunk and Morning Glory Yutaka
Episodes.Description: Yu reconciles with Himari, but finds himself at risk of failing classes.

Episodes.Title: The Scent of Cherry Sage
Episodes.Description: Rion is determined to participate in the study group to try to get closer to Yu.

Episodes.Title: The Cracked Crocus
Episodes.Description: The leak of Yu's identity as the creator of You leaves him juggling an uptick in orders from schoolmates.

Episodes.Title: Zinnia and Where Passion Lies
Episodes.Description: After his work results in troubles at school, Yu contemplates quitting his craft in accessories.

Episodes.Title: Love's Chocolate Cosmos
Episodes.Description: Ahead of summer break, Yu admits his feelings for Himari. Meanwhile, Kureha visits to offer Yu a deal.

Episodes.Title: The Meaning Behind Sunflowers
Episodes.Description: Yu, Himari, and Rion look for inspo for Yu's masterpiece during summer break.

Episodes.Title: Goodbye, Sunflower
Episodes.Description: With his decision to feature sunflowers, Yu works on his masterpiece to go head to head with Kureha.

Episodes.Title: Flowers that Bloom Along the Path of Dreams
Episodes.Description: As Yu and Himari decide to part ways for their dreams, along comes Himari's day of departure.

Entries.Title: Asterix & Obelix: The Big Fight
Entries.Description: When their druid forgets how to prepare the magic potion, Asterix and Obelix must defend the village as Caesar plots to use a Gallic law against them.

Episodes.Title: Episode I
Episodes.Description: The year is 50... no, wait, it's 78 B.C.! In a village in Gaul, Getafix is working on a magic potion and Obelix doesn't yet have superhuman strength.

Episodes.Title: Episode II
Episodes.Description: Determined to defeat the indomitable Gauls, Caesar decides to use their own laws against them. In the forest, Getafix comes across some pesky Romans...

Episodes.Title: Episode III
Episodes.Description: A Gallo-Roman chieftain challenges Vitalstatistix. Meanwhile, a centurion spies on Getafix, who tries to make the magic potion with explosive results.

Episodes.Title: Episode IV
Episodes.Description: With the fight fast approaching, the Gauls desperately search for another way to win — stirring even more trouble between Asterix and Obelix.

Episodes.Title: Episode V
Episodes.Description: As the Romans' dastardly plans for Gaul reach a boiling point, Metadata questions her loyalty and Asterix pulls out all the stops to save the village.

Entries.Title: Possibly the Greatest Alchemist of All Time
Entries.Description: Iruma Takumi finds himself caught up in a hero summoning, even though he’s not a hero. Summoned by mistake to Mildgard, a fantasy world of swords and magic, Takumi is given a chance to start over. Though he dreams of a peaceful life, the goddess Nolyn grants him “alchemy,” an ultra-powerful skill that allows him to create anything from holy swords to flying ships. His reluctant adventure begins!

Episodes.Title: I Was Summoned By Accident
Episodes.Description: Takumi Iruma is summoned to another world by chance. Since the goddess Nolyn cannot bring him back to his world, he is supposed to live in her fantasy world Mildgard. There, Takumi immediately saves a young girl and is taken to her village.

Episodes.Title: To a New Land
Episodes.Description: Maple, the spider monster that Takumi meets in the forest and Tames, possesses the Skill to create Spider Silk, an extreme luxury good! The silk becomes a hit amongst the villagers, and they welcome Takumi and his unique Skills as he grows accustomed to life in the village.

Episodes.Title: Contracts and Oaths
Episodes.Description: In order to create 100 of the toilets equipped with a magic device that Papek begged him for, Takumi visits the Mulan Company to procure help. After requesting "someone to the manage the mansion" and "someone capable of fighting and protecting me", Takumi meets a beautiful human girl, Maria, and a beautiful elf, Sofia.

Episodes.Title: Takumi Party's First Battle!
Episodes.Description: Takumi informs Maria and Sofia that he'd like to travel, so he registers them both with the Adventurer's Guild and forms an official party. After Takumi sends some of the guild's troublemakers packing, he's approached by the Guild Master and advised to quickly rank up his party, so the three head out together on a Quest to defeat goblins.

Episodes.Title: Shadow of Sidonia
Episodes.Description: Takumi wants to upgrade their gear for their journey, so he seeks out mythril and admantite ores. After consulting with the Adventurer's Guild, he accepts Quests to defeat monsters, gather Treant Wood, and escort a miner to excavate the ores. He plans to set out in three days time with the blacksmith, Dgambo.

Episodes.Title: A Drake Horse Appears
Episodes.Description: Word of Takumi's Purification magic device has reached the Holy Empire of Sidonia, and they demand that the Kingdom of Barcula hand over Takumi, but they refuse.

Episodes.Title: The Fox-Eared Girl of the Royal Capital
Episodes.Description: After welcoming the Drake Horse, Camellia, to his party, Takumi redoubles his efforts to build his carriage. Sofia starts to worry as he works with fervor and refuses to rest. The carriage is safely completed and they begin their journey to the Royal Capital with Marquis Godwin on board.

Episodes.Title: Let's Choose a Party Name!
Episodes.Description: After welcoming Reyva to their group, they complete the carriage to be offered to the king of Barcula.

Episodes.Title: Resolve
Episodes.Description: Takumi strengthens his defenses by creating a barrier and taming an Iron Golem named Titan, while the Emperor temporarily leaves him alone to focus on summoning heroes, and Nolyn fears the Church of Divine Light may inadvertently manifest an evil goddess.

Episodes.Title: Takumi Takes on Pioneering!
Episodes.Description: Takumi's group challenges the dungeon, Forest of the Beast King, and strengthens their bonds. Around that time Marquis Godwin consults with Takumi, and asks him to help create a pioneer village in the undeveloped lands to the south of his domain in order to secure a place for the refugees from a deserted village nearby.

Episodes.Title: Signs of Turmoil
Episodes.Description: Máni joins the Wings of Nolyn as they build the fortress town of Wedgefort, which grows more prosperous by the day. However, the Holy Empire of Sidonia activates their Hero Summoning, which causes the mana in the region to fluctuate, increasing the strength of the monsters outside the fortress' ramparts.

Episodes.Title: When Bonds Are Tested
Episodes.Description: Wedgefort is assaulted by a horde of monsters, and word of the emergency reaches Takumi. The Wings of Nolyn, Lion Fang, and Crimson Rose accept the Quest, and together the three parties fend off the assault, but the knights they fought alongside mention something concerning.

Entries.Title: Necronomico and the Cosmic Horror Show
Entries.Description: Miko Kurono, also known as Necronomico, graduates from middle school and decides to pursue her dreams of becoming a streamer. One day, as she’s with her childhood friend, Mayu Mayusaka, and her rival, Kanna Kagurasaka, she accepts an offer to play a new VR game. The game gives Miko the opportunity to take on mysterious challenges with other unique streamers she meets within the VR world.

Episodes.Title: [No Spoilers!] Let's Play the Old Ones' Demo [Cthulhu]
Episodes.Description: Struggling streamer Miko Kurono joins the new VR game "KADATH" to change her fate, after a wave of mysterious incidents where popular streamers collapse during livestreams. She soon discovers the game is a deadly trap by the gods and must survive the unfolding cosmic horror.

Episodes.Title: [SAN Check] Small Streamers Collab! [Great Old Ones]
Episodes.Description: The first game against the Great Old Ones begins.

Episodes.Title: [PvE] Just Another Day at the Old Ones' Academy [Shoggoth]
Episodes.Description: Eita adds a new rule to the game.

Episodes.Title: [Puzzle Game] Welcome to Hotel Reversal [Escape Room]
Episodes.Description: The Great Old Ones' next game is an escape room.

Episodes.Title: [Up and Down] Is Humanity Quiz a Kusoge? [Stole 1 Mil]
Episodes.Description: The streamers attend the third game of the Cosmic Horror Show, this time hosted by Ghatanothoa.

Episodes.Title: [Foodie] Summoned for a Day With the Old Ones [Ancient City]
Episodes.Description: The Great Old Ones manifest in the real world for a day of fun.

Episodes.Title: [Old Awakening] Kyoto Tower Defense [Cthugha]
Episodes.Description: The battle to defend Kyoto from the Great Old Ones' armies begins.

Episodes.Title: [Putting Out Fires] Miko and Kanna's TV Shot! [Top Cultist]
Episodes.Description: Humanity begins to go mad as the last game approaches.

Episodes.Title: [Finals] Crying Out Family in the Mountains of Madness [Hastur]
Episodes.Description: The last game begins at the Mountains of Madness.

Episodes.Title: [Raising Sim] I Made Me, and It's Got My Heart Thumping [Ghatanothoa]
Episodes.Description: Ghatanothoa makes a special game for Kanna to play.

Episodes.Title: [R'lyeh] Return From the Unlighted Chambers [Cthulhu]
Episodes.Description: In the final phase, Miko has to overcome a lot of obstacles if she wants to reach Cthulhu.

Entries.Title: The Laid Off Demon
Entries.Description: Adapted from the light novel "Unemployment Demon," tells a story of a powerful demon king who, while looking for a job and trying to find a way to lift his curse in order to pay off his debts, embarks on adventures. Alongside him is a rookie hero who, similarly, is working and adventuring to pay off his debts. Together, they have a chaotic and humorous journey.

Entries.Title: Milky☆Subway: The Galactic Limited Express
Entries.Description: Arrested for reckless space driving, super human Chiharu and cyborg Makina are sentenced to clean the Milky☆Subway—an old interplanetary train. Easy enough, right? Wrong. When the train suddenly takes off, they are thrown into a high-speed space-train spectacle packed with chaos, no plans, and zero strategy. Just pure momentum!

Episodes.Title: All Aboard!
Episodes.Description:
Freshly arrested, Chiharu and Makina are sentenced to scrub the Milky☆Subway.

It was supposed to be simple.

Episodes.Title: False Departure
Episodes.Description:
As part of their rehab program, Chiharu and Makina board the train for cleanup duty.

They’re joined by four reluctant misfits who clearly didn’t sign up for what’s coming.

Episodes.Title: Chiharu and Makina
Episodes.Description:
The Milky☆Subway launches without warning, six convicts aboard.

Flashback to the beginning: during interrogation, cracks start to show in Chiharu and Makina—and Officer Ryoko begins connecting the dots.

Episodes.Title: Eat, Fight, Repeat
Episodes.Description:
Chiharu and Makina head for the front car to stop the runaway train—only to crash into biker duo Akane and Kanata.

Forced to team up (awkward), they press on… straight into what appears to be a dining car?

Episodes.Title: HAIJO-KUN
Episodes.Description:
Now with Akane and Kanata on board, the crew pushes forward.

But a sketchy security bot blocks the way—and it’s not in the mood to negotiate.

Episodes.Title: Kurt and Max
Episodes.Description:
Flashback again: just hours before launch, cyborgs Kurt and Max are interrogated by Officer Ryoko.

Something’s off. But what?

Episodes.Title: Labor and Reward
Episodes.Description:
The gang struggles to get past the rogue security bot.

Their only hope? Kurt and Max.

Too bad those two are deeply allergic to teamwork.

Episodes.Title: Tempura Shrimp Tail
Episodes.Description: With Kurt and Max finally joining in, the six misfits charge ahead—only to be stopped cold by an unexpected bathroom break.

Episodes.Title: Delusion and Panic
Episodes.Description: A system glitch traps everyone in the train's bathroom. Chiharu gets stuck in the women's bathroom door, while Kanata, Kurt, and Max launch a daring escape plan.

Episodes.Title: Akane and Kanata
Episodes.Description:
Still trapped in the train’s bathroom, the team’s fate rests in Kanata’s hands.

Can he save the others—and maybe earn the trust of Akane, who once called him “a tempura shrimp tail”?

Episodes.Title: The Mastermind
Episodes.Description:
The truth is out: the train has been hijacked by O.T.A.M., the conductor AI.

Why is it trying to turn prisoners against each other?

And what’s its mysterious connection to Makina?

Entries.Title: Captivated, by You
Entries.Description: Joji Ema goes to an all-boys school. After the school’s athletic festival, Ema’s eccentric classmate Miyoshi Hayashi starts acting bizarrely towards him. Yuichi Medaka goes to a coeducational high school. He ends up sitting behind Akira Nikaido, an unsettling student most of the school doesn’t like. Explore an omnibus of stories about what it’s like to be young.

Episodes.Title: Someone Adorable
Episodes.Description: Jyouji Ema becomes curious about his strange classmate, Miyoshi Hayashi, who keeps asking if he is adorable.

Episodes.Title: Would You Be My Friend? / The Artist
Episodes.Description: A two-part story where Hayashi meets Megumi and Komatsu, and how his interests coincide with theirs.

Episodes.Title: Run, Yamada!
Episodes.Description: Every day, Shoutarou Yamada must listen for one thing at school. A voice yelling "Run, Yamada!" by a bully.

Episodes.Title: Nikaidou Behind Me
