Episodes.Description: Yuuichi dreads the new year, when the most ominous student, Akira Nikaidou, is assigned a seat behind him.

Entries.Title: Cultural Exchange with a Game Centre Girl
Entries.Description: Kusakabe Renji, a young man working at a game centre, sees an English girl named Lily Baker playing a crane game on Valentine's Day. Seeing her fail repeatedly to win a prize, Renji can't help but take action. The day after Lily finally gets her plushie, Renji receives an unexpected message from her that reads, "Be my valentine!" What started as a misunderstanding leads to cultural exchange!

Episodes.Title: Boy Meets the Game Centre Girl
Episodes.Description: While working at an arcade, Renji strikes up a friendship with an English girl who can't speak Japanese.

Episodes.Title: If Pushing Doesn't Work, Try Pulling
Episodes.Description: Renji's sister Aoi asks him to make her a "game center pro" before she visits the arcade with her friend Lily.

Episodes.Title: Where Is Your Brother?
Episodes.Description: After Renji and Lily go on their date, Aoi informs Renji that she invited Lily to come over for a study party.

Episodes.Title: Can I Get a Minute?
Episodes.Description: Lily's jealousy is ignited when a pretty girl who visits the arcade turns out to be Renji's college classmate.

Episodes.Title: This Is My Dad!
Episodes.Description: When Lily forces Renji to walk her home on a rainy day, the two happen to run into Lily's intimidating father.

Episodes.Title: I Didn't Notice That at All!
Episodes.Description: A new challenger shows up at the game center to compete for Renji's attention, but Lily steps in to stop her.

Episodes.Title: All Work and No Play Makes Hotaru a Dull Girl
Episodes.Description: Hotaru checks whether her classmates are engaging in meaningful activities in the arcade.

Episodes.Title: Happy Birthday to You
Episodes.Description: Lily invites her school friends and Renji to her birthday party and shows them how people celebrate in the UK.

Episodes.Title: Summer Holidays!
Episodes.Description: As Lily and friends enjoy their summer vacation, new and unique guests start to appear at Renji's game center.

Entries.Title: Beheneko: The Elf-Girl's Cat Is Secretly an S-Ranked Monster!
Entries.Description: After dying in a fight against the forces of evil, a knight found himself reincarnated as one of the most powerful monsters in the world: a behemoth! Problem is, he has to grow up before he can really strut his stuff, and a baby behemoth looks an awful lot like…a housecat?! And when an elf adventurer decides to take him in, she may need his help as much as he needs hers!

Episodes.Title: The Elf Girl and the Knight's Vow
Episodes.Description: A knight dies and is reincarnated into a baby Behemoth, an S-rank monster that looks just like a cat! A novice D-rank adventurer, Aria, adopts him as her kitty cat!

Episodes.Title: The Tigris-ear Blacksmith & A Brand New Skill
Episodes.Description: Aria and Tama visit the armor shop of their familiar blacksmith, Vulcan, to have Tama's armor tailored.

Episodes.Title: Urgent Quest - Defeat the Demons!
Episodes.Description: Disappearances plague the neighboring town of Lenard and the demon, Beryl, is behind it all. Aria accepts a quest to save the people in trouble.

Episodes.Title: Awaken - Behemoth!
Episodes.Description: Tama takes on the earth dragon, his fated enemy, in order to save Aria from the brink of death. Tama turns into a real behemoth!

Episodes.Title: Elf Girl & Dragon Girl
Episodes.Description: Stella continues making passes at Tama with her telepathic skills. Meanwhile, Tama feels uneasy as he watches her fight, driven by her old earth dragon instincts.

Episodes.Title: Girls of the Wandering Woods
Episodes.Description: The group is caught up in a new forest labyrinth. Tama and Aria are excited to explore an untouched earth said to be full of rare materials and rarer treasure chest.

Episodes.Title: Undead on Approach - Dark Tales of the Earl
Episodes.Description: Aria and friends desperately search for Lily and Feri. According to Vulcan, the Earl of Gladstone is rumored to be kidnapping young, beautiful women.

Episodes.Title: The Elf Girl Makes a Move
Episodes.Description: Lily and Feri join Aria's party. Aria is rewarded with a promotion to A-Rank Adventurer! Meanwhile, Tama unlocks the ability to evolve into his third behemoth form.

Episodes.Title: Fated Reunion in the Imperial City!
Episodes.Description: By invitation of the emperor, Aria and company travel to the imperial city of Klareal. There they meet legendary hero Prince Julius and the Holy Demoness Belzebuth.

Episodes.Title: The Powers of Tama and Aria
Episodes.Description: With news that one of the Demonic Four has returned to the labyrinth in Ruine, Aria's party, Julius, and Cedric's knights make way for its deepest depths.

Episodes.Title: The Philosopher's Stone and the Secret of Lumines
Episodes.Description: After escaping to the demon world, Vasaago's next stop is Aria's birthplace: Lumines. His target? The Philosopher's Stone.

Episodes.Title: Sacred Blade & Beast
Episodes.Description: The battle against Vasaago for the fate of the world has begun. Tama evolves into his third behemoth form and takes to the skies with Aria to retaliate!

Entries.Title: StuGo
Entries.Description: Six middle schoolers are tricked into attending a fake academic summer camp by a mad scientist. Now they’re stuck for three months on a wild tropical island with mind-reading manatees, giant fighting fungi and fashion-forward mutants.

Episodes.Title: Dog Eat Dog
Episodes.Description: MUTANT MISCHIEF! The kids must face the Mutant thieves who stole their food.

Episodes.Title: Legitimate Summer Camp
Episodes.Description: SWEET SUMMER SCIENCE! The kids arrive at Lullah's mysterious summer camp and attempt to fix her laser.

Episodes.Title: The Nannytee
Episodes.Description: OH THE HU-NANNYTEE! Lullah wants alone time and creates a Manatee-Nanny to watch the kids.

Episodes.Title: Noodle It (A Little Bit)
Episodes.Description: LIZARD LOVIN' LARRY! Pliny must choose - support Larry's noodling habit or keep him safe.

Episodes.Title: Diorama Drama
Episodes.Description: FIENDISH FIGURINES! Pliny tries to keep a promise when the kids play with a strange diorama.

Episodes.Title: Goat Racket
Episodes.Description: CRIME AND BEANS! Sara feels guilt after conning Larry out of his collectible beans.

Episodes.Title: Breakfast at Chippany's
Episodes.Description: CHIP BREAKFAST-HANDS! Chip wants to make a breakfast that will blow his friends' socks off.

Episodes.Title: Birdyguard
Episodes.Description: HERPETOLOGICAL HIJINKS! Larry saves a baby lizard and swears to protect it from harm.

Episodes.Title: No Manhands Is an Island
Episodes.Description: MARITIME MUTATION! Chip tries committing to the ways of survivalist Nils Vulfen.

Episodes.Title: Sister Swim
Episodes.Description: PERTURBING PORPOISE! When the kids encounter a dolphin, everyone is excited - except Merian.

Episodes.Title: Moon Moon
Episodes.Description: RESENTFUL ROBOTS! Lullah sends Sara to stop a rover from drawing a dirty rear on the moon.

Episodes.Title: Mailbog
Episodes.Description: DIRE DISPATCH! Francis goes on a quest to deliver a letter.

Episodes.Title: Finder's Kelpers
Episodes.Description: KELP-TOMANIA! Pliny and the Kelp Folk try to beat Lullah at her own game.

Episodes.Title: Truck Everlasting
Episodes.Description: NACHO NOSTALGIA! Mr. Okay worries Lullah is going to replace him.

Episodes.Title: Alpha Betta Chip
Episodes.Description: FISHY FISTICUFFS! Chip is forced to use slap-based tactics to defend a bullied mutant.

Episodes.Title: The Bomb Swapper
Episodes.Description: BLUFF GO BOOM! The kids’ prank accidentally lures one of Lullah’s nemeses to the island.

Episodes.Title: The Wolf of Jealousy
Episodes.Description: GOLD-RIDDEN GUILT! Larry must confront his jealousy - or be consumed by it!

Episodes.Title: Stench Mensch
Episodes.Description: OFF-PUTTING PUDDING! To keep a secret, Lullah is forced to help Pliny assist a pathetic grub.

Episodes.Title: Francis Wants to Be Alone
Episodes.Description: FRAGILE FRIENDSHIPS! A spiraling Merian tries to figure out exactly why Francis left her party.

Episodes.Title: The Sash
Episodes.Description: PRESIDENTIAL PANDEMONIUM! The kids vie for a presidential sash.

Episodes.Title: Deep Trent
Episodes.Description: ASININE ASSIGNMENTS! Merian tries to save Dr. Lullah's fish counter from a life of busy work.

Episodes.Title: Disaster Play
Episodes.Description: A PLAY TO SAVE THE DAY! The kids put on a play to warn mutants about a disaster.

Episodes.Title: Shapesister
Episodes.Description: SNEAKY SECRETS! The kids have to face their deepest fears to retrieve their lost ball.

Episodes.Title: Lullah's Game
Episodes.Description: HAND VS. HAND! Lullah tricks the kids into playing a devious game.

Episodes.Title: Night Mutants
Episodes.Description: MIDNIGHT MUTINY! Larry wants to see what the island's nightlife has to offer.

Episodes.Title: Chunk Beastknuckles
Episodes.Description: CHIP MODS HIS BOD! Chip wants his rival to see him as a tough, apex predator worthy of being hunted.

Episodes.Title: The Leg Farm
Episodes.Description: LEAPIN LEGS! Merian is sent to a special place to learn how to relax.

Episodes.Title: Unquenchable Thurst
Episodes.Description: NICE TO PEAT YOU! Pliny dislodges a naturalist from a bog and joins him on a journey of discovery.

Episodes.Title: Plantcis
Episodes.Description: CHLOROPHYLL-AINS! Francis has to protect a plant from a nefarious threat.

Episodes.Title: Big Ol' Heads Egg Salad Venture
Episodes.Description: EGGS-ISTENTIAL CRISIS! Merian struggles to open an egg salad stand with Pliny.

Episodes.Title: PANTelevision
Episodes.Description: MUTANT TV! The kids get sucked into a white-hot, Mutant soap opera.

Episodes.Title: Infinity Braid
Episodes.Description: FOLLICULAR FOLLY! Sara attempts to nail the perfect hairstyle so she can be the star of Francis' painting.

Episodes.Title: Primate Fear
Episodes.Description: COURTROOM CRISIS! Merian takes on the case of a destructive space chimp.

Episodes.Title: Francis' Last Straw
Episodes.Description: HIGH-STAKES HAGGLING! Pliny wants to play "Geoplomacy" when the kids discover six sandbars.

Episodes.Title: Phishin' Chip
Episodes.Description: SECRET AGENT NINCOMPOOP! Chip becomes a spy to prove he's not a nincompoop.

Episodes.Title: Shell-Shock!
Episodes.Description: SAVE YOURSHELLF! After a close call, daredevil Larry embraces a life of extreme caution.

Episodes.Title: Elephant Triumvirate Book 6: Trunkumvirate Triumphaphant
Episodes.Description: ELE-FAN-FIC-TASTIC! Sara lies in order to join the kids' "Elephant Triumvirate" book club.

Episodes.Title: Z.O.R.B.Z. (Zorbular Orb Rorb Borb Zorbs)
Episodes.Description: ZORBZ RORB THE BORB! Larry asks Mr. Okay to help unlock the true power of his dud Zorb.

Episodes.Title: Pea-Brained Mutant Crystal Nuptials
Episodes.Description: SEVEN COURSES OF CHAOS! A Mutant trio sets out to discover the purpose of some weird-shaped berries.

Episodes.Title: S.T.U.G.O.
Episodes.Description: SIX SUCKERS! A new visitor offers the kids the summer of their dreams.

Entries.Title: Demon's Ascension
Entries.Description: Liu Ming, since he was young, lived in a savage prison named Savage Island where the prisoners aren't controlled by any guard or security. When the island sinks due to "mysterious" events, only a handful of people survive - those survivors are then pursued by the government. On the other hand at another place two practitioners are worrying about what will happen to them because the young master that they were supposed to protect had died. Their young master looks nearly like our MC What will happen?

Entries.Title: Ameku M.D.: Doctor Detective
Entries.Description: Ten’ikai General Hospital’s Supervisory Department of Diagnostic Pathology handles cases other physicians deem too difficult to treat. It’s also where bizarre mysteries surface, from unexplained illnesses to strange murders even the police can’t solve. At the center of it all is Takao Ameku, a brilliant doctor determined to reveal the shocking truth behind these anomalies.

Episodes.Title: Dr. Sherlock
Episodes.Description: Ameku Takao is a genius doctor with a knack for solving all kinds of difficult cases. When a man with blue blood is brought to Tenikai General Hospital—where Takao is the vice-director—after having his leg bitten off by a large beast, she starts investigating the intriguing case with the aid of her colleague, Takanashi.

Episodes.Title: Blue Blood Cells and Dragon Fangs
Episodes.Description: Takao comes to the conclusion that the "large beast" responsible for severing the man's leg was, in fact, a Tyrannosaurus Rex. Following this shocking deduction, the case rapidly develops, and she and her crew head to the place where they hope to get answers to the remaining mystery of the victim's blue blood.

Episodes.Title: Into the Spell of Shimmering Light
Episodes.Description: "Do you believe a video can be cursed?" A girl walks in front of a train after watching a particular video and is subsequently admitted to a psych ward. Takao is the only one who believes her twin sister when she says it wasn't a suicide attempt but the result of watching a cursed video, and the genius doctor sets about investigating.

Episodes.Title: Spontaneous Human Combustion
Episodes.Description: "All who desecrate my grave shall be cursed to die." A university research team examining a grave reportedly linked to renowned onmyoji, Ashiya Doman, have started complaining about not feeling well, one after another. Takao is asked to investigate, but the case takes an unexpected turn.

Episodes.Title: Crimson Curse of the Sorcerer
Episodes.Description: Takao's diagnosis seems to solve Enzo's Curse. However, due to a mysterious death by fire, the investigation is right back at square one.

Episodes.Title: Fierce Blazing Finale
Episodes.Description: Despite another occurrence of the mysterious spontaneous human combustion phenomenon, the suspect arrested denies any involvement in either case.

Episodes.Title: Prescribed Poison
Episodes.Description: Takao gets sued for malpractice! The hospital director uses the lawsuit to push for the disbandment of the Department of Investigative Pathology.

Episodes.Title: The Night When the Angels Danced (1)
Episodes.Description: Several hospital staff report an angel in one room, and a pediatrician asks Takao for help with three children.

Episodes.Title: The Night When the Angels Danced (2)
Episodes.Description: Takao reveals the true identity of the "angel."

Episodes.Title: Drowning in a Dry Room (1)
Episodes.Description: Dr. Takanashi is ordered to return to the university hospital.

Episodes.Title: Drowning in a Dry Room (2)
Episodes.Description: Takao tries to clear Seiji's name before he is arrested by the police.

Episodes.Title: Drowning in a Dry Room (3)
Episodes.Description: The mystery of the drowned man is revealed.

Entries.Title: Your Forma
Entries.Description: In 1992, a viral encephalitis pandemic led to the creation of "Your Forma," an invasive brain-implanted device that records all sensory data. Special detectives called "Cyber Investigators" dive into this data to solve crimes. Prodigy Echika Hieda, isolated by her talent, is paired with Harold, a humanoid "Amicus." Together, they uncover the world's deepest secrets.

Episodes.Title: Mechanical Friends Amicus Robots
Episodes.Description: The main suspect in a recent assault case turns out to be Harold. However, during Harold's interrogation, someone else attacks his flatmate, Darya. Echika "Brain Dives" into Darya's "Your Forma" where she sees the attacker's face—which is identical to Harold's.

Episodes.Title: A Black Box
Episodes.Description: While interviewing Lexie, Echika receives a report about the ongoing investigation. It only strengthens her suspicions towards Harold. Echika decides to get to the bottom of this case, but shortly after, something unexpected happens to her.

Episodes.Title: Pursuit
Episodes.Description: It seemed like the investigation had advanced after apprehending Furman, but instead the case ends up taking a new turn. After further deductions, Echika and Harold arrive at a place where…

Episodes.Title: Regret
Episodes.Description: Echika, having realized Furman's true motives, discovers the shocking truth…and it's a huge secret involving Harold.

Episodes.Title: Persona
Episodes.Description: Echika feels uneasy from keeping the major secret about Harold. In the meantime, posts targeting the Cybercrime Investigation Department have been exposed on a message board.

Episodes.Title: Father and Daughter
Episodes.Description: Echika and her team found the spot where E's followers meet up. Bigga, who's helping with the investigation, can't contain her shock when she sees a certain person there.

Episodes.Title: Flower of Fire
Episodes.Description: The forces of evil hadn't stopped with the explosion at Totoki's apartment, they've also been creeping up on Echika. Once again, she finds herself in danger, and Harold takes on the taboo…

Episodes.Title: Fiction
Episodes.Description: Cyber-Inspector Echika and Assistant-inspector Harold once again partner up. Thanks to Harold's strategy, the real villain has finally come to light, but behind the culprit lies an unexpected truth.

Episodes.Title: The Nightmare of Petersburg
Episodes.Description: The time has come to reveal Harold's past. Once a wandering, lost Amicus, Harold was taken in by Sozon and began working alongside him as a detective. But then a gruesome case that would later be known as "The Nightmare of Petersburg” shook their world...

Episodes.Title: Footsteps of the Nightmare
Episodes.Description: After receiving an incomprehensible report from Totoki, Echika, and Harold head to the municipal police to find out the truth. It turns out that the report was about a phone call from someone who was never supposed to be able to reach them…

Episodes.Title: Replay of the Nightmare
Episodes.Description: Echika and Harold grow more and more suspicious upon learning that Abaev was the one who received the digital clone requested by Elena. At the same time, another incident once again mimicking the "Nightmare" takes place. The victim this time turns out to be someone completely unexpected.

Episodes.Title: Manifestation of the Nightmare
Episodes.Description: Harold and Bigga notice what all the victims from these attacks have in common from the message Echika left behind. They identify who and where the culprit is, and rush to rescue the abducted Echika, but…

Episodes.Title: Dawn of the Nightmare
Episodes.Description: It's time for Harold and Echika to confront each other. Echika tries to reason with Harold, who's burning with the desire for revenge. In the end, Harold comes to a decision, and―

Entries.Title: Everyday HOST CLUB
Entries.Description: This is a  story about everyday life follows ex-businessman Sekiguchi, who changes careers to become a host at "Club One" after getting sick. The colorful cast of co-workers includes a younger-brother type host who actually has over 20 years of experience in the field, a former idol, a social-game obsessed rough host, and others.

Episodes.Title: First Drink: "Career Change Night"
Episodes.Description: Sekiguchi (later Hajime) was feeling depressed after a lot of things happened at work, so he transferred to a host club called "Club One." The club was staffed by unique hosts from another dimension!

Episodes.Title: Second Drink: "Sexuality"
Episodes.Description: Hajime tries to get through conversations with just "I see" and "That's true" while serving customers. To learn how to please customers with more than just talking skills, he decides to talk to the number 3 host, Senichi, who is a tough guy.

Episodes.Title: Third Drink: "Symbol Of Friendship"
Episodes.Description: Hajime's salary is low, but the number two host, Ryoichi, notices this and offers to buy him a meal, and the two hit it off.

Episodes.Title: Fourth Drink: "Hajime's Choice"
Episodes.Description: Hajime is troubled by a customer's advances. He is forced to make a decision about the after-hours services the host will provide.

Episodes.Title: Fifth Drink: "Two Warriors"
Episodes.Description: Senichi has lost his number one spot in the social game score rankings. In order to spin the gacha, he gulps down champagne in his own way.

Episodes.Title: 6th Drink: "Koichi's Past"
Episodes.Description: Koichi can revive infinitely even if he vomits. Rumor has it that before going independent as Club One, he worked at the legendary host club "Trillion".

Episodes.Title: 7th Drink: "Makeup Master"
Episodes.Description: Hajime doesn't have any regular customers. He wonders if he should change his appearance, so he decides to watch a makeup video by a famous Osaka host to learn more.

Episodes.Title: 8th Drink: "Stop Fighting"
Episodes.Description: Ryoichi's original lighter for business purposes has gone missing. Ryoichi claims that Senichi stole it, but...

Episodes.Title: 9th Drink: "Guest From the West"
Episodes.Description: Osaka host Okonomiya Taro and Sauce Nishioka come to Club One. Koichi is asked why he quit Trillion.

Episodes.Title: 10th Drink: "Firestarter"
Episodes.Description: When a host approaches him on the street, Senichi tells him he is "Number 3 of Trillion" and silences him. If he keeps calling himself Number 3 of Trillion everywhere, he will get into trouble.

Entries.Title: The Most Powerful Vendor
Entries.Description: 20 years ago, a large number of "spiritual gates" suddenly appeared around the world. People having contact with the spirit gushing out of these gates would gain miraculous powers, and these people are called "spiritual warriors". Among them, those gaining "spatial powers" have become the synonym of the most powerful spiritual warriors because of their outstanding performance in a "beast invasion" and the small number of them. Jiang Nan grew up in an orphanage in Jiangcheng City of Lingzhou, and has determined to become a top spiritual warrior since childhood. At the age of 16, he gains the rarest and strongest spatial power and becomes the second spatial spiritual warrior. This is where the story begins.

Entries.Title: Moonrise
Entries.Description: After rebel forces attack Earth, a carefree heir becomes the prime suspect and joins a special military unit to find the true mastermind on the Moon.

Episodes.Title: The Night It All Began
Episodes.Description: Jack and his friends rush to attend a momentous celebration, blissfully unaware of the looming revolt that threatens to turn his world upside down.

Episodes.Title: A Fateful Day
Episodes.Description: After the attack, Jack wakes up in a hospital to find the city in ruins. He rushes home to find answers, but authorities suddenly pay him a visit.

Episodes.Title: An Unexpected Face
Episodes.Description: One year later, the VC3 squad lands on the Moon to execute its mission. Meanwhile, the Moon Chains rebel forces begin a takeover of Copernicus City.

Episodes.Title: What Matters Most
Episodes.Description: A devastating tragedy stirs memories of his grueling journey with the rest of the VC3 squad, reminding Jack of an important conversation with Eric.

Episodes.Title: Revelation
Episodes.Description: The squad's next mission: capture a close ally of Bob Skylum before the Joint Army does. Jack has a shocking revelation after confronting the target.

Episodes.Title: Reunion
Episodes.Description: As the squad struggles with the relentless attacks, Jack tries to wrap his mind around the fateful encounter. Can he trust Phil after all this time?

Episodes.Title: People of the Moon
Episodes.Description: Windy infiltrates the Goddard Base. Meanwhile, with Mary as their guide, the squad learns how the Earth-Moon conflict has impacted the moon people.

Episodes.Title: Mary
Episodes.Description: Phil recollects a dark memory when Dr. Salamandra arrives with urgent news. At Delambre Station, Mary shares her past with Jack when Rhys interrupts.

Episodes.Title: Unchanging Feelings
Episodes.Description: Inanna falls mysteriously ill, and while Mary knows someone who can cure her, they're in the opposite direction. Will the squad make the detour?

Episodes.Title: Pursuit
Episodes.Description: The squad finally arrives at Agarum City but faces a blockade. Hoping to reduce the number of casualties, Jack takes matters into his own hands.

Episodes.Title: Unknown
Episodes.Description: Dr. Salamandra abandons her fight with Jack to stop a rampaging L-Zone. They struggle to subdue the entity — until Mary suddenly appears.

Episodes.Title: Falling Shadows
Episodes.Description: As the rogue L-Zone advances toward Agarum City, the squad grapples with the discovery of Mary's mysterious quality. Later, the base is compromised.

Episodes.Title: Parting
Episodes.Description: While the battle between the rebel forces and the Joint Army rages on, Jack faces Rhys in a painful confrontation. Mary makes a desperate request of him.

Episodes.Title: The Past and Reality
Episodes.Description: Thirteen years ago, Rhys meets Jack for the first time. In the present, the VC3 squad plunges into a fierce battle zone to reach their target.

Episodes.Title: Expectations
Episodes.Description: Time is running out for Rhys and her team, but an unforeseen reunion disrupts their mission. Later, Mary and Jack reflect on everything that's happened.

Episodes.Title: Reminiscence
Episodes.Description: Phil recounts the day he learned the truth about everything and shares shocking information about Jack's true purpose. Dr. Salamandra interrogates Rhys.

Episodes.Title: Domination
Episodes.Description: While the L-Zone surrounds Copernicus City, Zowan and Duan free Rhys. In a clash with rebel forces, Inanna and the squad face a tough decision.

Episodes.Title: Carry On Your Will
Episodes.Description: Following a deadly scuffle, the L-Zone begins to act up and absorbs Mary in the chaos. Can Phil and Jack save her and the Moon before it's too late?

Entries.Title: Star Wars: Tales of the Underworld
Entries.Description: Two outlaws must navigate the galaxy's dangerous underworld as they chart their destinies.

Episodes.Title: A Way Forward
Episodes.Description: Asajj Ventress reluctantly teams up with an unexpected new ally.

Episodes.Title: Friends
Episodes.Description: A risky opportunity puts Ventress in the crosshairs of the Empire.

Episodes.Title: One Warrior to Another
Episodes.Description: Ventress finds herself in the middle of a local dispute on a backwater planet.

Episodes.Title: The Good Life
Episodes.Description: Two young friends get caught up in a gangster's scheme.

Episodes.Title: A Good Turn
Episodes.Description: Bane reunites with an old friend who is on the opposite side of the law.

Episodes.Title: One Good Deed
Episodes.Description: Cad Bane and his gang return home to settle a score.

Entries.Title: Welcome to Japan, Ms. Elf!
Entries.Description: Kazuhiro Kitase’s only hobby? Sleeping, of course. Since childhood, his dreams have been a portal to exhilarating adventures with an elf girl. During one of their explorations through ancient ruins, they both get scorched by a dragon, and Kazuhiro wakes up like usual. Except this time, he finds a familiar figure in bed beside him—the elf girl from his dreams.

Episodes.Title: Good Morning, Ms. Elf.
Episodes.Description: Average salaryman Kitase Kazuhiro's hobby is sleeping. In his dreams, he visits a fantasy world where he adventures with an elf he's befriended named Marie. But one day when he wakes, the girl he's only seen in his dreams is there beside him!

Episodes.Title: Have a Katsu-don, Ms. Elf.
Episodes.Description: Kazuhiro and Marie enjoy a day in Japan. Later, they theorize that they'll be able to return to Marie's world if they fall asleep together. That leaves just one problem—they'll wake in the same place they left, with an angry Arkdragon lying in wait!

Episodes.Title: Lost Magic Stones
Episodes.Description: Kazuhiro and Marie are enjoying life in both the fantasy world and Japan. They go to look for magic stones in the blazing heat of the Ujah Peak ruins.

Episodes.Title: Good Night, Ms. Elf.
Episodes.Description: Life in Japan continues to surprise and delight Marie. But when night comes, the ruins await her and Kazuhiro.

Episodes.Title: Illusory Swordsman
Episodes.Description: Kazuhiho and Marie have a plan to beat the bandits and stage a rescue, but the bandit boss has other ideas!

Episodes.Title: It's French Cuisine, Ms. Elf.
Episodes.Description: Kazuhiro and Marie focus on their plans to explore the labyrinth, then Kaoruko invites them out to dinner!

Episodes.Title: Shining Magic Stone
Episodes.Description: Exploration permit in hand, Kazuhiho and Marie visit Mewi and learn that something happened to the Arkdragon!

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Japan, Ms. Arkdragon.
Episodes.Description: The hot springs trip begins! The ladies enjoy delicious food and a relaxing soak, and Marie gets some advice.

Episodes.Title: Oracle and Honest
Episodes.Description: Kazuhiho and the others return to the other world where the high-level sorcerer Sven lies in wait for them.

Episodes.Title: A Fun Ancient Labyrinth
Episodes.Description: Kazuhiro and Marie enjoy a day off in Japan. Then, in the other world, they enter the labyrinth with Wridra.

Episodes.Title: Two People and One Furry Friend, Strolling Through Aomori
Episodes.Description: They're off to Aomori! While Marie enjoys the new sights and new foods, Kazuhiro recalls childhood memories.

Episodes.Title: It's a Blizzard of Cherry Blossom Petals, Ms. Elf.
Episodes.Description: Kazuhiro and Marie explore Aomori. Amid swirling sakura petals, their eyes meet and something shifts forever.

Entries.Title: I Left My A-Rank Party to Help My Former Students Reach the Dungeon Depths!
Entries.Description: Not every party treats you like a hero—especially when you’re a lowly red mage like Yuke. So, after years of constant ridicule by his A-rank party members, he ditches them. Searching for a new party, he reunites with former students Marina, Silk, and Rain, and joins their group. But on a quest to conquer the world’s greatest dungeon, they become entangled in chaos that threatens the world.

Episodes.Title: Clover Is Born
Episodes.Description: Yuke, a red mage, quits his A-rank party, Thunder Pike, because he feels they don't appreciate the support he provides. While seeking a new party, he encounters one of his former students, Marina, who invites him to join her new D-rank party.

Episodes.Title: The Forest Where a Magic Beast Dwells
Episodes.Description: Clover's first stream has drawn a lot of attention, so they accept another quest in a forest that's been taken over by a magic beast.

Episodes.Title: Overflow
Episodes.Description: Clover's success in slaying the Zarnag draws more attention to them—and draws Thunder Pike's attention back to Yuke.

Episodes.Title: Shadow Stalker
Episodes.Description: Clover accepts a quest to help promote an armor workshop's latest line of adventuring gear.

Episodes.Title: Mission
Episodes.Description: Clover goes house-hunting, and Simon tries to bring Yuke back by offering to grant his lifelong dream.

Episodes.Title: Achromatic Darkness
Episodes.Description: Clover begins its investigation of Achromatic Darkness... and already trouble is brewing.

Episodes.Title: The Pale, Immortal Ruler
Episodes.Description: Continuing the investigation of Achromatic Darkness, Clover reaches a floor of the dungeon that has... a sky?

Episodes.Title: One Who Was Once a Friend
Episodes.Description: Yuke decides to head back into Achromatic Darkness to save Jamie, but Simon stands in the way.

Episodes.Title: A Six-Leaf Clover
Episodes.Description: Shortly after Nene and Jamie officially join Clover, the party learns about a newly discovered dungeon.

Episodes.Title: Clover's Back in Action!
Episodes.Description: Clover travels to a newly discovered dungeon to undertake their first quest since returning to adventuring.

Episodes.Title: The Capital Distorted by the Twilight
Episodes.Description: Clover takes their first dive into the new dungeon near Duna, and everything they encounter feels off somehow.

Episodes.Title: The Golden Priestess
Episodes.Description: As scholars assess Clover's findings from the new dungeon, the unconscious girl they found inside wakes up.

Episodes.Title: Biblion, the Book Spirit
Episodes.Description: Clover returns to Glad Shi-im with three other parties in hopes of uncovering the truth of the twilight city.

Episodes.Title: One Gold
Episodes.Description: Clover returns to Glad Shi-im to infiltrate Vordan Castle and destroy the One Gold that threatens the world.

Episodes.Title: Crossing Time
Episodes.Description: Clover must battle the monsters of Glad Shi-im and even their own allies to find and destroy the One Gold.

Episodes.Title: Return From the Twilight, And...
Episodes.Description: When Yuke returns from Glad Shi-im, he learns that Rain has gone to see Mastoma, the Salmutarian prince.

Episodes.Title: The Seven-Leaf Clover
Episodes.Description: Clover returns to Finis with Niberune, who has officially become their seventh party member.

Episodes.Title: King's Order
Episodes.Description: A long-sealed dungeon in Salmutaria is reawakening, and King Vincent wants Yuke to go there and check it out.

Episodes.Title: The Dungeon Count of Welmelia
Episodes.Description: Clover begins their adventure in Salmutaria by inspecting the path to the dungeon that has reawakened there.

Episodes.Title: The World Turns Inside-Out
Episodes.Description: Clover's inspection of the dungeon in Salmutaria suddenly takes a frightening turn.

Episodes.Title: Tenebre
Episodes.Description: Prince Rafuma's reckless assault on Tenebre yields further insight into its truly terrifying nature.

Episodes.Title: An Unexpected Reunion
Episodes.Description: Clover finally enters Tenebre, fully expecting the unexpected... and still, what they find inside shocks them.

Episodes.Title: The End of the Darkness
Episodes.Description: Clover heads into the depths of Achromatic Darkness to find its Abyss Gate.

Episodes.Title: Beyond the Dream
Episodes.Description: Clover reaches the Abyss Gate in the depths of Achromatic Darkness, but can they succeed in closing it?

Entries.Title: The Gorilla God's Go-To Girl
Entries.Description: Sophia Reeler, a timid noble, received the Gorilla God’s blessing—the ultimate combat power. Now her dream of a peaceful student life is shattered as the royal knights recruit her unrivaled strength. Juggling school, the knight life, and her overwhelming power, Sophia learns the hard way that gorilla strength isn’t so simple.

Episodes.Title: The Gorilla Life of a Lady and Blessings
Episodes.Description: Sophia gets blessed by a rather unexpected animal god.

Episodes.Title: The Gorilla Signs of Affection That I Always Dreamed Of
Episodes.Description: Sophia becomes closer with Isaac, Eddie, and Louis.

Episodes.Title: A Gorilla Rhapsody of Sweets at the Royal Capital
Episodes.Description: Sophia goes to the royal capital to get her bangs cut and runs into a surprising person.

Episodes.Title: A Gorilla Rendezvous with a Dress and Bewilderment
Episodes.Description: Sophia reluctantly goes to the school party and ends up with a surprise partner.

Episodes.Title: A Lovely Gorilla Romance Filled with Danger and Blushing
Episodes.Description: Sophia ends up in a bombing incident. Will she be able to stop it?

Episodes.Title: Gorilla Lovers of Snow and Fire
Episodes.Description: Sophia gets stranded in the snow with a squirrel.

Episodes.Title: The Sofa and Romance's Gorilla Love Song
Episodes.Description: But can a squirrel really fall in love with a gorilla?

Episodes.Title: A Gorilla Romantic Comedy with the Girl I Fancy | A Gorilla Romantic Comedy with My Classmate | A Gorilla Romantic Comedy with My Friend That I Fancy
Episodes.Description: What kind of other relationships are going on at Sophia's school?

Episodes.Title: The Gorilla Land of Oceans and Swimsuits
Episodes.Description: What will happen to a gorilla and a squirrel when they go to the beach?

Episodes.Title: The Gorilla Labyrinth of Light and Darkness
Episodes.Description: The gorilla goes over to the squirrel's house. What could possibly happen?

Episodes.Title: The Mightiest Blessing and a Gorilla Rush
Episodes.Description: Just what is Daybreak and who is their leader, Leohart?

Episodes.Title: The Gorilla End Filled with Determination and Love
Episodes.Description: Who will win in the end? A gorilla or a leopard?

Entries.Title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class
Entries.Description: High school student Saito Hojo is set to inherit his grandfather’s major corporation. First, he must marry Akane Sakuramori, the girl he despises the most, and who hates him just as much. The two are determined to keep their unexpected marriage a secret from their classmates. But as they begin their newlywed life, the distance between them starts to close.

Episodes.Title: I'm Getting Married to a Girl I Hate in My Class
Episodes.Description: Saito is getting married to his classmate. But it's not just any classmate—it's his least favorite girl in school and archnemesis, Akane Sakuramori! And so begins a romcom of two stubborn love birds forced into marriage against their will.

Episodes.Title: A New Life
Episodes.Description: Saito and Akane secretly begin their new life together but soon run into a mountain of conflicting lifestyle preferences. Can the two find a way to meet in the middle?

Episodes.Title: My Wife
Episodes.Description: After resolving their differences, Saito and Akane begin to enjoy spending time together and all seems to be smooth sailing. Until one day, when Akane works herself too hard and gets sick, leaving Saito to take care of her.

Episodes.Title: Night Attack
Episodes.Description: With Shise's discovery of their secret, Saito and Akane scramble to keep others from finding out. Meanwhile, Akane encounters haunting events at home.

Episodes.Title: I Won't Lose
Episodes.Description: Himari reveals to Akane that she has a crush on Saito. While Akane agrees to help her get closer to Saito, she can't shake a nagging feeling.

Episodes.Title: Newlywed's First Date
Episodes.Description: Akane's revelation of a painful past prompts Saito to cheer her up by planning a day out together.

Episodes.Title: The Ring
Episodes.Description: Saito works his first part-time job to get a gift for Akane, but things go awry when it goes missing.

Episodes.Title: Senpai
Episodes.Description: A mysterious girl suddenly appears before Saito and he soon finds out that she's Akane's little sister.

Episodes.Title: Little Sister's Heartache
Episodes.Description: Maho continues to tempt Saito, but Saito learns the truth behind her actions when she falls ill.

Episodes.Title: Girlfriend (Tentative)
Episodes.Description: Saito and Akane become a rumor at school, so they come up with a plan as diversion.

Episodes.Title: Voice
Episodes.Description: Saito is invited to a party hosted by Tenryu, and Akane must stay home alone overnight.

Episodes.Title: I'm Getting Married to a Guy I Hate in My Class
Episodes.Description: Akane reveals her past encounter with Saito and confronts Himari in this Season 1 finale!

Entries.Title: I'm the Evil Lord of an Intergalactic Empire!
Entries.Description: After a life of honesty left him betrayed, Liam is reborn into a vast interstellar empire with one goal: be the galaxy’s worst evil lord. But no matter how hard he tries to be a tyrant, his “wicked” plans keep backfiring into peace, prosperity, and adoring fans. Galactic chaos, magic, and mecha await in this hilariously misconstructed tale of a villain who can’t help but to impress.

Episodes.Title: Revenge
Episodes.Description: He spent his life working for a black company, only to learn that his beloved daughter was born from the man his wife spent years cheating on him with - his own boss. Yearning for revenge on his death bed, he's reincarnated in a space fantasy as the Evil Lord Liam.

Episodes.Title: Rebirth
Episodes.Description: At the ripe age of 5, Liam is gifted a custom-order AI robot by his parents, and then granted full control of their fiefdom, the stellar system of Alcaeus, so they can abandon him for the capital and leave him shouldered with the family's debts.

Episodes.Title: Way of the Flash
Episodes.Description: Liam retains a martial arts instructor of questionable character.

Episodes.Title: First Battle
Episodes.Description: Nias customizes the Avid. Liam masters Flash, then defends his mine from pirates.

Episodes.Title: Honey Trap
Episodes.Description: Liam uses his loot from the pirates to replace his fleet and Nias tries to seduce him into buying her ships.

Episodes.Title: Treasure Island
Episodes.Description: Logs on the pirate ships reveals their home base and Liam argues with the warp gate so he can go raid them.

Episodes.Title: Princess Knight
Episodes.Description: Goaz tortures Christiania and her soldiers, grotesquely modifying their bodies. Liam rescues them.

Episodes.Title: Harem Project
Episodes.Description: Liam tries to build an NTR harem, but struggles because over 10,000 women are ready to eagerly consent to it.

Episodes.Title: Mass-Produced Maids
Episodes.Description: Liam laments not being more of an evil lord but his people & robots love him. The Guide leads pirates to him.

Episodes.Title: Decisive Battle
Episodes.Description: The Goaz pirates declare war on the Banfield domain, and Liam faces them in battle.

Episodes.Title: Evil Lord
Episodes.Description: Liam routs the pirates and faces Goaz in a final showdown.

Episodes.Title: Family
Episodes.Description: After hearing about Liam's success, his good-for-nothing family comes begging for more money.

Entries.Title: My Gift Lvl 9999 Unlimited Gacha: Backstabbed in a Backwater Dungeon, I'm Out for Revenge!
Entries.Description: God created nine races in the ancient times. Humans were the weakest, most ridiculed race among them. Light, a human boy, was fortunate enough to be invited to join a party of all nine races called the "Assembly of the Races." He was happy being a member for a while, but that was a short dream. His hopes were only to be betrayed by his fellow members at the largest, most heinous dungeon "Abyss." After surviving by himself at the bottom of Abyss, Light learns the true meaning of his gift "Unlimited Gacha." Light will rise from the worst despair to build his own empire of the strongest players.

Entries.Title: Honey Lemon Soda
Entries.Description: After middle school, with its bullying and nicknames, Uka Ishimori is excited for a fresh start at Hachimitsu High School. Kai Miura, a cool and uninhibited boy, sits next to her in class. Uka remembers she met Kai in middle school and with a single word, he had convinced her to attend Hachimitsu. Though he’s popular, Kai supports Uka in her efforts to fit in with her new classmates.

Episodes.Title: Because I Met You
Episodes.Description: After a bad experience in junior high, where her social anxiety was worsened by bullying, Uka Ishimori decides to change herself and the way she lives her life. Her first step is applying to Hachimitsu High School. Its attractions? A more relaxed school atmosphere, and the gruff but handsome Kai Miura.

Episodes.Title: Turning Into a Treasure
Episodes.Description: Uka displays some hidden talents that even she didn't know about. Meanwhile, Kai is being strangely mean to her her for some reason... Is it a misguided attempt to keep her safe?

Episodes.Title: Our Little Secret
Episodes.Description: Uka's happier than she ever dreamed. It's all new friends and new miracles until an incident on a school trip.

Episodes.Title: However Distant We May Be
Episodes.Description: Uka struggles to open up to her class about her past. A friend of Kai's undermines her confidence further.

Episodes.Title: A Great Person
Episodes.Description: Uka has a revelation about her own psychology thanks to Serina, Kai's ex-girlfriend.

Episodes.Title: In the Future, Too...
Episodes.Description: Uka and her friends are working hard on the culture festival. She's determined to make their café a success!

Episodes.Title: I’m Sorry I Love Him
Episodes.Description: Uka and Serina struggle to open up about their feelings. Can they figure it out over summer break?

Episodes.Title: Summon the Courage
Episodes.Description: It's summer break! Uka, Serina, and Kai all summon their courage and communicate.

Episodes.Title: Goodbye, Bumbling Self
Episodes.Description: Uka's father is concerned about Hachimitsu High again. Can he be convinced that it's the right place for her?

Episodes.Title: The Side of You No One Knows
Episodes.Description: Uka ponders the nature of her relationship with Kai. What are they to each other?

Episodes.Title: Feelings Burst Free
Episodes.Description: Everyone in Uka's class is discussing love. Is it better to hide your feelings, or let them fly free?

Episodes.Title: Honey Lemon Soda
Episodes.Description: Uka and Kai try to figure out the new development in their relationship... as the whole school watches.

Entries.Title: Übel Blatt
Entries.Description: Fourteen warriors set out to prevent an invasion, but only seven return. Three died along the way, and four were slain for betraying the empire. In truth, it is the Seven Heroes who turned on their allies so they could take all the glory. Ascheriit was their victim, but now, 20 years later, he is back to get revenge.

Episodes.Title: Durch Bruch (Break Through)
Episodes.Description: Blatt Meister Ascheriit was slain by his allies and was branded a traitor. Now, 20 years later, he is back with a new name, Köinzell, and a thirst for vengeance. Köinzell arrives at the border wall, Thousand Stonespears, at the Border City of Rielde-Velem. Here, he sets about infiltrating an underground monastery of corrupt monks.

Episodes.Title: Unter Morgen Monde (Under the Morning Moons)
Episodes.Description: During a deadly exchange against Rangzatz, Köinzell is thrust down to the depths of the underground monastery. However, Köinzell had visited this fortress with Ergnach in the past. And now, as Köinzell fends off the elite warrior monks, he releases the magic circle spell his comrade had once sacrificed his life to conjure.

Episodes.Title: Langer Regen (The Long Rain)
Episodes.Description: When Köinzell reaches the Seven Heroes' encampment, he is forced to confront the immense power and glory his former comrades have amassed since they murdered him in cold blood. Despondent, Köinzell is standing in the rain when a masked avenger makes an attempt on his life.

Episodes.Title: Köinzell
Episodes.Description: Chiliarch Fargo invites Wied and Aht to the mayor's manor at night. That night, the two are met by a horde of undead bandits risen through dark Wischtechian magic. Simultaneously, Fargo launches a brutal assault on the refugees, including Peepi. Under the moonlit sky, Köinzell unleashes the power of his Black Sword.

Episodes.Title: Die Burg vom Helden (The Castle of the Hero)
Episodes.Description: Schtemwölech welcomes Köinzell's assault with a powerful blast from Dragon's Maw, a Wischtechian magic artillery. Köinzell diverts its attack and breaches the defenses of the castle.Inside, Geranpen is faced with the ultimate choice: either remain loyal to his Lord or seek out the truth.

Episodes.Title: Schtemwölech
Episodes.Description: In the depths of the castle altar, Schtemwölech had been conducting vile experiments on demihuman girls. By infusing fairyblood to his, the landgrave had attained a physique of steel through a Wischtechian ritual. Now, Köinzell must confront this former friend to put an end to his twisted plan.

Episodes.Title: Der leere Sarg (The Empty Coffin)
Episodes.Description: A state funeral is held to pay tribute to Schtemwölech's glorious rule. Peepi and Altea reconvene with Köinzell, who had taken shelter in the mountains. As the company watch the funeral procession lay the landgrave's coffin to rest at the sacred burial site, Köinzell vows vengeance against the six remaining heroes.

Episodes.Title: Der Heldmörder (The Hero-Killer)
Episodes.Description: In a fit of paranoia, the deranged Batterygrave Barestar commands his men to search for the Hero-Killer in the Free City Jullas-Abllas, where Köinzell sought shelter. Meanwhile, under Glenn's leadership, Elsaria's company hunts for the treacherous rebel.

Episodes.Title: Junge Blätter (Young Leaves)
Episodes.Description: At the Hall of Swords, Glenn entrusts a manhunt mission to Ichfeis, a slave knight vying to restore the title Blatt Meister. Meanwhile, in the Free City Jullas-Abllas, Köinzell's fight against Elsaria and company takes a desperate turn. Eager to prove herself, Aht recklessly charges in, only to sustain an injury.

Episodes.Title: Gegenangriff (Counterattack)
Episodes.Description: Köinzell's stand against the batterygrave's military inspires the townsfolks of Jullas-Abllas to take up arms. Their bravery even convinces Elsaria, the Elector's daughter, to side with the Free City. Just as the tides are about to turn in Köinzell's favor, a powerful blast from a magic artillery cuts through the sky.

Episodes.Title: Gefühl zu… (With Feeling)
Episodes.Description: As Barestar's Floating Castle and magic artillery wreak havoc on all, the people recognize Köinzell's stand to protect the city and call him for what he is, a hero. Meanwhile, Elsaria and company thwart Barestar's men from snatching Marquis Glenn's latest Flagship of the Dragon Airship Fleet, and launch a counteroffensive.

Episodes.Title: Neues Schwert (New Sword)
Episodes.Description: Ichfeis, a slave knight who seeks to earn his freedom, faces Köinzell the Hero-Killer in a fated duel. As they cross blades, Ichfeis coaxes Köinzell to launch the Black Wing, the crowning technique of Ludift-style swordsmanship, and delivers his own imperfect rendition. Köinzell strikes back with a magnificent assault.

Entries.Title: The Too-Perfect Saint: Tossed Aside by My Fiancé and Sold to Another Kingdom
Entries.Description: Philia Adenauer hails from a family renowned for producing Saints for generations in the Kingdom of Girtonia. Saints fight to protect humankind from monsters, and Philia underwent rigorous education and training to earn her title. After her fiancé, Julius, breaks off their engagement, Philia is sold to the kingdom of Parnacorta for resources. Will her homeland survive without her?!?

Episodes.Title: The Saint Who Never Smiled
Episodes.Description: Saint Philia works hard to protect her country, but her "charmless" demeanor earns her nothing but scorn.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Parnacorta
Episodes.Description: Philia tries to get adjusted to her new life in Parnacorta, while the locals try to get adjusted to her.

Episodes.Title: Our First Date
Episodes.Description: Osvalt takes Philia on a date around Almburg while Mia tries to learn more about her sister's departure.

Episodes.Title: Feelings Entrusted
Episodes.Description: Philia gets a new ally, and she and Mia learn more about the forces conspiring against them.

Episodes.Title: Golden Freesia
Episodes.Description: Philia takes on an apprentice and learns more about the pasts of princes Reichardt and Osvalt.

Episodes.Title: Reason and Emotion
Episodes.Description: Mia seeks to impart the situation's urgency to Prince Julius, while Philia and her new friends send aid.

Episodes.Title: The Imprisoned Prince
Episodes.Description: Mia attempts to stir Prince Fernand to action while Philia reveals her own plan to save Girtonia.

Episodes.Title: With You, Who Gave Me Courage
Episodes.Description: Mia's time with Prince Fernand bears fruit, and her aunt, Hildegarde, makes her a proposal.

Episodes.Title: Crossroads of Fate
Episodes.Description: Julius, rattled by Fernand's improving health, attempts to solidify his control of the kingdom.

Episodes.Title: What I Wish to Protect
Episodes.Description: As the situation deteriorates, Philia must choose between upholding her duties and following her heart.

Episodes.Title: Archdemon Asmodeus
Episodes.Description: When Archdemon Asmodeus makes a play for his ultimate goal, Philia and all of her friends rally to stop him.

Episodes.Title: The Too-Perfect Saint: Tossed Aside by My Fiancé, Now in Another Kingdom
Episodes.Description: Philia and her friends take on Azmodeus for the last time.

Entries.Title: From Bureaucrat to Villainess: Dad's Been Reincarnated!
Entries.Description: After being struck by a car, 52-year-old civil servant Kenzaburou Tondabayashi finds himself reincarnated as the villainess of his daughter’s favorite video game! Committed to his role as the haughty and arrogant Grace Auvergne, Kenzaburou plays out Grace’s part in the game’s story… Except his kind nature and elegant Japanese manners accidentally turn the unlikeable Grace into the most admired girl in school instead.

Episodes.Title: Dad Becomes a Villainess
Episodes.Description: Kenzaburo Tondabayashi is a staunch, 52-year-old bureaucrat until he seemingly dies in a traffic accident! He then finds himself reincarnated into the world of the Otome game.

Episodes.Title: Dad Becomes a Sorcerer
Episodes.Description: It is only proper that Kenzaburo commits himself to Grace’s villainous role in the original story. Unfortunately, decades of learned habits are difficult to break.

Episodes.Title: Dad Makes a Pun!
Episodes.Description: Grace, aka Kenzaburo, integrates himself into the student council. He may be an effective bureaucrat, but his resourcefulness and modesty are raising unnecessary love flags.

Episodes.Title: Dad Summons a Beast
Episodes.Description: The day the students' familiars hatch arrives at long last. Meanwhile, in another world, two women must come to terms with the fate of a beloved husband and father.

Episodes.Title: Dad Gets Into Dual-wielding
Episodes.Description: Impressed by a rare accomplishment, the principal asks Grace aka Kenzaburo to participate in the Magic Exhibition.

Episodes.Title: Dad is Moved to Tears
Episodes.Description: Grace and Anna have both proven their worth time and time again. Unfortunately, there are those who insist on sowing division between them.

Episodes.Title: Dad Puts On an Exhibition
Episodes.Description: Grace’s father returns after a business trip, but proves he doesn’t know his daughter very well. However, as a fellow father, Kenzaburo understands that the man is trying.

Episodes.Title: Dad Becomes a Maid
Episodes.Description: Grace aka Kenzaburo invites Anna to stay at the Auvergne estate over the summer when it becomes clear she still needs to learn the ins and outs of high society.

Episodes.Title: Dad Gets Trapped
Episodes.Description: When the student council gets trapped in a labyrinth, it's up to Grace aka Kenzaburo and Anna to save everyone.

Episodes.Title: Dad Cross-Dresses
Episodes.Description: Grace aka Kenzaburo goes incognito to visit the bakery that Anna's family runs, but Anna's mother quickly deduces Grace's identity.

Episodes.Title: Dad Gets into an Elegant Pickle!
Episodes.Description: The student council decides to put on a gender-swapping play with Anna in the lead role! Unfortunately, Anna overworks herself to the point of collapse.

Episodes.Title: Dad Celebrates at the Campus Festival
Episodes.Description: The Elegance Cheat has a fatal flaw: Grace aka Kenzaburo can't perform without everything becoming unnecessarily fancy!

Entries.Title: Bogus Skill «Fruitmaster» ~About that time I became able to eat unlimited numbers of Skill Fruits (that kill you)~
Entries.Description: In a world where Skill Fruits grant powers, aspiring adventurer Light is stuck with the useless «Fruitmaster» skill. Eating another one results in death, so no do-overs. Meanwhile, his childhood friend Rena quickly rises to S Rank. But when Light accidentally eats a second Skill Fruit, he survives and discovers his true power: He can consume unlimited Skill Fruits and gain their abilities!

Episodes.Title: The Only Ingredient
Episodes.Description: Light, who dreams of becoming an adventurer, eats a skill fruit in order to gain a special ability. However, he acquires the bogus skill "Fruitmaster," which is completely unsuited to combat. Eating a second skill fruit results in death. Unable to try again, Light resigns himself to becoming a fruit farmer. Meanwhile, his childhood friend Lena gains the "Sword Saint" skill and debuts as an adventurer. One night, Light accidentally eats a second skill fruit, but...

Episodes.Title: Incomplete Light
Episodes.Description: Light becomes an adventurer and is reunited with Lena, now a rank S adventurer, at the guild. However, she acts coldly towards him, and Light is bewildered. The truth is the direction and thinking of Lena's party does not match her own, and she suffers every day. When Light learns about their cruelty, he decides to rescue Lena and have her join his party.

Episodes.Title: The Magic Castle of Spirits
Episodes.Description: Light, Lena, and Ayla are hired by the guild to figure out why some adventurers went missing and find them. When they arrive at the count's manor that is their one lead, they encounter adventurers who have been turned into undead. The three of them fight as they head deeper into the manor, where they find Dratena, who uses the "Necromancy" skill, waiting for them.

Episodes.Title: Taboo Skills
Episodes.Description: The members of Luxeria defeat the undead controlled by Dratena's "Necromany" skill one after another. The battle grows even more intense with the appearances of the now undead Count of Montes and a Soul Reaper, a monster that turns living humans into undead. During the battle, Light learns of the existence of widely-hated "taboo skills."

Episodes.Title: A Tumultuous Argument
Episodes.Description: While Light rests after collapsing, Lena and Ayla are called to the adventurer's guild to report to the guild's authorities on the incident with the Wicked Dragon. They attempt to get information on "Black Swan" and Dratena, but the Holy Sister cleverly dodges their questions, so Lena offers the Wicked Dragon's scale in exchange for access to records concerning Dratena.

Episodes.Title: The Legendary Blacksmith
Episodes.Description: Light and Ayla visit the Tradesman's District in search of a blacksmith who will make Light a powerful sword. They're directed to the Bolst Workshop, but on their way there, they come across a girl being pursued by a violent group of men.

Episodes.Title: The Thundering Beast
Episodes.Description: Light has successfully rescued Monica from her kidnappers, but Zamdo proves to be a formidable opponent.

Episodes.Title: The Indomitable Torch Flame
Episodes.Description: For Light to have a chance of beating Zamdo in combat, Monica must make him a sword, but can she get it done in time?

Episodes.Title: The Reunion By the Lake
Episodes.Description: While looking for Dratena in the city of Athena, Lena encounters Flower Hat and her subordinate Yuan.

Episodes.Title: Waves of Frenzy
Episodes.Description: Lena and Dratena must work together to stop the monsters being summoned by the strange mist.

Episodes.Title: Blessing of the Fairies
Episodes.Description: Lena unexpectedly gains the ability to defeat both Argos and the Wicked Dragon.

Episodes.Title: The Evening Star
Episodes.Description: After defeating Argos and the Wicked Dragon, Lena and her companions speak with a mirage of the Fairy King.

Entries.Title: Teogonia
Entries.Description: Humans fight to protect their land from invading demi-human tribes in relentless battles. As his world is engulfed by intense warfare, Kai, a village boy from Lag, joins the fight to defend all he knows. After Kai’s comrades fall one by one and he’s injured, he suddenly recalls memories from another life. A fantasy tale unfolds as a village boy explores a world of magic, mystery, and heroism.

Episodes.Title: Kai of Lag Village
Episodes.Description: Kai's destiny changes when he reproduces an ability that he saw in a strange dream.

Episodes.Title: Lady Jose
Episodes.Description: Kai travels to Eda Village with Lady Jose, who teaches him about the duty of guardian bearers.

Episodes.Title: Arbitration God
Episodes.Description: Kai returns to the valley where his journey started, where he learns more about the valley god.

Episodes.Title: A Small Paradise
Episodes.Description: Kai's accomplishments attract the attention of Vezin, and Kai recalls a childhood memory.

Episodes.Title: The Priest and the Inspector
Episodes.Description: An inspector from the central plain visits Rag Village, and Kai escorts a priest following an org band.

Episodes.Title: Rigdaros
Episodes.Description: Kai battles Adurakan, a powerful org guardian bearer, in order to protect the valley.

Episodes.Title: Truthseeker
Episodes.Description: The scouting party returns to Rag Village only to learn it was devastated by an attack during their absence.

Episodes.Title: To Ispi Rio
Episodes.Description: Kai and Nada fight for their lives while Lag Village defends itself from another macaque attack.

Episodes.Title: The Power of God
Episodes.Description: Macaques come flooding through the gate opened by the inspector. Will Kai arrive in time to save Lag Village?

Episodes.Title: The Great God Kanae
Episodes.Description: The macaques ask Kai to save them from the evil Great God Kanae.

Episodes.Title: Diabo
Episodes.Description: Kai and his allies confront the diabo, but it is not easily defeated.

Episodes.Title: Protector of Kanae
Episodes.Description: Kai's life is slowly drained away after being swallowed by the diabo when he hears a voice...

Entries.Title: Bullet Bullet
Entries.Description: In the near future, civilization has collapsed. Gear works in a junk shop, retrieving stolen goods alongside Qu-0213 and White Bear. After accepting a mysterious request to steal an important item, they soon find themselves hunted by deadly assassins.

Episodes.Title: Beyond the Horizon
Episodes.Description: In the near future, civilization has collapsed, and the world has become a wasteland. Despite their poverty, the people use remnants of past civilizations to lead resilient lives. Gear works in a junk shop while also retrieving stolen goods alongside the robot Qu-0213 and White Bear, a gambler.

Episodes.Title: You Decided to Do It
Episodes.Description: The city is abuzz with the news that a grand theft has been carried out by Gear, White Bear, and Qu-0213. On the run from the police, the three culprits return to the junk shop, only to fail to receive their reward.

Episodes.Title: I Learned Not to Trust People
Episodes.Description: With one assassin after another hot on their trail, Gear, White Bear, and Qu-0213 find themselves fleeing from intense pursuit. They cannot get hold of Noah, and their beloved car, Bullet, is running dangerously low on gas. The trio must quickly devise a plan to escape the mess they are in.

Episodes.Title: We Are Your Family
Episodes.Description: Reunited safely with Noah, the trio hands over the requested item, only to find that it is not what Noah wanted at all. The real treasure is a completely different item.

Episodes.Title: You Fool
Episodes.Description: Gear is left crushed by a sense of helplessness after Noah is kidnapped. Gear stumbles across a Gotcha spinoff titled, "The Escape Story of the Great Villain Road." Watching the unstoppable determination of the hero stirs something within Gear, reigniting his resolve.

Episodes.Title: You Have the Right to Know
Episodes.Description: After Gear, Qu-0213, and Noah are arrested by the capital's police and separated from White Bear, they are taken underground, facing imminent execution. However, at the last moment, their restraints are mysteriously removed.

Episodes.Title: Time to Get to Work
Episodes.Description: Shaken with sorrow and anger after learning the truth, Gear and his friends decide to collaborate with the Resistance, determined to expose the government's secret to the world. As the day of the operation approaches, they work tirelessly to prepare for the challenges that loom on the horizon.

Episodes.Title: The World Is Much Bigger, Tougher, and Uglier
Episodes.Description: Gear and his team race to escape with the top-secret government data they have stolen, but Barrel blocks their path, announcing that their plan has already failed. Gear, driven by an unshakeable determination to change the world, refuses to give up.

Episodes.Title: That Guy Is Like Spinach Stuck in Your Teeth
Episodes.Description: Captured by the National Security Agency, Gear, White Bear and Qu-0213 are imprisoned in an extremely cold and desolate facility. Stripped of their freedom, each of the three is forced to confront their personal struggles and the harsh realities of their situation.

Episodes.Title: I Have Discovered a Way Only I Can Change the World
Episodes.Description: Following their failed escape attempt, Gear, White Bear, and Qu-0213 are imprisoned on a secluded island surrounded only by the sea. As they adapt to life behind bars, they unexpectedly cross paths with the assassin Cook siblings.

Episodes.Title: Do Not Stop Moving Forward
Episodes.Description: Gear and his comrades, joined by the assassins and the Resistance, race toward the capital at full speed. However, their path is blocked by the government’s autonomous security system. To make matters worse, the capital’s police forces launch an assault from both the ground and the skies.

Episodes.Title: Bullet/Bullet
Episodes.Description: After a fierce struggle, Gear, White Bear, and Qu-0213 finally reach the deepest part of the capital’s underground. To destroy the core of the system, they head through a door, eventually arriving in a pitch-black space. A spotlight flickers on, revealing a mysterious figure.

Entries.Title: mono
Entries.Description: Satsuki Amamiya was feeling down due to the graduation of the high school Photography Club’s president. However, her best friend and fellow member An Kiriyama encourages Satsuki to dedicate herself to the newly merged Cinephoto Club. Join Satsuki and An as they set out to track down a missing camera, meet new faces, and capture stunning photos and videos along the way.

Episodes.Title: mono Trip
Episodes.Description: Satsuki Amamiya, a member of the Photography Club, finds herself in a slump as her beloved club president graduates from high school. Her best friend, An Kiriyama, cheers her up, reigniting Satsuki's motivation to give the club her best again. But the 360-degree camera Satsuki bought at an online auction hasn't arrived yet! Satsuki and An pay the seller a visit.

Episodes.Title: Making of Some Aerial Photography! / Visiting a Classmate, 3000 Leagues - Motovlog Part 12
Episodes.Description: Satsuki and An use a makeshift drone to try some photography when they receive notice that the photography club will be dissolved due to the lack of members. Troubled by this news, they invite fellow classmate Sakurako Shikishima from the Cinema Club, which has also received a dissolution notice. Meanwhile, Haruno is stuck on her manga draft when her high school friend, Kako Komada, pays her a visit. The two hit the road for a tour.

Episodes.Title: Right Before It Becomes an Anime!! The Manga Pilgrimage Stamp Rally with a Schedule from Hell!
Episodes.Description: Haruno gets word of a manga that will be adapted into an anime. As she lives in the real-life location of that manga's story, she scouts out locations and decides to make it a focus for her manga creations. Haruno tries to carry out her plan to visit these manga pilgrimage sites on an ambitious schedule, but the other members of the Cinephoto Club can't seem to hide their unease. And so begins the hellish schedule of this location scouting tour....

Episodes.Title: A Comfy Manga Artist Goes on a Winery Tour - Motovlog Part 13 / Taking Pictures of Food and Getting Full Until We Explode
Episodes.Description: Haruno invites Satsuki and the rest to join an event where they take pictures and eat while walking. The three girls happily accept, thinking it's the perfect event for the Cinephoto Club, but they find out they'll be going around shops that serve generous portions of food to the point they'll be full! They're disappointed in the food brought to them, but this is just the beginning of their fight.

Episodes.Title: The Story of Dry-Cured Ham in Yamanashi / A Haunted Spot and Incident of Possession
Episodes.Description: The dry-cured ham that Haruno was looking forward to enjoying ended up being used as one of the recipe's ingredients! With a little convincing from Kako, the group heads out to buy some famous Yatsugatake ham instead. While on the road, they drop by abandoned places and ski areas here and there, enjoying some Kiyosato curry and visiting a variety of stores that sell ham.

Episodes.Title: Taking the Perfect Picture of a Maruishi Dosojin in Yamanashi! / We'll Enjoy Some Curry in Yamanashi
Episodes.Description: As a story idea for Haruno's manga, the girls participate in a "maruishi" hunting event in the prefecture.

Episodes.Title: First Time for an Anime Adaptation / Calling All Manga Artists! Minobu Walker
Episodes.Description: One of Haruno's manga artist friends, Isuzu, gets her work selected to be adapted into an anime! Worried about the money involved and how busy she'll be, she confides in Kurokuma and Haruno about how uneasy she feels about everything. The girls worry for Isuzu and, as a change of pace, participate in the Minobu Donburi Walk together.

Episodes.Title: Nagano/Toyama Trip That's on the Test (The First Night)
Episodes.Description: Haruno and the Cinephoto Club head to Nagano for a two-night-three-day trip for a scoop. While everyone raises their hand to suggest places they want to go to, An says she wants to film some skateboarding downhill with an action camera. To do this, though, they'll need someone to ride the skateboard with her....

Episodes.Title: Nagano/Toyama Trip That's on the Test (The Second Night)
Episodes.Description: The girls meet up and head over to Kurobe Dam, where they watch a documentary about the dam's construction.

Episodes.Title: Nagano/Toyama Trip That's on the Test (The Third Night)
Episodes.Description: It's the last day, and the group has gone all over Nagano to get this scoop. The group arrives at Togakushi, Nagano, where they try making fresh soba. They break into two teams: adults and children, and have a competition to make some soba! And finally, the group makes their last stop at a Ninja Trick Mansion, but what exactly awaits them there?

Episodes.Title: Enjoying All the Spots on the Yamanashi Shaved Ice Map
Episodes.Description: There are only two days left of summer vacation. As Cinephoto Club reflects upon this past summer, they realize they haven't eaten shaved ice yet! To make this the best summer vacation without any regrets, the group takes one last trip to enjoy all the shaved ice spots listed on the Yamanashi Shaved Iced Map.

Episodes.Title: POV Horror - What ever shall we do?
Episodes.Description: The Cinephoto Club begins shooting a horror film, though not everything is as it seems.

Entries.Title: A Record of a Mortal's Journey to Immortality: The Void War
Entries.Description: Director's cut of Fanren Xiu Xian Chuan 3rd Season.

Entries.Title: Legend of Princess Chang-Ge
Entries.Description: Shortly after astrology predicts destruction to befall the Tang Dynasty, a coup d'état led by the crown prince Li's very own brother kills him and his wife and sons. Li's daughter, princess Yongning, manages to escape, but is soon declared dead alongside her family. Full of wrath, the princess swears to avenge them as she takes on the identity of a young man, Li Chang Ge, and moves to the Shou province to advance her goals. Li Chang Ge uses her wits to gain the trust of the Shou emperor and swiftly climbs the military ranks as a brilliant strategist. Captivatingly drawn, Song of the Long March portrays the feisty girl's adolescent journey toward countless unknown adventures, faithful comradeship, as well as formidable enmity awaiting her along the way.

Episodes.Title: Chains Are Made To Be Broken

Entries.Title: The Dinner Table Detective
Entries.Description: Rich heiress Reiko Hosho lives a double life as a novice detective, fighting crime under Inspector Kazamatsuri—also from a wealthy family. After work, Reiko sheds her pantsuit to don a lovely dress for dinner each day. Difficult cases force her to confide in her butler Kageyama, who proceeds to savagely ridicule her inability to solve mysteries, all while brilliantly unraveling each case himself.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the murderous party File 1
Episodes.Description: Wealthy heiress Reiko Hosho leads a double life as a novice detective. One day, an incident erupts at a birthday party she attends with friends from her college days. The victim is one of her old classmates, and Reiko's friends are labeled as suspects for matching the attacker's description. Stirring in confusion with only 20 minutes to solve the case, a man suddenly appears to reveal the culprit.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the murderous party File 2 / Here's a message from the dead File 1
Episodes.Description: Mystery butler Kageyama concocts a peculiar plan to catch the criminal lurking in a luxury hotel, after which Reiko and her friends realize the hidden complexity of their own emotions. Reiko then tackles the murder case of a real estate tycoon. Each of the victim's relatives harbor suspicious motives to kill, but a single photograph proves essential in accelerating this perplexing investigation.

Episodes.Title: Here's a message from the dead File 2
Episodes.Description: While investigating the murder of a real estate tycoon, Reiko examines an erased dying message, a bloody trophy, and a cord yanked from the curtains. Without proof, however, she reaches a dead end...until savage butler Kageyama emerges to solve the mystery. Reiko and Kyoichiro think outside the box to trap the murderer, peek inside the victim's mindset, and end a chain of events fueled by revenge.

Episodes.Title: Please be aware of two-timing affairs File 1
Episodes.Description: With Kageyama as her chauffeur, Reiko and her friends visit a crowded summer festival, where a cracked smartphone is discovered. Its owner was poisoned in his apartment, and he died wearing nothing but briefs. Three women the victim dated simultaneously on a matching app fail to match the height of a suspect seen exiting his residence, which leaves Reiko puzzled at the true culprit's identity.

Episodes.Title: Please be aware of two-timing affairs File 2 / The person who dropped it is a VTuber File 1
Episodes.Description: Women of differing heights are spotted at the crime scene. Kageyama suspects that elevator shoes disguised the murderer's appearance. After learning that the victim had scammed several women via dating apps, Reiko inches closer to the truth. Later, a delivery man is found dead with an item belonging to his favorite VTuber, and it's discovered that the two even frequented the same hospital.

Episodes.Title: The person who dropped it is a VTuber File 2
Episodes.Description: After a delivery man falls to his death, Reiko and Kyoichiro investigate his connection to popular VTuber "Kuru Kuru-Chan," who is blamed for the murder by fans online. Kageyama assists in analyzing a mystery figure planting bugs, untouched food deliveries, and hints to the true culprit left at the crime scene. The victim leaves a note reading, "I've had enough of this world," but in what context?

Episodes.Title: There is no such thing as a completely locked room File 1
Episodes.Description: A famous painter is stabbed in his own studio, pointing to his masterpiece wall painting "Sleeping Beauty" just before dying. Suspects include his art-jacking son, his second wife, and an art magazine writer with whom he supposedly had an affair. Reiko and Kyoichiro investigate how the killer escaped a locked studio, eventually learning of the victim's connection to a certain "Appraisal Queen."

Episodes.Title: There is no such thing as a completely locked room File 2 / Please don't drown in this river File 1
Episodes.Description: Kageyama locates a secret passageway to solve the locked-room murder mystery. Upon encountering a deranged woman wielding a knife, Reiko is left with nowhere to escape. On the next case, a white-suited journalist's body is discovered by the river. Despite being dry, his cause of death is drowning. With debts to pay, he had targeted a well-known "Shaketopia" actress whom Reiko adored as a child.

Episodes.Title: Please don't drown in this river File 2
Episodes.Description: Journalist Ryota Ishiguro's body is found on the riverbank, but although the cause of his death is drowning, the body is dry. Reiko's investigations lead her to Shiho and Satoshi Kambara, a loving couple from whom Ishiguro had been demanding money, but they claim to have an alibi. The discovery of a silver spoon with the engraving "Shiho to Leo" takes the case in an unexpected direction.

Episodes.Title: Murder lies in a beautiful rose
Episodes.Description: A woman's body is found in a bed of blooming roses at the prestigious Fujikura residence. The victim is Toshio Fujikura's fiancée, and the suspects include members of the family. Reiko, who happens to be their neighbor, is fearful that her identity will be exposed. As the investigation continues, they discover that the victim's pet cat is missing, which may be a key to solving the case.

Episodes.Title: The bride is behind locked doors
Episodes.Description: Reiko attends the wedding of Sawamura Yuri, who she cherishes like a younger sister. The groom is Hosoyama, a consultant for a family friend. When Yuri is attacked and gravely injured in her room during the party, Reiko risks her identity being revealed to help solve the case. But when the crime scene is found to be a perfect locked room, Reiko is suspected of being an accomplice.

Episodes.Title: What is it that you have lost?
Episodes.Description: Trouble strikes the Sawamura family again when Miyuki Sawamura is kidnapped and a ransom of 50 million yen is demanded. With no other suspects, Reiko sets her sights on Hosoyama. She takes Kageyama to the ransom handover disguised as a couple. Despite the perpetrator's traps, they inch closer to the truth, and find that the case is connected to an incident that occurred three years prior.

Entries.Title: Let's Go Karaoke!
Entries.Description: The president of the chorus club, Satomi Oka, is approached by a yakuza named Kyoji Narita. Kyoji's yakuza group holds a customary karaoke competition, and whoever earns the title of worst singer must get a tattoo. Since he was asked to be Kyoji's singing teacher, Satomi has no choice but to go along with these practice sessions. Brought together by karaoke, where will Satomi and Kyoji end up?

Episodes.Title: The Encounter
Episodes.Description: Okada Satoshi, a third-year middle school student and the head of the choir club, is suddenly approached by a yakuza named Narita Kyoji at the choir competition venue, who says, "Let's go sing karaoke!" I'm called out to. At the Matsuribayashi gang, where Kyoji is, there's an annual karaoke contest, and the request was for singing lessons so he wouldn't be crowned the worst singer.

Episodes.Title: Nightmare
Episodes.Description: Satomi finds himself having nightmares, only for it to worsen when a group of Yakuza ask him for help.

Episodes.Title: Parting Ways
