Episodes.Description: With the big day coming up, Satomi must sort his feelings as his time with Kyouji draws closer to an end.

Episodes.Title: Crimson
Episodes.Description: Left in disbelief, Satomi knew there was only one place to go if he wanted to find out Kyouji's condition.

Entries.Title: Mashin Creator Wataru
Entries.Description: Wataru Hoshibe, an elementary school student in fourth grade, is a RyuTuber who wants to become a superstar. His adventure begins in the Chubukai parallel world alongside Ryujinmaru, a Mashin that Wataru created out of blocks to defeat the final boss, Enjoda!

Episodes.Title: 【The Savior is a RyuTuber】Wataru Hoshibe has Arrived!
Episodes.Description: Wataru Hoshibe and his cousin Kakeru Amabe prepare to stream on RyuTube, when they are suddenly pulled into the parallel world of Chubukai.

Episodes.Title: 【Here Comes Fuujinmaru】Offline's Forehead is in Danger!
【Prank】Reuniting with Kakeru!?
Episodes.Description: Wataru finally reunites with Kakeru, but a prankster is harming the local villagers...

Episodes.Title: 【Jumping to the End】Heading to Enjoda's Hideout!
【Urgent Apology】Ryun Ryun's Dark Past!?
Episodes.Description: Ryun Ryun has been busy taking care of Wataru and the others since morning. While looking at the map, Wataru notices a reaction from the Rainbow Blocks nearby, but Ryun Ryun seems to be acting strangely and his directions are unreliable. When they finally arrive at their destination village, the villagers see Ryun Ryun and run away. Wataru and the others are confused when a "Honhon" that looks just like Ryun Ryun appears!

Episodes.Title: 【Survival】Will Kakeru and Friends Pull Through?
Episodes.Description: While Wataru and Co. are relaxing in luxury, Kakeru, Sho and Mygah find themselves lost in the jungle.

Episodes.Title: 【Viewer Discretion Advised】Let's Go to the Haunted House!
【Compilation】Offline is Such a Traitor!
Episodes.Description: Kakeru finally remembers the face of the person who had captured him and it's... Offline?!

Episodes.Title: 【Lifetime Version】100 Ways to Spot a Lie!?
【Must-See Recipe】Obtaining the Great Power of God!
【Mashin Remodeling】It Became Unfixable After Dismantling LOL
【Maro’s How-To】You Too Can Be a Popular RyuTuber!
【Impersonation Makeup】Maro is Maro and Maro is Maroron
【Divine Episode】Asking for the Secret of the World!
【A Battle of Manliness】A Manly Showdown Between Men!
【Serious Match】Get All 7 or You Can't Return!
【Bad News】A Burning World and A Sudden Parting
【The Two Saviors】Let's Create! Our Bright Future!

Entries.Title: Win or Lose
Entries.Description: As a championship game looms, eight characters are thrown a curveball in their off-the-field lives.

Episodes.Title: Coach's Kid
Episodes.Description: Laurie's insecurity about the upcoming championship manifests into a sentient blob called Sweaty.

Episodes.Title: Blue
Episodes.Description: Umpire Frank, a pro on the field, lives his life from the sidelines, unable to let down his guard.

Episodes.Title: Raspberry
Episodes.Description: Star catcher Rochelle knows money is tight—when she gets a chance to earn some cash, she's all in.

Episodes.Title: Pickle
Episodes.Description: Hard-working single mom Vanessa adores her kids and the love she gets for her social media posts.

Episodes.Title: Steal
Episodes.Description: Stuck at big sister Taylor's boring softball games, imaginative Ira befriends troublemaking teens.

Episodes.Title: Mixed Signals
Episodes.Description: Cool and confident, pitcher Yuwen is in conflict with Little Yuwen—his childlike, vulnerable self.

Episodes.Title: I Got It
Episodes.Description: Kai finds joy in new friends she makes on the softball team, but an injury nearly sidelines her.

Episodes.Title: Home
Episodes.Description: Coach Dan's leadership is crucial as the team stumbles their way toward their championship game.

Entries.Title: The Red Ranger Becomes an Adventurer in Another World
Entries.Description: Togo Asagaki was the Red Ranger in a heroic Ranger squad. During their final battle against an evil organization, he gave his life to guarantee their triumph. But fate had other plans, and he found himself reborn in an entirely different world. Embracing his new role as an adventurer, he transforms into Kizuna Red and continues his pursuit of justice, helping those in need.

Episodes.Title: The Red Ranger and the Mage
Episodes.Description: Yihdra is the brilliant child of a disgraced court mage, who seeks to redeem her family's reputation and use sorcery for good. But when she meets an adventurer who transforms into an all-red suit wielding otherworldly weapons, it could be the first step in achieving her dream... or it could drive her crazy!

Episodes.Title: A Red Ranger and Adventurers
Episodes.Description: Yihdra has become an adventurer to learn more about Togo and his powers, but after an adventuring duo earns her hatred with some rude remarks about her father, it escalates into a race to see who can clear a dungeon first.

Episodes.Title: The Red Ranger, the Hero, and the Princess
Episodes.Description: Teltina, is the third princess of the kingdom of Avallost, joined by her Hero, Lowji. She is on a crusade to combat a threat to the people, and eager to recruit Yihdra and Togo, but her knight in shining armor isn't quite as enthusiastic...

Episodes.Title: The Red Ranger and the Blades of Bonds
Episodes.Description: A Mana Seed-empowered lord is oppressing his citizens, so it's up to Togo and his friends to stop him.

Episodes.Title: The Red Ranger and the Demon Queen's Children
Episodes.Description: Togo and his friends are brought to the Sorcery Tower, headquarters of Yihdra's rival.

Episodes.Title: The Red Ranger and the Mage's Dream
Episodes.Description: While Princess Teltina recovers, Red and Yihdra focus their efforts on investigating mana seeds and mana metal.

Episodes.Title: The Red Ranger and the Sun Forest
Episodes.Description: Red and the group set off on a mission to investigate the elves who live in a forest in the middle of a desert.

Episodes.Title: The Red Ranger and Bondkiller
Episodes.Description: Raniya frets about confronting Azir, so Red shares a story about when he had to battle a friend of his own.

Episodes.Title: The Red Ranger and the Mental Mask
Episodes.Description: Red and his friends confront Azir, whose despotic conquest threatens the Sun Forest.

Episodes.Title: The Red Ranger and the Mask of Pain
Episodes.Description: A newly empowered Azir faces off against Red and his friends, and the odds don't look good.

Episodes.Title: The Red Ranger and a New Power
Episodes.Description: Azir becomes a rampaging sandstorm, forcing Red and the others to fight a literal force of nature.

Episodes.Title: Kizuna Black
Episodes.Description: Togo unleashes a forbidden power to save his friends, but it may end up costing him everything in exchange.

Entries.Title: SHIROHIYO - Reincarnated as a Neglected Noble: Raising My Baby Brother with Memories from My Past Life
Entries.Description: Ageha Kikunoi was a spoiled 5-year-old before he suddenly recalled memories from a past life. Then, he loved to cook, sew, and sing above all else. In this world, Ageha and his younger brother, Regulus, try to navigate the Kikunoi house as corruption among the aristocracy deepens. They’ll need skills from Ageha’s past life, blessings of gods and elves, and magic spells to help them on their way!

Episodes.Title: I Got My Memories From My Past Life Back!
Episodes.Description: A Japanese man who likes cooking and sewing is reborn as a chubby noble child.

Episodes.Title: My First Time Meeting My Brother
Episodes.Description: Ageha meets his young brother Regulus for the first time, and learns about his family.

Episodes.Title: The Kikunoi Family's Circumstances
Episodes.Description: Ageha is forced to confront his family's ugliness.

Episodes.Title: I Made Origami for My Brother, and Chawan-Mushi for Me
Episodes.Description: Ageha makes him and his brother special things that remind him of his old home.

Episodes.Title: I Don't Think I'm Going to Live a Long Life
Episodes.Description: Ageha tries to think of ways he can help foster Regulus's education.

Episodes.Title: My Embroidery Sold
Episodes.Description: Ageha takes a trip into town for the first time.

Episodes.Title: Using Magic to Visit the Capital
Episodes.Description: Ageha takes a trip to the capital and meets two musicians.

Episodes.Title: H-Hello! It's an Honor to Meet You!
Episodes.Description: Ageha meets another god, one who has a lot to say to him.

Episodes.Title: The Greatest Singer in the Empire Is Born!
Episodes.Description: Ageha goes to see Maria's performance in the capital.

Episodes.Title: My Heart Is Full of Teachings and Sincerity
Episodes.Description: Ageha's family is concerned about his well-being and would like him to enjoy his childhood more.

Episodes.Title: I Made a Friend
Episodes.Description: Ageha makes his first friend in his new life.

Episodes.Title: I'll Use My Memories from a Past Life to Make a Business Deal
Episodes.Description: Ageha comes up with a big plan to bring prosperity to the Kikunoi lands.

Entries.Title: Iron Man and His Awesome Friends
Entries.Description: Follow the adventures (and misadventures) of best friends and super geniuses, Tony Stark, Riri Williams and Amadeus Cho as they work together to solve problems both big and small and protect their city.

Episodes.Title: Enter the Iron Friends
Episodes.Description: Tony promises his friends a park day, but Ultron steals the toys.

Episodes.Title: Amadeus Cho's Eggcellent Eggventure!
Episodes.Description: Amadeus upgrades a truck, but accidentally turns it into a giant chicken!

Episodes.Title: Great Expo-tations
Episodes.Description: The Iron Friends must save the pier—then stop Ultron from turning Stark Expo into Ultron Expo!

Episodes.Title: Bouncy Boots
Episodes.Description: Absorbing Man steals the power of bouncy boots.

Episodes.Title: Totally Awesome Beach Day
Episodes.Description: Ultron crashes beach day to build his HQ, and the Iron Friends must stop him

Episodes.Title: Swarm Stinks It Up
Episodes.Description: the Iron Friends race to save Granny Williams' peach pies from Swarm's stink bugs.

Episodes.Title: The Ultron Song
Episodes.Description: Ultron takes over the airwaves, and the Iron Friends must stop him

Episodes.Title: Black Panther and the Boot
Episodes.Description: a visit from T'Challa turns tense when a device threatens his suit and the IQ.

Episodes.Title: Captain America Goes Fast
Episodes.Description: Ultron steals Cap's power-pack and goes turbo

Episodes.Title: Ironheart's Awesome Playground
Episodes.Description: Riri's playground plans are bugged by Swarm's power-draining robo-mosquitoes.

Episodes.Title: Tony and the Rolling Stones
Episodes.Description: Tony tries to move a boulder blocking the trail

Episodes.Title: Ironheart's Muddy Adventure
Episodes.Description: Riri wants to play paper boats, but Swarm has drained the creek to ruin the park.

Episodes.Title: Welcome to Wakanda
Episodes.Description: In Wakanda, Ultron steals Black Panther's tech and must be stopped

Episodes.Title: Puppy Dog Fun
Episodes.Description: at Doggy Adoption Day, Swarm uses collars to cause chaos with the pups

Episodes.Title: Ironheart's Baseball Blast
Episodes.Description: The Iron Friends must stop Absorbing Man, who steals a pitching machine to wreak havoc

Episodes.Title: Swarm the IQ
Episodes.Description: Amadeus plans a bioluminescent wave party, but Swarm shows up to cause trouble at the IQ.

Episodes.Title: Iron Friends Trick or Treats!
Episodes.Description: Amadeus uses a robot costume for Halloween, but it goes on a candy rampage.

Episodes.Title: Leaping into Fall
Episodes.Description: Swarm steals all the pumpkins, and the team must get them back.

Episodes.Title: Special Delivery for the Iron Friends

Entries.Title: The Mononoke Lecture Logs of Chuzenji-sensei: He Just Solves All the Mysteries
Entries.Description: In 1948 Tokyo, just right after the war, Kanna Kusakabe had just become a second-year at a high school when she meets the new language teacher, Akihiko Chuzenji. Mysterious supernatural things keep happening around Kanna. Once again today, Kanna is going to open the doors to the library prep room to seek help from the surly Chuzenji-sensei who is waiting inside.

Episodes.Title: The New Teacher With a Stern Face
The Man in the Blue Cloak
The Wicker Basket That Must Not Be Opened
The Pranks of the Brownie / Salome's Head
The Girl Enjoys Delicacies in Autumn

Entries.Title: Once Upon a Witch's Death
Entries.Description: Meg Raspberry is just an apprentice witch celebrating her 17th birthday. That is, until Faust, her magic teacher and Perennial Witch of the Seven Sages, suddenly reveals she is going to die. To stop the Death Sentence curse, Meg must create the Seed of Life using tears of joy from 1,000 people. Join Meg on her travels as she collects the happy tears from everyone she meets to gain eternal life!

Episodes.Title: The Witch with One Year to Live
Episodes.Description: Apprentice witch Meg Raspberry is told she will die in a year unless she collects one thousand tears of joy.

Episodes.Title: The Apprentice Witch and the People of Lapis
Episodes.Description: Meg's friend Fine requests her help with fixing a watch.

Episodes.Title: Wisdom Visits From the East
Episodes.Description: Meg is visited by Inori, the Witch of Wisdom, while Faust is away on business.

Episodes.Title: Blessings With the Opening of the Gate
Episodes.Description: Meg helps Sophie, the Witch of Blessings and one of the Seven Sages, open the gate at the Otherworld Festival.

Episodes.Title: Flowers Bloom in the Festival Night Sky
Episodes.Description: While preparing for the parade, Meg and Sophie meet Marie, a woman looking for the man she met a year ago.

Episodes.Title: An Evening Sky Without Magic
Episodes.Description: Meg brags to Faust about how easy it has become to collect tears and is forbidden from using magic.

Episodes.Title: Words and Disasters and Ceremonies
Episodes.Description: Meg attends a special magic ceremony held once every 20 years.

Episodes.Title: The Family Bewitched by a Devil
Episodes.Description: Meg sees a burn-like scar on a girl's neck that is only visible to her.

Episodes.Title: The Old Giant Tree Sleeps
Episodes.Description: The sacred tree of Lapis has become polluted by magic and must be removed to prevent further damage.

Episodes.Title: The Bell of Blessings Rings With the Sound of the Waves (Part One)
Episodes.Description: Meg and Inori visit Aquamarine, a resort destination with a cutting-edge medical facility.

Episodes.Title: The Bell of Blessings Rings With the Sound of the Waves (Part Two)
Episodes.Description: Meg and Jack experience a breakthrough in their research, and a massive disaster threatens the entire island.

Episodes.Title: The People I Love
Episodes.Description: Meg has mysterious nightmares about a lone witch floating above a destroyed city.

Entries.Title: Medaka Kuroiwa Is Impervious to My Charms
Entries.Description: For Mona Kawai, winning hearts and turning heads comes naturally. Everything changes when Medaka Kuroiwa, a new transfer student, arrives. He won’t even give Mona a second look, and it turns her life upside down! Mona tries everything she can to win Medaka over, even going to the extreme at times. Tune in to a new rom-com about a queen bee and an unfazed boy among the school’s halls.

Episodes.Title: Can't Charm Him
Episodes.Description: Mona Kawai had never met a boy who could resist her charms. Enter Medaka Kuroiwa, who not only withstands her every move but also acts like he's disgusted by them! Is Mona's queen bee ego capable of taking no for an answer?

Episodes.Title: In Love with Him
Episodes.Description: Mona continues her attempts to charm Medaka, but she suddenly realizes that she might have competition?

Episodes.Title: School Festival with Him
Episodes.Description: It’s time for the school festival, and Mona is convinced that the event vibes will make her moves on Medaka more effective. Is she right, though?

Episodes.Title: Legend with Him
Episodes.Description: Mona and Medaka find themselves at the Bridge of Love, the location of the school festival legend.

Episodes.Title: Basketball Girl with Him
Episodes.Description: Mona and Medaka encounter Asahi Shonan, a strong-willed basketball star who seems rather confrontational.

Episodes.Title: Nursing with Him
Episodes.Description: When Medaka comes down with a cold, caring for him becomes a new battleground for Mona and Asahi.

Episodes.Title: Lockscreen with Him
Episodes.Description: A new battle arises over the fate of Medaka's phone wallpaper... and Halloween costumes for the girls.

Episodes.Title: Halloween with Him
Episodes.Description: Mona sets out for the Halloween party, her sights set on making Medaka's lockscreen.

Episodes.Title: Best Friend with Him
Episodes.Description: Tomo, Mona's childhood friend from Osaka, is here in Tokyo and ready to cause some chaos!

Episodes.Title: Theme Park with Him
Episodes.Description: The gang hits up a theme park for Tomo's welcome party, and she and Asahi both have plans afoot!

Episodes.Title: Alone with Him
Episodes.Description: Mona is stranded with Medaka at the theme park, leading to an important realization

Episodes.Title: First Love with Him
Episodes.Description: Mona is in love! How will this change the dynamic between her and the gang, and Medaka most of all?

Entries.Title: Apocalypse Hotel
Entries.Description: Following the collapse of civilization, one storied hotel stands among the ruins of Tokyo’s Ginza district. Overrun by nature, this lone hotel continues to defy humanity’s collapse. Current guests: zero. Check-ins scheduled today: zero. Yesterday’s website traffic: zero. Enter with caution in this story of survival and mystery in a world where the memory of humanity begins to fade.

Episodes.Title: A True Hotel Is Always Storied
Episodes.Description: Yachiyo and her staff are ready to welcome you to the Gingarou Hotel... except there's nobody left on Earth.

Episodes.Title: Tradition Evolves with Innovation and Experimentation
Episodes.Description: The Gingarou Hotel gets its first guest in over a century, but he's not human! Do aliens even count as guests?

Episodes.Title: A Smile Is the Ultimate Ambiance
Episodes.Description: A group of humans return to Earth... but not all is as it seems.

Episodes.Title: Food and Etiquette Are Mainstays of Culture
Episodes.Description: Yachiyo and Ponko head out in search of new ingredients.

Episodes.Title: Provide Unlimited Hospitality in Limited Time
Episodes.Description: A new pair of aliens arrive at the hotel, but the shortage of alcohol will be a problem.

Episodes.Title: Our Only Vice Is Service
Episodes.Description: The end times have come to Earth... and it seems they will be staying at the Gingarou Hotel?

Episodes.Title: Bow Down Deep But Always Aim High
Episodes.Description: The gang decides to launch a satellite for promotion, but Ponko has other ideas.

Episodes.Title: Discipline with a Fist! Reconcile with a High Five!
Episodes.Description: What happens after Yachiyo gets stranded in space?

Episodes.Title: Bookmark Today's Page in Our Guests' Lives
Episodes.Description: After reconciling with Yachiyo, Ponko has some news to share.

Episodes.Title: Clean Sheets Symbolize Pure Hearts
Episodes.Description: The Gingarou receives an unnerving guest who requests total secrecy about his visit...

Episodes.Title: Wag Your Tail, but Never Wag a Shift!
Episodes.Description: Labor standards say Yachiyo has been overworked, and Ponko demands that she take time off.

Episodes.Title: Aim to Be the Number One Hotel in the Galaxy
Episodes.Description: Gingarou and Earth receive a visit from an old, old friend.

Entries.Title: ZENSHU
Entries.Description: After graduating from high school, Natsuko Hirose starts her career as an animator. Her talent quickly flourishes, and she makes her debut as a director in no time. Her first anime becomes a massive hit, sparking a social phenomenon and earning her recognition as an up-and-coming genius director. Her next project is set to be a romantic comedy movie themed around first love! However, having never been in love herself, Natsuko struggles to understand the concept of first love, and as a result, she’s unable to create the storyboard, causing the movie production to come to a standstill. One day, she passes out while working on her storyboard and wakes up in the world of her favorite childhood anime movie "A Tale of Perishing."

Episodes.Title: FIRST STROKE
Episodes.Description: An up-and-coming anime director, Natsuko Hirose, is busy trying to storyboard a rom-com themed feature film, but because she's never experienced first love, she can't seem to progress with her storyboards.

Episodes.Title: DEFEND
Episodes.Description: The prophet of the Last Town, Elder Baobab, decides that Natsuko should join the Nine Soldiers, but her and Luke are at odds. Natsuko tries to figure out a way back home, but then remembers what happens next in "A Tale of Perishing" and realizes everyone's in danger again.

Episodes.Title: DESTINY
Episodes.Description: The Last Town has their Harvest Festival and the Nine Soldiers get some time off. That's where Luke meets Destiny. In "A Tale of Perishing," the two fall in love, but Natsuko coming into the this world seems to be throwing off that destiny...

Episodes.Title: ETERNITY
Episodes.Description: Natsuko notices that Memmeln is acting strange. In the movie, there is a scene with Memmeln that's a mystery even to fans, so Natsuko tails her...

Episodes.Title: JUSTICE
Episodes.Description: Destiny asks the Nine Soldiers to bring food to some orphans and they run into a former Nine Soldier, Justice.

Episodes.Title: CHANGE
Episodes.Description: Natsuko loses to the Voids for the first time, but still tries to continue her selfish actions.

Episodes.Title: FIRST LOVE
Episodes.Description: Natsuko tries to figure out exactly what first love feels like for her upcoming film.

Episodes.Title: CONFESSION
Episodes.Description: Luke finally tells Natsuko how he really feels about her.

Episodes.Title: HERO
Episodes.Description: Luke thinks about his life as the legendary hero.

Episodes.Title: CHAOS
Episodes.Description: Rumors start to spread about Natsuko which leads the people of the Last Town to turn on her.

Episodes.Title: DESPAIR
Episodes.Description: Luke suffers more loss and falls into despair while Memmeln comes up with a certain plan with Meg and Sally.

Episodes.Title: ZENSHU
Episodes.Description: Natsuko has to draw one final thing to save the Last Town from its greatest threat.

Entries.Title: I Have a Crush at Work
Entries.Description: Yui Mitsuya and Masugu Tateishi aren't just any coworkers—they totally have the hots for each other. His helpful yet humble attitude makes her giddy, and her cuteness leaves him grinning like a fool. Problem is, they're trying to keep their new relationship under wraps to avoid making things awkward at work. But seeing how they can't keep their hands off each other, they run the risk of spilling their little secret with each passing day at the office.

Episodes.Title: I Have a Crush at Work

Entries.Title: Me and the Alien MuMu
Entries.Description: A cat-like alien from a distant galaxy, MuMu, arrives on Earth. His goal is to learn about home appliance technology on Earth to recover the technology his species has lost. The protagonist, Sakurako, has a typical university life, but everything changes with MuMu's arrival! What begins as an unexpected cohabitation quickly turns into a whirlwind of chaotic events. The chemistry between Sakurako and MuMu leads to a super-spectacular, appliance-filled, and cat comedy adventure.

Episodes.Title: MuMu, Sakurako and the Risk of Apocalypse
MuMu, Sakurako and the Day the Earth Stood Still

Entries.Title: The Banished Court Magician Aims to Become the Strongest
Entries.Description: Once a loyal court magician supporting the crown prince from behind the scenes, Alec Ygret is cast aside and exiled for only knowing support magic. But just as he hits rock bottom, he reunites with Yorha Eisentz, a former comrade from the legendary party Lasting Period. Invited to rejoin the team that once made history, Alec returns to dungeon exploration—and begins a new chapter in his life!

Entries.Title: See You Tomorrow at the Food Court
Entries.Description: Meet Wada, who gives off an unapproachable vibe, and Yamamoto, who strikes fear into those around her because of her looks. Though the two girls attend separate high schools, they meet up at a shopping center's food court almost every day. Take a little peek at the laid-back afternoons Wada and Yamamoto share as they reflect on the ups and downs of high school life together.

Episodes.Title: WADA1234 / Nazca Lines Aliens / Psibola / Change Before You Have To
Episodes.Description: Wada and Yamamoto meet up and discuss social media, dreams, over-the-counter drugs, and handy English phrases.

Episodes.Title: Rigged Crane Game / Single-Ply Double Roll / Dream Theater / A Doggy Purpose
Episodes.Description: Wada and Yamamoto tackle claw machines, toilet paper, reader-insert fanfiction, and a bowl of spicy udon.

Episodes.Title: Breastibility / Naokin / Sisters / October 21st
Episodes.Description: Wada and Yamamoto contemplate kanji readings, fandom culture, raising pets, and asking personal questions.

Episodes.Title: Caramel Ribbon / We Live in Opposite Directions / It Doesn't Stink / Generic Wada
Episodes.Description: Wada and Yamamoto talk about going to the dentist, stranger danger, new hairstyles, and look-alikes.

Episodes.Title: SSR / So Annoying / Arahama Beach
Episodes.Description: Wada and Yamamoto contemplate permanent markers, how relationships change people, and summer getaway plans.

Episodes.Title: Randy / Gorilla Tape / Toxic Fan / See You Tomorrow at the Food Court
Episodes.Description: Wada and Yamamoto ponder shifting loyalties, digital surveillance, content monetization, and fad diets.

Entries.Title: Food for the Soul
Entries.Description: Follow the daily lives of five new undergrad college girls as the eat, laugh, and deepen their friendships. They love delicious, want to have lots of fun together, study hard, and enjoy their college life to the fullest!

Episodes.Title: Welcome to the Food Culture Research Club
Episodes.Description: University student Mako Kawai lives a quiet life. Then one day, she's unexpectedly invited to join a club.

Episodes.Title: I Might Want to Cook
Episodes.Description: Mako and the others are told they must hold an activity to show what their club is about or be disbanded!

Episodes.Title: My Money's Gone!
Episodes.Description: Mako and the others decide to go out together on the weekend, but then Shinon's money for the trip disappears!

Episodes.Title: This Is Nana Hoshi
Episodes.Description: Mako accidentally bumps into a scary girl after German class. Later, that same girl shows up at the club room!

Episodes.Title: Want to Go for a Drive?
Episodes.Description: Kurea and Shinon get their licenses, so the club decides to go for a drive... but they end up on the freeway!

Episodes.Title: Could It Be I’ve Gained Some Weight?
Episodes.Description: The club goes out for a day of shopping. When Mako tries on a skirt, she's shocked to find it doesn't fit!

Episodes.Title: I Don't Think I'll Ever Forget
Episodes.Description: The club trip begins! After the train and sightseeing, they plan to use the outdoor oven. But then, it rains!

Episodes.Title: The Air Conditioner Is... Broken?
Episodes.Description: Nana spots her escaped pet in the worst location. Then, one hot day, the club's air conditioner won't turn on!

Episodes.Title: Let's Try Running a Stall!
Episodes.Description: The club decides to have a food stall at the university fair, which means Nana will have to help customers!

Episodes.Title: I'm Home
Episodes.Description: The club takes a trip to Mako and Shinon's hometown. Mako is nervous about meeting her old friends again.

Episodes.Title: Are You Free for Christmas?
Episodes.Description: Three of the club members study late and get locked in the building! Later, the club plans a Christmas party.

Episodes.Title: Thanks for the Feast!
Episodes.Description: The club gathers to give their clubroom a New Year's cleaning. They reminisce and enter the new year together!

Entries.Title: Anyway, I'm Falling in Love with You.
Entries.Description: It’s the year 2020, and Mizuho is having the worst 17th birthday ever. Her parents forgot it’s her birthday, she still can’t seem to get close to the senior she likes, and all her school trips and tournaments are canceled thanks to a new disease going around. She’s convinced she’ll never have the kind of youth she’s always dreamt of…until her childhood friend, Kizuki, suddenly asks her out.

Episodes.Title: An Awful Birthday
Episodes.Description: July 1st, 2030. Manga editor Nishino Mizuho is having the worst 27th birthday ever. The manga she’s in charge of will be ending. However, when she sees a group of high school students having fun, she recalls her own adolescence. 10 years ago, during her second year of high school, Mizuho had four childhood friends who she grew up with in a residential neighborhood known as Koigahama Highlands…

Episodes.Title: I'll Be by Your Side
Episodes.Description: Kizuki, who Mizuho saw as the crybaby little brother of the group, has lately been hitting on her. Since Mizuho believed her and Kizuki would be childhood friends forever, she is not sure how to approach this situation. He's on her mind to the point where she seems disoriented, and even says something that could potentially push Kizuki away.

Episodes.Title: Warmth
Episodes.Description: Afraid of ruining their relationship, Mizuho tells herself not to fall for Kizuki. All the stress makes her ill, and her friends come to help.

Episodes.Title: Fireworks for the Future
Episodes.Description: After spending the day at the aquarium, Kizuki asks Mizuho to cheer for him at his swim meet.

Episodes.Title: How to Be Together Forever
Episodes.Description: As the fireworks are set off, Mizuho rushes to look for Kizuki. At the pool she runs into...?

Episodes.Title: I Don't Want to Be Just Friends
Episodes.Description: Mizuho is reluctant to visit Kizuki's house for dinner while her dad is away.

Episodes.Title: Playing Nice
Episodes.Description: Shugo's older brother, Togo, makes a surprise return to Koigahama Highlands.

Episodes.Title: The Shape of One-Sided Love
Episodes.Description: Mizuho goes out with Shugo and Togo and strongly contemplates her feelings for Kizuki.

Episodes.Title: The Times I Spent With You
Episodes.Description: Shin steps up as the student council president to ensure the Ao High Festival can be held.

Episodes.Title: Impulse
Episodes.Description: The group goes on a camping trip! Airu tells Shin to be more selfish and he follows his suggestion.

Episodes.Title: Things That Change
Episodes.Description: Mizuho starts becoming aware of Shin's intentions after he kissed her at the campsite.

Episodes.Title: Neverending Dream
Episodes.Description: Shin and Kizuki compete over Mizuho. Meanwhile she finds out the results of the Newcomers' Manga Competition.

Entries.Title: The Rise of Twin Souls
Entries.Description: Lin Fan, born into a prestigious family in Dalin County, was once a celebrated genius chosen by the Heavenly Prodigy Token. However, his life takes a tragic turn when his fiancée steals his Martial Soul, leaving him powerless and disgraced. Just as his life hits rock bottom, a mysterious Great Demon attaches itself to him, reigniting his shattered Martial Soul and awakening a rare Dual Martial Soul Constitution. Empowered with this newfound strength, Lin Fan begins his journey of revenge and self-discovery, rising from obscurity in a small county town to battling his way through countless realms and dimensions across the universe.

Entries.Title: I'm Living with an Otaku NEET Kunoichi!?
Entries.Description: In order to protect an ordinary businessman, Tsukasa Atsumi, from demons, a genius kunoichi, Shizuri Ideura, signs a master-servant contract with him on the condition that she stays with him. Despite her cool appearance of defeating demons, Shizuri is an otaku NEET who spends all her time playing video games. While Shizuri is spoiled by Tsukasa and leads a lazy cohabitation life, the quirky Kunoichi gather together.

Episodes.Title: Somehow I Started Living with an Otaku NEET Kunoichi
Episodes.Description: Kunoichi Shizuri saves average salaryman Tsukasa from a near death experience!

Episodes.Title: Somehow a Perverted Kunoichi Showed Up
Episodes.Description: Tsukasa forgets his lunch which sets of a series of events leading to Ayame’s arrival.

Episodes.Title: Somehow a Kunoichi with Very Bad Luck Showed Up
Episodes.Description: After sending Ayame away, a new kunoichi appears.

Episodes.Title: Somehow I Was Targeted by a CPL Kunoichi
Episodes.Description: Tsukasa goes out on his own and is ambushed.

Episodes.Title: For Some Reason, Kunoichi Lovers Moved In
Episodes.Description: Tsukasa discovers something about Ayame during a fight with a Yoma.

Episodes.Title: Somehow a Rom-Com Loving High School Girl Was Monitoring Me
Episodes.Description: Shizuri is disappointed by a lack of lovey-dovey feelings.

Episodes.Title: Somehow I Suffered for a Date
Episodes.Description: Shizuri is determined to find out Tsukasa's feelings toward her.

Episodes.Title: Somehow I Fully Enjoyed My Akiba Date
Episodes.Description: Tsukasa asks Shizuri to accompany him shopping in Akihabara.

Episodes.Title: Somehow the High School Girl Reached a New Love Frontier
Episodes.Description: When Tsukasa and Shizuri went on their Akiba date, Himari staked out in the bushes to snoop.

Episodes.Title: Somehow a Tsundere Kunoichi Showed Up
Episodes.Description: Hina drives back a Yoma that has ambushed her master, Toru.

Episodes.Title: Somehow a Kunoichi Maid Burst Onto the Scene
Episodes.Description: Hina's extremely bad luck is out of control.

Episodes.Title: Somehow I Decided to Quit Being a NEET
Episodes.Description: The kunoichi succeeds in paying off the debt owed to Saya.

Episodes.Title: Somehow the Former NEET Did Her Best with Chores and Work
Episodes.Description: Shizuri decides to stop being a NEET. How hard could that be?

Episodes.Title: Somehow the Strongest Assassin Appeared
Episodes.Description: Evidently, hard enough that withdrawal sets in.

Episodes.Title: Somehow This Became a Fighting Anime
Episodes.Description: Killa and Crena launch an attack, trying to kidnap Tsukasa.

Episodes.Title: Somehow Supporting Characters Have Started to Shine
Episodes.Description: Kanna, Hina, and Ayame rush to help Shizuri, who is in a very tight spot.

Episodes.Title: Somehow I Was Asked to Continue Being a NEET
Episodes.Description: Tsukasa confesses to Shizuri how he truly feels.

Episodes.Title: Somehow an Old Story Began
Episodes.Description: The reason for Saya's actions and secrets will be revealed.

Episodes.Title: Somehow There Was Bedlam in the Bathhouse
Episodes.Description: Shizuri and the others visit a luxury bathhouse with jacuzzis, showers, massage chairs.

Episodes.Title: Somehow the Tsundere Kunoichi's Sister Showed Up
Episodes.Description: Shizuri and the others visit a luxury bathhouse with jacuzzis, showers, massage chairs.

Episodes.Title: Somehow the Troublesome Sisters Spoke of Their Memories
Episodes.Description: A brokenhearted Yuzu wanders around the city after seeing her beloved sister Kanna as a tsundere maid.

Episodes.Title: Somehow I Started a Neighborhood Friendship with a High School Girl I'm Basically Meeting for the First Time
Episodes.Description: Shizuri and Himari face each other in a tense atmosphere.

Episodes.Title: Somehow Perversion and Bad Luck Formed a Team
Episodes.Description: Hina's improved luck comes with an unlucky side effect, derailing her "special training" with Ayame.

Episodes.Title: The NEET Kunoichi Somehow Had a Drinking Party
Episodes.Description: Later, a drinking party causes utter chaos!

Entries.Title: Who Made Me a Princess
Entries.Description: The story of Athanasia, forsaken princess of the Obelian Empire, ends with her execution at the hands of her own father—or does it? Her tragic tale is the plot of the novel The Lovely Princess. But now, a modern woman who read the book has just woken up as baby Athanasia herself, filled with her own memories and knowledge of the story she’s stuck in! Determined to survive her doomed fate, infant Athanasia embarks on this new life with a plan: avoid attention and hoard valuables to fund her escape. When her plan goes awry, she suddenly needs to charm her way into the good graces of her father, the beautiful tyrant emperor, so he doesn’t kill her again!

Entries.Title: Women Wearing Shoulder Pads
Entries.Description: Marioneta is proud and wealthy Spaniard living in 1980s Quito, Ecuador. As she goes through her life, Marioneta encounters a diverse group of eccentric and ambitious women as they all navigate the ups and downs of love, family and cuys.

Episodes.Title: Ámame Ódiame
Episodes.Description: A mysterious stalker follows Marioneta as she launches a new business venture. Is the stalker a lover, an enemy, or a little mix of both?

Episodes.Title: ¿Quieres? ¿Quieres? ¡Compra!
Episodes.Description: Marioneta confronts her greatest business rival, Doña Quispe, but she doesn't come empty-handed. She brings a duck.

Episodes.Title: Corazón Retorcido
Episodes.Description: Marioneta attends a meeting of animal rights activists in order to befriend a twelve-year-old girl named Nina Quispe.

Episodes.Title: El Cordón Umbilical
Episodes.Description: Marioneta wakes up in a warehouse, terrified and traumatized. She must overcome her fears to direct a TV commercial.

Episodes.Title: La misma noche que anoche
Episodes.Description: Marioneta throws a New Year's Eve party that ends with her in flames.

Episodes.Title: Tres Tristes Tigres
Episodes.Description: Coquita, Espada and Nina go on a road trip to discover the truth behind Marioneta's cuys.

Episodes.Title: Madre Pródiga
Episodes.Description: All secrets are revealed as the sun sets over Nina and Coquita sitting on the edge of a cliff.

Episodes.Title: Mami Mami Mami
Episodes.Description: Nina is committed to making Marioneta pay for her crimes, even if it means kidnapping her.

Entries.Title: Leviathan
Entries.Description: Set in an alternate steampunk past, an Austrian fugitive prince and a Scottish airman in disguise embark on an unexpected quest to prevent a world war.

Episodes.Title: Into the Storm
Episodes.Description: 1914. Prince Alek of Austria-Hungary goes on an unusual practice session in a Stormwalker. In Edinburgh, Sharp eagerly takes flight in a Huxley.

Episodes.Title: Prelude to War
Episodes.Description: As Europe teeters on the edge of an all-out war, Alek struggles with his new life in hiding. Sharp gets acquainted with the Leviathan and its crew.

Episodes.Title: Clankers and Darwinists
Episodes.Description: Alek learns why he's hunted and, despite Volger's advice, sneaks out to aid the Leviathan's crew. He saves Sharp, who doesn't buy the prince's story.

Episodes.Title: The Weight of the Past
Episodes.Description: With Clanker forces hot on their tail, the wounded Leviathan needs a miracle to get off the ground. Alek makes an offer the Darwinists can't refuse.

Episodes.Title: Far to the East
Episodes.Description: The Leviathan encounters a deadly Clanker weapon on its journey towards Istanbul. Upon arriving in the city, Alek and his comrades make plans to escape.

Episodes.Title: Shadows of Istanbul
Episodes.Description: Sharp and Dr. Barlow finally meet the Sultan, hoping to smooth things over with a rare gift. Meanwhile, a mysterious girl saves Alek from a German patrol.

Episodes.Title: Stormy Seas
Episodes.Description: A patrol jeopardizes the British secret operation, forcing Sharp to flee into Istanbul's streets. Alek commits himself to the revolutionary army's cause.

Episodes.Title: Behemoth
Episodes.Description: On the day of the coup, Alek urges Klopp to leave for his safety. Later, unexpected news forces the revolutionaries to act before the Behemoth arrives.

Episodes.Title: Tunguska
Episodes.Description: The Leviathan and its crew arrive in Siberia to meet Barlow's uncle. He reveals the source behind numerous mysterious phenomena around the world.

Episodes.Title: Truth and Lies
Episodes.Description: Tensions run high after Alek learns the truth about his friend. But before they can talk things over, Sharp gets into a dangerous predicament.

Episodes.Title: Goliath
Episodes.Description: Determined to uncover the truth about Tunguska, Alek and Sharp confront Tesla and learn about the invention responsible for the destruction: the Goliath.

Episodes.Title: Under the Same Sky
Episodes.Description: Tesla issues a deadly ultimatum as a last resort. Can Sharp and Alek, stuck on opposing sides, prevent the conflict from escalating before it's too late?

Entries.Title: Mickey Mouse Clubhouse+
Entries.Description: Mickey and pals welcome everyone back to the clubhouse for all-new adventures filled with songs, laughs, handy helping, and fun new surprises.

Episodes.Title: Mickey's New Helper
Episodes.Description: Mickey and pals meet Little Helper, a handy helping friend. When it floats away in a glove balloon, they race to rescue it using their Mouseketools!

Episodes.Title: Clarabelle's New Coop
Episodes.Description: When Clarabelle's coop is wrecked, Mickey and friends rebuild it using Mouseketools, giving her chickens a new, improved home!

Episodes.Title: Goofy's Sock Hunt
Episodes.Description: Goofy's socks vanish during naps, and soon Mickey's stuff goes missing too! They find Pluto gathering items to build a cozy bed for a mama cat and her kittens.

Episodes.Title: Puppy Pluto
Episodes.Description: Professor Von Drake's Itty Bitty Baby Ray turns him and Pluto into babies! Mickey and pals use Mouseketools to reverse the shrink ray.

Episodes.Title: Goofy Pizza
Episodes.Description: Goofy's hungry for pizza, but the fridge is missing ingredients. Mickey and pals use Mouseketools to gather what's needed and make a delicious pizza to share!

Episodes.Title: Minnie's Tune Train
Episodes.Description: Professor Von Drake gifts a calliope car for the Clubhouse Choo-Choo train. Minnie performs a song, and she and Mickey help friends finish chores to join in.

Episodes.Title: Please the Bees
Episodes.Description: Donald shakes a beehive, upsetting the bees. They buzz after him, but Mickey and pals use Mouseketools to build a new hive and calm them down.

Episodes.Title: Minnie's Dinner Party
Episodes.Description: The pals help Minnie throw a dinner party for Clara Cluck. Using Mouseketools, they set the table, dress up in hats, and finish cooking before guests arrive.

Episodes.Title: Minnie's Backpack Adventure
Episodes.Description: Minnie makes special backpacks, inspiring a hike to Goofy Rock. Using Mouseketools, they reach the top where Goofy climbs his namesake rock for a photo.

Episodes.Title: Mickey's Mail Mix-Up
Episodes.Description: Dozens of letters and packages arrive at the Clubhouse by mistake. Mickey and Minnie find out that Von Drake's mail-sorting invention is broken.

Entries.Title: A Ninja and an Assassin Under One Roof
Entries.Description: On the way home from school one day, Konoha Koga rescues Satoko Kusagakure, a ninja who escaped her village. Soon, pursuers from the village show up in search of Satoko only to be deftly dealt with by Konoha. As it turns out, the unassuming high schooler is actually an assassin. Thus, the potentially cutthroat cohabitation of a ninja and an assassin begins!

Episodes.Title: A Ninja and an Assassin Meet
Episodes.Description: Konoha wants to become the best assassin and it seems that Satoko's ninja skills will come in handy.

Episodes.Title: Daily Life of a Ninja and an Assassin
Episodes.Description: Satoko attempts to buy new clothes for herself and runs into Kuro, the leader of the runaway ninjas.

Episodes.Title: A Ninja and an Assassin's Job
Episodes.Description: Satoko tries to find a part-time job, but it's not as easy as she thought, and Kuro's SO appears!

Episodes.Title: A Ninja and an Assassin's Relationship
Episodes.Description: Satoko attempts to charm Konoha with Kuro's suggestions.

Episodes.Title: A Robot and an Assassin Under One Roof
Episodes.Description: Satoko is replaced by... A robot? And Konoha is none the wiser, forming an unshakable bond with the robot.

Episodes.Title: A Busty Girl and an Assassin Under One Roof
Episodes.Description: With the help of Marin's invention, Satoko tries a new ninja skill: Breast Storage Ninjutsu!

Episodes.Title: An Assassin and Her Classmate's Friend
Episodes.Description: Satoko takes interest in social media while Konoha is introduced to school prodigy, Aoi, who helps with her future career plans.

Episodes.Title: A Ninja and an Assassin's Big House
Episodes.Description: Satoko and Konoha move out, but it appears they're not alone in their big new house.

Episodes.Title: A Ninja and an Assassin's Experiment
Episodes.Description: Satoko needs to find a new iconic outfit and find out the extent of her ninjutsu's capabilities.

Episodes.Title: A Ninja and a Baby Assassin
Episodes.Description: Marin is kidnapped and Konoha is turned into a baby! It's up to Satoko to save the day.

Episodes.Title: A Ninja and an Assassin's Big Dilemma
Episodes.Description: Satoko's injured and Konoha takes on challenging missions due to her career and life being on the line.

Episodes.Title: A Ninja and an Assassin Under One Roof
Episodes.Description: As Satoko waits to hear back from Konoha, she gets a few upgrades. But will Konoha come home safe and sound?

Entries.Title: The Daily Life of a Middle-Aged Online Shopper in Another World
Entries.Description: Kenichi Hamada is just a regular, middle-aged man working as an illustrator in Japan. One day, he is transported to another world and wakes to find himself in the middle of a dangerous forest filled with ravenous monsters. He quickly discovers a massive online shopping site that can deliver him exactly what he needs. Join Kenichi on his search for relaxation in a new world!

Episodes.Title: An Unfamiliar Forest
Episodes.Description: Kenichi, a single man close to 40, suddenly finds himself standing in the woods of another world. After realizing his Skill lets him use the major online retailer "Shangri-La" from his original world, he exchanges items from this new world for money and purchases various products to survive outdoors. However, his life is soon thrown in peril as he finds himself surrounded by monsters.

Episodes.Title: Curry Is Justice!
Episodes.Description: Kenichi is steadily increasing his sales when Myaley and other beastfolk are lured into him by the smell of spices. He refuses to sell spices to them so he can stay off the radar of the spice syndicates, but he gives into pressure from the beastfolk and offers an alternative. Primula, the first daughter of the Mallow Trading Company appears before Kenichi.

Episodes.Title: A Small House in a Big Forest
Episodes.Description: Kenichi decides to live in the forest, but first he must build a cabin with all its accessories in order to lead a peaceful life.

Episodes.Title: Adventurers (Kenichi and His 8 Allies)
Episodes.Description: Primula has been kidnapped by bandits! Kenichi gathers some allies and heads off to rescue her.

Episodes.Title: The Moon Over an Old Castle
Episodes.Description: After rescuing Primula, Kenichi returns to collect his reward and sell their loot, but now it's only a matter of time before he attracts the attention of the nobles.

Episodes.Title: The Book Loving...
Episodes.Description: Kenichi re-establishes his base at the lake near Astrantia where he makes picture books with Anemone and Anemone makes a new friend her age.

Episodes.Title: Creep Forth!
Episodes.Description: After fending off an attack on Crouton, Kenichi secures the Chicory to save Mary and helps them immigrate to Norspaul before Primula finally catches up to him in Astrantia.

Episodes.Title: The Timid Mage
Episodes.Description: Primula establishes a restaurant in Astrantia and brings home her new bodyguard, the catwoman, Nyamena, while Kenichi mines gems from a cliffside.

Episodes.Title: So It's a Spider, So What?
Episodes.Description: Myaley discovers a dungeon near their home that harbors gems and giant cave spiders. While her and Kenichi try to clear it out, Primula's restaurants deal with harassment from the spice syndicate.

Episodes.Title: The Story of Canals
Episodes.Description: The Eupatorium Viscountcy is behind on their mandated construction of a public canal, so the nobles turn to Kenichi for aid, and Primula learns Thogalum has been ripping off the nobles and the construction crew.

Episodes.Title: Shock!
Episodes.Description: Kenichi briefly looks for information on Anemone's mother, and then Mallow arrives so they can root Thogalum out of the Eupatorium Viscountcy.

Episodes.Title: To Sa-Kura
Episodes.Description: Forced to fight, Kenichi threatens the nation before Princess Lilith offers him a way to back down.

Entries.Title: Disney: Twisted-Wonderland - The Animation
Entries.Description: Ordinary high school student Yuken Enma suddenly finds himself transported from Tokyo to Night Raven College and immediately begins alienating its residents. Unable to wield magic, unsure of the customs, and stunned by the new reality he finds himself in, Yuken starts searching for a way back home. Constantly finding himself tangled up in adventures with his troublemaking new classmates, Ace and Deuce, Yuken needs to find his way home before incurring the wrath of the Rose-Red Tyrant, Riddle Rosehearts.

Entries.Title: Catch Me at the Ballpark!
Entries.Description: To escape his tiring job, weary Murata finds escape at a nearby baseball stadium. While the games are thrilling, it’s Ruriko, the gyaru as cold as the beer she serves but secretly a sweetheart, who keeps him coming back. As her first regular, Murata discovers the warmth behind her frosty demeanor, and their hilarious, heartwarming encounters light up the ballpark and maybe even their hearts.

Episodes.Title: Ruriko the Beer Vendor Girl / Welcome, Regular / Candy and Tears
Episodes.Description: Wage slave Murata comes to the ballpark to relax, until a new beer vendor girl catches his eye...

Episodes.Title: The Definition of a Baseball Fan / No! Never! / The Head Scarf of Innocence
Episodes.Description: A mysterious woman visits the ballpark, Ruriko tries to max her following, and a meal vendor laments her fate.

Episodes.Title: The Goddess of Baseball? / The Invincible Mascot / Rah! Rah! Rah!
Episodes.Description: A foreign player seeks motivation, a mascot helps the other staff, and Ruriko and Murata encourage each other.

Episodes.Title: Soul Announcer / The Suggestion Box Incident (Pt. 1) / The Suggestion Box Incident (Pt. 2)
Episodes.Description: Nagisa the announcer struggles with her usual bit, and Detective Ruriko tries to crack a case.

Episodes.Title: Ticks Me Off! / The Meal Pack Capriccio / Different Faces
Episodes.Description: Ruriko's jealousy is sparked, Yuki meets a rival in the concourse, and a rain delay threatens a MotorSuns win.

Episodes.Title: A Good Kid / So Many Treasures / Going Off-Script
Episodes.Description: Sara deals with unexpected customers, the vendors clean out the back room, and an all-star game goes wild.

Episodes.Title: The Pointless 99 Times / Bonds Forged Over Food / Transform!!
Episodes.Description: Ruriko gets inspired, Ichinomiya struggles with inferiority, and a new spread appears in Weekly Baseball.

Episodes.Title: It's the Wind's Fault / Signs / Watch Out for Online News!
Episodes.Description: There's a windy day at the park, Ruriko attends a game on her off day, and a tabloid reporter shadows Aona.

Episodes.Title: Tommy's Melancholy / Mr. Murata / Show Your Sun
Episodes.Description: Ruriko meets a baseball dog, Murata's wallet goes missing, and the team pumps themselves up for the playoffs.

Episodes.Title: Us Back Then / Whack That Bottom! / The Double-T Duo
Episodes.Description: Kohinata meets a former co-worker who is now dedicated to acting.

Episodes.Title: The Clincher! / The Clincher! (Pt. 2) / The Clincher! (Pt. 3)
Episodes.Description: Ballpark regulars and new fans come together to cheer on the MotorSuns in their playoff clincher game!

Episodes.Title: Transformative Game / Last Message / It's Opening Day, Okay?!
Episodes.Description: The MotorSuns and their fans bid farewell to the season with high hopes for the next year.

Entries.Title: Candle in the Tomb：South Sea Tomb
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: #COMPASS2.0 ANIMATION PROJECT
Entries.Description: In the combat providence analysis system, "COMPASS2.0," heroes gather alongside human partners in a dreamlike space. The heroes have to keep fighting to produce enough energy to keep the system running. One hero named 13 is a troublemaker who refuses to find a partner. When 13 is nearly kicked out, a new player named Jin agrees to join him. Can they bring peace to the world of #COMPASS2.0?

Episodes.Title: This Is #COMPASS2.0
Episodes.Description: Welcome to #COMPASS2.0, where heroes from different worlds gather to enjoy time with their human partners.

Episodes.Title: Will You Be My Partner?
Episodes.Description: Jin and the mysterious 13 are supposed to be partners now, so why does 13 seems to elude him at every turn?

Episodes.Title: A Comrade in Trouble
Episodes.Description: Jin and 13 have to put their differences aside when another friend needs their help.

Episodes.Title: Chasing the Mastermind
Episodes.Description: Jin, 13, Aojiru, and Jeanne venture to another world to track down the culprit behind the virus.

Episodes.Title: Defeat the Irregular
Episodes.Description: While Jin and 13 investigate the virus, Reiya stumbles upon the presence of “irregulars” in #COMPASS.

Episodes.Title: Something Is Chasing After Us
Episodes.Description: Several heroes are now hot on the trail of the irregular phenomenon, but something may be after them as well.

Episodes.Title: Please Remember
Episodes.Description: One hero is determined to take the irregulars' power for himself, leading to a dangerous confrontation.

Episodes.Title: Aim for the Tower
Episodes.Description: When disaster strikes across #COMPASS, Jin and 13 rush to the center of it all.

Episodes.Title: I Want to See You Again
Episodes.Description: When Jin is forced to log out of the game, he'll have to find a creative way back in.

Episodes.Title: We Will Begin Anew
Episodes.Description: Jin must confront his past before he can move forward.

Episodes.Title: Here I Am
Episodes.Description: Jin is back in the game, but now he must stop a massive update from changing everything.

Episodes.Title: So, the Connecting World
Episodes.Description: Can the heroes and their partners reconnect in time to save the world?

Entries.Title: I May Be a Guild Receptionist, but I'll Solo Any Boss to Clock Out on Time
Entries.Description: Alina thought she had found the perfect job as a guild receptionist. It’s stable, safe, and has a super cute uniform. But this dream gig turns into an overtime nightmare whenever adventurers get stuck clearing a dungeon. Tired of the long nights, Alina starts taking down the bosses herself! She even earns the name Executioner for her impressive skills. Can she keep her identity a secret?

Episodes.Title: I'm a Guild Receptionist, so I Want a Peaceful Life
Episodes.Description: Alina became a guild receptionist because she thought it'd be an easy, safe, secure job. However, in reality, she's so swamped with work that she's stuck pulling overtime day after day... and she's had enough!

Episodes.Title: I May Be the Executioner, but I'll Be Fired if People Find Out, so I'll Have to Use Force
Episodes.Description: Jade has found out that Alina is the Executioner and hounds her to join Silver Sword. Then a certain adventurer with a grudge sets a raid boss loose...

Episodes.Title: I May Be Silver Sword's Tank, but I Want to Take On a Really Tough Dungeon
Episodes.Description: Glen has learned Alina's secret and proposes a duel. If she loses, she must go to the Chalk Tower with Silver Sword.

Episodes.Title: Relics, Secret Quests, and Dark Gods Keep Interfering with My Work, so I'll Destroy Them All
Episodes.Description: The guiding crystal Jade gave Alina starts to glow, signaling that he's in peril, so Alina rushes to help.

Episodes.Title: I May Be Silver Sword's Healer, but Even I Could Use Some Healing
Episodes.Description: Even after nursing Jade and Lowe back to health, Lululee is depressed over the loss of her weapon and skills.

Episodes.Title: I May Be Silver Sword's Back Attacker, but I'm Gonna Catch the Jerk Who Started That Rumor
Episodes.Description: Alina and Silver Sword go undercover to find the source of the rumor about relics that grant Dia skills.

Episodes.Title: I've Waited Forever for the Centennial Festival, so I'm Gonna Enjoy It, No Matter What
Episodes.Description: While Alina finally enjoys her first Centennial Festival, Lululee confronts the shadows of her past.

Episodes.Title: I May Be a Useless Healer, but I'm Going to Do Everything I Can
Episodes.Description: As Alina and Jade struggle in battle against a dark god, Lululee questions her role as a healer.

Episodes.Title: I May Be in My Third Year as a Guild Receptionist, but I'm Starting New-Employee Training
Episodes.Description: Alina attends new-employee training in hopes of learning how she can avoid working overtime ever again.

Episodes.Title: A Ghost May Show Up During Training, but Nobody Told Me About It
Episodes.Description: Jade suspects that the "man in black" who's been luring adventurers into danger is someone he knows very well.

Episodes.Title: It May Be a Trap, but I Have to Keep Moving Forward
Episodes.Description: Deep beneath guild HQ, Alina and Silver Sword find the "man in black," who finally reveals his identity.

Episodes.Title: I May Be a Guild Receptionist, But I'll Fight to the Bitter End to Get Out of Working Overtime
Episodes.Description: Glen attacks Alina and Silver Sword ruthlessly, but they still cling to the hope of saving him.

Entries.Title: I'm a Noble on the Brink of Ruin, So I Might as Well Try Mastering Magic
Entries.Description: While innocently enjoying himself after work, one man’s life changes forever. He wakes in the body of Liam Hamilton, the youngest son of a noble house on the brink of collapse. Amid the chaos, Liam realizes he finally has time to learn and practice magic. Once he begins, it takes his life for an even bigger turn. Can Liam master magic and save his noble family? The aristocratic fantasy begins!

Episodes.Title: Liam Tries Using Magic for the First Time
Episodes.Description: Liam is an office worker in another world and does not know how he got there. In this new realm, he takes over the body of Liam, the fifth son of a noble family that's about to lose its status, although that doesn't concern him. In this world, magic exists, and he can learn to wield it.

Episodes.Title: Liam Tries Becoming an Adventurer
Episodes.Description: Albrevit seems worried about the idea of Liam wanting to succeed his father, so he decides to introduce him to the Hunters' Association, where the young magic enthusiast will soon earn recognition.

Episodes.Title: Liam Tries Talking to a Dragon Fiend
Liam Tries Taking an Elf Familiar
Episodes.Description: Radon asks Liam to protect some fairies from a forest, as their wings are highly coveted. As part of the process, his magic continues to evolve.

Episodes.Title: Liam Tries Getting Engaged to the Princess
Episodes.Description: Laim and the elves continue building their village in the Promised Land, which attracts the attention of monsters and humans alike.

Episodes.Title: Liam Tries Making Incredible Armor
Episodes.Description: Liam continues to build his nation's strength by recruiting a group of trolls and learning to recreate Radon's magic battle armor.

Episodes.Title: Liam Tries Fighting Dracula
Episodes.Description: Liam's village is threatened by a massive horde of vampires led by a Dracula.

Episodes.Title: Liam Tries Becoming King of the Promised Land
Episodes.Description: Those under the Dracula's rule have been saved. Liam is now king, recognized by both the people and the surrounding countries.

Episodes.Title: Liam Tries Talking to a Girl
Episodes.Description: Lady Flora's visit is interrupted by an exploding monster.

Episodes.Title: Liam Tries Creating and Playing in an Ocean
Episodes.Description: Liam finds a way for his citizens to procure their own water and salt.

Episodes.Title: Liam Tries Building a Magic City
Episodes.Description: Liam stays in his kingdom while Jamil watches him to ensure he doesn't interfere with the drought, so Jamil gets an idea.

Episodes.Title: The Kingdom of Liam Radon
Episodes.Description: The dragon knights of Quistador request an audience with Liam.

Entries.Title: 海尔兄弟高清重制版
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Koupen Chan
Entries.Description: Koupen Chan is an adorable baby emperor penguin who spreads positivity and cheer.

Episodes.Title: I'm Koupen-chan, nice to meet you!
This Kind of Flower Viewing, Too

Entries.Title: MIRU: Paths to My Future
Entries.Description: Born in a distant future, MIRU, a weaponless robot, travels across time to support people from different eras. MIRU meets individuals from different times and places, people who, despite their struggles, live their lives with determination. Through their encounters with MIRU, people take small yet meaningful steps forward. These steps, like the "Butterfly Effect," create waves of change, moving toward a brighter future.

Episodes.Title: Episode 079: Stardust ‌Memory
Episodes.Description: Yoshimura, a space janitor who has spent 10 years collecting space debris is urged to retire by his boss, due to advances in AI technology. His replacement is a young pilot named Umi. While Umi takes her training seriously, Yoshimura remains unmotivated. However, the two soon find themselves facing a critical emergency.

Episodes.Title: Episode 101: The ‌King ‌of ‌the ‌Forest
Episodes.Description: Mario, who lives in a tropical rainforest, works as a tour guide, spending his days leading tourists through the forest. However, the forest has gradually changed since he was a child. Then one day, he stumbles upon an illegal gold mining site…

Episodes.Title: Episode 217: Londonderry Air
Episodes.Description: Ame attends music school, pursuing her dream of becoming a professional pianist. While she works at a construction site to pay for her tuition, her secret joy is playing a public piano on a street corner. One day, her piano skills are noticed, and she is invited to participate in an AI demonstration experiment…

Episodes.Title: Episode 630: Re: MIRU
Episodes.Description: In a world plagued by division, conflict, and worsening global warming, a young diplomat, Toshi, returns home after successfully brokering a peace negotiation. But his moment of relief is short-lived, as news of the negotiation’s collapse plunges him into despair. Exhausted and wandering the streets aimlessly, he is unexpectedly saved by an unremarkable, middle-aged man.

Episodes.Title: Episode 926: Wait, I’ll Be There
Episodes.Description: In a frozen post-apocalyptic world, Airu travels with her companion Pochimaru. Their mission is to travel the world making flowers bloom using the “magic sand” left behind by her mother, a botanist. Deep in a mountain of dead trees, they meet Izumif, a boy who says he’s from the distant future…

Entries.Title: Wealth and Wonder
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Ancient War Soul
Entries.Description: An all-powerful Martial Emperor is killed and returns to life after tens of thousands of years in the body of a young man named Qin Feng. With his supreme martial soul awakened and his practice of the martial way, he clashes with countless wielders and makes waves that shakes all planes or realms of existence!

Entries.Title: Embers
Entries.Description: A village boy’s dream to join the elite Hell Hunters turns into a citywide crisis when he unknowingly aids an enemy operative. As a powerful villain sends forces to recover stolen data, a single act of kindness sets off a deadly chain of events that threatens the fate of Ember City.

Entries.Title: Little Fairy Yao
Entries.Description: The story of Tieu Tien Chi Dao starts when Hidden Clan Lord Hoa Uyen attacks the Heavenly Court and battles High God Nam Trach. Celestial maiden Ngu Chi Dao dies saving Nam Trach but is reborn in Hoa Uyen's body with lost powers. Aided by Hidden Guard Thinh Chieu, she recovers her strength while living a dual identity as the Clan Lord and the maiden Chi Dao.

Entries.Title: Rock Is a Lady's Modesty
Entries.Description: Forced to give up playing guitar when her mother remarried a rich real estate tycoon, Lilisa Suzunomiya's passion for music reawakens when she meets Otoha Kurogane, her seemingly perfect classmate who is secretly a heavy metal drummer!

Episodes.Title: Good Day to You♡ / Quit Playing the Guitar!!!
Episodes.Description: Lilisa had to adapt to her new life of privilege and pretended to be someone she wasn't at Oushin Girls Academy. That is, until she catches Otoha drumming in the music room.

Episodes.Title: Let's Collaborate♡ / I Will NEVER Admit to That!
Episodes.Description: Lilisa wants absolutely nothing to do with Otoha anymore. Unfortunately for her, that's easier said than done since the drummer refuses to leave her alone.

Episodes.Title: Let's Do It! Let's Do What Feels Good! / Wanna Start a Band?
Episodes.Description: Lilisa's love of rock roars back to life during a jam session. She may pretend otherwise, but once unleashed, her repressed spirit will not back down without a fight.

Episodes.Title: Want to Use a Peer Seeker? / I'll Get Them Thrown Out!
Episodes.Description: Alice despises her new sister and mother and is determined to drive them out of her home. Meanwhile, Lilisa and Otoha start their search for new band members.

Episodes.Title: My Heart Is Racing♡ / Whip Yours Out, Too!
Episodes.Description: Lilisa and Otoha vow to wipe that cocky grin straight off Jun's stupid face with a performance to remember! Little do they know, however, that Alice is in the audience.

Episodes.Title: Will You Let Me Join Your Band? / Get Rid of Her, Immediately
Episodes.Description: The Prince of Oushin is renowned by the entire school, but she's hiding a secret, just like Lilisa. Meanwhile, Otoha receives an unexpected offer from an old friend.

Episodes.Title: I Want to Change! / Get on My Level, Friggin' Noob
Episodes.Description: Thanks to Otoha, the four band members will participate in a battle of the bands. Tina shows no signs of improving and talks of kicking her out begin.

Episodes.Title: In No Way Is That a Waste! / I Have a Secret Plan♡
Episodes.Description: Five days—if Tina can improve in five days then she can stay in the band. Lilisa will make sure of it.

Episodes.Title: It Is Finally Our Turn♡ / You're All Too Loud!
Episodes.Description: The battle of the bands kicks off and their problems immediately begin. Tina is out of sync, and Lilisa's performance stands out in a bad way.

Episodes.Title: I Know You Can Do Way Better Than That! / I Wanna Rock Out With Them Again!
Episodes.Description: Tempers flare after a crushing defeat, but not for the expected reason. Tamaki finally understands why Otoha chose Lilisa over her and has an important decision to make.

Episodes.Title: I Want to Be the Noble Maiden / It Lets You Dance All Over Them
Episodes.Description: As Lilisa strives to become a refined lady for her mother's sake, she unexpectedly encounters a former student who has been honored with the title of Noble Maiden.

Episodes.Title: I Will Bow Out of Playing / We'll Prove We're the Best!
Episodes.Description: Lilisa and the others gear up for their final shot to rock the Live House, resolved to take down the boy band Bacchus.

Episodes.Title: Rock Lady
Episodes.Description: Rebellion is the soul of rock, so who cares what anyone thinks? Rock Lady's passion roars through every beat, and they'll prove it to Bacchus, the crowd, and themselves.

Entries.Title: My Status as an Assassin Obviously Exceeds the Hero's
Entries.Description: Akira Oda and his high school classmates are summoned to another world! While the other students are granted cheat abilities through the summoning, Akira merely gains the abilities of a mediocre "assassin." However, his status soon surpasses "hero," the strongest profession. After Akira becomes suspicious of the King behind the summoning, he is falsely framed for a crime and forced to flee.

Entries.Title: Babanba Banban Vampire
Entries.Description: When 15-year-old Rihito falls in love, an ancient vampire who craves 18-year-old virgin blood must protect the teen's virginity at all costs.

Episodes.Title: The Vampire of the Public Bathhouse
Episodes.Description: A vampire works in a bathhouse in hopes of drinking the virgin blood of its heir Rihito, who worryingly falls in love on his first day of high school.

Episodes.Title: The Unpleasant Vampire
Episodes.Description: Ranmaru worries he has inadvertently made Aoi interested in Rihito. Rihito chats with Aoi the next day after school, but they soon get into trouble.

Episodes.Title: Franken and the Vampire
Episodes.Description: After saving Aoi, a hungry Ranmaru tries to resist the urge to feed on her. Rihito soon arrives at the scene and comes to a mistaken realization.

Episodes.Title: The Vampire's Slumber Party
Episodes.Description: Franken proclaims his admiration for Ranmaru, who tasks him with protecting Rihito. Franken tags along with them back to the Tatsuno house for dinner.

Episodes.Title: The Vampire of Fate
Episodes.Description: Rihito's teacher Sakamoto — an undercover vampire hunter of notable lineage — learns that his longtime foe Ranmaru lives with the Tatsunos.

Episodes.Title: A Vampire Put on The Spot
Episodes.Description: As Sakamoto tells Ranmaru the reason for his unexpected request, a puzzled Rihito walks in on them. Ranmaru reveals how Sakamoto's ancestor died.

Episodes.Title: The Cornered Vampire
Episodes.Description: At the Koi Bathhouse, Franken and Sakamoto attempt to bring their plan to fruition by urging Rihito to tell Aoi how he feels about her.

Episodes.Title: A Gal and the Vampire
Episodes.Description: Tough girl Kaoru is charmed by Rihito's cuteness, but when she goes to return a handkerchief he lent her, she can't seem to drop her brash attitude.

Episodes.Title: A Certain family and the Vampire
Episodes.Description: After a confrontation with Kaoru's father, Ranmaru attempts to drink Kaoru's blood. However, he's repulsed by her makeup — which gives him an idea.

Episodes.Title: Mr. Sakamoto and the Vampire
Episodes.Description: Sakamoto tells Ranmaru he was attacked by a vampire at the school. After a remedial night class, Franken and Kaoru encounter a boyish-looking vampire.

Episodes.Title: Love, the Cross, and the Vampire
Episodes.Description: Thoughts of Rihito give Ranmaru strength as he struggles against the formidable Nagayoshi. Suddenly, Kaoru appears with an improvised weapon in hand.

Episodes.Title: And Thus, A New Vampire
Episodes.Description: Ranmaru asks Rihito's father to let Nagayoshi stay in the apartment behind the bathhouse. A newly inspired Nagayoshi declares he's in love with Kaoru.

Entries.Title: Headhunted to Another World: From Salaryman to Big Four!
Entries.Description: In an alternate fantasy world, the Demon King reigns with a formidable army led by his Four Heavenly Kings. One happens to be Uchimura Denosuke, a normal salaryman unexpectedly plucked from his mundane life by the Demon King himself. But even in this new realm, Uchimura is bestowed no particular powers. Can he survive treacherous missions with only the knowledge of an office worker?

Episodes.Title: Tips on How to Pass the Entrance Exam in Another World
Episodes.Description: Uchimura is a regular office worker who did his best to find a job at a company and worked hard, but was constantly overlooked by his superiors. Just when his superiors decided to shunt him off to another dead-end branch, Uchimura is abruptly summoned by the Demon King of another world to work as one of his four generals.

Episodes.Title: The Art of Negotiation in Captivating a Stubborn Tribal Chief
Episodes.Description: Hired as an Elite General, Dennosuke’s first task is to negotiate a merger with the leader of the resource starved Ogre Tribe. Despite their suffering and the Ogre leader's stubbornness, Dennosuke works to find a way forward for the Demon lord's army.

Episodes.Title: Now I Understand! Elite General Communication
Episodes.Description: Dennosuke now has the help of Olulu, the daughter of the leader of the ogre clan. This fact greatly annoys Ulmandra, who tries to get close to our protagonist with little success.

Episodes.Title: Breakthroughs Happen Even With Magic!
Episodes.Description: The Dark Lord gives Dennosuke a new task: to research the magical arts so that everyone can use magic even without the necessary power. And this time, he will have the help of the elusive Sylphid.

Episodes.Title: The Best Way to Enjoy a Stroll Through the Marketplace in Another World
Episodes.Description: Having done so much under the Overlord's direct orders, Dennosuke now feels he must step up his game by becoming proactive. He decides to make a bold move by researching the marketplace with Ulmandra, hoping to find a hint to make the army even greater.

Episodes.Title: The Art of Managing People
Episodes.Description: Uchimura is off to go on his first business trip to the Golden Kingdom, where he must negotiate a trade with the formidable Rampage King. Will his previous experiences help him get the deal he needs to solve the current crisis?

Episodes.Title: Conditions to Become a First-class Merchant
Episodes.Description: Rampage King suddenly no longer wants to trade with the Demon Army saying he could get it elsewhere. Uchimura must now find out why this is happening.

Episodes.Title: Bring Down the Scalpel of Justice to the Corrupt Organization!
Episodes.Description: The guild is monopolizing the gim to get rich! Will Uchimura and Sylphid be able to find the proof they need?

Episodes.Title: The Sins and Punishments of an Evil Merchant.
Episodes.Description: Uchimura is in trouble as their plans get sabotaged by a spy. Will his next move expose the evil merchant?

Episodes.Title: Sword and Shield
Episodes.Description: Uchimura's next challenge is to deal with a calamity as well as deal with a racial conflict within the army.

Episodes.Title: A Battle Without Heroes.
Episodes.Description: With Ulmandra down, Uchimura starts to lose himself as he hastily tries to devise a plan against the wyverns.

Episodes.Title: How to Find Your Way of Life
Episodes.Description: Uchimura was asked to become the next King by the Demon Overlord?! Will he overcome his fears?

Entries.Title: Farmagia
Entries.Description: In Felicidad, farmers known as the Farmagia raise monsters under the peaceful rule of the Magus Diluculum. After the Magus passes, a power struggle erupts among forces using monsters to seize control. In the town of Centvelt, Farmagia Ten and his friends band together against the despotic new ruler, Glaza. Ten, his friends, and their home-grown monsters must stay strong to defend their freedom.

Episodes.Title: The Beginning of Chaos
Episodes.Description: On the vast farmlands of Centvelt in the continent of Avrion, the Farmagias diligently tend to their fields. Meanwhile, Ten spends his days slacking off, focused on raising the ultimate monster. One day, shocking news arrives: The Magus Diluculum has suddenly died.

Episodes.Title: Rebellion of Avrion
Episodes.Description: Airing on Friday, January 17, 2025 Ten and Leii face off against the masked warrior Zanas, who attacks an orphanage. Overwhelmed by the vast difference in their abilities as Farmagias, the two find themselves in a dire situation. However, with the timely assistance of Nares, they manage to successfully repel Zanas. After the battle, gazing upon the ruins of the burned-down orphanage, Ten and the others resolve to rebel against the new Magus, Glaza.

Episodes.Title: Reunion in Enemy Territory
Episodes.Description: To defeat Manas, Ten, Leii, and Arche infiltrate Perfectus as an elite strike team, aiming for the castle. During their mission, they reunite with their missing comrade, Emero. While Ten is overjoyed by the reunion, Emero gazes at them with a stern expression and utters a chilling remark.

Episodes.Title: Uniting Bonds
Episodes.Description: Determined to match Emero, who demonstrated mastery over controlling monster powers, Ten repeatedly attempts to "Unite" but fails no matter how hard he tries, growing increasingly frustrated. Then, Emero appears before Ten and the others once more, but this time, he shows even greater hostility toward them.

Episodes.Title: To the City of Muscles
Episodes.Description: After defeating Manas and returning to Avrion, Ten and the others let Arche rest to recover from a sudden collapse. Ten and Leii then head to their next destination, Rahatluk, on their own. Successfully infiltrating the city, they pull a cart through the streets, only to realize someone is hiding in the cargo. That person is...

Episodes.Title: Beyond the Corpses
Episodes.Description: As Ten and the others panic over Chica's disappearance, Zanas once again stands in their way. Effortlessly deflecting their attacks, Zanas reveals that Chica has been captured by the Corpus before leaving. Determined to ensure their dear comrade's safety, Ten and his group rush to Rahatluk Fortress.

Episodes.Title: In return for the Truth
Episodes.Description: After a fierce battle with the Corpus, Ten and his group emerge victorious. Returning to Avrion, they throw a party to celebrate Emero's return. While everyone enjoys the festivities, Ten, worried about Arche’s absence due to poor health, goes to visit her—only to discover that she has disappeared. Together with his comrades, Ten desperately searches for her, but...

Episodes.Title: The Chosen Ones
Episodes.Description: Receiving a report from Anzar, who has infiltrated Sonrisa and uncovered the guard placements, Nares assigns Ten and the group the mission to defeat L'Oreille. They land in Sonrisa and begin their advance, but while Anzar steps away to scout the enemy, they are ambushed by L'Oreille, Zanas, and Glaza.

Episodes.Title: The Three Angels
Episodes.Description: On the day of peace negotiations, Nares faces L'Oreille with her army on the continent of. Tension fills the air as Ten and the others quietly observe the two. Declaring no intent to attack, Nares speaks calmly, but L'Oreille, with a sinister smile, unleashes the supposedly undecipherable grand magic, "Harvest Festival.

Episodes.Title: Through the Darkness
Episodes.Description: Nares wakes up in the Magus’s castle, where she is shocked to see the Oración Seis, who were believed to be dead. To her further confusion, Lisan mocks her, and standing before her is the former Magus, Diluculum. Meanwhile, Ten and the others, assaulted by L'Oreille, are swallowed by an impenetrable darkness with no light in sight.

Episodes.Title: The Path of the Brother
