Episodes.Description: Having completely lost their sense of self, the Oración Seis transform into Reapers and charge at Ten and the others with terrifying roars. Each of them faces a one-on-one battle, but Ten, confronted by Nares, hesitates to fight. Unable to summon any monsters, he desperately continues to call out to her, torn and unsure of what to do.

Episodes.Title: Dragons of Centvelt
Episodes.Description: Together with Anzar, who has regained his sense of self, Ten and the others challenge the Magus Diluculum to a final battle. However, even their strongest attacks have no effect on Diluculum. As the world gradually collapses due to the "Grand Harvest Festival," Ten and his comrades continue to struggle desperately, refusing to give up.

Entries.Title: Cat's Eye
Entries.Description: By day, sisters Hitomi, Rui and Ai run the popular Cat's Eye Café; by night, they slip into the shadows, executing high-stakes art heists with precision and style.

Entries.Title: 斗破苍穹合集篇
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Grisaia: Phantom Trigger
Entries.Description: What was once "Mihama Academy," a sanctuary for young girls, has now been transformed into a SORD (Special Organization for Research & Development) training school dedicated to fostering talent for national defense. Rena and Maki specialize in firearms, Tohka and Gumi excel at sniping, Chris handles explosives and data processing, and Murasaki is a skilled ninja for intelligence operations. Together, they take on cases too complex for the police or Self-Defense Forces, repeatedly facing dangerous missions. This is the story of these young girls, painted in blood and gunpowder.

Episodes.Title: Mother's Cradle I
Episodes.Description: Taiga from the elementary division joins Rena and the others at Mihama Academy Class A. Chris gets named as her higher officer, and she asks Haruto, the handler for the reason. What does Chris think as she carries Taiga on her back after a hard workout?

Episodes.Title: Mother's Cradle II
Episodes.Description: A terrorist attack transpires at the medical university Taiga visited. The perpetrators are members of a new religious group seeking to obtain a virus to be used for bioterrorism. The United Nations decides to conduct an air strike to prevent the virus from spreading worldwide. Receiving the news, Class A was ordered to stay put. However, Chris ignores the order to rescue Taiga on her own.

Episodes.Title: Mother's Cradle III
Episodes.Description: Chris fights the terrorists with explosives but gets shot. Class A heads to the scene after receiving a warning. Class A's operation begins.

Episodes.Title: Phantom Blade I
Episodes.Description: Murasaki's sister, Yuuki, returns to Class A. Rena is annoyed with her, and Murasaki doesn't seem herself. What happened to the sisters in their past?

Episodes.Title: Phantom Blade II
Episodes.Description: Several years before, Haruto visited Yuuki's village to learn "Phantom Blade." One day, the village got ambushed, and Murasaki suspected Haruto.

Episodes.Title: Bluest Blue I
Episodes.Description: Haruto was born by an experiment. He was raised by Ichiru, Nogami, and Aoi Aoi, a group of assassins. Let us look into how "Haruto Aoi" came about.

Episodes.Title: Bluest Blue II
Episodes.Description: Phantom Trigger got a mission to destroy a religious group. Who awaited the team was a very familiar face.

Episodes.Title: Arisaka's Journal
Episodes.Description: Arisaka must decide on Class A's overseas deployment request. Enishi and Chloe awaits Class A.

Episodes.Title: Rite of Passage
Episodes.Description: All SORD forces are called upon. Haruto encounters Chloe. He points his sword to his archenemy who killed Aoi.

Episodes.Title: Heaven's Door
Episodes.Description: Patrick and Bruno meet a group of young Sisters in a dugout. We just want to live...

Episodes.Title: The Right Choice
Episodes.Description: As members of Mihama Academy fight their own battles, former Phantom Trigger makes a big decision.

Episodes.Title: The Fated Answer
Episodes.Description: All SORD forces except Class A retreat. Rena is remembering the time when she was picked up by Haruto.

Episodes.Title: Phantom Children
Episodes.Description: The battle is coming to an end. This is the story of Phantom Trigger drenched in blood and smoke.

Entries.Title: I Want to Escape from Princess Lessons
Entries.Description: Leticia Dorman, daughter of a duke, is less than thrilled to be engaged to a crown prince. Betrothed since childhood and trained to be queen, she always hoped Prince Clarke would fall for someone else one day. So when he shows up at a ball with another woman, Lettie excitedly retreats to the countryside to start her new life—only for Clarke to appear, determined to win her heart.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Leticia loved playing in nature before she was sent to the castle as a candidate to marry Prince Clarke. Years of harsh princess lessons seem to have transformed Leticia into a lady... until a ball one night where she finds her prince with another woman.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Leticia moves to her family's countryside estate and spends her time frolicking in nature. While she is fishing one day, her ex-fiancé Clarke suddenly appears. Puzzled by the visit, Leticia shows Clarke around the village and then learns a shocking fact.

Episodes.Title: I Wish you Happiness
Episodes.Description: Clarke forces Leticia to return to the castle. Upon arriving, he promises that she will be able to spend as much time in nature as she wants. Leticia starts to wonder if marriage is not such an awful idea after all, but she still yearns for more freedom.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Stuck behind bars in a new room, Leticia talks to Brianna and Nadir about her hopes and dreams before noticing a hidden door during an escape attempt.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: When Leticia steps out from an evening ball after seeing Clarke with another woman, she is suddenly kidnapped.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: With the help of her friends, Leticia temporarily leaves the castle to investigate Clarke's new mystery lover.

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Louis plots to woo Maria with a surprise gift of macarons but instead triggers a tense, late-night ghost hunt.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Clarke thinks back on Leticia's early days at the castle and reevaluates his naive attempts to make her happy.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: Shortly after Leticia resumes her lessons, a strange incident occurs at the newly renovated conservatory bath.

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: Leticia recalls joyful childhood memories after Queen Laura reminds her that Prince Clarke was her first love.

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: With wedding preparations in full swing, rumors spread that Clarke wishes to renounce his claim to the throne.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Leticia and Clarke settle in to married life as their friends playfully encourage them to take the next step.

Entries.Title: 7 Bears
Entries.Description: Forget the Seven Dwarfs — here come the 7 Bears! This lovable pack of furballs is putting a fuzzy twist on the classic fairy tales you thought you knew.

Episodes.Title: Snow White and the Seven Bears / The Seven Bears Not Dwarfs
Episodes.Description: Snow White has moved in — and she won't budge until the bears help her reclaim her magic boots. The bears think their brother has transformed into a fly.

Episodes.Title: The Dancing Potion / The Potato Touch
Episodes.Description: The bears use magic to get the Prince grooving at the King's Ball. The Witch grants one bear the power to turn anything — or anyone — into a potato.

Episodes.Title: Stumblebumpskin / The Perfect Toast
Episodes.Description: The bears meet a naughty gnome who challenges them to a butt-kicking contest. A search for the perfect slice of toast puts Snow White in danger.

Episodes.Title: Bearpunzel / Princilocks and the Seven Bears
Episodes.Description: A bear's wish for a big, bouncy butt lands him in a tight spot. The brothers help Prince Charmless win the King's approval with a royal manners makeover.

Episodes.Title: Bearsel & Gretel / Jack & the Bearstalk
Episodes.Description: The bears hear a rumor that makes them worry the Witch wants to eat them. One bear gets the King's attention after eating magic beans.

Episodes.Title: The Big, Bad Favor / Basket Case
Episodes.Description: The bears protect three pigs — and a huge potato stash — from a hungry wolf. Red Riding Hood drags the brothers into her battle with the Big Bad... Jerry?

Episodes.Title: The Pied Butt Scratcher / Princess & the Pea-tato
Episodes.Description: Armed with a magic flute, the bears try to rid the land of itchy butt bugs. A tiny potato hidden under a mattress gives the bears a sleepless night.

Episodes.Title: Bears Vs. Dwarfs / The Bear in the Magic Lamp
Episodes.Description: Snow White helps the Seven Dwarfs take over the bears' mine. While helping kind storyteller Scheherazade, the brothers get sucked into her magic lamp.

Episodes.Title: The Bear Prince / The Ugly Guardling
Episodes.Description: Prince Charming mistakes one of the brothers for his favorite teddy bear. After bumping his head, a bear thinks he's a member of the King's royal guard.

Episodes.Title: Cinderella's Quiceanbeara / Puss' N Bears
Episodes.Description: Fairy asks the bears to host Cinderella's 15th birthday party. Then, Puss in Boots helps the brothers track down the mythical, magical... Crystal Potato!

Entries.Title: GUILTY GEAR STRIVE: DUAL RULERS
Entries.Description: Sin Kiske, the forbidden child of a human and a magically crafted biological weapon called a Gear, lives in a world where magic has replaced science, and scars from the Gear rebellion remain. Attending his parents’ taboo-breaking wedding, he encounters a mysterious girl with deep hatred for Gears, and their fateful meeting threatens to upend the world once again.

Episodes.Title: Ceremony
Episodes.Description: Sin witnesses his parents’ sacrifice and vows to confront Unika to learn her true motive.

Episodes.Title: Belief in Peace
Episodes.Description: Unika disrupts the peace ceremony, triggering a fierce clash as Sin tries to reach her true intentions.

Episodes.Title: A Soaring Angel
Episodes.Description: Sin confronts Unika to prevent a new war, while Elphelt goes missing during a critical investigation.

Episodes.Title: King of Gears
Episodes.Description: Sin confronts his failures, Unika questions herself, and the true enemy's identity begins to surface.

Episodes.Title: King's Decision
Episodes.Description: Sin and Unika lose control as Future Nerville’s plan triggers a global Gear rampage.

Episodes.Title: Emissary from the Future
Episodes.Description: With the world at stake, the warriors clash against a relentless power that threatens everything.

Episodes.Title: Dark Sun
Episodes.Description: Sin leads a final charge to stop Nerville as allies unite and the fate of the world hangs in the balance.

Episodes.Title: What Makes You, You
Episodes.Description: Unika and Sin face a pivotal battle that will shape their futures.

Entries.Title: Everything Is Fine with the Emperor
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: 黑诏书万历
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Ling Tian Du Zun
Entries.Description: The animation  "Ling Tian Du Zun" is adapted from the web novel of the same name by Qimao's contracted writer You Mu. Ling Tian, a sword saint of his generation, went against the will of heaven to seize the stele in order to save his beloved, but was plotted against by the way of heaven. When he fell, he perished together with the way of heaven, but was unexpectedly reborn, returning to the moment of his death three hundred years ago when his dantian was completely destroyed and his sword bone was taken away. His beauty is still there, his old enemy is still there, and he has been on the long road to becoming a saint, so why not start over? In this life, he vows to rewrite his destiny and make up for his regrets!

Entries.Title: ZatsuTabi -That's Journey-
Entries.Description: When aspiring manga artist Chika’s storyboards get rejected, she ditches her desk for an adventure! Armed with a quirky social media poll, she sets off on a spontaneous journey of random crowdsourced destinations. From hilarious mishaps to heartwarming encounters, Chika discovers inspiration, friendship, and herself, one unpredictable stop at a time.

Episodes.Title: The First 1,225 Steps
Episodes.Description: Manga artist Suzugamori Chika goes on a journey guided by poll results. Her first destination: Aizuwakamatsu.

Episodes.Title: The Real Deal! A Lively Journey for Two
Episodes.Description: Chika visits Matsushima alone and feels a little lonely. Koyomi joins her journey to Kurobe in Toyama.

Episodes.Title: Perfect the Way It Is
Episodes.Description: Chika and her junior Yui go on their first journey together to Takamatsu, Kagawa, in the Shikoku region.

Episodes.Title: Smile by the Sea
Episodes.Description: Chika travels to Kyoto with manga artists Fuyune and Riri and gets inspired by their creative process.

Episodes.Title: Crows, Dragons, Soba, and a Remote Island
Episodes.Description: Chika journeys to Tochigi alone and then to Awashima with Koyomi.

Episodes.Title: An Epic Midsummer Journey!
Episodes.Description: Chika's Awashima journey with Koyomi ends, and Yui joins for "The Epic Summer Journey: Tokyo Arc."

Episodes.Title: A City Where You Can Meet Gods? And Then...
Episodes.Description: Chika visits the Ise Shrine with Riri. Then, Yoshimoto sends her off on a night bus trip with Yui and Fuyune.

Episodes.Title: Three Girls, Cozy and Full of Laughs
Episodes.Description: Chika explores Hiroshima with Fuyune and Yui. She then produces a draft that gets approved by her editor.

Episodes.Title: Completion at the Hot Spring, Then the First Sunrise
Episodes.Description: Chika goes on a solo journey to Aomori and then to Wakayama to see the first sunrise of the year.

Episodes.Title: Home in My Heart
Episodes.Description: After Chika returns from her solo journey in Wakayama, Koyomi joins her for a journey to Hanamaki in Iwate.

Episodes.Title: A Pilgrimage with Master
Episodes.Description: Chika visits Izumo-Taisha in Shimane with Fuyune, where she finds out that Fuyune and Riri had an argument.

Episodes.Title: That's Journey
Episodes.Description: Riri makes a surprise appearance, inspiring Chika. Yoshimoto offers Chika a shot to get her one-off published.

Entries.Title: The Sword Emperor of Eternity
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: 神探小五
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: 喜羊羊与灰太狼之狂野新宇宙
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Twins Hinahima
Entries.Description: Two girls dreams of going viral on TikToker until they discover something strange in their videos

Entries.Title: RoboGobo
Entries.Description: Five adorable adopted pets are given super-powered Robo-Suits by kid inventor Dax, then going on a mission to save other pets in trouble and learning how to become a family in the process.

Episodes.Title: Pizza Panic
Episodes.Description: Dax tries to get Team RoboGobo to agree on how to stop a fish-stealing Gimme Pig.

Episodes.Title: Crab-Tastrophe!
Episodes.Description: Shelly and Wingo try to prove they are responsible by pet-sitting crabby Crabitha.

Episodes.Title: Hopper Hears a Ewe
Episodes.Description: RoboGobo must rescue a flock of sheep from Mönkey Wrënch.

Episodes.Title: Gimmie Goes Glam!
Episodes.Description: When Gimme Pig takes over the Heads 'n Tails Salon, Allie and Booster set aside their differences to rescue everyone.

Episodes.Title: Odd Turtle Out
Episodes.Description: Pupsicle convinces Shelly that Wingo is no longer her best friend.

Episodes.Title: The Runaway Raccoon Balloon
Episodes.Description: The team saves RoboGobo-super fan raccoons, Risky and Royale, from a runaway parade balloon.

Episodes.Title: Birdbath Blizzard
Episodes.Description: When Pupsicle freezes a bird bath, RoboGobo must rescue Bob Beaks' flock of birds.

Episodes.Title: Wingo's Way
Episodes.Description: Dax and Wingo must get back the team's Robo-Suits from Gimme Pig.

Episodes.Title: Crabitha First
Episodes.Description: Dax and Booster help Crabitha learn to let go when she and Pupsicle get in a tug-of-war over pizza.

Episodes.Title: Into the Mönkey Möbile
Episodes.Description: To save a pig lost inside Monkey Wrench's hideout, RoboGobo helps Hopper focus.

Episodes.Title: The Birthday Bandit
Episodes.Description: Dax helps Booster stop The Slink from going invisible and ruining a birthday party.

Episodes.Title: Let's Hear it for Allie!
Episodes.Description: When Mönkey Wrënch creates a noisy problem, Allie must be brave to save the day.

Episodes.Title: A Hop on the Wild Side
Episodes.Description: When RoboGobo visits the Wild Side, Hopper learns how to tie a knot to save a cub.

Episodes.Title: Skatepark Snafu
Episodes.Description: After Dax uses his mum's invention, he and Booster must rescue Crabitha from a skatepark.

Episodes.Title: The Water Wheel Steal
Episodes.Description: Dax, Allie and Hopper save Gimme Pig from a giant water wheel.

Episodes.Title: We Got the Tweet
Episodes.Description: Mönkey Wrënch takes away Team RoboGobo's ability to communicate.

Episodes.Title: A Sparkle In the Dark
Episodes.Description: Dax and Allie help a firefly overcome her fear of the dark.

Episodes.Title: The Towering Inflato
Episodes.Description: Hopper must rescue a prickly porcupine from a bouncy house.

Episodes.Title: The Arcade Raid
Episodes.Description: Gimme Pig uses a giant claw machine to steal prizes at the arcade.

Episodes.Title: Homestead Stampede
Episodes.Description: Dax helps Allie become a super cowgirl when they visit Farmer Faye.

Episodes.Title: The Raccoons Who Cried Rescue
Episodes.Description: Risky and Royale pretend to be in danger so Team RoboGobo will rescue them.

Episodes.Title: Jumpin' Jaguars
Episodes.Description: Dax and Allie meet a jaguar cub with limb difference.

Episodes.Title: Bouncy Ball Baddie
Episodes.Description: Hopper and Booster rescue a family of foxes.

Episodes.Title: Spray Paint Showdown
Episodes.Description: When The Slink tries to ruin art, Shelly learns to paint what she feels.

Episodes.Title: Allie Oops!
Episodes.Description: When Pupsicle freezes the Groundhog Day party, Gus the Groundhog helps Allie discover her silly side.

Episodes.Title: The Great Bridge Face-Off
Episodes.Description: Wingo learns patience to outsmart The Slink.

Episodes.Title: Crab-Cuffed
Episodes.Description: The Slink and Gimme Pig get stuck together.

Episodes.Title: Bees is for Booster
Episodes.Description: Booster must learn to be calm around bees to stop Gimme Pig.

Episodes.Title: Pedal to the Medal
Episodes.Description: Dax and Booster help a lizard get his prize medal back from Gimme Pig.

Episodes.Title: When You Wrench Upon a Star
Episodes.Description: Monkey Wrench plans to disrupt the team's campout.

Episodes.Title: Get-A-Pet Day
Episodes.Description: When a friendly tarantula scares people at the pet adoption, Dax and Allie must help him find a forever home.

Episodes.Title: The Mess-Making Machine
Episodes.Description: Booster and Dax team up with Risky and Royale to stop Mönkey Wrënch.

Episodes.Title: The Eggy Sitter's Club
Episodes.Description: Hopper keeps his promise to care for a rare egg, even when Gimme Pig steals it.

Episodes.Title: Gimme Grabs Gill
Episodes.Description: Gill the goldfish flees his vet check-up.

Episodes.Title: Happy Dad's Day
Episodes.Description: On Father's Day, Dax reunites a lost baby elephant with her dad while waiting to spend time with his own dad.

Episodes.Title: Bye Bye Blankie
Episodes.Description: Booster struggles with giving away his old blankie.

Episodes.Title: The Slink's Sidekicks
Episodes.Description: When the Slink tricks Risky and Royale into joining her crew, RoboGobo must rescue them.

Episodes.Title: Wide Side Slide
Episodes.Description: Dax and Hopper help a scared penguin go down a slide to escape Pupsicle's Mecha-Muttsicles.

Episodes.Title: No Platypus Like Home
Episodes.Description: RoboGobo and Park Ranger Pep help a platypus find a home.

Episodes.Title: Roller Rink Rumble
Episodes.Description: When Mönkey Wrënch causes trouble at the Roller Rink, Team RoboGobo must rescue a hamster in a runaway hamster ball.

Episodes.Title: The Chirp Chasers
Episodes.Description: On a rainy day, RoboGobo must quietly capture a cricket before it wakes up Dr. V's pet patient.

Episodes.Title: Play Day
Episodes.Description: Dax and Booster stop the Slink from stealing the main role in a play.

Episodes.Title: Mammoth Meltdown
Episodes.Description: When Pupsicle wakes a frozen Mammoth, Shelly uses her smarts to save the Ani-Mall.

Episodes.Title: Silly Suit Switch-A-Roo
Episodes.Description: When Mönkey Wrënch swaps the team's Robo-Suits, Dax teaches the hero pets to adapt to the change.

Episodes.Title: The Maze of Mystery
Episodes.Description: Dax and Booster follow clues into a big hay bale maze to catch a sneaky snack thief.

Episodes.Title: Scaredy Bat
Episodes.Description: RoboGobo saves a scared bat and stops the Slink from haunting MetroPet Island.

Episodes.Title: Family Fun Night Fiasco
Episodes.Description: Hopper's family fun night plans keep getting interrupted when baddies show up with plans of their own.

Episodes.Title: Team Baddie
Episodes.Description: When all the baddies team up, RoboGobo must become Robo-Jumbo to stop them.

Entries.Title: Iyanu
Entries.Description: Set in the magical kingdom of Yorubaland, follow teenage orphan girl, Iyanu, a heroine who must uncover the mystery behind her newfound powers to save her people from an ancient curse threatening to destroy humanity.

Episodes.Title: The Chosen
Episodes.Description: Iyanu, aka The Chosen, triggers her Divine Powers, escapes Elu, and embarks on a journey to uncover the truth behind the evil lurking in Yorubaland.

Episodes.Title: The Exiles
Episodes.Description: Fleeing evil Chancellor Nuro, Iyanu meets the Corrupt Divine Beast Ekun and Biyi. As she uncovers her powers, she explores hidden Wonders beyond Elu.

Episodes.Title: The Eso of Eso
Episodes.Description: Kanfo, leader of the Eso Warriors, brings his son Toye to hunt Iyanu, while she meets Mama Sewa, a sage with secret knowledge of her past and powers.

Episodes.Title: The Arrival
Episodes.Description: As Elu's political climate worsens, Iyanu intensifies her training with Sewa while two armies converge on the Riverlands Settlement to capture her.

Episodes.Title: The People of the Deep
Episodes.Description: Iyanu, Biyi and Sewa battle the Corrupt Divine Beast Ekun and the People of the Deep, while Elu's Workers demand justice from the King and Nuro.

Episodes.Title: The Walk of Death
Episodes.Description: Iyanu, Biyi, Toye and Ekun (aka TEAM CHOSEN) cross The Rinku Plains to find The Source, key to Iyanu's powers and lifting the Curse on Yorubaland.

Episodes.Title: The Betrayal
Episodes.Description: As Elu falls into civil war, Biyi and the Oba share stories of heartbreak. Team Chosen struggles to reach The Source while Olori searches for Iyanu.

Episodes.Title: The Sacred
Episodes.Description: Team Chosen reaches The Sacred Settlement, where Iyanu must pass three Trials to prove she's The Chosen, while Nuro, now possessed, pursues them.

Episodes.Title: The Source (1)
Episodes.Description: As Cursed animals besiege Elu, Iyanu searches for The Source. Meanwhile, Biyi, Toye, Olori and Kanfo battle Nuro's forces to buy time for Iyanu.

Episodes.Title: The Source (2)
Episodes.Description: Iyanu reaches The Source and faces a devastating choice. As Elu nears destruction, her allies fight a final battle against Nuro and the Fallen One.

Episodes.Title: Iyanu: The Age of Wonders
Episodes.Description: Ages before The Chosen, Yorubaland thrives -- until the diabolical Meje appears. Warriors Dara and Ishe must stop it and prevent the Age of Darkness.

Entries.Title: OKITSURA: Fell in Love with an Okinawan Girl, but I Just Wish I Know What She's Saying
Entries.Description: When Teruaki Nakamura transfers to laid-back Okinawa, he falls for the lively Kyan-san—but her dialect is a complete mystery to him. With Higa-san translating, Teru's misunderstanding-filled island life takes off... and subtle hints suggest Higa-san might want his heart too. On this serene island, love flows as freely as the ocean breeze!

Episodes.Title: The Girl I Like Speaks in Uchinaaguchi
Episodes.Description: Nakamura Teruaki has moved south to Okinawa from Tokyo and fallen in love with a local girl. There's just one problem, though: her Okinawan dialect is so thick that he can't understand a word she says!

Episodes.Title: A Beach Party Is Just a Social Gathering?!
Episodes.Description: Teruaki is excited for the big class beach party, but he's the only one who wants to swim?!

Episodes.Title: Shiisaa and Eisaa
Episodes.Description: Teruaki learns more about Okinawan traditions, goes to a festival...and sneaks off somewhere "naughty"?!

Episodes.Title: Blow Your Finger Whistle at the Beautiful Sea!
Episodes.Description: Teruaki learns to whistle, and how the Okinawans dance.

Episodes.Title: Kariyushi Wear by Mistake!
Episodes.Description: Teruaki tries on what he thinks is just a Hawaiian shirt, and discovers it has a deeper history than he imagines.

Episodes.Title: I Want to Cry "Okinawa Soba"!
Episodes.Description: Teruaki learns the history of Okinawan soba, and a typhoon closes in.

Episodes.Title: Vipers and Mongooses
Episodes.Description: Teruaki learns the sorrowful tale of the time mongooses were brought to Okinawa.

Episodes.Title: Yui Rail Rides to the Music!
Episodes.Description: Teruaki discovers that there are no trains in Okinawa.

Episodes.Title: Amazing! The Iriomote Cat!
Episodes.Description: Kyan tells Suzu the story of the Iriomote cat and its ancient history.

Episodes.Title: The True Identity of the Yaaruu?!
Episodes.Description: Teruaki takes Higa on a test of courage and is shocked by what he finds.

Episodes.Title: Goya? Gooyaa?
Episodes.Description: Teruaki learns the truth about goya and gooyaa.

Episodes.Title: Anshee Matayaa! (See You Again Sometime!)
Episodes.Description: Kyan panics when she finds out that Teruaki likes her.

Entries.Title: My Friend's Little Sister Has It In for Me!
Entries.Description: Unfortunately, Akiteru knows from experience that isn't the case. Because every girl he interacts with shows him nothing but scorn, and he's not scored a single date from it! Luckily, he's more concerned with securing a spot for him and his game-development buddies at his uncle's business. But when his uncle throws him a condition that involves playing the part of his daughter's boyfriend, Akiteru has no choice but to take it.

Entries.Title: One Piece in Love
Entries.Description: The story is about three high school students: a young male student, his girlfriend and a third wheel who is a One Piece fanatic. Their names are similar to the Straw Hat Pirates and the group form a fan club dedicated to One Piece.

Entries.Title: Magic Maker: How to Make Magic in Another World
Entries.Description: On the night of his 30th birthday, one man’s dreams of wielding magic come true after he unexpectedly passes away. He wakes as Sion, a young child in another world. He and his elder sister, Marie, are the children of a lower-class noble family who govern their region. After receiving conflicting messages from their father, Sion and Marie set out on an adventure to uncover the magic.

Episodes.Title: Marie and Shion
Episodes.Description: Marie absolutely adores her younger brother Shion, everything from the way he secretly plays pretend to the oddly grown-up look he gets sometimes. One day, he asks their father about something called "magic" and their whole lives change.

Episodes.Title: There Is No Magic in This Other World
Episodes.Description: After yearning for magic throughout his first life, Shion lives his second life in another world without magic. But his sister's discovery at a lake has given him hope. As he researches the luminous phenomenon, he feels his dream stir back to life.

Episodes.Title: Goblin Attack
Episodes.Description: Goblins are sighted near the village. Gawain goes to hunt them while Shion and others from the village hide in the mansion for protection. Suddenly, there's a pounding at the door and a window shatters—a goblin has broken into the mansion.

Episodes.Title: Magical Research Begins in Earnest
Episodes.Description: Shion's father finally approves of his magic research, which leads Shion to a new discovery. Marie seems troubled as she devotes herself to her sword.

Episodes.Title: Lightning Ore and Bolt
Episodes.Description: Shion and Marie's relationship is mostly back to normal. Now, Grast has a problem that only Shion can solve.

Episodes.Title: Guild and Monster Suppression
Episodes.Description: Left shaken by his father's words, Shion continues his research by taking it into the field to hunt monsters.

Episodes.Title: Daily Life Begins to Break Down
Episodes.Description: Two years after Shion and the others' first monster hunt, a mysterious red light flashes through the clouds.

Episodes.Title: I Will Do the Healing
Episodes.Description: Marie is gravely ill and strange monsters have attacked. Shion is determined to do everything he can to help.

Episodes.Title: Lethargy Sickness ~Treatment and Research~
Episodes.Description: Shion devotes himself to finding a cure for lethargy sickness. Rose, worried for her friends, offers to help.

Episodes.Title: The Night Menace Has Come
Episodes.Description: The night menace appears once more. Shion and the others race out to defend Istria from horde of wraiths.

Episodes.Title: Sorcery and Magic
Episodes.Description: Ainswelf's arrival changes everything. Shion steps up to challenge a foe far more powerful than himself.

Episodes.Title: Who Am I Really?
Episodes.Description: Exhausted from the battle, Shion sleeps for a week. He wakes to concerned faces and a mysterious phenomenon.

Entries.Title: Throne of the Sword Master
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: U Takes Terra
Entries.Description: Mini-series set in the Arknights universe following the adventures of streamer Eureka.

Episodes.Title: The Kjerag Deal
Episodes.Description: Running from debts? Pfft, as if! This is me DROWNING in sponsorship deals, thank you very much, dear clients! Now, would you look at that mountain! So... snowy!

Episodes.Title: What the Fright, Siracusa?
Episodes.Description: Wait, THIS is Siracusa?! So SCARY~ Quick, smash that like button to give your favorite host U some courage! WAAAAAAAH! ...Actually, you know what? Just hit the SKIP button for me, pretty please!

Episodes.Title: The Rap of Columbia
Episodes.Description: Your girl U just teleported into Columbia and guess what? Turns out, I'm a natural at, like, everything here. Your U-Official, is here to electrify ALL of Terra!

Episodes.Title: U's Guide to Getting Fed: NYE Edition
Episodes.Description:
Uh oh! It's New Year's Eve and U's wallet is EMPTY... But GOOD NEWS! Shangshu folks are SO nice!

So, prepare to be amazed by U's ingenious Free Grub Challenge!

Episodes.Title: Jungle Jams & Metal Mayhem!
Episodes.Description: Join your favorite intrepid host, U, as I fearlessly pull back the mysterious veil of Acahualla! Buuuut... who IS this "Gavial" anyway?

Episodes.Title: Terra Economics
Episodes.Description: Ever since taking that Terra Investment Masterclass, your girl U is a WHOLE NEW PERSON—and I'm feeling better than ever! This time, I'm gonna win back EVERYTHING I lost before! From Sargon all the way back to "that place"—I'm gonna make it BIG!

Episodes.Title: Sami Expedition: Real and Raw
Episodes.Description: You know what they say—after every storm comes the sunshine! Your fearless Streamer U has made it to Sami! This untouched wilderness is gonna give me the EXCLUSIVE content—I'm streaming with EVERYTHING!

Entries.Title: WUKONG
Entries.Description: As demonic forces run rampant and heretical paths prevail, countless lives are plunged into misery. In this era of chaos, a mysterious stone descends upon the world, transforming into the enlightened Stone Monkey, burdened with the mission to save all living beings. Bound by the cycle of cause and effect, he must once again face his ancient foe. Will he defy fate and rewrite his destiny, or fall into darkness? This is the origin of Sun Wukong's rise as a legendary great demon.The soul of the ape is about to awaken.

Entries.Title: Promise of Wizard
Entries.Description: On a moonlit night, Akira Masaki finds herself in a magical world where wizards and humans coexist. Every year, they must face an enormous, deadly moon that attacks the planet. Their only hope lies with the Wizards of the Sage, appointed to fight the supernatural threat. But Akira soon discovers she wasn't summoned by chance—she was chosen to lead them in battle.

Episodes.Title: The Wind Is Strong, and the Cats Are in a Frenzy
Episodes.Description: On a bright night illuminated by the full moon, Akira steps into her apartment's elevator and encounters a man who's dressed bizarrely and tells her many strange things then disappears. Once the elevator doors open, she finds herself in another world.

Episodes.Title: Those Who Defy the Cruel Moon
Episodes.Description: The Maledictor from the East, Faust, had protected one of his comrades in the last battle against the Great Calamity and was gravely injured. Akira visits him after being told she might be able to save him. She then meets various wizards from the Northern Country and the most powerful wizard, Oz.

Episodes.Title: A Heartfelt Breakfast
Episodes.Description: It's decided that a ritual to summon new wizards will be performed. The only one who can perform this ritual is the Sage, Akira. While preparations were being done for the ritual, Akira was reading notes about the wizards in the Sage's Tome to get closer to them.

Episodes.Title: The Unknown, Fear, and Mutual Prosperity
Episodes.Description: Akira and the wizards meet the new wizards that Akira successfully summoned.

Episodes.Title: A Mixer With Some Free-Willed Wizards
Episodes.Description: Akira and the wizards hold a mixer and then, Akira, Cain, Riquet, and Arthur head north to see Oz.

Episodes.Title: Something Someone as Innocent as You Can Do
Episodes.Description: Akira and the wizards get ready to head to their parade in the Central Country.

Episodes.Title: Uninvited Guests at the Party
Episodes.Description: The wizards and Akira enjoy themselves at the party held for them but then some uninvited guests show up.

Episodes.Title: The Fragments of the Distorted Miracle
Episodes.Description: Akira and a few of her wizards go investigate a graveyard.

Episodes.Title: A Melancholic Dance on Thin Ice
Episodes.Description: Owen is suspected of trying to murder Nicholas and Chloe gives a scarf to a friend.

Episodes.Title: I Can Keep Walking Even If I'm All Alone
Episodes.Description: Akira and the wizards head back to the Wizards' Hall after the incident with Owen in the Central Country.

Episodes.Title: The Bird of Omen Awakens
Episodes.Description: There seems to be something peculiar about Owen and Snow and White remember the truth about the Umbra Volans.

Episodes.Title: May Your World Be Blessed
Episodes.Description: Akira and the wizards face off with Nova.

Entries.Title: Araiguma Calcal-dan
Entries.Description: The story is set around five employees working hard in the lesser Tama branch of a secret society aiming for world domination called the Calcal Group: an aspirational new recruit, a polite but self-conscious superior, a modern guy with a cold attitude to everything, a hotheaded but kind senior employee and a handsome older man leading the pack.

Entries.Title: Dusk Beyond the End of the World
Entries.Description: The world is on the verge of changing from an old fashioned society to a new world, due to issues such as gender, race and compliance along with technological innovations such as an evolving AI. Even in this world where black and white is now gray, we believe that "love" will always exist but in myriad forms and not just between people. This includes love between human and robot and its unique expression. The beauty of these emotions will be shown sometimes beautifully, sometimes brutally, and sometimes comically. How long can this love last? When a robot outlives its human partner, can their love hope to endure?

Entries.Title: Maebashi Witches
Entries.Description: Welcome to Maebashi City, Gunma Prefecture. For first-year high school student Yuina Akagi, her middling life takes a wild turn the moment a mysterious frog named Keroppe shows up and asks her, “Why don’t you become a witch?” Alongside Azu Niisato, Kyoka Kitahara, Choco Mitsumata, and Mai Kamiizumi, Yuina and her friends are excited to make people’s dreams come true as the Maebashi Witches.

Episodes.Title: What’s Wrong With the Status Quo?!
Episodes.Description: Yuina meets a talking frog and becomes a witch apprentice. Now she must make flowers bloom in people's hearts.

Episodes.Title: You’re as Cheap and Flimsy as Your Clothes
Episodes.Description: Yuina decides to befriend Azu, who clearly hates her. The girls try and attract customers to the flower shop.

Episodes.Title: The Word 'Lazy,' Pronounced as 'Being Yourself'
Episodes.Description: Azu must confront her deepest insecurities after she lashes out at a customer for her appearance.

Episodes.Title: Go for a 70 Over a 100
Episodes.Description: The girls find out there's a mapo thief in their midst. An old friend of Mai's shows up at the flower shop.

Episodes.Title: Is That 70% of 100%?
Episodes.Description: After exhausting most of their mapo, the Maebashi Witches are in danger of turning back into normal girls.

Episodes.Title: Choco's Big, Round, Chocolate Cake
Episodes.Description: Business at Dreamy Dreamy Flower is booming. However, Kyoka notices that Choco has been acting strangely.

Episodes.Title: When Things Suck, It Sucks to Admit That They Suck
Episodes.Description: Choco breaks character after a customer interrupts her party, and the other girls find themselves at a loss.

Episodes.Title: Kyoka-chan, You Sure Are Dumb
Episodes.Description: Choco is absent from the shop and Yuina comes down with a fever as the Tanabata festival looms ever closer.

Episodes.Title: The Maebashi Witches Are Far Evermore
Episodes.Description: Yuina wants to enjoy some classic summer staples before vacation ends, but she's met with reluctance from Azu.

Episodes.Title: I'll Never Forget Today, Even After I Forget
Episodes.Description: The Maebashi Witches must take back the flower shop or lose all memories of their time as witch apprentices.

Episodes.Title: Have We Met Before?
Episodes.Description: Yuina takes a trip to Tokyo by herself, but she can't help but shake the feeling that something's wrong.

Episodes.Title: I Think I'm Done Being a Witch
Episodes.Description: Yuina and the others have recovered the memories of their time together, but their decision shocks Eiko.

Entries.Title: Flower and Asura
Entries.Description: The story is set in Tonakishima, a small island with a population of 600. Hana, a high school girl who lives on the island, loves recitals, and holds regular reading sessions for the island's children. Mizuki, the president of the Broadcasting Club, senses Hana's power to attract people through her reading and invites her to join the club. Hana joins the Broadcasting Club and experiences many firsts with the other members.

Episodes.Title: Hana and Mizuki
Episodes.Description: Hana's love of storytelling draws the attention of the Broadcasting Club's president, Mizuki, who tries to recruit her. However, Hana has reasons to decline her offer.

Episodes.Title: Interest and Talent
Episodes.Description: The new club members must take turns introducing one another, causing Hana to wonder what her strengths are.

Episodes.Title: Dreams and a Sleepover
Episodes.Description: Hana's enthusiasm deflates as Mr. Kichijoji readies the club for an upcoming competition. Why must she want to win? Why can't she just enjoy doing what she loves?

Episodes.Title: A First and a Friend
Episodes.Description: A spontaneous question causes Hana to freeze during her first broadcast. It's one thing to stick to the script. But improvising? That's a completely different story.

Episodes.Title: Blue Spring and an Umbrella
Episodes.Description: Anne is realistic, while Hana is idealistic; disagreements are inevitable. However, that won't stop Hana from trying to befriend her fellow club member.

Episodes.Title: Scripts and a Pancake
Episodes.Description: The club members decide on what category they will each compete in at the Kyoto NHK Cup preliminaries, recitation or announcing. Toga will not enter in either.

Episodes.Title: Big Sister and Little Brother
Episodes.Description: It’s a tight deadline, but the broadcasting club has the will to complete their submission to the original TV drama category.

Episodes.Title: Satisfaction and Unfinished
Episodes.Description: Shura is an expert storyteller, and her ability to conjure an entire city in her audience’s mind proves that Hana still has a long way to go.

Episodes.Title: Matching Charms and a Falling-Out
Episodes.Description: Hana makes new friends during a recitation workshop. Little does she know that one of them has a connection to Anne's past.

Episodes.Title: Orange Blossoms and Resolve
Episodes.Description: What's the best way to improve one's skills? There are many answers, but no single best path.

Episodes.Title: Friends and Family
Episodes.Description: A wedding invitation, a surprising discovery, and an unexpected complication threaten to derail the Broadcasting Club's hard work just before the preliminaries.

Episodes.Title: Hana and Shura
Episodes.Description: The Club may have concocted a clever plan to reach Mizuki, but one formidable final boss stands in their way: Mayumi Usurai, Mizuki’s grandmother.

Entries.Title: The Strongest Upgrade
Entries.Description:
Our main guy, Zhao Fang, gets thrown into a fantasy world—but there’s a catch. He’s stuck as a powerless, disgraced young master, with only a loyal maid by his side. Sounds rough, right? But Zhao Fang isn’t sweating it. Thanks to his deep gaming experience, he quickly cracks the system, exploits game-breaking glitches, and starts power-leveling like a pro.

With every secret realm he conquers, Zhao Fang unlocks new abilities, takes on crazy system-assigned missions, and proves that he’s no ordinary player. He’s here to dominate the game world, one upgrade at a time.

Entries.Title: 奶龙之奇妙冒险
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Wylde Pak
Entries.Description: Lily and Jack are half-siblings thrown together for a summer who must learn how to navigate their new family dynamic while also helping with the Wylde Pak family's chaotic pet grooming business.

Episodes.Title: Best Summer Ever?
Episodes.Description: Jack and Lily are half-siblings living on opposite ends of the world — until Jack shows up on Lily's doorstep for the summer. Their arguing sends the family's new grooming trailer careening through town and they must save their family's livelihood and Halmoni, who is stuck inside.

Episodes.Title: Sad, Single, and Stranded
Episodes.Description: Will and Min show Jack around to help him find a good story. Lily spills boba in Jack's suitcase and tries to hide the evidence.

Episodes.Title: A Waste of a Perfect Summer Day
Episodes.Description: Jack tries to find the big picture as Lily shows him how to spend a perfect summer day in Canyon Valley.

Episodes.Title: Woori World
Episodes.Description: Lily and Jack embark on the epic quest of navigating their local Asian market, Woori World, competing to find a highly coveted box of imported Hallasand cookies.

Episodes.Title: Finding FlamingoFan85
Episodes.Description: When someone trashes the Groom & Board with a nasty online review, Lily won't rest until she finds out who FlamingoFan85 really is. With Jack's help, the mystery only gets weirder.

Episodes.Title: Just a Little Pipe Problem
Episodes.Description: When Jack and Lily mess up the plumbing at the Groom & Board, things spiral fast! While Min and Jack rush to the hardware store for a fix, Lily and Will try to clean up the mess.

Episodes.Title: Camp Chuck
Episodes.Description: Chuck's got a new hustle: theatre camp! Jack and Lily are sure it's a scam, but there's more to the chaotic show than they realized.

Episodes.Title: The Three Ravens
Episodes.Description: Ellie and the kids investigate cryptic Mrs. Withers, but when Jack goes missing in her creepy home, Ellie and Lily must save him.

Episodes.Title: Left Holding the Bag
Episodes.Description: Eager to become master criminals, Lily and Jack help Chuck with his dirty laundry, but are they ready for a life of crime?

Episodes.Title: The Meatball of Canyon Valley
Episodes.Description: When Halmoni chooses Jack over Lily to be her Trot dance competition partner, a jealous Lily seeks revenge.

Episodes.Title: Sticky Fingers
Episodes.Description: Min asks Jack to run a simple errand, but Charlie the Gibbon intervenes, sending Jack and Lily chasing after him.

Episodes.Title: Warriors Against the Realm
Episodes.Description: Lily introduces Jack to her favorite video game, but when he keeps losing, Jack binges the game and turns into a toxic troll.

Episodes.Title: Sungandeul
Episodes.Description: Slice of life vignettes that illustrate the modern-day family dynamic.

Episodes.Title: The Boba-Get
Episodes.Description: The kids try to save the café using pucker limes, but are quickly forced to save Canyon Valley from the pucker.

Episodes.Title: Be Your Own Bean
Episodes.Description: Lily and Min both realize how similar they are to their moms.

Episodes.Title: Meats of Strength
Episodes.Description: Beef invites Jack to a sleepover, but Jack, a sleepover newbie, freaks out over impressing his friend.

Episodes.Title: Dead Ed's
Episodes.Description: Jack and Lily try to prove they're the one true local, enduring a series of bizarre quests in the local dive.

Episodes.Title: The Secret of Lake Island
Episodes.Description: Lily introduces Jack to the deserted Lake Island theme park. When they get stranded, their new friendship quickly crumbles.

Episodes.Title: Father, Son, and Furniture Store
Episodes.Description: Will tries to connect with Jack at the oddball store Mike A's, but everything goes awry and they must fight.

Episodes.Title: LAD
Episodes.Description: Lily and her BFFs Anusha and Debs fight to win the coveted trophy at Hank n Beans arcade.

Episodes.Title: Before 10am
Episodes.Description: Determined to learn the truth about Jack's secret morning life, Lily does the unthinkable and wakes up early but her sleuthing gets them both in big trouble.

Entries.Title: Tasokare Hotel
Entries.Description: Who is the real you? The "Tasokare Hotel" exists in a state of twilight limbo, allowing souls caught between the afterlife and the world of the living to rest. Neko Tsukahara arrives with no memory of who she is or how she came to be there, and is shown to a room filled with items relating to her past. As she searches for a way to remember who she was, a certain incident confronts her.

Episodes.Title: Twilight Girl
Episodes.Description: Neko Tsukahara wakes up in a vast, desolate wilderness, where the twilight stretches to the horizon. She has no memory of who is or how she ended up there. Suddenly, the "Tasogare Hotel" appears behind her. Upon entering, she is greeted by a manager with a head on fire. Unsure whether she's alive or dead, Neko begins searching for a way to regain her memories, when a mysterious guest arrives.

Episodes.Title: The Bet of a Lifetime
Episodes.Description: Neko Tsukahara decides to work at the "Tasogare Hotel", a place that exists between the worlds of the living and the dead. Under the guidance of Atori-senpai, she begins her strange life there. One day, a guest with a love for gambling and a pachinko ball for a head requests a game of mahjong. Later, as she tries to tidy up his cluttered room, an old black telephone suddenly starts ringing...

Episodes.Title: The Blood-Soaked Pansy
Episodes.Description: Neko Tsukahara is settling into her job at Tasogare Hotel. Hoping to prove herself, she volunteers to assist a new guest—a man with a pansy-shaped head and an unsettling vibe. After escorting him to his room, Neko searches for clues to help him recover his memories. She soon discovers that in the living world, he was a medical student and part-time detective named Masaki Osoto.

Episodes.Title: Friendship and Responsibility
Episodes.Description: Neko Tsukahara and Haruto Atori guide two unusual guests—one with a kendo mask for a head and the other with a smartphone head—at the Tasogare Hotel. Clues in their rooms reveal the women were childhood friends and members of the same high school kendo club. As their rooms transform, they gradually recover memories of their shared past and the events that brought them to the Tasogare Hotel.

Episodes.Title: The Seaside Ash-covered Princess
Episodes.Description: Neko and Ruri escort a loving couple to an ocean-view suite, where the woman has a sudden realization. While searching, they find a Cinderella script, sparking memories of the couple's past, though their fate remains unknown. As Osoto and Neko discuss the relationship's oddities, a piercing scream from the woman echoes through the hotel.

Episodes.Title: Space and Music
Episodes.Description: A rocket-headed boy and a black cat wander into Tasokare Hotel. The boy chases the cat around, desperate to befriend it, but never catches it. The cat keeps its distance yet stays close, silently watching over him. Just then, a record-headed guest appears and cheers up the boy. As they play, the boy realizes this man is the legendary saxophonist who once inspired Atori to pursue music.

Episodes.Title: A Carousel and Brass Knuckles
Episodes.Description: Neko runs into Ruri as she is about to leave her room. Looking inside the room, Neko learns what happened to Ruri in the living world. Then a woman with a brass knuckle head arrives at the hotel. She seems disinterested in searching her room for clues, but eventually Neko learns that the woman is a single mother. And Ruri starts to notice similarities between her own mother and the new guest…

Episodes.Title: The Idol Girl
Episodes.Description: National idol group 365 Sister Q (aka 3Q)’s Kaneko Konomi arrives at the hotel. Neko is thrilled to meet her longtime idol. Unlike other guests, Kaneko’s face remains unaltered, and she still has her name and memories. During a meal, a radio in the restaurant suddenly airs 3Q’s press conference - revealing Kaneko’s fate. She entrusts Neko with her final, unfulfilled wish.

Episodes.Title: A Girl's True Face
Episodes.Description: With Konomi Kaneko’s long-lost solo performance - her final wish - approaching, Neko scrambles to gather band members. She repeatedly tries to convince Atori to join as the saxophonist, but he refuses due to a painful past. Can they pull off the concert and send Kaneko off to the afterlife as she wished? As emotions clash, the stage is set for a night of fate and farewells.

Episodes.Title: The Hidden Room
Episodes.Description: After successfully pulling off Konomi Kaneko’s live show and making peace with Atori, Neko suddenly recalls a past-life incident, though the details remain unclear. Meanwhile, Atori mentions Osoto's complaints about room service. Curious and unconvinced, Neko heads to the room alone, notices something has changed, and as she digs deeper, she uncovers a hidden room…

Episodes.Title: Handguns and Hell
Episodes.Description: Neko discovers a hidden room belonging to Osoto, where she finds a diary listing new victims and countless photos of Atori from the living world. Convinced he’s scheming something at the hotel, she prepares to stop him. Kiriko tells her about a special handgun in the manager’s office and determined, she confronts Osoto, demanding to know why he’s obsessed with Atori even now.

Episodes.Title: Revenge
Episodes.Description: In the heat of battle, Osoto is shot and killed. As a consequence, Atori is dragged into the depths of Hell. Blamed for the tragedy, Neko is fired and sent back to the living world. She finds out that her salary from the hotel is paid in hours, and Ruri approaches her with a request. Given a chance to turn back time, Neko returns, determined to face Osoto one last time.

Entries.Title: A Mangaka's Weirdly Wonderful Workplace
Entries.Description: The story centers on Nana Futami, a rookie shōjo manga artist who is supported by her female editor Kaede Satō and her assistant Mizuki Hazama. Even though Nana sometimes suffers from intense delusions due to (what she tells herself is) an occupational illness, she keeps working day-to-day with the help of those around her.

Entries.Title: Ave Mujica - The Die Is Cast -
Entries.Description: After losing everything in a single night, Sakiko Togawa reaches out toward an even deeper abyss, one that will drag everyone around her down as well. Gathering the lives of girls burdened with their own troubles and desires, Sakiko raises the curtain on a perfect masquerade. On a stage where sorrow, death, fear, love—even the solace of forgetting—are stripped away, will their masks be torn off and shatter into oblivion?

Episodes.Title: Sub rosa.
Episodes.Description: Under the leadership of the founder Sakiko, Ave Mujica's popularity and reputation are thriving. Dedicated to ensuring the success of their next stage performance, Sakiko pours her all into creating the perfect stage. However, discord arises among members dissatisfied with the band's direction.

Episodes.Title: Exitus acta probat.
Episodes.Description: Thanks to Nyamu's scheme, the members of Ave Mujica had their masks removed on stage.

Episodes.Title: Quid faciam?
Episodes.Description: Mutsumi's mental exhaustion takes its toll, and she makes a mistake during the live performance. Sachiko's quick reaction helps resolve the situation, but the impact it had on the audience will pose a problem for the future of Ave Mujica.

Episodes.Title: Acta est fabula.
Episodes.Description: Ave Mujica continues to develop thanks to Mutsumi. There is no trace of the previous discord, and all its members are in harmony.

Episodes.Title: Facta fugis, facienda petis.
Episodes.Description: The band disbands in the middle of their national tour. The members of Ave Mujica each return to their own lives.

Episodes.Title: Animum reges.
Episodes.Description: Mortis clings onto Soyo and attempts to enlist her help in order to wake up Mutsumi, who has fallen into a deep slumber. Just how will the MyGO!!!!! members react to seeing "Mutsumi", who has completely changed from her previous self...?

Episodes.Title: Post nubila Phoebus.
Episodes.Description: The MyGO!!!!! members have finally learnt the truth behind CRYCHIC's disbandment. Sakiko's broken words of not knowing who Mutsumi, Ave Mujica nor CRYCHIC are incite reactions from the former CRYCHIC members, to the point where they can no longer just stay still...

Episodes.Title: Belua multorum es capitums.
Episodes.Description: The ordinary girls have at last bid farewell to the place they called home. Upon witnessing CRYCHIC's performance, Umiri, consumed by a burning jealousy, takes it upon herself to revive Ave Mujica.

Episodes.Title: Ne vivam si abis.
Episodes.Description: Umiri schemes, Mortis clings to her, Nyamu crashes due to her current situation, and Uika is filled to the brim with agony. As a result, everyone's hidden motives become entangled...

Episodes.Title: Odi et amo.
Episodes.Description:
"I want to dedicate my whole life to you."

Powerful words, but are they empty?

Episodes.Title: Te ustus amem.
Episodes.Description: What we are about to show you is the story of a girl with a secret.

Episodes.Title: Fluctuat nec mergitur.
Episodes.Description: As fate surges before her like a raging storm, all that remains in her struggling hands is...

Episodes.Title: Per aspera ad astra.
Episodes.Description: The path they have traveled, the scenery of where they are now. "The seasons have changed..."

Entries.Title: Cute High Earth Defense Club Hi-CARA!
Entries.Description: The time is Taisho an era filled with the scent of romance, where people's hearts still know compassion.

Episodes.Title: Romantic Revolution Hi-CARA!
Episodes.Description:
Once upon a time, there was a hero who protected the Earth from a great crisis... And now, in the face of another crisis, a new hero is born from Binan High School's "Earth Defense Club"! ...Huh? Who were those former heroes? Well, it was "those guys", "those guys". ...Huh? Why are you blurring out the names? It's a multi-verse setting, so mumble mumble... (vague)　

Anyway, the new defense department - Unzen Shinkuro, Sukayu Narushi, Unohana Sousuke, Oshamanbe Ushio and Aso Akuta.

Episodes.Title: Algae Is HI-CARA!
Episodes.Description: With the help of the feline science of the mysterious future cat Nuru, the five members of the Defense Club have become the "Hi-CARA Romantic Squad" and successfully defeated the monsters plotting to take over the Earth. Then, before them appears the "Ban-CARA Avant Guard Corps", an Earth Conquest Club led by the mysterious prairie dog Master Kyan. Their true identities are none other than Doumeki Straight, Nyutou Samon and Nekoma Tasuku, roommates at the Kurotama Dorm and members of the Binan High School Student Council. With lies and enemies under the same roof, it's impossible for something not to happen... right?

Episodes.Title: The Twit-Tree Is Hi-CARA!
Episodes.Description: Once a month, Binan High School's Handsome Boys Contest is held as a regular event. Since entering the school, Sukayu Narushi has been winning the contest in a row, and is a beauty guru recognized by both himself and others.

Episodes.Title: Being a Mom Is Also Hi-CARA!
Episodes.Description: For the dorm students who live away from their parents, the absence of their dorm breadwinner is a real crisis for their lives.

Episodes.Title: Being Hi-CARA at the Swimming Contest!
Be Hi-CARA at the Ninja Village!
Episodes.Description: Summer vacation has begun at Binan High School, and Aso Sorata returns home with the gluttonous Oshamanbe, whom he caught with mountain delicacies. Waiting for them in their hometown are Aso's three younger brothers.

Episodes.Title: Being Hi-CARA on the Crab Cannery Ship!
It's Hi-CARA Even If Your Stomach Hurts!
It's Hi-CARA Even If You're Alone!

Entries.Title: Reincarnated as the Daughter of the Legendary Hero and the Queen of Spirits
Entries.Description: Ellen is a young girl reincarnated from modern-day Japan as a half-spirit. Her father, Rovel, is the legendary hero who saved the kingdom, and her mother, Origin, is the primordial queen and ruler of all spirits. Furthermore, she herself has the overpowered ability to manipulate the elements. While looking absolutely adorable, this perfect little girl will fall back on her past life's knowledge and the power of the spirits to protect her precious family!

Entries.Title: With You, Our Love Will Make It Through
Entries.Description: When high schooler Mari bumps into a fellow tardy student, she's surprised to find out he's a beastfolk who's to attend her school! After all, it's not rare for beastfolk to coexist alongside humans, but it's still uncommon, with the prejudice and all. Nervous to meet one at first, Mari soon learns there's more to him than his furry exterior. In fact, the more she gets to know him, the more she finds herself drawn to him, his steadfastness, his kindheartedness, and…his body…

Entries.Title: Classic★Stars
Entries.Description: At Gloria Private Academy, where stars are born, Beethoven was a fighter, until music chose him. In the prestigious music department, students who match the talent of legendary musicians inherit their gifts and names. Trading his gloves for melodies, he steps into a world where notes hit harder than fists, determined to win the ultimate competition.

Episodes.Title: Emotion 01: For My Own Soul
Episodes.Description: An injured boxer transfers to Gloria Academy and ends up in the music dept. to find he has a "gift."

Episodes.Title: Emotion 02: Nachtmusik Will Change Into Wings
Episodes.Description: Mozart was offered to write music for ice skater, Misha Cartin. Will he be able to impress the Ice Prince?

Episodes.Title: Emotion 3: Reality Through the Filtered Lens
Episodes.Description: After scoring low on his exam, Beethoven gets appointed a tutor by Miharagi. And that tutor is… Chopin?!

Episodes.Title: Emotion 04: Tonight, Enjoy a Playful Dream
Episodes.Description: Frustrated, Beethoven runs into Liszt, who sheds a new light on his situation. Will Beethoven find his path?

Episodes.Title: Emotion 05: Howl. Sing. Create
Episodes.Description: Now that Beethoven has decided to join, he must prove to his teammates how serious he is by writing a song.

Episodes.Title: Emotion 06: The First Star
Episodes.Description: It's showtime. Beethoven must make up for lost time as they practice their routine for the preliminaries.

Episodes.Title: Emotion 07: Acceptance of the Heart
Episodes.Description: The group feels hopeless as tension rises between the members. Will a trip to the hot springs reunite them?

Episodes.Title: Emotion 08: Love Is Freedom
Episodes.Description: Qualifying in the preliminary, the group is ready to move on, except Liszt. Will Gran★MyStar lose a member?!

Episodes.Title: Emotion 09: A Rough Nightmare
Episodes.Description: Every time Chopin sees his own reflection, he refuses to look. Will he be able to fight off his inner demons?

Episodes.Title: Emotion 10: An Irreversible Note
Episodes.Description: Mozart's traumatic past is triggered when "he" appears. Will Mozart overcome it and look to the future?

Episodes.Title: Emotion 11: Light Up the Love for Music in This Beat
Emotion 12: One to Place Judgment
Episodes.Description: With Beethoven critically injured, will Gran★MyStar be able to perform at the finals and surpass DIs=Cord?!

Episodes.Title: Emotion 13: STARS MELODY
Episodes.Description: As the last performers, will Gran★MyStar manage to take the top?! The world is in for a surprise.

Entries.Title: Kaijuu Sekai Seifuku
Entries.Description: Following the chaotic and heartwarming daily lives of Kaijuu who have come to Earth to conquer the world and live with their human masters.

Episodes.Title: I Want You to Clean Up
Episodes.Description: I'm a 28-year-old office worker who lives with monsters in Tachikawa. The monsters' names are Mera, Gooska, Aniki, and Sugar. Living together is just fun... but it seems that's not all that great.

Episodes.Title: I Want to Go on a Diet
Episodes.Description: I started exercising to try and get rid of my weight. The monsters help me out, but it seems like more of a nuisance than a blessing. And then, Sugar finally gets a great skill... but how?!

Episodes.Title: I Want to Go Outside and Play
Episodes.Description: On a nice day, you took the monsters to the park. The monsters were nervous about swinging on the swings for the first time. But you taught them how to ride them... and they had a lot of fun!

Episodes.Title: It's Children's Day
Episodes.Description: It's Children's Day. The boss made the monsters helmets and swords out of newspapers. The monsters are engrossed in play sword fighting. There is one more thing in the sky that makes the monsters happy...

Episodes.Title: It's Moving Soba
Episodes.Description: One day, a box of moving soba noodles was left in front of my house. It seems that someone has moved in next door. But they look like some pretty surprising people!

Episodes.Title: They are New Monsters
Episodes.Description: It seems that two monster brothers, GaoGao and Garuga, have moved in next door. Will they be able to get along with the others?

Episodes.Title: The House Next Door is Leaking
Episodes.Description: The Gaogaru brothers live with a businessman a little younger than them. They just moved in, and now their house is leaking... They call for help, a skilled repairman!

Episodes.Title: It's a Cat
Episodes.Description: The cat Shisho, the siblings' idol, seems to have learned a lot of things. But he still hasn't mastered bath time. The only way to surpass Shisho is to master bath time.

Episodes.Title: It's the Monsters' Secret
Episodes.Description: Mera, Gooska, Aniki and Sugar are not just cute monsters. They each have their own incredible secrets!

Episodes.Title: My First Time Meeting My Neighbor
Episodes.Description: This was your first face-to-face encounter with your neighbor! Since you both live with monsters, you two seemed to hit it off right away. With monsters so close by, could there be more out there...?!

Episodes.Title: My First Bookstore
Episodes.Description: At the bookstore that you took us to, the monsters seemed to be fascinated by the dinosaur picture book. But then they wondered, "What are dinosaurs?" You had trouble explaining it...

Entries.Title: The Dark History of the Reincarnated Villainess
Entries.Description: Konoha Satou has a dark history, written throughout middle school a fantasy adventure of love and magic about the Count's daughter Konoha Magnolia and the knights who love her. But when it looks like that dark history is going to be uncovered by her mother, Konoha panics and dies in a traffic accident. Opening her eyes, she finds that she's been reincarnated into the world of her own dark history as Iana Magnolia, the worst villainess of her own creation.

Entries.Title: Room of Guilty Pleasure
Entries.Description: This overworked and underpaid teacher, Mr. Sasaki, has his whole life turned upside down when he stumbles upon the "Guilty Hole." He thinks it's a dream when he sees the student's shoe lockers have been transformed into selection panels... seeing one that catches his eye, he joking picks her... When she appears in his classroom in the middle of the night, throwing insults at him, but her eyes seem to linger on him, tinged with embarassment. "I'll finish this quickly so... Don't hold back, ok...?" Thus begins a forbidden relationship... Welcome to the Guilty Hole, where anything is allowed--

Entries.Title: The New Chronicles of Extraordinary Beings: Preface
Entries.Description: Hao Ren was a typical young man from a small city who was barely making ends meet while living in an old house. However, via a strange turn of events, he becomes a "universe police officer." A problem is developing in his domain, the Dream Plane Universe, as he struggles to oversee a home inhabited by strange, non-human residents that his enigmatic superiors have assigned him.

Entries.Title: Oh My God... Yes! A Series of Extremely Relatable Circumstances
Entries.Description: Follow three women – Sunny, Tulip, and Ladi – who live in the not-so-distant future of South Central LA as they navigate womanhood in an unpredictable, tech-driven world.

Episodes.Title: you fools!
Episodes.Description: Sunny and Tulip clash on how to parent a giant demon baby while Ladi is hell bent on destroying it.

Episodes.Title: fieh
Episodes.Description: After being dumped, Tulip rebounds with a rapping spider. Sunny and Ladi try to convince her that her new arachnid boyfriend is bad news.

Episodes.Title: like literally eat them?
Episodes.Description: Accompanied by a Man Tiger, the girls are chased through South Central by a cult of outdated bots who believe their destiny is to eat the rich.

Episodes.Title: steel ball sounds like a very dangerous game
Episodes.Description: SteelBall champ Jicheal Mordan wants to have a baby with Sunny and bankroll her life. Now if only she can remember where she put her uterus ...

Episodes.Title: 23 and me and me and me and me and me
Episodes.Description: Things go awry when Sunny attempts to produce a "better" Jamal over and over... and over again.

Episodes.Title: a beast a broad and a baker whose name is warrenmacytom
Episodes.Description: While Sunny spirals about getting older, Tulip seeks closure in all the wrong places until Ladi takes control.

Episodes.Title: or i'll give you something to cry about
Episodes.Description: The girls discover an ominous DO NOT TOUCH button in the Pixel Bar that, when pressed, ignites a series of very strange encounters.

Entries.Title: Welcome to Magical Girl Village (illegally occupied)
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Swallowing the Heavens
Entries.Description: The Legendary Transformation of Young Wu Yu from a Mortal to an Immortal and Buddha.

Entries.Title: Goldie
Entries.Description: Follow Goldie as she shakes up her beloved town of Boysenberg with her best friends. Together, they learn that being different is something to celebrate—and it's a whole lot of fun.

Episodes.Title: Giant Surprise / Stuck
Episodes.Description: Goldie tries to find the perfect present for Teeny. Goldie's friends band together to help her out of a sticky situation.

Episodes.Title: Tall Teeny / Pilroy
Episodes.Description: Realizing she's too short for rides at the fair, Teeny tries to grow taller. Petey's imaginary friend goes missing.

Episodes.Title: The Hiding Spot / Frand or Foe
Episodes.Description: Goldie struggles to play hide-and-seek like her friends. When she can't fit inside Teeny's house for a sleepover, Goldie gets creative.

Episodes.Title: Birds of a Feather / Mayor Teeny
Episodes.Description: Goldie works hard to find a best friend for everyone. Teeny steps into an important job for the day.

Episodes.Title: Li'l Cutie / Boysenween
Episodes.Description: Inspired by Teeny's cat adoption, Goldie looks for a pet of her own. Goldie makes a costume for a magical springtime holiday.

Episodes.Title: Damage Control / Petey the Stargazer
Episodes.Description: Mrs. Petunia searches for a new home. When Petey stops believing in aliens, Goldie tries to reignite the magic.

Episodes.Title: The Choir / The Egg
Episodes.Description: Goldie joins the choir but worries she's too loud. Upon finding an egg in her nest, Goldie does her best to care for it.

Episodes.Title: Super Goldie / A Mammoth Friend
Episodes.Description: Goldie flies into action as her new heroic persona. A cuddly pal shares the same big feelings as Goldie.

Episodes.Title: Teeny Ball / A Crushing Nightmare
Episodes.Description: Teeny creates a game — but it might just have too many rules. Goldie has a nightmare and faces a new fear.

Episodes.Title: Goldie on a Roll / Big Time Trouble
Episodes.Description: Goldie's friends team up to build a giant pair of roller skates. Goldie travels back in time to undo an embarrassing moment.

Episodes.Title: My Fair Goldie / Flying Solo
Episodes.Description: As the mayor's dinner party approaches, Goldie worries she isn't fancy enough. Goldie struggles to take care of herself while Romeo is away.

Episodes.Title: Goldie's Tooth / Wooly's News
Episodes.Description: The tooth fairy leaves Goldie a special surprise. Goldie feels sad when Wooly shares tough news.

Episodes.Title: Earworm / The First Snow
Episodes.Description: Goldie and Romeo write a catchy new tune that sweeps Boysenberg. A frosty surprise sparks major excitement.

Entries.Title: Mermicorno: Starfall
Entries.Description: In a fantastical and magical undersea world, where a team of Mermicorno (enchanting half-Unicorno/half-fish creatures) join together to save the ocean from the threat of the evil Ika Inkblot.

Episodes.Title: Mission Mermicorno
Episodes.Description: Astra, a winged mermaid-unicorn known as a "Mermicorno," sets out on an adventure to find her missing sister.

Episodes.Title: Entrenched
Episodes.Description: To get information on Pearl Girl, Astra strikes a risky deal with a powerful fish ... but gets more than she bargained for.

Episodes.Title: Ghost Town
Episodes.Description: After the Mermicornos stumble across an eerie Ghost Town, a shocking surprise is revealed about Gwen's past ... and present.

Episodes.Title: Dance, Magic, Dance!
Episodes.Description: Forced to take refuge in the Creepy Kelp Forest, the Mermicornos find themselves at the mercy of the mischievous Water Sprites.

Episodes.Title: Practice Makes Perfect
Episodes.Description: The Mermicornos try to level up their powers in a magical training shell, but Astra's obsession with perfection puts them all in danger.

Episodes.Title: When You Squish Upon a Star
Episodes.Description: When Squishella is given the dream opportunity to become a pop star, she learns that fame comes at a cost.

Episodes.Title: Ocean's Five
Episodes.Description: The Mermicornos plan a heist to recover a Mermicorno artifact, but Kameko starts to doubt her value without powers of her own.

Episodes.Title: Epic Fail
Episodes.Description: When Astra crafts a faulty Talisman, Squishella and Gwen are placed in a situation that hits too close for comfort.

Episodes.Title: A Song of Ice and Fire Noodles
Episodes.Description: After losing her ice powers from eating spicy ramen, Gwen takes desperate measures to get them back.

Episodes.Title: As You Squish
Episodes.Description: A town of seahorses mistakes Squishella as their fabled hero, which she fully embraces.

Episodes.Title: Fin-Loose
Episodes.Description: The Mermicornos meet a community of fish who have banned dancing, but Nautique shakes things up by teaching some moves to a rebellious kid.

Episodes.Title: Underwater Pressure
Episodes.Description: The Mermicornos encounter a creature that plays on their anxieties, while Sawtooth attempts to drain the last fallen star.

Episodes.Title: Total Eclipse of My Heart
Episodes.Description: The Mermicornos daringly attempt to rescue Pearl Girl from Ika Inkblot's lair ... but not everything goes according to plan.

Episodes.Title: Aftershocks
Episodes.Description: As Astra struggles with the events of the Lunar Eclipse, Sawtooth wrestles over new insight from his past.

Episodes.Title: Two Player Game
Episodes.Description: To obtain a relic that could lead to the Mermicorno Kingdom, Astra and Gwen journey into a secret vault under the Pearl Palace.

Episodes.Title: Special Delivery
Episodes.Description: Kameko sets out to find her dad, while Nautique recounts his life post-Starfall with Squishella.

Episodes.Title: Singer Wrong Writer
Episodes.Description: While Ika begins training Dark Pearl, Squishella enters a talent show -- but her determination to win has monstrous consequences.

Episodes.Title: Turtle Recall
Episodes.Description: After discovering she's part of a secret society of turtles, Kameko starts to wonder where she belongs when she doesn't fit in.

Episodes.Title: The Masked Ice-Venger
Episodes.Description: When the Mermicornos find a community of fish being bullied, Gwen takes matters into her own hooves.

Episodes.Title: Memories of a Mermicorno
Episodes.Description: The Mermicornos finally make it to the Mermicorno Kingdom ... but new revelations threaten to change the Mermi-Crew forever.

Episodes.Title: No Place Like Home
Episodes.Description: The Mermi-Crew set out in search of Valentina ... but soon realize that while finding her is easy, getting her to leave is hard.

Episodes.Title: Kraken Down
Episodes.Description: Astra adopts a laid-back persona to impress Rip Tide and Sunsprite. Meanwhile, Squishella's jealousy leads to magical mayhem.

Episodes.Title: Song of Sawtooth
Episodes.Description: After discovering his creative side, Sawtooth must decide if he's a Hench-Shark or a Mermicorno.

Episodes.Title: Gill-ty As Charged
Episodes.Description: As the Mermi-Crew readies to face Ika again, they're met with a surprise that may help their mission ... or cause them to fail entirely.

Episodes.Title: A Sea of Stars (1)
Episodes.Description: A cruel deception forces Astra to devise a risky plan to save the Mermicornos from being further torn apart.

Episodes.Title: A Sea of Stars (2)
Episodes.Description: In the final battle, the Mermi-Crew must come together -- or risk losing the ocean as they know it forever.

Entries.Title: Haunted Hotel
Entries.Description: After inheriting a hotel from her late brother, a single mom moves in with his good-natured ghost — and high-maintenance guests who will never check out.

Entries.Title: The Ruins of Kunlun Linglong
Entries.Description: It tells a story based on the worldview of the ancient Chinese strange book Shan Hai Jing, showing the bond that transcends time between the two male protagonists, Xiaoyu and his master Tianyi.

Entries.Title: Super Team Canada
Entries.Description: Six little-known Canadian superheroes try to save the world from evil giant robots, an unemployed octopus and needy hardware store clerks. The stakes are high for the stereotypically underdog Canadian super-unknowns, who are called in as Earth’s last resort when all other superheroes have been destroyed.

Episodes.Title: And So It Begins... / Do you mind if we continue?
Episodes.Description: After an evil alien kills Earth's powerful superheroes, the world leaders are forced to enlist some lower-tier Canadian superheroes.

Episodes.Title: The Boys from Brantford / Patch Me if you Can
Episodes.Description: A demented hockey coach creates an army of deadly clones to destroy the NHL, but S.T.C. has a few things to S.A.Y. about that.

Episodes.Title: Who Wants To Kill a Windmillionaire? / P.E.(a)I.
Episodes.Description: S.T.C is invited to a convention, but learns it's a trap sprung by a man intent on killing Bryan Adams. We didn't say it was a great plan.

Episodes.Title: Wed on Arrival / Brine Never Pays
Episodes.Description: A pushy alien wedding planner takes over Earth for a destination wedding.

Episodes.Title: Shy Noon / High School Abuse-ical
Episodes.Description: A super shy villain takes over gravity - is Super Team Canada up (or down?) for the challenge?

Episodes.Title: The Pooch Pack Goes Wack / Permission Impossible
Episodes.Description: Canada's favorite cheap children's cartoon crime-solving dogs get turned into giant monsters. A tale as old as time.

Episodes.Title: From Dork To Dawn / Polite Raiders of The Lost Temple of Doom
Episodes.Description: Breakaway falls under the spell of a charming misogynist who is also a charming monster.

Episodes.Title: One Hit Blunder / Careful What You Task For
Episodes.Description: Super Team Canada wins a worldwide singing competition then has to fix the chaos that causes.

Episodes.Title: A Sticky Situation / Back to the Present
Episodes.Description:
A secret race of Pancake People plans to steal Canada's secret maple syrup reserves and kill the world leaders.

When a rock that controls time gets in the hands of S.T.C., they unwittingly unleash multiple pasts and futures. None of them good.

Episodes.Title: Uh Oh! / Uh Oh 2: The Heretic
Episodes.Description:
S.T.C. is invited to an awards show celebrating them. However, they learn that this show and the free buffet may not be all they seem. Then they die.

The dead Super Team Canada literally makes a deal with the Devil, but not that one, to return and save the day.

Entries.Title: Hero Without a Class: Who Even Needs Skills?!
Entries.Description: In this world a goddess bestows each person with a class and skills that will determine one's life direction.
