Despite being born the son of a Sword Princess and an Archmage, Arel has not received a class or skills. So, Arel must rely on his own grit, determination and natural talents to pursue and achieve greatness—becoming a new kind of hero. A hero without a class!

Entries.Title: The Weasy Family
Entries.Description: Foster father of two darling little twin ducklings, Weasy has decided to raise them as good weasels - loving burglaries, crazy games, wild challenges and the Art of taking it easy in life. But don’t be fooled – all this doesn’t just happen at random! There are principles and a moral code to be respected!

Entries.Title: 小仙之遥
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: A Star Brighter Than the Sun
Entries.Description: Sae and Kōki have been friends since childhood. One fateful day at the end of middle school, she has a revelation: Kōki has grown up! Now they're in high school, and she has another revelation: she has feelings for Kōki! But Sae isn't the only girl who does… The question is, who does Kōki have feelings for?!

Entries.Title: Ninjago Legends: Monstrosity
Entries.Description: After ‘the Merge,’ Kai finds himself in the dark and dangerous Land of Monsters. Surrounded by terrifying creatures, he’s not just looking for his friends—he’s fighting to survive! As his journey unfolds, Kai uncovers shocking secrets and realizes he’s not alone in this twisted world. What secrets lie hidden in the shadows?

Entries.Title: May I Ask for One Final Thing?
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Mighty Nein
Entries.Description: When a powerful arcane relic known as "The Beacon" falls into dangerous hands, a group of fugitives and outcasts, bound by secrets and scars, must learn to work together to save the realm and stop reality itself from unraveling.

Entries.Title: In the Name of Ying Tai
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Splinter Cell: Deathwatch
Entries.Description: Legendary agent Sam Fisher is drawn back into the field when a wounded young operative seeks out his help.

Entries.Title: I am the Blade
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Super Duper Bunny League
Entries.Description: A team of bunnies turned superheroes is ready to battle danger in all its forms as they defend Important City from their archnemesis (and accidental creator), the inept Dr. Fuzzleglove and a ridiculous rogues' gallery of cartoony villains.

Episodes.Title: Super Duper Bunnies!
Episodes.Description: The origin story of how these seemingly ordinary bunnies become the Super Duper Bunny League.

Episodes.Title: Chocolate Bunnies!
Episodes.Description: Dr. Annabelle saves Easter from an evil villain with a chocolate chip on his shoulder.

Entries.Title: GINTAMA - Mr. Ginpachi's Zany Class
Entries.Description: Announced at the "Gintama Ato no Matsuri 2023" event: an anime adaptation of a light novel spin-off series of Gintama. The storyline revolves around class 3-Z's students and their wacky homeroom teacher Ginpachi-sensei.

Entries.Title: Neko Konogoro: Country Unification Arc
Entries.Description: Follows Nekotarou, a cat from Kagoshima who aims to unify the country.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Follows Nekotarou, a cat from Kagoshima who aims to unify the country.

Entries.Title: Nmeneko
Entries.Description: Follows the funny and amusing daily lives of two cats who want to live life doing only fun things.

Entries.Title: SANDA
Entries.Description: Set in a future with a declining birth rate, SANDA follows a boy named Sanda who finds out his classmate, Shiori Fuyumura, plans to kill him because of a "curse" he carries and Fuyumura's missing friend.

Entries.Title: Tatsuki Fujimoto 17-26
Entries.Description: Six studios and seven directors adapt the early works of Tatsuki Fujimoto, the mastermind behind "Chainsaw Man," into an anime anthology. Each episode is an anime adaptation of a short story he drew from ages seventeen to twenty-six, including the first manga he ever submitted for competition. Watch as vivid tales of young love, chaos, madness, and the bonds between people unfold in each episode.

Episodes.Title: A Couple Clucking Chickens Were Still Kickin’ in the Schoolyard
Episodes.Description: A tale of two survivors' bond in a post-apocalyptic world.

Episodes.Title: Sasaki Stopped a Bullet
Episodes.Description: A story that explores the intense emotions of adolescence.

Episodes.Title: Love Is Blind
Episodes.Description: A sci-fi romantic comedy about love on a cosmic scale.

Episodes.Title: Shikaku
Episodes.Description: A twisted love story of an unhinged assassin girl.

Episodes.Title: Mermaid Rhapsody
Episodes.Description: A touching romance between a boy and a mermaid centered around an underwater piano.

Episodes.Title: Woke-Up-as-a-Girl Syndrome
Episodes.Description: A story about finding one's true self beyond gender norms.

Episodes.Title: Nayuta of the Prophecy
Episodes.Description: Depicts the journey of siblings bound by a harsh destiny.

Episodes.Title: Sisters
Episodes.Description: Depicts the rivalry, conflict, and growth between artistically inclined sisters.

Entries.Title: GoWest: Overworked
Entries.Description: Fifty years ago, the world was suddenly invaded by "Hundun". Murong Qiong founded the Demon Sect, but was still unable to defeat "Hundun". God Messenger Yi Zhihua came and taught them the demonization skill, helping them defeat "Hundun". After God Messenger left, the demonization skill was out of control. Murong Qiong felt disappointed and retired. His subordinate Yu Huabing took the opportunity to take over his position and improved the skill, creating an egoistic era full of primordial Qi, thus a prosperous world of martial arts. However, the consequence is that all martial artists have become "overworked monsters". A young ambitious man named Dongfang Sheng finds Murong Qiong in GoWest restaurant, and wants him to restore the glory of the world of martial arts. This is the start of the funny story.

Entries.Title: 呼噜噜幻影队
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: A Gatherer's Adventure in Isekai
Entries.Description: Kamishiro Takeru is a completely ordinary salaryman who reincarnates in another world—a world of swords and magic called Madeus—and starts his new isekai life with lots of new skills! Takeru must make the most of his enhanced physical strength, unbelievable magic power, and the "Search" ability that allows him to find items of worth as his great isekai journey begins!

Entries.Title: Divine love Deep blue
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Momentary Lily
Entries.Description: Robotic invaders wiped out all life, but Renge fights to survive using her powers. With no memories, she roams the city until she meets five other young women, each with unique abilities. Together, they make the most of their lives, cooking delicious meals between battles with mechanical monstrosities. As they uncover the secrets of their powers and pasts, they find strength in their friendship.

Episodes.Title: Saury Hitsumabushi After the Loneliness
Episodes.Description: In a lonely city where all the inhabitants have been erased by mysterious machines, Renge encounters a team of girls who have been fighting the machines. She cooks them a meal.

Episodes.Title: Canned Mackerel Italian-style Tomato Hot Pot Together
Episodes.Description: Now that Renge has joined the group's ranks with her powerful weapon, Yuri feels capable of confronting the Goliath, a huge machine, and continuing to advance.

Episodes.Title: Unforgettable Canned Crab and Canned Mackerel Chirashi Sushi
Episodes.Description: With Yuri having passed away, the team must decide what to do next. The photos being posted on social media may offer a clue.

Episodes.Title: Rich and Warm Corn Beef Miso Ramen
Episodes.Description: A sudden snowstorm forces the girls to take refuge in a school.

Episodes.Title: Wishing On Mackerel, Oyster, and Egg Zosui Soup Kuzushi Kiritampo Style
Episodes.Description: The relationship between Erika and Hinageshi becomes strained. A duel between the big sister and the gamer begins.

Episodes.Title: Pool Videos, Summer and Shanghai-style Squid Yakisoba
Episodes.Description: The team makes videos by the pool to prove on social media that they are humans.

Episodes.Title: Fighting Together for Shio Musubi
Episodes.Description: The team fights a large group of Wild Hunt threatening what appears to be Citron's group.

Episodes.Title: Chocolate Bars Once the Rain Stops
Episodes.Description: Renge meets Suzuran and discovers that she may not be who -- or what -- she thinks she is.

Episodes.Title: Laughed All Night and Put Lots of Secret Ingredients in a Surprisingly Tasty Curry
Episodes.Description: Suzuran's group prepares to move to Citron's settlement.

Episodes.Title: One More and a Missing Can
Episodes.Description: The team chase Yuri into a station and discover more than they can wrap their head around.

Episodes.Title: Cooking Together With the Untouchable Girl
Episodes.Description: Hinageshi hacks the facility's AI, forcing it to explain its role.

Episodes.Title: Such A Fun Full-Course Meal
Episodes.Description: Balor approaches. It's up to the copies -- and Renge -- to protect the survivors.

Episodes.Title: Ending on an Ochazuke Buffet with Everyone Around
Episodes.Description: The girls continued their fierce battle in "Everyone's Ochazuke Buffet."

Entries.Title: Martial God's Supreme Peak
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: 果茶蜜探
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Wonderblocks
Entries.Description: Follow Wonderblocks Go and Stop, and a whole host of lovable characters, as they learn to think for themselves and work together to solve any problem that comes their way.

Episodes.Title: Go
Episodes.Description: Wonderblock Go gets everything and everyone moving in Wonderland! It's noisy, exciting fun. However, things start to go wrong quickly until Wonderblock Stop arrives.

Episodes.Title: Stop
Episodes.Description: Wonderblock Stop is Go's new best friend! She loves to think things through. Stop shows her new friends how taking a moment to reflect can help solve all sorts of problems.

Episodes.Title: Hop
Episodes.Description: Go and Stop meet Little Frog and a Do Block called Hop. Go, Hop and Stop discover a new magic that helps Little Frog hop to new heights.

Episodes.Title: Moo!
Episodes.Description: It's Cow's big moment in the concert, but she just can't moo at the right time. Go, Stop and Do Block Moo help Cow get her confidence back just in time for the show.

Episodes.Title: Cluck!
Episodes.Description: Secret Agent Chicken is on a mission to get into the hen house, but she doesn't have the right password. Can Go, Stop and Cluck help her crack it in time?

Episodes.Title: Mooving Up
Episodes.Description: Cow's dinner is stuck in the hayloft! Can Stop and Go help her reach her meal?

Episodes.Title: Splat!
Episodes.Description: The Wonderblocks help Arty figure out how to make the perfect pattern for Toad.

Episodes.Title: The Breakfast Bears
Episodes.Description: The Three Bears are making a mess of their breakfast. Can the Wonderblocks help?

Episodes.Title: Moo! Cluck! Baa!
Episodes.Description: Cow, Sheep and Secret Agent Chicken take part in a musical contest.

Episodes.Title: Dancefloor Delight
Episodes.Description: The Wonderblocks help Arty hop in different directions to light up the disco floor!

Episodes.Title: Step by Stepping Stone
Episodes.Description: The Wonderblocks help Arty figure out the right directions to cross some stepping stones.

Episodes.Title: Rainy Day Bears
Episodes.Description: The Wonderblocks help the Three Bears get ready for some rainy day fun!

Episodes.Title: Tower of Flowers
Episodes.Description: Go wants to surprise Toad with a colourful pattern tower, but she needs Arty's help.

Episodes.Title: Building Sandcastles
Episodes.Description: The Three Bears are having trouble building sandcastles!

Episodes.Title: First Things First
Episodes.Description: Sing along with Go and Stop as they get ready for a picnic.

Episodes.Title: What Can We Do?
Episodes.Description: Everyone’s arriving for a special movie. Projectionist Secret Agent Chicken thinks she can make film night even better, but she doesn’t realise the audience have arrived and are waiting for her to start the movie. Go and Stop try to get her attention with the help of Cow and the Do Blocks. Just when it seems like no one is able to help, Go and Stop notice Slide Do Block in the audience. Can sliding the door get them into Secret Agent Chicken’s projection room?

Episodes.Title: Woodland Wiggle
Episodes.Description: Cow discovers Go and Stop disco dancing in the forest. She loves their moves and wants to learn how to do them, but she doesn’t think she’ll be able to wiggle, spin and clap in time to the music. There’s too much to remember. Go and Stop realise that Cow needs to master each dance move separately before she can make all the actions fit the beat.

Episodes.Title: Magic Beans
Episodes.Description: Go and Stop are in the garden tending to the plants. Do Blocks Grow Stem, Grow Leaf and Grow Flower arrive with some magic beans. If they do Wonder Magic with the Do Blocks, how will the magic bean plants look? Go is delighted to discover that changing the order of the magic makes the plants look very different. However, Stop is more keen to make the beans grow into normal shapes.

Episodes.Title: Musical Bears
Episodes.Description: The band are supposed to be performing at the bandstand tonight, but they have fallen ill. Luckily, the Three Bears are happy to step in for them. There’s just one problem... they don’t know how to play the instruments! Which of the drum, double bass and the trumpet do they strum, blow and bash? Go and Stop realise that they need the aid of the Do Blocks to solve this problem.

Episodes.Title: Sounds Like a Plan
Episodes.Description: Cow thinks that Go and Stop have planned a birthday party for her. They are too polite to tell her that this is not the case! How can Go and Stop give Cow a party to remember when there is so little time to organise it?

Episodes.Title: Top Secret Holiday Hideout Plan
Episodes.Description: When visiting Secret Agent Chicken at the barn, Go and Stop discover that she has a special mission for them. She gives Go and Stop a map to help them get to her secret hideout. Meanwhile, she is off on a different mission and leaves them to work things out on their own.

Episodes.Title: Someone's Been Eating My Porridge
Episodes.Description: There’s a problem to be solved at the Three Bears’ house. Someone has eaten Little Bear’s Porridge! Go and Stop decide to investigate. Going into full detective mode, they interview the three suspects: the bears themselves.

Episodes.Title: Here We Go Again
Episodes.Description: Toad is late for a meeting because he cannot get his rail cart to move fast enough to reach the station. Go, Stop and Do Block Push come to his aid. Unfortunately, progress is very slow, even though their Wonder Magic makes the rail cart move. It is only when Again joins them that they discover a way to get the rail cart to move fast enough for Toad to reach his destination in time.

Episodes.Title: It's Wonderful What You Can Do

Entries.Title: Tojima Wants to Be a Kamen Rider
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: This Monster Wants to Eat Me
Entries.Description: Hinako, a high school student with a dark past, lives alone in a town by the sea. Haunted by a constant sensation of drowning, she can barely go through the motions of her tedious life…until the day a monster tries to eat her! After passing out in the struggle, she awakens to find she's been rescued by a beautiful mermaid. However, salvation comes at a cost—the mermaid's protection will last only until Hinako has matured into the perfect meal! Hinako's first instinct isn't to run or scream, though, and an unlikely relationship between monster and prey unfolds… "I've come to devour you."

Entries.Title: Gabriel and the Guardians
Entries.Description: It follows Gabriel, a Celestial Guardian in the mythical world of Ara who is tasked with protecting the Tree Eternal — even as his companions falter, Gabriel stays true to his mission and never loses hope through this story of identity, rebellion, faith and redemption.

Episodes.Title: Palizha'ah! (invasion!)
Episodes.Description: Gabriel, the celestial guardian of Parah’dem, confronts an unexpected invasion when a chaos giant threatens the sacred realm. Meanwhile, in the mortal world, Nok, a hunter, fights for survival, and Namay’ah, a determined princess, seeks divine intervention. As their destinies intertwine, the battle to protect light and order unfolds, testing their strength and purpose in ways they never imagined.

Entries.Title: Wandance
Entries.Description: Kaboku has always just gone with the flow, marching in step to the drumbeat of the expectations of those around him: parents, school, plans for the future. It feels predictable, safe, and… empty. But one night, Kaboku's at school late, and he happens on a girl alone, moving wildly, turning a blank space of concrete into a canvas. This is Hikari Wanda, a member of the hip-hop dance club. Kaboku is immediately smitten, but the road to stepping out of his shell is a long one. The club is almost entirely girls, and they're all, well, way better than him. What's ahead is unknown, and that's terrifying, but it also means, for the first time in Kaboku's life… a taste of freedom.

Entries.Title: Pyramid Game
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Not a Box
Entries.Description: Get creative with bright-eyed bunny Riley! With just one cardboard box, Riley imagines magical worlds full of new friends and fantastic adventures.

Episodes.Title: It's a Boat / It's a Mountain
Episodes.Description: Powered by imagination, Riley sails away to help a pizza-loving sea creature make friends. Riley invents a mountain in the hopes of kissing a cloud.

Episodes.Title: It's an Egg / It's a Pumpkin
Episodes.Description: After a baby dinosaur hatches, Riley uses her imagination to teach it how to play games. Riley gets creative to grow the biggest pumpkin ever.

Episodes.Title: It's a Castle / It's a Plane
Episodes.Description: Adventurous Riley embarks on a magical quest to become a knight. Soaring above, Riley tries to keep up with a group of pinky-pink birds.

Episodes.Title: It's a Fly-in-the-Sky Balloon / It's a Piano
Episodes.Description: Riley takes flight and imagines surprising ways to cool off Sunny, the sun, on a very hot day. Riley searches for silly sounds to make music.

Episodes.Title: It's a Choo-Choo Train / It's a Treasure Chest
Episodes.Description: On a railway adventure, Riley gathers bananas for an unexpected baking project. Riley heads to the beach to collect beloved keepsakes.

Episodes.Title: It's a Comet / It's a Cowboy Hat
Episodes.Description: Riley blasts off on a mission to dunk a cookie in a moon river. Cowboy Riley saddles up to chase down a balloon bandit.

Episodes.Title: It's a Bed / It's a Submarine
Episodes.Description: A not-so-sleepy Riley tries to befriend an under-the-bed monster. Riley journeys down the drain to reunite with lost bath toys.

Episodes.Title: It's a Spaceship / It's a Present
Episodes.Description: Riley zooms away to a distant planet and meets a cute space alien. Riley's birthday inspires an amazing party full of surprises.

Entries.Title: DIGIMON BEATBREAK
Entries.Description: "e-Pulse," which is generated by human thoughts and emotions, was used as the energy source for the AI support device "Sapotama." From the shadows of this remarkable development, terrifying monsters appear. Digimon are living beings that evolve by consuming e-Pulse. Tomoro Tenma is drawn into an extraordinary experience after meeting Gekkomon, who suddenly appears from his Sapotama. While living together with Kyo Sawashiro and other members of the bounty hunting team "Golden Dawn," Tomoro renews his resolve. What new future will be forged by humans and Digimon?

Entries.Title: The Dangerous Convenience Store
Entries.Description: A timid clerk working night shifts under gangster threats finds unexpected comfort in a mysterious man—who buys one thing he’ll never forget.

Entries.Title: Yano-kun's Ordinary Days
Entries.Description: Yoshida is the chairman of the class and she is always worried. Her biggest worry these days is that Yano, who is in her class, comes to school every day with a serious injury. She can't take her eyes off Yano, who is injured in every possible way! She can't wait to help him!

Entries.Title: Shukan Ranobe Anime
Entries.Description: Light-novel Anime will present new stories in five-minute episodes, penned by big names from the world of light novels. The episodes will also be produced in landscape format and aired as "Weekly Light Novel Anime" starting July 12.

Entries.Title: Tim Rex in Space
Entries.Description: Follow a T-Rex named Tim, his big brother Tommy, little sister Tia, and triceratops bestie Kai as they tackle kid-shaped adventures with dino-sized solutions in space.

Entries.Title: 钢炽之芯
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Shattering the Galaxy
Entries.Description: Seeking his parents, the mountain youth Jiang Han embarks on a journey of cultivation. He accidentally activates the Celestial Beast Cauldron, a legacy left by his mother, and awakens supreme magical powers! From then on, he defies fate and changes his destiny. He battles heaven and earth. On the battlefield where the gods fell, he fights bloody battles against countless races, carving a path to the heavens with his mortal body! He vows to fight for a bright future for humanity.

Entries.Title: 二十四节气密码
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: 反派初始化 动态漫
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Li'l Miss Vampire Can't Suck Right
Entries.Description: Luna Ishikawa is a dark and mysterious vampire—or so she'd like her new classmates to believe. The truth is, while she may be one of the not-so-mythical bloodsuckers, she doesn't really live up to the hype. She's short and clumsy, and she can't even suck blood properly! So when her classmate Tatsuta Ootori discovers her little “drinking problem,” he can't help but lend a hand. Can he nurse Luna from the small, timid animal she is into a fearsome creature of the night?!

Entries.Title: Kill Lupercal
Entries.Description: Set in the siege of Terra itself, Kill Lupercal follows a Warlord Titan and its crew as they seek to end the war for the Throneworld in a single devastating blow.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: As the Siege of Terra rages, a group of Loyalist Titans attempt to hunt down and eliminate the Arch-Traitor, the Warmaster Horus, in the first episode of this new three-part original Warhammer animation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Princeps Gemnon and Aurora Ferrum take a gamble on glory – but will unforeseen resistance put an early end to their mission?

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Keeso and Gemnon lead the charge on the traitorous Warmaster's position. The risk is great, but the reward could mean salvation for the Emperor's forces – if all is as it seems.

Entries.Title: Guys Next Door
Entries.Description: It’s mind-bending meta-metaphysical mayhem meets a soulful comedic meditation on the zeitgeist —where secret agents, techno-future-post-pre-humanistic science, and modern-day existential angst collide and create a new future for us -- and you!

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: Three normies team up with three government assassins to survive and triumph in the dangerous wacky world of espionage, biohacking, and global conspiracy while asking the question: what is life about?

Entries.Title: Fengwu Demon Chef
Entries.Description: The foodie universe based on the Classic of Mountains and Seas will lead you into the world of the Demon Chef on a fantasy journey.

Entries.Title: Let's Play
Entries.Description: Samara “Sam” Young is a developer in Los Angeles who's about to achieve her dreams with her first video game, Ruminate. That is, until a popular streamer gives the game a scathing review. Even worse, Sam finds out the troublesome critic is now her new neighbor!

Entries.Title: Alma-chan Wants to Be a Family!
Entries.Description: A body that combines the appearance of an adorable young girl with overwhelming combat efficiency. An AI with intelligence and decision-making skills that surpass human capabilities—the perfect autonomous robot, "Alma" was created by the overlooked young genius scientists Enji and Suzume whose brilliance should've been recognized by the world! Alma calls Enji and Suzume "Father" and "Mother" which leaves them completely flustered. Regardless, the three begin a life together as a family in order to nurture Alma's powerful AI and help her evolve into the ultimate robot. Alma's curiosity has no limits as everything she sees and touches is new to her. Alma keeps Enji and Suzume on their toes with her unmatched learning capabilities and unstoppable energy as she explores the bigger world. A brand-new kind of family comedy (?!) begins!!

Entries.Title: Knights of Guinevere
Entries.Description: In a global sky-park, two dreamers pin their hopes on a damaged Princess Android - their possible salvation or doom. A psychological thriller between the clouds and lurking shadows below.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: The first episode of Knights of Guinevere.

Entries.Title: Xuanyuan Xiaodou: The legend of mountains and rivers
Entries.Description: The little human girl Xuanyuan Xiaodou transforms into a beautiful fairy girl with oriental style. With the guidance of the ancient messenger Bai Ze, she fights against Queen of the darkmoon  who stole the "Shanhai Scroll: Dragon Son Fragment" and saves the world!

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: A girl from earth named "Xuanyuan Xiaodou" wishes to become a magical fairy girl. She found a cat witch is named Baize who just fought with queen Youyue who stole then Shanhai Jing from the Shanhai gate. That marks the beginning of Baize and Xiaodou's destiny

Episodes.Title: Episode 31
Episodes.Description: Fu Feng's painful past is showing!! He is actually betraying the queen of the moon!! He has to claimed to The queen of the dark moon the He's Secretly helping Xiaodou! His hope led to her and now he's being punished by the queen?? Can Xiaodou save him??

Entries.Title: RoboForce: The Animated Series
Entries.Description: In 2089 Detroit, RoboForce is obsolete and has no hope of becoming heroes. That is until a mysterious code virus infects the UA101 bots, and no one besides RoboForce can stop them.

Episodes.Title: Rebooted, Rewired, and Ready to Go
Episodes.Description: Years after the elite and incorruptible RoboForce was made obsolete, the bots are called to back duty when their replacements turn on humanity.

Episodes.Title: Way Down Below
Episodes.Description: RoboForce finds a long-lost friend at the bottom of the ocean along with a clue that brings them closer to unmasking the leader of the Bot Uprising.

Episodes.Title: The Search for S.O.T.A
Episodes.Description: While looking for a friend from the past, the cracks in RoboForce become too big to ignore.

Episodes.Title: Journey to the Center of Maxx
Episodes.Description: With the help of S.O.T.A 64, RoboForce must save Maxx 89 from a rogue virus, while a twisted and powerful Bot from the past is resurrected.

Episodes.Title: To Break These Earthly Bounds
Episodes.Description: RoboForce clash with evil Bots and face Detonator, an army-killing machine, as they are forced to choose a side.

Episodes.Title: Today Detroit, Tomorrow the World
Episodes.Description: Taking their battle to space, RoboForce tries to end the Bot Uprising, while unlikely friendships begin to blossom.

Entries.Title: 喜羊羊与灰太狼之奇侠大营救
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: A Wild Last Boss Appeared!
Entries.Description: The year is 2800 and Lufas Maphaahl—The Black-Winged Tyrant, Great Conqueror, and leader of the Twelve Heavenly Stars—has returned. A man wakes up in the body of his MMO character 200 years after her defeat during an player-made event in the game, Exgate Online. Now, he's stuck in her body. But this isn't a game, it's real. With her reign long over, and her legacy one of fear, Lufas must journey through the world of Exgate, looking for answers, possible comrades, and all the monsters her "death" unleashed upon the world...

Entries.Title: Transformers: CYBERWORLD
Entries.Description: The Autobots and Decepticons find themselves pulled by an unknown mastermind into the virtual realm of Cyberworld. Forced to compete in challenges to earn energon and gain strength, the trapped Transformers must battle the elements and each other to try and survive long enough to figure out who's behind it all.

Episodes.Title: Commence Program
Episodes.Description: Optimus Prime finds himself tumbling headfirst onto a strange and hostile alien planet. His attempts to discover more about his surroundings are met with violent onslaughts from the monstrous Scorponok and the fearsome Grimlock, who chases Optimus through the Jungle.

Episodes.Title: Prime Target
Episodes.Description: Bumblebee battles Megatron in a target shooting challenge while Optimus Prime races through the jungle, away from Grimlock, to reach his old friend.

Episodes.Title: Crate Point, Well Fought
Episodes.Description: After Bumblebee is wounded by Megatron, he and Optimus Prime race to a mysterious crate drop that could provide them with powerful upgrades. But they're not the only ones! Grimlock and Snarl are after the loot themselves - will Optimus and Bumblebee get there first?

Episodes.Title: River Race Ruckus
Episodes.Description: Optimus Prime and Bumblebee are travelling the banks of the river, in the Jungle region, when they are surprised by the arrival of Elita-1 - in the midst of a dangerous high speed race against her rival Sky-Byte. Misunderstanding the stakes, Optimus and Bumblebee force their way onto the track, disrupting the game and kicking off a fight between the hapless trio and an emboldened Sky-Byte.

Episodes.Title: Smoke & Mirrors
Episodes.Description: Optimus Prime, Bumblebee, and Elita-1 sneak into Cyber City on a covert mission for crucial intel - but the shadows hide surprises and secrets alike. Bumbebee receives a rare item drop, but things are not what they seem and not before long, the heroes are thrown into a dizzying maze of illusions.

Episodes.Title: Screamer City Arena
Episodes.Description: Get ready for the ultimate Bot Battle Royale! Optimus Prime and his team sneak into Cyber City with Mirage, but things don't go as planned. Now they are stuck in a last-bot-standing challenge against the city's most  powerful ruler! Who will survive the arena?

Episodes.Title: Hunter vs Hunted
Episodes.Description: To stand a chance against the ruthless Scorponok, Optimus Prime and the team set out to recruit the Dinobots. But things don’t go as planned and Optimus is forced into a dangerous challenge: a hunter-versus-hunted showdown with Grimlock himself!

Episodes.Title: What Goes Up
Episodes.Description: Optimus Prime and his team enter Cyberworld's toughest challenge yet: a vertical race straight up into the sky. However, Optimus comes face to face with his enemy, Megatron for the first time on Cyberworld. With both teams racing for the Energon, who will make it to the top first?

Entries.Title: Badjelly
Entries.Description: A fresh reimagining of Spike Milligan's Badjelly the Witch, the classic tale of a lost cow, a mysterious forest and a sinister sorceress. Featuring the voices of Miriam Margolyes, Rhys Darby & Rose Matafeo.

Episodes.Title: Once Upon A Time
Episodes.Description: Tim and Rose enter the Dark Forest in search of their missing cow, Lucy - setting them on a path towards the horrible witch Badjelly.

Episodes.Title: The Dark Forest
Episodes.Description: Tim and Rose meet Binklebonk, a tree goblin living in fear of The Beast of The Backwoods.

Episodes.Title: Who's Game?
Episodes.Description: The path to Mudwiggle’s ferry leads the gang through the lair of The Unfungi, a grumpy old hermit who lives in a cave full of puzzles and traps.

Episodes.Title: Shark Thursday
Episodes.Description: Mudwiggle ferries our heroes through shark infested waters - with a Dulboot in hot pursuit.

Episodes.Title: Dazed and Confuddled
Episodes.Description: Badjelly takes matters into her own hands as the gang makes their way through a field of dangerous confusalilies.

Episodes.Title: Mouse Trap
Episodes.Description: The gang are captured by Dinglemouse, a swashbuckling rodent who used to be a banana.

Episodes.Title: Pick a Path
Episodes.Description: The gang make their way through the foggy, froggy Fwomp Swamp - and Badjelly tries a new way of capturing her prey.

Episodes.Title: Separation Anxiety
Episodes.Description: Badjelly and Dulboot get a taste of what life would be like without each other, and one of them does not like it.

Episodes.Title: A Storm on Bearded Mountain
Episodes.Description: Tim and Rose get separated from their friends in a blizzard and fall prey to the evil, scheming Badjelly.

Episodes.Title: Soup for One
Episodes.Description: Tim and Rose are trapped in Badjelly’s dungeon, and Dinglemouse takes her shot at once again becoming a banana.

Episodes.Title: Giant Problems
Episodes.Description: Tim and Rose manage to escape Badjelly’s dungeon, but cannot leave without Lucy.

Episodes.Title: How Now Save Our Cow
Episodes.Description: Tim and Rose manage to free Lucy and reunite with their friends, only to be overpowered by an enraged Badjelly.

Episodes.Title: The Horridible End
Episodes.Description: The gang fight together against the evil Badjelly, in a climactic battle to save the Dark Forest once and for all.

Entries.Title: LEGO Star Wars: Rebuild the Galaxy - Pieces of the Past
Entries.Description: A new threat rises in the galaxy, and Sig Greebling and Darth Dev must combine their powers of Force Building and Sith Breaking to stop it. Alongside Jedi Bob, Yesi Scala and Servo, they will journey into the deepest corners of Lego Star Wars lore, uncovering pieces of all the galaxies that have come before.

Entries.Title: Mechanical Marie
Entries.Description: Marie, a former legendary martial artist, now conceals her identity as a human and starts working as a "robot" in the mansion of Arthur, heir to a conglomerate that despises humans. Her human identity must remain hidden—because one slip-up and she's dead! Her naturally emotionless demeanor helps her maintain her "robot" disguise and flawlessly perform her duties, all while struggling to protect Arthur from assassins sent to take his life. She lives each day on the edge with her heart racing, because Arthur is head over heels for Marie, and her human identity is nearly exposed!

Entries.Title: Marie Antoinette ni Tensei Shita node, Zenryoku de Guillotine wo Kaihi Shimasu
Entries.Description: A modern-day otaku girl wakes up in the body of Marie Antoinette. Knowing her life is on the line, she decides to user her fangirl knowledge to win over the people of France—by turning the gentleman of Versailles into history's first idol group!

Entries.Title: Minnie's Bow-Toons: Pet Hotel
Entries.Description: Minnie and Daisy embark on new adventures as they open their latest enterprise, a Pet Hotel! This paws-itively fabulous getaway is the perfect place for pets to be pampered, play, and have fun while their owners are away.

Episodes.Title: 1. Happy Barkday
Episodes.Description: Minnie and Daisy want to throw a birthday party for puppy Cream Puff, but their doggie treat decorating machine goes bananas.

Episodes.Title: 2. Puppy Pool Party
Episodes.Description: When a new hotel guest is too scared of water to join in on the Pet Hotel puppy pool party, Minnie and Daisy pull out all the stops to help her take part in the fun.

Episodes.Title: 3. Here We Goat Again
Episodes.Description: Minnie and Daisy scramble to keep a bouncing baby goat from destroying the hotel.

Episodes.Title: 4. Bit of a Stretch
Episodes.Description: The girls try to impress a potential guest by promising the Pet Hotel has yoga classes, then wind up trying to run one without knowing any yoga moves.

Episodes.Title: 5. Scoot on Over
Episodes.Description: Millie and Melody help Minnie and Daisy see that it's easier to keep up with all the pets at the Pet Hotel when they're riding a scooter. The problem is, the pets want to ride too.

Entries.Title: Chikuwa Wars
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Piggy Builders
Entries.Description: Piggy Builders follows Cornelia, Cesar and Charlie, three curly-tailed piggy siblings who love building and solving problems in their community – and, most importantly, they love each other!

Episodes.Title: Pie Party
Episodes.Description: Charlie has made a huge pie for the Piggies to share! But Wilf wants it all for himself and sabotages his own house to trap the Piggies outside. While they fix his home, Wilf settles in theirs... until the Piggies rush back to save their pie party!

Episodes.Title: Bookcase Chaos
Episodes.Description: The Piggies are called to find Fred’s lost book, but his bookshelf collapses when they arrive! The Piggies split up: Charlie and Cornelia repair the shelf, while Cesar searches with neighbours... who end up giving them even more books to organise!

Episodes.Title: Egg Race
Episodes.Description: Kitty wants to experience the way Sasha bounces everywhere. The Piggy Builders create an egg-shaped vehicle for Kitty. Wilf makes it go wild, and the Piggy Builders have to find a way to stop it!

Episodes.Title: Drum Drama
Episodes.Description: Fine Forest is buzzing with excitement as the Fine Forest Drums Festival approaches. The Piggies make a lot of drums for everyone, but they mysteriously disappear. The Piggies create a huge drum and hide inside to uncover this mystery.

Episodes.Title: Whoosh
Episodes.Description: Keith is on the way to his first music lesson with Brian, but a wild air stream blocks the path, sweeping everyone away! The Piggies must help him cross, but they can’t agree on which materials to use. Can they solve the problem before it’s too late?

Episodes.Title: Big Top
Episodes.Description: Reg asks the Piggies to put on a show for the Bunnies. Cesar builds a stage, while Cornelia and Charlie gather performers. They decide it will be a circus show. In the end, the Piggies are clowns, transforming the stage into a big top!

Episodes.Title: Prodigious Pumpkin
Episodes.Description: Fiona asks the Piggies to help transport her pumpkin to the Vegetable Festival. They agree, but the pumpkin is so big, it's nearly impossible. The Piggies will have to turn it into a carriage!

Episodes.Title: Green Thumb
Episodes.Description: Brian asks the Piggies to help him grow a special little plant. They nurture it as their pet plant, and it grows so big that they can no longer keep it at home. Parting with their beloved plant feels impossible...

Episodes.Title: Bear Berry Day
Episodes.Description: It’s Bear Berry Day! The Piggy Builders come up with a way to help Brian reach the top of the tree to pick berries on the special day. But Wilf wants the berries too...

Episodes.Title: Night of the Shooting Stars
Episodes.Description: Shooting stars are flying over Flat Top Mountain. Everyone in Fine Forest climbs the mountain, except Fiona, who has hurt her foot! The Piggies can’t leave her behind. Will a rocket do the trick?

Episodes.Title: Biggy Boulder
Episodes.Description: The full moon makes Wilf howl all night! The next morning, everyone is exhausted… and there’s a boulder blocking Brian’s door! He’s the only one who knows how to stop Wilf’s howling, so they have to budge that boulder.

Episodes.Title: Speedy Cat
Episodes.Description: Kitty wants a racetrack. For Cornelia, it's the perfect opportunity to prove she's the fastest builder... but she works too quickly and doesn't manage to get it right. Fortunately, the Piggy Builders know how to work as a team to give themselves a second chance!

Episodes.Title: A Door for Some Deer
Episodes.Description: Fred and Dana's door makes a squeaky sound, so they call the Piggy Builders to fix it. The Piggies decide to upgrade the entire door. They build the greatest door ever, but then forget how to open it.

Episodes.Title: Naptime
Episodes.Description: The Bunnies' sleeping mobile breaks. The Piggy Builders come up with great ideas to create a new one. The problem is, the improvements amuse the Bunnies so much that they get too excited to sleep!

Episodes.Title: Camping Badges
Episodes.Description: Keith and Rebecca want to earn their camping badges. The Piggies set up the perfect site, but as night falls, strange noises echo through the forest… is it a monster? Their adventure is at risk - until they realise it’s Wilf, and he is even more scared than them!

Episodes.Title: Flappy Snap
Episodes.Description: Cherry wants to photograph a rare and shy butterfly. The Piggy Builders are eager to help, but they get so competitive that they scare it away. Cherry is heartbroken. To fix their mistake, they’ll have to work together.

Episodes.Title: Back of the Net
Episodes.Description: The Piggies decide to help Keith play with his ball, but their failed attempts lead to more and more repairs for the neighbours. Things get so bad that Wilf ends up confiscating the ball. Keith isn't allowed to play any more? Now, that is impossible!

Episodes.Title: Flying Cherry
Episodes.Description: Cherry dreams of soaring through the sky. The Piggy Builders build her a plane, but she jumps in without learning to fly. Taking off is easy, but landing? A disaster! Cherry thinks flying isn’t for her, but for the Piggies won't give up.

Episodes.Title: Keen Keith
Episodes.Description: Keith is excited to help the Piggy Builders repair a fence, but it turns into a disaster. The little goat feels guilty. When the Piggies discover that Wilf is sabotaging everything, they can't let Keith give up!

Episodes.Title: Captain Keith
Episodes.Description: Keith wants to have a pirate adventure. The Piggies build him a wheeled ship, and together they sail across Fine Forest in search of a treasure. When Wilf hears about their hunt, he joins the crew. But he only has one thing in mind... to steal the treasure!

Episodes.Title: The Pig Chill
Episodes.Description: It's the hottest day of the year in Fine Forest! The Piggies build an ice machine for cold drinks, but Wilf, wanting it all to himself, accidentally causes a blizzard.

Episodes.Title: Honking Wolf
Episodes.Description: Dana wants to cheer Wilf up and asks the Piggies to find something that will make him happy. But Wilf takes advantage of their kindness and requests a honking vehicle - just to annoy everyone! When it breaks, Wilf is even more miserable.

Episodes.Title: Fiona's Surprise
Episodes.Description: The Piggies are called on multiple missions and decide to split up. They soon realise they were all working on Fiona’s surprise birthday! Nothing is ready… Mission impossible? Not if they join forces!

Episodes.Title: Model Forest
Episodes.Description: The Piggies are building a model of Fine Forest, and each house must match the real one. But when a drop of gold paint lands on Fiona’s yurt model, Wilf is convinced it hides treasure. He will do whatever it takes to get the yurt - no matter the risk!

Episodes.Title: Cloud
Episodes.Description: Fiona wants to experience what it’s like to float on a cloud. The Piggies create a homemade floating cushion, but it is so relaxing that Wilf falls asleep on it... and floats away! The Piggies must catch that cloud before it drifts too far.

Episodes.Title: Treasure Hunt
Episodes.Description: Brian sets up a treasure hunt for the Piggies and is excited to challenge them with riddles tailored to their building skills! But Wilf is determined to find the treasure first - and keep it for himself. He might just ruin this unforgettable day…

Entries.Title: 咖宝车神之晶兽战队
Entries.Description: It tells the story of Kabao commander Tian Xiaoka and his crystal Kabao friends facing various threats and challenges together.﻿

Entries.Title: Cartoonified! With Phineas and Ferb
Entries.Description: Your favorite celebrities become cartoons as they go on wild adventures with Phineas and Ferb.

Episodes.Title: Kylie Cantrall
Episodes.Description: Phineas and Ferb invent a time-travelling pocket watch and invite ‘Descendants’ star Kylie Cantrall on an adventure through the ages when a wooly mammoth crashes the party.

Episodes.Title: Xochitl Gomez
Episodes.Description: When Phineas and Ferb welcome Xochitl Gomez to their backyard to test out a new batch of superhero serums, Xochitl finds herself battling ninjas with a rather odd superpower.

Entries.Title: AQUARION Myth of Emotions
Entries.Description: The Aquarion, a giant mechanized fighting suit, is humanity’s best weapon against interstellar threats. Human pilots trained and worked together to defeat Shadow Angels, invading Abductors, and kinetic energy monsters over thousands of years. Once again, humanity must turn to the Aquarion. With the fate of the Earth hanging in the balance, will the suit be enough to save mankind?

Episodes.Title: What She Told
Episodes.Description: Otori Sakko is a second-year student at Enoshima Academy, a private school for gifted students. Cocky and fearless, he is often shunned by his peers. One day, Sakko's recently deceased friend Sayo reappears and starts talking about 12,000 year-old myths.

Episodes.Title: A  Wish for Carnations
Episodes.Description: The Elementals learn that the beast they fought is a Shadow Angel from mythic space. Their role is to fuse the Vector Machines into Aquarion and fight those enemies back. Sakko recalls playing with Sayo, Momohime, and a certain robot in an Enoshima cave.

Episodes.Title: Not Yet Knowing
Episodes.Description: The universe's ability to self-correct made Sayo's funeral occur before her death. It seems only the Elements are aware that Sayo was in their class, but when Momohime asks about it, the students share a vision of a super-civilization with winged beings.

Episodes.Title: A Sacred Bond
Episodes.Description: After piloting Aquarion together, Momohime and Rimiya sense a special connection to each other. They go on a date to try to understand their feelings.

Episodes.Title: Somebody
Episodes.Description: The Elements battle another Mythic Beast and make a strange new friend while pondering their school's legends.

Episodes.Title: Tell Me Your Secret
Episodes.Description: Hana keeps trying to attack Momohime and Sun makes mysterious comments about the beasts to the other Elements.

Episodes.Title: What Our World Is
Episodes.Description: Hana starts questioning the nature of the Beasts while Sun draws mesmerized students to a mysterious activity.

Episodes.Title: A Dream Inside an Egg
Episodes.Description: Momohime urges Sakko to explore his feelings for Sun before another Beast attack threatens the whole universe.

Episodes.Title: At the End of Reincarnation
Episodes.Description: Sakko and friends find themselves trapped in a hellish landscape where they start to feel unfamiliar emotions.

Episodes.Title: Inside a Totally Changed World
Episodes.Description: As Sakko and friends learn more about their past, they ponder ways to prevent the destructive union of worlds.

Episodes.Title: With a Promise from Long Ago
Episodes.Description: With Momohime's fate in doubt, the Elements recall past experiences and face a potentially devastating battle.

Episodes.Title: Let Us Share a Myth about Love
Episodes.Description: The World Awakening Council reveals its agenda while past and present overlap as the universes begin to unite.

Entries.Title: 灵笼精编版
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Hakatha Qasas Al Quran
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: 까망과 베르의 푸드트럭
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Spice Frontier
Entries.Description: Centuries after the destruction of Earth, Kentucky Williams and his cyborg companion, C-LA, lead the crew of the Serrano on an intergalactic, flavor-driven adventure to hunt down the last remaining Earth spices. But they too are being hunted by a ghost from C-LA's past.

Episodes.Title: Escape from Veltegar
Episodes.Description: The Serrano crew’s excursion to Veltegar goes awry when they’re chased by a giant space lobster and crash land on the desert planet. While Eloy repairs the ship, Kent, Ada, and Nexus seek the lost Human settlement they came to find. Trouble arises when they’re attacked by a tidal wave of carnivorous scarabs. These are smart bugs, and even C-LA will need a hand if they’re to survive. Meanwhile, Ada continues her search alone. What she discovers would put a smile on the face of any flavor aficionado. But something unexpected finds her—something that will mark the beginning of a whole new adventure.

Entries.Title: monpoke
Entries.Description: Pikachu arrives on Monpoké Island. There, the iconic 'mon will meet Dedenne, Ludicolo and many others.

Entries.Title: Il Baracchino
Entries.Description: Il Baracchino, once the coolest comedy club around, is now a drunken, cockroach-infested dive...and it could soon become a Doner Kebab! But Claudia, an aspiring art director, wants to save it: she puts together a ragtag line-up of comedians for an evening that could change everything. Too bad the biggest obstacle is Maurizio, the gruff unicorn owner of the place.

Entries.Title: Muzik Tiger In the Forest
Entries.Description: In the Muzik Forest, by a beautiful lake, live three tigers—Toffee, Tiffy, and Teffi— along with a mouse named Willy and a moon rabbit called Polmi. They lead a carefree life, not working, but every day is filled with fun and fascinating moments

Episodes.Title: A Day in the Muzik Forest
Episodes.Description: In the vibrant and unique Muzik Forest, a place where animals with distinct personalities live, Toffee and the friends spend another carefree day enjoying their freedom.

Episodes.Title: Walking Watermelon?
Episodes.Description: Toffee comes across a walking watermelon while taking a walk.

Episodes.Title: All Good Today!
Episodes.Description: While taking a walk with Willy, Toffee happens to encounter Teeffee who guards the safety of Muzik Forest.

Episodes.Title: Porumee's New Menu
Episodes.Description: As always, Porumee is putting in effort to create a new recipe for bread. Toffee and the friends visit Porumee's store and curiously taste the new bread.

Episodes.Title: Let's Play at the Beach!
Episodes.Description: Toffee spends some relaxed time, watching Taffee play in the sand at the beach.

Episodes.Title: Teeffee is a Guardian of Sea?!
Episodes.Description: Toffee and Willy are enjoying fishing. Is Teeffee protecting the waterfront?

Episodes.Title: A Blacksmith, Kumee
Episodes.Description: Kumee who is skilled at crafting various items, is making something as usual.

Episodes.Title: Here Comes Soapy!
Episodes.Description: A cloud of cotton is falling from the sky…

Episodes.Title: Look at me, Toffee!
Episodes.Description: Soapy is seeking attention from Toffee, but Toffeee is glued to the computer...

Episodes.Title: Toffee's Market of Wonders
Episodes.Description: Toffee and Willy set up a small flea market to sell their unusual finds from the lake.

Episodes.Title: Let's Make a Parfait!
Episodes.Description: Toffee and the friends spot a delicious-looking parfait and are eager to learn how to make it. Porumee decides to host a parfait making class for them!

Episodes.Title: Not easy being an art model
Episodes.Description: Toffee becomes an art model for Taffee's drawing, but staying still is too boring for Toffee..

Episodes.Title: Mint Chocolate Chip is the Best!
Episodes.Description: Toffee has an undeniable love for mint chocolate chip. Are you also a mint chocolate chip lover?

Entries.Title: 2Aliens
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Lil Kev
Entries.Description: Set in 1993 North Philadelphia, follow 12-year-old Kevin Hart, whose wild imagination and unshakable optimism constantly collide with his neighborhood's harsh realities. At the same time, his no-nonsense mother Nancy juggles night shifts as an E.R. nurse while waging a one-woman war to keep Kev on track – no easy feat with his mischievous older brother Robert blazing all the wrong trails, his trainwreck father Henry's outrageous attempts to win Nancy back, and his ex-con uncle Richard Jr.'s questionable life advice.

Episodes.Title: Take Your Kev to Work
Episodes.Description: Kev uses Uncle Richard's jail ball antics at basketball tryouts and accidentally starts a riot, so Nancy decides to scare him straight with a visit to her job at the ER.

Episodes.Title: Kev the Babysitter
Episodes.Description: Kev's plan to go to his crush Rhe Rhe's party is thwarted when he gets stuck babysitting Uncle Richard's two rowdy kids; Nancy goes to a spoken word poetry night with Marisol.

Episodes.Title: Laugh at My 'Paign
Episodes.Description: When the community pool closes, smooth-talking city council candidate Coleman Bridges proves unhelpful, so Kev schemes for Henry to run against Coleman.

Episodes.Title: Mr. Uncle Mom Jr.
Episodes.Description: Uncle Richard is put in charge of the boys while Nancy takes a risk visiting a new hair salon; when Kev and Robert's troublemaking plans go awry, Richard and Henry clean up the mess.

Episodes.Title: Driving Miss Nancy Crazy
Episodes.Description: Inspired by Rev. Mooney's sermon, Kev and Nancy try to prove each other wrong as they help their racist elderly neighbor; Richard thinks Miss Green is avoiding him.

Episodes.Title: Trial and Terror
Episodes.Description: Kev's class completes a read-a-thon challenge, but with a logbook tracking their progress stolen and their pizza party at risk, the class holds a mock trial to catch the thief; Nancy and Marisol devise a plan to save their endangered hospital.

Episodes.Title: The King and Queen of Harts Play Spades
Episodes.Description: Nancy and Henry head to Baltimore to reclaim their Spades glory from years past, and find their relationship spark reignited; nervous Kev gets the attention of a girl, and Richard's plans to spend a quiet weekend with Miss Green are crashed.

Episodes.Title: This Isn't 39
Episodes.Description: Nancy freaks on her birthday when she learns she's not turning 39, but 40; her friend Loretta arrives to take her out for one last crazy night; Kev and Henry trail them to keep Nancy away from other men; Richard helps Robert make a prison cake.

Episodes.Title: Bittersweet Charity
Episodes.Description: Nancy offers to watch Dirty Dante, and finds she enjoys mothering the grateful kid; Kev takes advantage of Nancy being distracted and gets into trouble staying out late; Richard suspects Miss Green is losing interest in him since he's gone straight.

Episodes.Title: Sink or Swim
Episodes.Description: Kev starts a swim team with new kid Brian; Nancy hosts a dinner for Coleman to discuss the growing crime problems; surprising Nancy, Henry also arrives for dinner to win her back; more folks crash the dinner, leaving Nancy frantic as chaos ensues.

Entries.Title: HANA-Doll*: Reinterpretation of Flowering
Entries.Description: Boys auditioning for the “Hana Doll Project." They all came with dark pasts in mind. They were not the only ones with secrets. The production company that sponsored ask them one condition for passing the audition; In order to "blossom" as perfect idols, the boys have to sign a contract that they will undergo an operation to implant a special “seed” in their bodies in exchange for their lives. There is no one who refuses. "No matter what the cost, I will make my dream come true." Will their determination blossom?

Episodes.Title: Do Hana Ningyo Dream Of Becoming An Idol?
Episodes.Description: The six who passed the audition start living together, aiming for their official debut. Everyone tries to get along with each other to ease their tension, but there is one person who refuses to get along with them. The atmosphere is awful. Lessons are full of mistakes, and the unit doesn't come together. Meanwhile, a stern notice is issued by the production company...

Episodes.Title: It's Not A Tragedy, But A Comedy.
Episodes.Description: Rihito stubbornly rejects the other members and becomes isolated. Mahiro, who has a strong sense of responsibility, tries his best to mediate between them, but to no avail. Memories of a rainy day flash through his mind. A distorted afterimage makes him strongly aware of "that guy." The same scent, emotions that should have been suppressed. Just before the final lesson evaluation test, something strange happens to Rihito...

Episodes.Title: The Invisible Flower Is in a Box.
Episodes.Description: The pre-debut is finally decided, and Anthos and the others head to the location for the music video shoot. Amidst the excited voices, Chise is alone, looking at "him" with a gloomy face. The color of her heart is reflected only in her eyes - the production company's cruel verdict causes the complex colors to eat away at Anthos. And then, one more person experiences a new abnormality...

Episodes.Title: Flowers Smell Sweet Even If You Call Them By Different Names.
Episodes.Description: The voices of the members congratulate Kaoru for her blossoming. Impatience, jealousy, anxiety, irritation - their true feelings are revealed because they are serious. Some have blossomed, and some have not. Mixed with their hidden pasts, the gap that was half filled becomes deeper again. Is it a coincidence or a destiny? Resonating with the clashing confessions, new buds begin to tremble.

Episodes.Title: Clockwork Level Up
Episodes.Description: Finally, Anthos has landed a big TV job. The Idol Competition Sports Day will allow them to perform alongside famous idols, and is the perfect chance for these budding guys to make a name for themselves. Anthos is enthusiastic, but there are voices that mock them and call them "cyborgs." The shadow of the hyenas that prey on the industry is creeping up on them...

Episodes.Title: Once-In-A-Lifetime Encounter in Room 317
Episodes.Description: The long-awaited release event and public press conference were held. It was supposed to be a grand stage of joy and excitement. A gossip reporter criticizes Anthos's body modification surgery. Mahiro's secret is revealed, and the members are shaken. Their blossoming...tears them apart, giving rise to frustration and rampage...

Episodes.Title: A Knight Fallen into the Ripples of Tears
Episodes.Description: Mahiro and Yota see off the blossoming members as they head off to promote their new song. Left behind in the dorm, their hearts sink. It's painful to see them acting strong out of concern for their friends. Then they receive something from the production company. It makes them happy, even if just for a moment...

Episodes.Title: When the Sun Wakes Up
Episodes.Description: The dark side of Anthos becomes news, and curious eyes turn to them. Their secret of being from an orphanage is revealed, and to make matters worse, Yota is forced to suspend his activities due to an aggravation of his injury. What is the answer he comes up with in this corner? During a fan meeting with only the five of them, a small shadow takes a step forward.

Episodes.Title: A Knight Fallen Into the Ripples of Tears
Episodes.Description: Mahiro and Yota see off the blossoming members as they head off to promote their new song. Left behind in the dorm, their hearts sink. It's painful to see them acting strong out of concern for their friends. Then they receive something from the production company. It makes them happy, even if just for a moment...

Episodes.Title: Stand by Me
Episodes.Description: Thanks to Anthos' efforts, public opinion of him has begun to change little by little, and Yota has blossomed and regained his usual energy. Meanwhile, Mahiro is the only one who has yet to blossom. He is depressed, and keeps getting NGs even during location shoots. Ryouga is worried. Mahiro rejects him. The promise they once made with "that guy" ties the two together and binds them...

Entries.Title: Transformers Wild King
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Long March Toward the Universe
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Forget That Night, Your Majesty
Entries.Description: Born the despised daughter of a noble family, Lunia escapes her grim fate by marrying the cursed Duke, Hades Khronoa. But after a single loveless night, she vanishes without a trace, unaware that she’s carrying his children. Seven years later, Hades is determined to reclaim Lunia and finds her... as well as the children he never knew existed. As secrets resurface and emotions reignite, can this broken couple untangle the past and face the future together?

Entries.Title: Quiet Please!
Entries.Description:
One month into living on his own, Yi-hyuk was hoping for an exciting, dramatic start to his independent life—but not this kind of drama. What he doesn’t expect is to be tormented by the thunderous noise coming from the apartment next door.

Determined to put an end to it, he confronts his neighbor—only to make things infinitely worse when he accidentally punches him in the face.

Yi-hyuk tries everything—from childish pranks to petty power plays—but his neighbor just won’t budge. He even pleads on his knees to make the noise stop. Just when it seems the feud will never end, they finally manage to call an uneasy truce.

And somewhere along the way, Yi-hyuk realizes he might be falling for the very person who once drove him up the wall.

Entries.Title: Belfort & Lupin
Entries.Description:
Lupin’s street-smarts combined with Belfort’s aristocratic know-how make them an unstoppable pair! They both have an insatiable thirst for mischief and adventure.

Together, they explore every nook and cranny of the Palace and join forces with animals they meet.

Episodes.Title: The Wig House
Episodes.Description: Today, Mr. Binet, the royal wigmaker, is in a panic: the Queen's favorite wig has disappeared. Gazette, the mouse, is upset because this wig is her home.

Entries.Title: The Destiny Ruler
Entries.Description:
Since ancient times, Dahe Shenzhou has been a land where virtue and evil have been at odds. Numerous justice-related sects have banded together to combat the evil's twelve irresponsible sects. The justice Jinyi Sect's low-level supernatural power is Li Wannian, who possesses ordinary cultivation. He wants to live a life of peace and quiet, lying flat in the Jinyi Sect and receiving a salary.

He unexpectedly learned, however, that he possessed the eternal capacity to instantly resurrect at the point of life-or-death crisis while completing a task to deal with the transfer. More significantly, he can improve his cultivation after each resurrection by receiving incentives in the form of points based on his overall performance at the time of his beheading. To put it another way, Li Wannian has to make a valiant sacrifice, and in a way that inspires and motivates others if he hopes to advance his cultivation.

Entries.Title: Ganglion
Entries.Description: Early 2000s Tokyo. Isobe, a combatant for the evil corporation Ganglion, spends his days on the battlefield. Whether it's the "Tokyo Cedar Pollen Operation" or the "Mount Fuji Demolition Plan," he faces off in nothing but a bodysuit, only to be crushed by the hero Hopeman time and again. As he struggles under unreasonable bosses during the dawn of compliance, his story unfolds—a workplace drama dedicated to all who work, following the bittersweet life of a salaryman soldier.

Entries.Title: Plus-sized Misadventures in Love!
Entries.Description: "This is my punishment - someone as hideous as me falling for someone as good-looking as you..." Yumeko had a mountain of complexes about herself. Then, a terrible accident befalls her. Though somehow saved from the brink of death, Yumeko wakes up a completely different person. "Is this...me...?! I'm SUPER cute!!" Those around her can't hide their surprise and wonderment at this 180-degree change... But, Yumeko's new hyper-positive attitude starts to change her surroundings, too. Worries and complexes can affect anyone, and Yumeko will chop right through those of her various supporting characters!! In love, work, friendship... And an attempted murder case?!

Entries.Title: SI-VIS: The Sound of Heroes
Entries.Description: The story centers on the members of the SI-VIS co-ed vocal unit that is wildly popular both inside and outside Japan. Their true secret identity is a group of heroes who fight against a mysterious calamity threatening to destroy the world. Through their live performances, they gather the power to fight.

Entries.Title: 仙逆合集篇
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: RockOlandia
Entries.Description: Animated show from Puerto Rico based on the 1980 theater production for children.

Episodes.Title: Seven Little Goats and the Big Bad Wolf
Episodes.Description: A group of young kid goats face the Big Bad Wolf, while learning about friendship, solidarity, and family union.

Entries.Title: BeddyByes
Entries.Description: Join best friends MeMo and BaBa as they travel across the remarkable Planet BeddyByes, meeting new and familiar faces on their mindful and soothing journey to bedtime.

Episodes.Title: Seeds
Episodes.Description: MeMo and BaBa discover a dandelion clock and marvel at how a seed can become a beautiful flower.

Episodes.Title: Hug
Episodes.Description: MeMo and BaBa discover that sometimes all you need is a hug to make things better.

Episodes.Title: Lost
Episodes.Description: MeMo comforts BaBa when they lose their precious forever flower.

Episodes.Title: Jumpy Planet
Episodes.Description: BaBa wants to jump, like MeMo. Together they find a fun way to help BaBa bounce.

Episodes.Title: Noise
Episodes.Description: BaBa loves playing with a noisy drum but discovers that not everyone likes loud noises.

Episodes.Title: Circles
Episodes.Description: MeMo and BaBa discover different types of circles all over Planet BeddyByes.

Episodes.Title: Surprise
Episodes.Description: MeMo and BaBa unwrap a surprise parcel as they travel across Planet BeddyByes.

Episodes.Title: Sticky Leaf
Episodes.Description: MeMo and BaBa can’t get rid of a sticky leaf but then find surprising ways to play with it.

Episodes.Title: Floating
Episodes.Description: MeMo and BaBa enjoy seeing and playing with floaty things.

Episodes.Title: Flute
Episodes.Description: BaBa wants to play the flute as well as MeMo. MeMo helps BaBa learn to play the recorder

Episodes.Title: Sorry
Episodes.Description: BaBa learns that when you say sorry, you need to truly mean it.

Episodes.Title: Mystery Song
Episodes.Description: MeMo and BaBa go on a hunt for an intriguing sound.

Episodes.Title: Wheels
Episodes.Description: MeMo and BaBa have fun discovering wheels and the joy of motion.

Episodes.Title: Hiccup
Episodes.Description: BaBa has the hiccups. MeMo helps to make them disappear before BeddyByes time.

Episodes.Title: Wind
Episodes.Description: MeMo and BaBa discover many new ways to play on a windy day.

Episodes.Title: Stars
Episodes.Description: BaBa wants to see a shooting star but must learn to be patient.

Episodes.Title: Where's Yummy?
Episodes.Description: MeMo and BaBa learn that their game of spotting Yummies is, in fact, a hunt for Yummy Dog.

Episodes.Title: Red and Yellow Together
Episodes.Description: MeMo and BaBa learn about two very special colours.

Episodes.Title: Gentle
Episodes.Description: With MeMo’s help, BaBa learns how to be gentle with animals and delicate objects.

Episodes.Title: Looky Tube
Episodes.Description: MeMo and BaBa play with a cardboard tube and learn to look at the world together.

Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Red Fox
Entries.Description: In Ibana, the so-called "Red Nation," there lives a mythical creature known as the Red Fox—said to take on human form and steal human livers. Though the legend of the Red Fox has long faded into obscurity, the world is once again thrown into chaos with its sudden reappearance. At the heart of this turmoil stands the princess of the Red Nation named Sana.

Entries.Title: 封灵特优生 动态漫
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Do Not Watch This Show
Entries.Description: Wizz is a pompous blue monster who is stuck in a TV show that he does not want you to watch! Luckily, Wizz's friends help him navigate the hilarious consequences of being the star of a show that he'll do anything to escape.

Episodes.Title: Frog
Episodes.Description: A witch's spell is going to transform Wizz into a frog if you watch this episode! Can he trick you into switching off?

Episodes.Title: Bucket
Episodes.Description: A mysterious bucket is following Wizz everywhere. It's going to pour all over his head if you keep watching and he's desperate for that not to happen.

Episodes.Title: Shrinking
Episodes.Description: Mr Goblin puts a curse on Wizz for being rude. The more you watch, the more Wizz shrinks!

Episodes.Title: Friends
Episodes.Description: A terrible monster is about to arrive... or so Wizz thinks. It turns out to be a nice monster named Nessie who just wants to be Wizz's friend.

Episodes.Title: Stinky
Episodes.Description: It's a smelly disaster for Wizz! The more you watch this episode, the more everything around him starts to stink. Disgusting!

Episodes.Title: Treasure
Episodes.Description: Wizz has a pirate's map and is hunting for treasure. But he doesn't want you to find it before he does, so you'd better not watch!

Episodes.Title: Sleep
Episodes.Description: Wizz just wants to go to sleep, but Mr Goblin has cursed him to stay awake... if you keep watching this episode!

Episodes.Title: Getting Older
Episodes.Description: Wizz is growing old, fast. Way too fast! If you keep watching, he'll be 100 years old before the end of the episode!

Episodes.Title: Ghost
Episodes.Description: Wizz receives a note that says 'A Ghost' will be dropping by at the end of the episode. Can he protect you (and himself) from the spooky visitor?

Episodes.Title: Fart
Episodes.Description: Wizz has a very embarrassing problem. He needs to fart and does NOT want you to watch. So, he tries to make the episode extremely boring.

Episodes.Title: Parents
Episodes.Description: Wizz does not want you to meet his parents because he thinks they're embarrassing. Or is it because they want him to him to take part in a family tradition: jumping over a cactus.

Episodes.Title: Vanish
Episodes.Description: When Wizz loses Mr Goblin's bike and doesn't say sorry, everything around him begins to disappear. Can he break the curse before there's nothing left?

Entries.Title: Lana Longbeard
Entries.Description: Lana is a super-feisty, forward-thinking and passionate 11-year-old girl, who is also the heir to her father’s adventuring ship, the Mighty Windbreaker. Along with her captain dad and his diverse crew (an orc, a dwarf, a barbarian and a cyclops), she sails across the Ten Realms, dreaming of becoming one of the greatest adventurers of all time. But first, she must overcome some challenging obstacles: impulsivity, stubbornness, extreme curiosity, disdain for rules … and a love of pancakes. All the best things about her!

Episodes.Title: Quest For Your Life
Episodes.Description: It's Lana's 12th birthday, and she's decided it's time to start her hero's journey.

Episodes.Title: Fruits of Terror
Episodes.Description: Lana explores a jungle island with Bo and discovers a strange talking plant.

Episodes.Title: Oh Fishsticks!
Episodes.Description: Lana must complete a quest within 24 hours or be kicked out of the Adventurers' Guild.

Episodes.Title: Recipe for Disaster
Episodes.Description: Lana must bake a cake and heal a friendship to escape the Whirlpool of Eternal Doom.

Episodes.Title: It Always Comes Back
Episodes.Description: Lana and Andar have the same temperament, but different weapons. Hammer vs Boomerang!

Episodes.Title: Beard of Evil
Episodes.Description: Lana battles against a haunted pirate beard.

Episodes.Title: Grifters Adrift
Episodes.Description: Lana and Bo accidentally trash the Mighty Windbreaker just before the ship's inspection.

Episodes.Title: The Zingalinger
Episodes.Description: Lana asks Chopov to to teach her the epic art of roasting in an effort to be cool.

Episodes.Title: Flap Shack Attack
Episodes.Description: Lana's obsession with her collection of Flap Shack toys leads the crew into danger.

Episodes.Title: Don’t Lose Your Head
Episodes.Description: When the Mighty Windbreaker gets a cursed figurehead, Lana struggles to finish the quest.

Episodes.Title: Four Wrongs Make a Right
Episodes.Description: Lana stages a fake quest to raise Andar’s spirits ...oops she raises evil spirits instead.

Episodes.Title: The Sea-Grass is Always Greener
Episodes.Description: After a magic wish goes wrong, Lana and her nemesis Horatius switch bodies.

Episodes.Title: Can of Worm
Episodes.Description: Lana sets the crew on a quest to the Lost Isle of the Titans.

Episodes.Title: The Legend of Andar
Episodes.Description: Lana discovers Andar never defeated the monster that made him a legend.

Episodes.Title: It Takes Two to Durango Tango
Don't Rock the Dinghy
Episodes.Description: Lana and Bo try to jump up the Questers' leaderboard by taking on a dangerous mission.

Episodes.Title: Battle of the Blargs
Episodes.Description: Lana discovers that her loveable pet Sprog has a mysterious and dangerous side

Episodes.Title: A Wrinkle in Crime
Episodes.Description: Lana decides to help a little old lady get a necklace back, but ends up in deep trouble.

Episodes.Title: Bash From the Past
Episodes.Description: Lana discovers Greta's past as a member of a Barbarian rock band.

Episodes.Title: Father Knows Quest
Episodes.Description: Tired of Andar's rules, Lana jumps at the chance to be Sorlak's "daughter for a day".

Episodes.Title: Dressed to Quest
Episodes.Description: Lana dyes her hair blue and leads the crew in defiance of Captain Andar.

Episodes.Title: Going Bozork
Episodes.Description: Bo must discover the true essence of being an orc hero to save the crew.

Episodes.Title: Five Star Fury
Episodes.Description: Lana gets the crew to class-up the Mighty Windbreaker to impress journalist Zephyr Zeen.

Episodes.Title: Prophecy of Doom
Episodes.Description: A renowned Oracle predicts that Lana will only bring ruin and disaster to her loved ones.

Episodes.Title: Catch That Flying Fish
Episodes.Description: Lana and the crew race to stop their Flying Fish messenger before it reaches the Admiral.

Episodes.Title: Undercover Captain
Episodes.Description: Lana tries to help Andar after he gets a bad score on an anonymous performance review.

Episodes.Title: Going Overboard
Episodes.Description: Lana finds that having Dr Chopov as a personal guardian is not all it's cracked up to be.

Episodes.Title: Tale of the Wolf Mom
Episodes.Description: Lana has an adventure with Otsana, her cool shapeshifting wolf mom.

Episodes.Title: Dice of Destiny
Episodes.Description: Lana pushes her luck and plays with the power of the Titans

Episodes.Title: A Hardwired Holiday
Episodes.Description: Lana and STONK switch boats for a Guild exchange program.

Episodes.Title: Escape From Escape Island
Episodes.Description: Lana and Horatius must work together if they are going to escape from Escape Island.

Episodes.Title: Lana the Something Super Great and Totally Awesome
Episodes.Description: Lana must go through a naming ceremony with Grammy Longbeard on Ched-iyaq.

Episodes.Title: Baron Buckethead
Episodes.Description: Lana stands by Helmet Hugo when he is challenged to a duel by a powerful knight.

Episodes.Title: Fan Friction
Episodes.Description: Lana babysits Admiral Lovejoy's starstruck niece, Avery Lovejoy who is Lana's biggest fan!

Episodes.Title: War and Pizza
Episodes.Description: Lana and Bo turn against each other and escalate a villagers' bickering into a pizza war!

Episodes.Title: Bo Diggity
Episodes.Description: Lana handles Horatius, whose palace is about to collapse while Bo handles his orc parents. Actors:

Episodes.Title: Throw a Beard a Bone
Episodes.Description: Lana teams up with Saltybeard’s beard to save Andar, but has this villain reformed?

Entries.Title: Latair the Earth
Entries.Description: The story begins when a child meets Latair, a fairy of the Earth. With Latair’s magical powers, the child transforms into various creatures and embarks on a journey through ecosystems around the world, becoming friends with the animals they encounter. However, these new friends are all endangered species. Moved by a desire to protect them, the child decides to become an Earth Saver.

Entries.Title: Tomica Heroes Jobraver: Tokusou Gattai Robo
Entries.Description: The anime features "Braver" units, which combine job-related robots called "Jobroids" with "Armor Tomica" automobiles related to police, fire fighters, emergency medical personnel, trash collecting, and construction.

Entries.Title: Don't Touch Kotesashi
Entries.Description: Kouyou Kotesashi, a sports doctor with massage skills, enrolls at Seiwa University Affiliated High School to secure a scholarship. He works as a live-in dorm manager, managing the school's talented female athletes and managing their well-being through intense training and massage therapy.

Entries.Title: Dr. Seuss's Horton!
Entries.Description: Young Horton explores the Jungle of Nool with his two best friends: going on daring adventures, helping their community, and learning how to stand up for what's fair.

Entries.Title: Fight For The Throne
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: PetitCure ~Precure Fairies~
Entries.Description: Get all Cure and Relaxed with PetitCure, Precure's first series featuring "Little Friends."

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: The race for pancakes is on!

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: Enjoying a beautiful scenery on the ferris wheel at night!

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Dizziness is never a good feeling.

Episodes.Description: Komugi & Yuki (From Wonderful Precure!) and Tsubasa (From Soaring Sky! Precure) chilling with cool drinks!
