Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: A hallway of magic mirrors and an unforgettable ride is in store for the Precure Fairies!

Entries.Title: Pretty Pretty Please I Don't Want to be a Magical Girl
Entries.Description: A story about a girl named Aika who, you guessed it, doesn't want to be a magical girl. She's fallen out of love with her work over time but gets the job done regardless. Will she be able to reignite her passion with the help of her magical sidekick, Hoshi and her new best friend Zira? Or will those pesky evildoers, Eclipse and Lady DeVoid continue to keep her down? Who knows!?

Episodes.Title: I Don't Want to be a Magical Girl
Episodes.Description: Aika's lost her enthusiasm as a magical girl but keeps fighting anyway. With her sidekick Hoshi and friend Zira's help, she strives to find her spark again while facing villains Eclipse and Lady DeVoid.

Entries.Title: Shabake
Entries.Description: The story is set in Edo, and centers on a sickly but kind-hearted young man, and the mysterious spirit that watches over him.

Entries.Title: Legend of the Ethereal Sword-Immortal
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Dream Photobooth
Entries.Description:
Pheles Academy is a prestigious boarding school that is glamorous and free, but with strict school rules. However, there was a secret in this school that must not be revealed.

Uno, a fallen angel who transferred from heaven, Chris, half cat and half demon, March, made of green apple flavored gummy bears, and Yongjin, a shy boy with octopus tentacles. These three unique characters are enjoying their youth, but eventually they open the door to their own world.

The door opens into a strange, alien space that is neither reality nor a dream. Endless white corridors, distorted classrooms, giggling cats.... What will happen to them in this gradually distorting world? What is the secret hidden in Pheles Academy? And will they be able to graduate safely?

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Pheles Academy is a prestigious boarding school that is glamorous and free, but with strict school rules. However, there was a secret in this school that must not be revealed.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: Chris appears to Uno soaking in the bathtub with his clothes on...

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Guided by Chris, Uno walks down the corridor. What lies ahead...?

Entries.Title: Acorn Culture Center
Entries.Description:
"A corporate executive who hates hobbies is trapped in an endless hobby hell at a cultural center!"

Dotori Cultural Center. A hot spot for middle-aged people, where they can learn and make friends. On Mondays, it is filled with the scent of ink from calligraphy, and on Saturdays, it is a peaceful place filled with the sounds of the grandmothers' funky town.

The story of a slightly odd group of grandmothers who end up defending the Dotori Cultural Center from the destruction brought by Goo Doo-ri, the vice president of Universe Group, and their humorous journey of growth.

Entries.Title: Rising in The Fire
Entries.Description: In times of crisis, the protagonists join hands with many comrades in arms to fight against evil with professional abilities and endless courage. In the end, justice is served and darkness has nowhere to hide...

Episodes.Title: Damn It, I Have Tolerated You For So Long!
The Bad Fate Caused By A Bottle of Disinfectant
Working In Pairs Makes The Work More Tiring!
What’s The Point Of Keeping This Life Going!
There Are So Many Loopholes, It's Really Stupid
The Number You Dialed Was Not Answered

Entries.Title: Cat God
Entries.Description: The story unfolds through the eyes of cats, offering glimpses of intense battlefields, fleeting moments in history, heartfelt family bonds, and imaginative visions of the future. Rendered in a variety of styles, including ink painting, 2D animation, 3D visuals, and stop motion, it captures the essence of Eastern aesthetics. Ten surreal and enigmatic scrolls about cats are revealed, one by one, drawing the audience into their mysterious world.

Entries.Title: Gekkan! Nanmono Anime
Entries.Description: A new short anime series based on the characters "Nandemo Ikimono" created by illustrator and character designer Yuri Yokomizo. The stories follow the lives of any and all things, from animals and plants to food and objects.

Entries.Title: BESTIALE
Entries.Description: Yrehn, an Osamodas guardian, lives a peaceful life with the legendary Elante. With them, the great eagle Eryx and the boarataur Boarus stand ready to fight should their lives be threatened. But their peaceful existence comes to an end when Karn, the great hunter-eater, lands on their island refuge. Commissioned by a strange bird, the lop hunter captures the Elante and takes her to his ship, the Bloodboat.

Episodes.Title: Voracious
Episodes.Description: Karn, the famous hunter-eater, treats himself to new prey for lunch. An excellent cook, Karn takes the time to prepare the meat. Just as he's about|to savor his meal, a strange black bird comes along and offers him a deal.

Episodes.Title: Bound
Episodes.Description: Yrehn, guardian of the Elante, lives happily with Eryx, Boarus and the creature on Mishel's island refuge. Their peaceful lives are disrupted by the arrival of Karn who has come to capture the Elante. A fierce battle ensues between the hunter-eater and the legendary animal's protectors.

Episodes.Title: Hunted
Episodes.Description: Karn has captured the Elante, and it is Yrehn's duty as guardian to do everything in her power to save her. Aboard the Bloodboat, the black bird demands that the creature be handed over, but the hunter refuses. Their quarrel is interrupted by the arrival of Yrehn and Eryx, both determined to save the Elante.

Episodes.Title: Karn
Episodes.Description: On the Bloodboat, Karn dresses Yrehn's wounds. Melancholic, the hunter-eater recalls moments from his long life.. He is drawn from his reverie by an attack led by Nimoda disguised as the strange black bird.

Episodes.Title: Nimoda
Episodes.Description: At the end of his fight with Nimoda, Karn is swallowed by the Krakolodon. Nimoda returns to her home in the Osamodas Kingdom. Aboard the Bloodboat, Yrehn must quickly find a way to catch up with her sister, so she can fulfill her mission to save the Elante.

Episodes.Title: Fierce
Episodes.Description: Yrehn manages to track the Elante back to Nimoda's castle. But time is running out if she's to save the creature. In the castle, Nimoda puts her plan into motion.

Episodes.Title: Tenacious
Episodes.Description: Despite Nimoda's pleas, Yrehn remains focused on her goal and interrupts the ritual. A violent battle ensues between the two sisters. Amid the chaos, Orbin regains consciousness and spots the Elante near him.

Entries.Title: Ada
Entries.Description: A young girl called Ada juggles her life as a library assistant and her imaginary world as she explores how various transformative technologies could shape our future.

Entries.Title: Dungeons & Television
Entries.Description:
Once upon a time, when television broadcasting itself was an adventure.

The invention of the television has made it possible to broadcast any event, however it is still an era where swords and sorcery abound. It has come for the cameras to turn their lens towards the darkness of dungeons, previously only known to adventurers.

Fighting countless monsters and constant equipment problems, the camera-wielding adventurers continued on, hoping to broadcast the first live dungeon capture. What may await them ahead?

Episodes.Title: We Are TV
Episodes.Description:
After fleeing from monsters,

the young wizard Marda encounters a strange group led by an elf named Syi.

They introduce themselves as the Royal Broadcasting Guild (OHG) Dungeon Location Team, but...

Entries.Title: Femme Fatale Ikusei Keikaku
Entries.Description: When a girl's heart is broken by her ex-boyfriend, her cousin hatches a plan: he'll become a gorgeous femme fatale, seduce the ex, then dump him!

Entries.Title: Talon
Entries.Description: A sci-fi/fantasy narrative set in the late Cretaceous period, focusing on a young misfit Dakotaraptor named Talon. Unlike her ferocious peers, she is intelligent, empathetic, and seeks camaraderie, setting her apart in a world governed by survival of the fittest.

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: Talon's unique traits attract Zekyr, an enigmatic otherworldly entity who, along with his acolyte Azirak, recruits Talon to help combat the Vair’un, a conquering army threatening the cosmos. As Talon embarks on a perilous journey, she faces numerous challenges that test her resolve, learning that true strength comes from understanding and friendship, resulting in a found family that will reshape the prehistoric world.

Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Binnenvet
Entries.Description: Colorful, absurdist sketch show full of situations that are recognizable for both children and adults. From an excuse company to a parent outlet or a noisy tooth fairy.

Entries.Title: Les 3 Mousquetaires
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: The Sisters Grimm
Entries.Description: Two orphaned sisters navigate a town full of people torn straight from fantasy and fairy tales, confronting heroes and villains alike, while investigating the mystery of their missing parents.

Entries.Title: 迷你特工队超能力战警
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Coal
Entries.Description: Follows Ethan Bishop, an eight-year-old boy navigating a difficult time in his life that lands him on Santa’s naughty list. In response, Santa implements ‘Plan C,’ sending a legendary Lump of Coal to guide Ethan on a “ho-ho-hilarious journey.” Through a series of positive and negative experiences with the coal, Ethan discovers a life-altering artistic talent.

Entries.Title: The Last Dynasty
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Haha, You Clowns
Entries.Description: Three jacked, surprisingly kindhearted brothers are accompanied by their loving and similarly swole father as they engage in a series of adventures to bond after their mother's passing.

Entries.Title: TOMICA & TOM
Entries.Description: After you fall asleep or while you're out, what are Tomica and Tom doing? Are they sleeping peacefully in the toy box? Are they just sitting there on the floor? Or maybe... No one knows the story of Tomica and Tom, but today we'll let you in on a special secret.

Entries.Title: Dog Days Out
Entries.Description: When their humans are away, a cute and curious pup and his dog pals love to play with their best friends — their favorite toys!

Episodes.Title: Spider-Dog / Messy Golf / To Fly Again
Episodes.Description: Holm and Button pretend to be squirrel-fighting superheroes. A game of golf goes off course when the ball goes missing. A pigeon eats too much dog food.

Episodes.Title: Doggy Kart Race / The Baby-Sitters / Turkey Rush
Episodes.Description: The dogs and toys rev up to race around the neighborhood. Sneaky squirrels plot to swipe Holm's snack. Momo's ball hides inside a delicious turkey.

Episodes.Title: Protect the Sausage Tree / Banana Figure Skating / Dancing King or Queen
Episodes.Description: Holm plants sausages in the ground to try and grow more. Slippery banana peels turn the street into a skating rink. The dog friends have a dance battle.

Episodes.Title: The Birthday Gift / The Golden Treasure Hunt / Soccer Day
Episodes.Description: A pigeon steals a special present. Holm and Button follow a treasure map and find a surprise. A soccer match brings out the pups' competitive sides.

Episodes.Title: Crazy Frisbee / The Missing Bucket List / Stormy Roller Coaster
Episodes.Description: The dogs and their pals have a frisbee catching contest. Someone snatches Holm's bucket list bone. A storm shakes up Holm and Button's camping plans.

Episodes.Title: A Sleepless Night / Bubble Town / Catch That Ghost
Episodes.Description: Janggoon's snoring ruins Holm and Button's sleep. A floating fart bubble threatens to stink up the neighborhood. Holm and Button host a Halloween party.

Episodes.Title: Stick Together / Escaping the Heat / Bath Time Is No Fun
Episodes.Description: A bubble gum balloon goes "pop!" The dogs fight over a block of ice during a heatwave. Victoria and D5 team up to give Holm and Button a bath.

Episodes.Title: Burger Bedlam / The Disastrous Date / Moving Tree House
Episodes.Description: Momo tries to get his paws on a spicy hamburger. Holm goes on a date with Wari — but he can't stop farting! Holm and Button's tree house rolls away.

Entries.Title: My Stupid Boss: The Animated Series
Entries.Description: Kerani hopes to escape Bosman's chaos after being transferred to a branch office in a small Sarawak town, but his hopes are quickly shattered as the turmoil persists.

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: Kerani and employees are shocked that the new office is not suitable. Bossman doesn't care, facing the mafia. He still adds 10 workers even though the rickety mess is full, then tricks the narrow space like a public transportation.

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: The delivery is messed up because of Bossman. The employees suffer from Bossman's forced English Day for the sake of cooperation with The Royal Family.

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: Azhari's salary is cut, Kerani & staff retaliate against Bossman by sabotaging office property. Clerk also has a mission to teach Bossman's wife to cook without being a teacher, but Mrs. Boss's chaotic method makes Clerk have to take over the kitchen.

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: Kerani, the 'mother' of the employees, learns to let them be independent. Can she resist her motherly desires? Bossman asks Kerani to prevent Faisal from resigning and opening a business, because he is a reliable worker with small wages.

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: For the sake of the client, Bossman borrows a Smart TV, but his English is broken, threatening the presentation. Fed up with Bossman's actions, the employees hide Mr. Kho's birthday karaoke party in the office.

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: Chaos in the office! Bossman forces employees to look for anniversary gift letters in the trash. When Bossman is absent due to a rat glue incident, the employees' freedom is shattered by specific messages that make your hair stand on end!

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: Bossman faints, the blind employee takes advantage of the situation! Then, Bossman invites Clerk to golf, tells him to be a spy on the past of Mrs. Boss and a business colleague who turns out to be an ex and is liked by the Father-in-law!

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: Bossman takes Kerani to the funeral home to collect Mr. Lim's debt to his deaf mother, causing chaos. To prove that the factory is not haunted, Bossman & Kerani stay there and discover a mystery.

Episodes.Title: Episode 9
Episodes.Description: The disciplinary system of the in-laws for the Kerani and officers united to return Bossman to the factory. After paying for TV advertisements, Bossman exploited the officers to make bombastic promotional videos despite having little funds!

Episodes.Title: Episode 10
Episodes.Description: The glue dilemma! Kerani's and Bossman's hands are permanently glued, chasing time before the slime launch. Kerani also faces the challenge of reconciling Bossman and his wife, so that he does not continue to trouble the office!

Episodes.Title: Episode 11
Episodes.Description: Bossman recruits former mafia as a security guard, Kerani is worried that the factory will be stolen. Azhari joins the backbiting club and leaks gossip to Bossman to get time off, risking being hunted down by Kerani, the club chairman.

Episodes.Title: Episode 12
Episodes.Description: Kerani must save Adrian, who Bossman is exploiting to seduce the supplier's sugar mama for a discount. Bossman suffers a heart attack, but the lazy man tricks his wife's fitness sensor with the help of an office employee!

Episodes.Title: Episode 13
Episodes.Description: In order to resign, Keranj with PMS have to endure anger all day facing an office full of emotions.  Bossman is determined to destroy his wife's ex-boyfriend's shop opposite, the employee's favorite hangout spot!

Entries.Title: Jack the Reaper
Entries.Description: A man with no memories finds himself in an interrogation room with a young policewoman. When she storms out after an unproductive conversation, he's stabbed by an intruder... and everything starts over.

The brightness of the light in Happy Town depends on the townsfolks glee, so each time it starts to fizz out, the duo set out on a mission to make the sign shine bright again by helping others and encouraging everyone to help each other too.

Episodes.Title: Magical Insecurities
Episodes.Description: In this adventure, Loriner and Jessie find a mysterious lizard wizard, and by accident create a really messy situation with some flesh monsters. Jester too, but he is in worse troubles.

Entries.Title: Piripenguins
Entries.Description: Five fun, unpredictable penguin pals learn about life, friendship and working together in their iceberg colony. Jump in at the deep end with Pancake, Nugget, Brinicle, Looph and Flutter for some flippertastic adventures.

Episodes.Title: Nugget's Nuglets
Episodes.Description: Nugget annoys Pancake with constant demands while ill in bed. To say sorry, she makes him a special bracelet. But Nugget is upset when others get `nuglets' too.

Episodes.Title: Pancake's Syncing Feeling
Episodes.Description: The Piris are in the final of the synchronised swimming competition and are beyond excited. All except Pancake, who worries he will spoil their chances of glory with his two left flippers.

Episodes.Title: The Merguin
Episodes.Description: The Piripenguins fall under the spell of a magical Merguin, a mermaid-penguin, who has the ability to change their personality. But all is not as it seems.

Episodes.Title: Flashy Flippers
Episodes.Description: A sales rep visits. Despite Pancake's doubts, he convinces the Piris to buy extra flippers. The penguins discover that their purchases are duds but find a clever new use for them.

Episodes.Title: The Piri Fitness Craze
Episodes.Description: Nugget's new fitness device sparks a craze on the berg. Running, skating and jumping, the Piris battle it out to score the most points, with a surprise winner.

Episodes.Title: The Mystery Gossiper
Episodes.Description: A mystery gossiper's stories in the newspaper cause friction among the Piripenguins, until Brinicle sets a clever trap to discover their secret identity.

Episodes.Title: Baking Mad
Episodes.Description: Flutter helps Brinicle with his brioche cooking to get ready for an exam, but the dough expands to a colossal size.

Episodes.Title: Detective Pancake Investigates
Episodes.Description: When Pancake's precious golden algae goes missing, all the Piri friends fall under suspicion. Pancake turns detective and replays the evening - but the solution is far from obvious!

Episodes.Title: Penguin Games
Episodes.Description: When Millie the Squid devises a set of tough penguin games to test the Piripenguins, Pancake and Nugget must stick together and rely on their friendship to succeed.

Episodes.Title: Misty Mountain Mystery
Episodes.Description: The Piris plan a trip to Tippety Top to see the famous southern lights but lose each other in an ice fog. When Nugget thinks she sees a monster, Pancake proves an unlikely hero.

Episodes.Title: My Fair Pancake
Episodes.Description: When the Emperor Penguin visits the berg, he discovers Pancake is a long-lost Prince. Pancake learns how to act royal, but all the attention goes to his head.

Episodes.Title: Gone Bird
Episodes.Description: Exhausted with requests for help, Looph deliberately disappears. The Piris turn detectives, searching the berg with little success until her ingenious plan is finally revealed.

Episodes.Title: Flutter's Honour
Episodes.Description: After Pancake saves him from a mishap, Flutter vows to repay the debt. But his risk-averse behaviour drives Pan to distraction until a real emergency allows the debt to be repaid.

Episodes.Title: Top of the Swaps
Episodes.Description: The Piripenguins face a set of tricky problems, but they discover that swapping items and working together can provide clever solutions, turning a regular day into an extraordinary one.

Episodes.Title: The Wishing Tree
Episodes.Description: Nugget attempts to make all her Piri friends' secret `wishing tree' hopes and dreams come true - but gets them the wrong way round, with funny and very unexpected consequences.

Episodes.Title: Pancake's Party Panic
Episodes.Description: Pancake is persuaded by Nugget to have a massive birthday party, but when the bash grows increasingly over the top, he finds his own unique way to handle the pressure.

Episodes.Title: A Whale of a Problem
Episodes.Description: Out in the ocean, the Piripenguins encounter a massive, angry whale called Norman, who wrecks their boat. Can the Piripenguins brave their fears and find a way to cheer him up?

Episodes.Title: LOOPH 2.0
Episodes.Description: Nervous about public speaking, Looph builds a robot to deliver a science talk in her place, but her Piripenguin friends are determined to help her do it herself.

Episodes.Title: The Lucky Charm
Episodes.Description: After a spate of unfortunate accidents, Pancake becomes convinced that rubbing a lucky icicle will bring him good luck - but panics when it's rubbed away, until his friends step in.

Episodes.Title: Nugget's Muddy Mishap
Episodes.Description: When Nugget's favourite teddy bear gets accidentally washed by Pancake, the Piripenguins try to restore its unique smell by painstakingly recreating Nugget's happiest memories.

Episodes.Title: Brinicle's Shopping Spree
Episodes.Description: The Piripenguins vow to change shopping-mad Brinicle's wasteful ways. But when their clever recycling plan proves too exhausting, Looph comes up with an alternative solution.

Episodes.Title: The Millie Mix-Up
Episodes.Description: The Piripenguins are annoyed to find that their holiday home has been double-booked by penguin nemesis Millie the Squid. With both refusing to move, is a resolution possible?

Episodes.Title: One Flutter Too Many
Episodes.Description: Flutter accidentally clones himself, leaving the berg flooded with scores of badly behaved penguins. As trouble spreads, the Piris must find a way to lose the unruly duplicates.

Episodes.Title: Brinicle's Bestaurant
Episodes.Description: Brinicle tries to turn the Krispy Krill shack into a top restaurant to impress a secret reviewer, but chef Pancake's cooking proves unpopular, and Looph's plate machine misfires.

Episodes.Title: The Mysterious Monster
Episodes.Description: The shadow of a monster causes panic among the Piris, apart from Nugget, who is keen to investigate a new mystery. She finally tracks down the creature, but is all exactly as it seems?

Episodes.Title: The Piris' Inky Issue
Episodes.Description: The Piris take refuge in grumpy Millie the squid's cave during a storm but accidentally damage a painting. Can they find a clever way to fix it before Millie finds out?

Entries.Title: 三国演义
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: HIRAETH
Entries.Description: Somewhere between life and death, earth and space, here and there, 20 lost souls compete in a gameshow hosted by a lonely and eccentric living entity. With the promise of resurrection and a beyond belief wish, they'll live forever tonight.

Entries.Title: The Insipid Prince's Furtive Grab for The Throne
Entries.Description: No description available

Entries.Title: Hey Duggee's Squirrel Club
Entries.Description: What has Duggee got planned for us today? Come and join Happy, Roly, Tag, Norrie and Betty, you’ll have so much fun at Hey Duggee’s Squirrel Club!

Episodes.Title: Cool, Man
Episodes.Description: At Squirrel Club, Detective Puppy solves the mystery of a missing biscuit, the Rabbits tell us what’s cool, and the Squirrels help Delivery Chipmunk with a huge parcel.

Episodes.Title: Hey Quacky!
Episodes.Description: Worm and Ladybird wonder what's going on at Squirrel Club. There's a gorilla playing drums, some helpful ducks, a hot frog, four goats and a hospital run by chicken doctors.

Episodes.Title: Frog Song
Episodes.Description: It’s fun on the counting train until Naughty Monkey starts to drive! Ethel makes a shape, Frog drops beats with a ribbit song, and Enid turns into anime to chase after a mouse.

Episodes.Title: What's Hot
Episodes.Description: Billy and the Sillies introduce a visit to chicken A&E, the Squirrels build a bug house, Norrie has her chance to shine, and the Penguins give facts about what’s hot and what’s not.

Episodes.Title: I'm Hungry
Episodes.Description: King Tiger and the Jelly wonder what Duggee has planned for today. Tag wants a snack, Enid has a musical cheese chase, and Norrie has a haircut.

Episodes.Title: Potato Time
Episodes.Description: At Squirrel Club, Duggee forgets how to woof, Duggly comes to visit, Roly celebrates Potato Time, and Billy teaches everyone the Bugatron dance!

Episodes.Title: Song of Peace
Episodes.Description: Betty recalls the first time she pushed the red button, the Squirrels explore a range of emotions with Happy, Angry Bull tells a not-so-sleepy bedtime story, and the gerbils sing.

Episodes.Title: Squirrel Babies
Episodes.Description: Spring has sprung! There are cute baby animals to meet and frolic with, Hennie bounces around in new dance shoes, and Happy loves water as much as Roly loves potatoes!

Episodes.Title: Ladybird's Game Show
Episodes.Description: Spot the odd one out or guess who lives here. A great memory tip from Duggee, an edition of The Agony and Eggstacy, and how to draw Enid - down to her last whisker.

Episodes.Title: Campfire Choir
Episodes.Description: Today at Squirrel Club, there are all sorts of comparisons to learn - from small to smallest, hungry to hungriest, and Duggee to Duggiest!

Episodes.Title: Stick Time
Episodes.Description: How many siblings does Norrie have? What’s Duggee’s favourite badge? What does everyone do on Fridays? Squirrel Club has the answers!

Episodes.Title: Calm Down
Episodes.Description: Water, water, everywhere – there’s a flood in our hospital soap opera! Grown-up Tag the firefighter splashes around. It's a good job grown-up Happy the lifeguard is on hand.

Episodes.Title: Master of Puppets
Episodes.Description: At Squirrel Club, there’s a story told in blocks, the tale of a first tooth, a fable about changing emotions, and a yarn involving the Squirrels as puppets.

Entries.Title: Hai! Myakumyaku desu
Entries.Description: Myakumyaku is a mysterious creature born 3.5 billion years ago who wants to talk to someone about life and the future. And that's when he meets a lazy old man! Does the old man and Myakumyaku seem to get along? Or maybe not? A heartwarming comedy with conversations that will make you chuckle.

Entries.Title: Plant Peeps
Entries.Description: The crazy lives of the plants living in a hydroponic garden.

Episodes.Title: The Pump
Episodes.Description: When the hydroponic system's pump fails, the Plant Peeps face a life-or-death crisis. As hydration levels drop, tensions rise, and blame falls on the messy tomato, Tomy. With time running out, the plants must work together to unclog the pump, sending the smallest among them, Baby Carrot, on a daring rescue mission.

Episodes.Title: Grow A Spine
Episodes.Description: The Plant Peeps are under attack-this time from Jaws, the house cat, who's snacking on Radishmir's leaves. As the plants struggle to defend themselves, a mysterious new arrival, Spiny the cactus, offers a solution. While most of the plants are charmed by Spiny's resilience and independent water supply, Carrod remains skeptical, fearing the newcomer will divert resources. But when Baby Carrot is in danger, Spiny proves that sometimes, a little toughness goes a long way.

Episodes.Title: Plants Got Talent
Episodes.Description: It's time for the annual talent competition, and the Plant Peeps are ready to show off their skills-singing, juggling, magic, and even psychic abilities. But when Tomy secretly "juices" with extra nutrients, the entire hydro system's pH level skyrockets, turning the plants bitter-literally. As chaos erupts on stage, it's up to Spiny to figure out what went wrong before the competition spirals out of control.

Episodes.Title: The Garden Girls
Episodes.Description: In this whimsical Golden Girls parody, the hydroponic garden's peace is uprooted when Straw's aphid infestation sparks chaos among the veggie crew-Pep (Blanche), Peazy (Sophia), Corny (Dorothy), and Straw (Rose). As the bugs threaten their leafy lifestyles, the plants scramble between marigold traps, ladybug predators, and a soapy exterminator showdown, all while trading sharp-tongued barbs and plant-themed puns.

Episodes.Title: Unidentified Fly Object
Episodes.Description: When Straw's late-night UFO scare rattles the hydroponic garden, Curu fuels the panic with tales of alien abductions while Cauli drops cryptic hints about a traumatic "probing" incident. As debates over rapture theories and rogue pests divide the plants, their paranoia reaches a boiling point-but the real threat might be closer than they think.

Episodes.Title: Happy Sproutday, Curu
Episodes.Description: When the Plant Peeps throw a Sproutday bash for Curu, the celebration takes a trippy turn after Curu shares a mystical tale about "magic mushrooms" and eternal energy. As the plants unexpectedly tap into cosmic vibes, chaos erupts-leading to wild revelations, existential meltdowns, and a leafy mishap that leaves Ro questioning his foliage future. A psychedelic plant party where sproutdays aren't the only thing growing... or not growing.

Episodes.Title: Shiny Gold Circle
Episodes.Description: When the Walkers' marital spat over a lost wedding ring leaves the Plant Peeps starving, the desperate veggies hatch a risky plan: retrieve the ring from the jaws of danger-literally. With Baby Carrot venturing into the cat's litter box and Spiny on defense duty, Carrod's parental panic clashes with the group's chaotic teamwork. A high-stakes mission where love, hunger, and a predatory cat collide.

Episodes.Title: Furquake!
Episodes.Description: When the hydro garden is rocked by a "Furquake"-a cat-induced earthquake courtesy of Jaws-the Plant Peeps scramble to survive the chaos. Straw's harmless prank on Baby Carrot quickly takes a backseat as the predatory feline wreaks havoc: swiping snacks, terrorizing veggies, and sparking panic. Amid the clawed chaos, an unexpected ally emerges with a tech-savvy trick to distract Jaws.

Episodes.Title: Cat Repellant and Barbie Shoes
Episodes.Description: As Jaws' reign of terror continues, the Plant Peeps split forces: Mousey spearheads a tech-savvy mission to order cat repellent (and Barbie shoes), while Pep and Sergeant Ro whip the veggies into shape with a chaotic bootcamp. Between vine-swinging drills, Tomy's antics, and Snappy's footwear obsession, the plants' survival plan hinges on teamwork-and a well-timed same-day delivery.

Episodes.Title: Full Moon Party
Episodes.Description: When Curu's spooky tale of La Llorona kicks off a full-moon storytelling night, Baby Carrot's playful antics spiral into a chaotic mashup of horror tropes- vengeful corn robots, werewolf transformations, and flame-wielding superheroes. As the plants' campfire story blurs with reality, even Dragolyn's vanity takes a fanged turn.

Episodes.Title: The P Team
Episodes.Description: As Jaws' snack-time threats escalate, the Plant Peeps form "The P Team"-a ragtag defense squad armed with war paint, laser gadgets, and pulleys-to outwit the feline menace. While Carrod frets over Baby Carrot's risky role and Mousey rallies the troops with a fiery pep talk in the style of Independence Day, chaos erupts when Tomy's tech fails mid-operation. A high-stakes game of cat-and-plant ensues, testing their teamwork... and Baby Carrot's knack for daredevil heroics. The leafy crew's survival hinges on guts, gadgets, and one tiny drone ace.

Entries.Title: Ninja vs. Gokudo
Entries.Description: Since ancient times, the ninja and the yakuza have been at war, spilling blood around the world as empires rise and fall. So when, in the modern age, Shinoha, a ninja, meets Kiwami, a gangster following the path of the yakuza—the gokudo—and discovers they have common interests, the obvious assumption is that nothing good can come of it. But can it be that one burgeoning bromance will shake up a 300-year grudge? Who will win the struggle for real ultimate power?

Entries.Title: Chao Tales
Entries.Description: Sonic, alongside an arrogant Shadow Chao, experiences all sorts of antics in Chao Tales: a new short series about a year in the life of the Chao Garden and all its residents!

Episodes.Title: Episode 1
Episodes.Description: While on a springtime run, Sonic stumbles upon a Chao Garden with a problem: they've got a Chao Egg that won't hatch, and a bossy Shadow Chao intends to get the new baby Chao out, one way or another!

Episodes.Title: Episode 2
Episodes.Description: It's chow time in the Chao Garden! Sonic is helping the Chao get a bite to eat until the resident trickster, a Shadow Chao, decides to make trouble...

Episodes.Title: Episode 3
Episodes.Description: It's a special day for the Chao; a whole bunch of little animals have come to visit! It's time for the Chao to pick our their favorite traits and transform. But when the Shadow Chao gets a bit too greedy, they run the risk of becoming something terrifying...

Episodes.Title: Episode 4
Episodes.Description: To beat the heat, the Chao are dancing and making music with Sonic in the shade. The Shadow Chao wants to crash the party, but even their shenanigans can't stop this jam session!

Episodes.Title: Episode 5
Episodes.Description: When all the Chao in the garden decide to run a race, the Shadow Chao confidently blazes in. Will pride be enough to fuel their path to victory? Can Sonic help them learn a little humility?

Episodes.Title: Episode 6
Episodes.Description: As the leaves start to change, the Shadow Chao is busy training, and they've gained a fan. Will the Shadow Chao push them away, or finally begin to soften up?

Episodes.Title: Episode 7
Episodes.Description: As winter closes in on the garden, the evil Dr. Eggman attacks, determined to level the Chao's precious forest for lumber. But Sonic is ready for him... or at least he thinks he is.

Episodes.Title: Episode 8
Episodes.Description: The battle against Dr. Eggman isn't going well. Will Sonic and his Chao friends be able to turn the tables on the doctor and save the forest?

Entries.Title: Potion Will Save Me
Entries.Description: Kaede, an ordinary high school girl, wakes up in an unfamiliar alleyway. It is a mysterious another filled with beastmen, elves, and dragons. Kaede noticed an unfamiliar book in the backpack she was carrying. It was a mysterious book that could create potions simply by chanting the word “creation”! For Kaede, who had been thrust into this another world, the potions she created became the sustenance that supported her life. While hoping to one day return to Japan, her struggles in this another world continue—.

Entries.Description: Gilly, Nico and Franny live in a small and unassuming town and for whatever reason very few, even themselves don't seem to recognise their interstellar affliction. They may be stupid...

Episodes.Title: Pilot
Episodes.Description: Aliens Nico, Gilly and Franny accidentally get involved in a hit and run involving loving father William Denning. Shenanigans ensue as they try to revive him while keeping the cops from suspecting them.

Episodes.Description: After receiving an invitation to a house warming party from their illustrious new neighbour Mr Egg, the gang soon finds out that this night, wasn't going to turn out how they thought.

Entries.Description: Senior Inspector Pradyuman, a young intense officer befriends 3 intelligent, savvy teenagers keen on investigation and crime fighting. CID Squad is a crime thriller series follows Inspector Pradyuman and his apprentice crew of investigator kids .This unique relationship between the kids and idealistic officer is the success to solving cases in each episode.

Episodes.Description: Shoma, Hanto, Sachika and Rakia are busy helping to prepare the Hinamatsuri event (Doll Festival) in the shopping district.

Entries.Title: Adventures of Dolly
Entries.Description: Adventures of Dolly follows Dolly and her friends - Ronny, Marty, and Crodo as they navigate fun, real-life adventures. From silly mishaps to life lessons, they tackle everyday challenges with humor, teamwork, and friendship, proving learning can be fun.

Episodes.Title: My Family
Episodes.Description: In this heartwarming episode, we dive into Dolly's life with her family, exploring the special bonds and connections that make them so close-knit. Through small moments, we see how her family shapes her personality and values.

Episodes.Title: True Friend
Episodes.Description: A new student joins Dolly’s school, bringing excitement and uncertainty. Will this newcomer fit in with Dolly's group, or will they shake up the dynamics? Discover how first impressions pave the way for new friendships.

Episodes.Title: The Purpose
Episodes.Description: Dolly learns a valuable lesson on appreciating the little things in life. As she discovers the beauty in everyday moments, her perspective begins to shift, opening her heart and mind to a world full of meaning.

Episodes.Title: Kite Play
Episodes.Description: It’s a breezy day, and Dolly and her friends head out to fly kites, creating colorful skies and unforgettable memories. Through laughter and friendly competition, they learn the joy of simple pleasures.

Episodes.Title: Rockstars
Episodes.Description: The Rockstar group makes an appearance at school, bringing music, energy, and inspiration. Dolly and her friends can’t help but join in the excitement as they experience a thrilling performance that leaves a lasting impression.

Episodes.Title: Dance Time
Episodes.Description: The school’s big dance competition is coming up, and Dolly and her friends are determined to win! But can they come together and pull off a memorable performance? Watch as they face challenges, practice, and learn the true spirit of teamwork.

Episodes.Title: Life Lesson
Episodes.Description: In this episode, the kids embark on an exciting journey, but along the way, they learn an important lesson about what to believe and what not to believe. Through fun and adventure, they discover the value of thinking carefully before trusting big promises

Episodes.Title: Final Exams
Episodes.Description: With final exams around the corner, Dolly and her friends buckle down to prepare. In this episode, we see the importance of dedication and support as they navigate study sessions, late nights, and last-minute worries.

Each episode features a character (usually Michael or Merle) getting into some sort of trouble or hardship because of his or her bad choices. But then they’re reminded of stories from the Bible (usually narrated by Pearl) to help them find the right way to proceed.

Entries.Description: There's nothing sweeter than friendship — and this heartwarming playlist of episodes and specials feels like a great big hug!

Episodes.Description: Follow the candy trail? No problem! Kitty-tine's Day leads to treats, songs and crafts as Gabby and friends find creative ways to say "I meow you."

Episodes.Title: The Creature Cases: The Vanished Valentine
Episodes.Description: A red panda is ready to declare her love for her sweetheart, but he's nowhere to be found! Can Sam and Kit help her find him in time for Valentine's Day?

Episodes.Title: True: Happy Hearts Day
Episodes.Description: True and Bartleby try to cheer up the Rainbow Kingdom's loneliest citizen, but his gloomy mood is contagious! Can a trio of wishes turn things around?

Episodes.Title: Go Dog Go: A Ball for All
Episodes.Description: Dogs in Pawston give balls to each other on Ballentine's Day to show how much they care. But Tag and Scooch aren't prepared and need to find balls fast!

Episodes.Title: Super Monsters: Monster Heart-Friend Night
Episodes.Description: A magical Dragon Moon helps the Super Monsters send cards to the special people in their lives on Monster Heart-Friend Night.

Episodes.Title: Ada Twist, Scientist: My Messy Valentine
Episodes.Description: Rosie built a special Valentine's Day catapult called "The Love Launcher," but it isn't working the way she'd hoped. Time to get organized and fix it!

Episodes.Title: Charlie's Colorforms City: Charlie and the Lost Valentines
Episodes.Description: On Valentine's Day, Charlie Cupid spreads love around Colorforms City, but the Prickly Princess makes everyone sad when she steals all the valentines!

Episodes.Title: Mighty Express: Chug-a-Love Day
Episodes.Description: Mandy Mail wants to deliver the Chug-a-Love Day cards to everyone in town all by herself. But she'll learn things are easier with help from a friend.

Entries.Title: Gig Work
Entries.Description: GIG WORK is an adult animated action/adventure TV show. Set in a dark and dystopian world, a group of friends struggle to make ends meet while battling their own inner demons. The show explores themes of friendship, survival, and the quest for meaning in a society teetering on the brink of collapse. It is a reflection of the experiences of Gen Z and millennials during the isolation of COVID-19 and the struggles of working in the gig economy.

Entries.Title: Carson Earl Gets Grounded and Arrested
Entries.Description: In this black-and-white grounded series, Carson Earl gets both grounded and arrested for committing a lot of crimes in Chico, California. He gets in trouble by Elijah Levnox.

Episodes.Title: Carson Earl Steals a Chocolate Bar at a Liquor Store
Episodes.Description: Carson Earl wants a Kit Kat from the liquor store, but as Elijah won't let him get one, he steals the chocolate bar without paying for it.

Episodes.Title: Carson Earl Becomes a Snatcher
Episodes.Description: During a Plotagon short film competition at the park, Carson Earl's phone dies mid-way through. With no other option, he steals someone's phone to finish the video.

Episodes.Title: Carson Earl Sneaks Into the Movie Theater
Episodes.Description: Carson Earl sneaks out of the house to go to the movies and see A Minecraft Movie, only to find out that tickets are sold out.

Episodes.Title: Carson Earl Hijacks a Train
Episodes.Description: Carson Earl wants to visit Universal Studios Hollywood so badly, but when Elijah refuses to take him, Carson steals a train to get there, until things don't go so well.

Episodes.Title: Carson Earl Lets a Gorilla on the Loose

Episodes.Description: Stranded in the desert, Roo, Umba, and Metric battle exhaustion and a spider-crow. With Morrigan’s guidance, they challenge Balor, Fomoire’s ruthless leader, for Éire’s survival.

Episodes.Title: Loah
Episodes.Description: With Loah partially restored, Roo, Umba, and Metric face Balor, Fomoire’s fearsome leader, in the Circle of Death. But Roo’s self-doubt threatens their survival and Éire’s fate.

Episodes.Title: Balor
Episodes.Description: Roo, Umba, and Metric challenge Balor in the Circle of Doom to unite the planet’s creatures. But as Roo battles doubt and grief, he must find the courage to fight for their future.

Episodes.Title: Reunion
Episodes.Description: As Tentagon drains Éire and targets Fomoire, Roo, Umba, and Metric reunite with family and uncover Holt’s power. With Balor’s help, they must stop the Blight before Branock wins.

Episodes.Title: The Great Battle (1)
Episodes.Description: As Branock absorbs Tentagon’s energy, Roo, Umba, and Metric unite Fomoire’s creatures. With Jeannie’s discovery and the Blight closing in they must harness Holt’s power to stop him.

Episodes.Title: The Great Battle (2)
Episodes.Description: Roo, Umba, and Metric unite Fomoire’s forgotten inhabitants for a final battle. As Jeannie unlocks Holt’s power they must harness Super-Holt to defeat Branock and free the universe

Entries.Title: The World of Lafcadio Hearn's Kwaidan
Entries.Description:
Based on the work of Lafcadio Hearn (Koizumi Yakumo), a resident of Matsue City, Shimane Prefecture, who left a significant mark on Japanese ghost story literature, this animated series utilizes AI production techniques.

The original characters were created in-house, and the same script was produced using two different approaches: an "anime-look version" created in a standard 2D animation style, and a "live-action-look version" that emphasizes the horror of the ghost story with photorealistic AI rendering. Each version will be broadcast in a different time slot.

This entry is for the "anime-look version" broadcast.
